tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 38 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mesapo mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'a 'dra dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lhe gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod r+ṣa po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhye/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs rta ge 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par nu ro/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/

bsdu sgrig gsal bsha/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bri se pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 spo

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'a sa ra phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhug spro sdo pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs tre 3 sdo zhus/

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed/ byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni spo dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nasdi du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan sne 4 snye la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song stsi krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu pa rtag wang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis —1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam—'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yi she thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa rka tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhung tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab bshus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod r+ṣa po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang ngo bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor 'o/ sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam d+nghapo sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

gsol 'debs rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur ma'i rang 'grel bzhugs/ 1nyid kyi gsol 'debs phun tshogs dge legs ma bzhugs/ ༷ 5bde ba can gyi smon lam bzhugs/ 7gsol 'debs dpal ldan rgyal ba thams cad ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 9zhal gdams zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༷ 12rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i dgung lo bzhi pa yan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus zhig bzhugs/ ༷ ༷ 14slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge yid ches gsum ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 37dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar 'phrin las rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༷ 72rje btsun bla ma dam pa kun dga' dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gser gyi rnga bo che zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 149dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs pa dang yan lag drug gi lam gyi zab gnad dag bzhugs/ 216

'phags pa don yod lcags kyus gsungs pa bzhugs/ ༷ ༷ 219grub thob shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi thabs lam gser gyi phung po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༷ 246grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'bri tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༷ 271'chi med grub pa'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / 282'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag bzhugs so/ / ༷290'chi med grub pa'i khrid yig gsal bar ma thon pa'i man ngag 'jug tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༷305rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rtsen ma'i skur ston pa'i zhal lung sogs bzhugs/ 309

༄༅/ /gsol 'debs rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur ma'i rang 'grel bzhugs/oX swā sti/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur rgyal ba'i sras/ /srid zhi kun spangs srid zhi kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa bla ma'i tshul/ /sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dir bstod pa'i don 'chad pa la/ bstod pa dngos kyi don dang / 'jug gi don no/ /dang po ni dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don gsum las/ dang po ni bla ma'i yon to sangs rgyas dang dbyer med ston pa ni/ brjo da par bya'o/ /bstod pa'i bsod nams rgya chen po 'byung ba ni dgos pa'o/ /bsod nams kyi mthus tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas sangs rgyas pa ni/ dgos pa'i yang dgos pa'o/ /phyi ma phyi ma snga ma snga mar rag las pa ni 'brel pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur/ zhen/ bya ba tshigs su bcad pa gcig las/ tshig rkang dang po ni rgyu'i sgo nas bstod/ gnyis pas ni/ 'bras bu'i sgo myos bstod/gsum pa dang bzhi pas ni mdzad pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni khyod ni rgyal byā kun bskyed par byed pa'i cu tu gyu bye pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo sangs rgyas kun las kyang sngar sangs rgyas yin kyang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis sras kyi tshul bzung nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas sems can gyi don mdzad par ston pa dang / ji skad du/ shes —1—

pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa/ /zhes/ gsungs pa ltar/ stong pa nyid kyi don mngon sum du gzigs pas srid pa'i mtha' spangs shing / snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par spyod pa'i zhi ba chad pas myang 'das kyi mtha' kun spangs mod kyis/ khyod kyis srid pa'i sems can thams cad dang nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs pa zhi ba'i go 'phang thob pa kun sgyus bdug po'am/ gtso bo'am bla mar gyur pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/mdzad pa'i sgo nas dpyal ldan ge skor swo sdom pā he ru ka nyid bla mu dam pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i tshul bzung nas/ 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bstsal ba'i ming tā ra nā tha sgrol ba'i mgon sto zhes bya ba'i blo lwa gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i slob dpon gang zhe na/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs shing chags la ma bsdams pa/ rang 'dod bla ma slob ma'i ni/ /blo bzang ldan pa'i mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'i skyon ni rnams spangs shing / /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtser ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'kho/ra 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon de/ /dang ba'i bdag nyid dbang po btul/ /zhes pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin la/ khyad par dzig cig gis sangs rgyas la dkri bar byed pa la/ shes rab ye shes dag ni sems dang de'i rnam pa dag kyang rnam pa bcu po nyid du gyur/ /dbang po ni dri med ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan

lta bu 'di la bzhugs pa gang yin pa/ /de las lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba 'pho ba med pa'i rang bzhin 'gyur med nyid ni bzhi pa ste/ /sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gis thugs dang zhal la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang / thig le 'gyur ba med pa'i bde chen rang gis kyang nyams su myong zhing / de lta bu'i lam la slob ma yang dkri bar nus pa ste/ mtshan nyid de dag ldan dgos la/ 'di nyid dang ldan na gong gi thams cad dang mi ldan yang tshe gcig sangs rgyas la dkri bar nus pa'i slob dpon yin la/ de gnyis dang mi ldan pa ni gong du bshad pa bzhin thams cad tshang kyang / skye ba 'di nyid la mchog ster bar mi nus pa'i/ yon to de gnyis tshang ba gal che'o/ /tshig rkang dang pos rgyal ba kun gyi sras su bstan pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la zhugs pa'i bsod nams kyis tshogs dang / chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po dang ldan par gyur pa ni/ rgyu tshogs kyi sgo nas bstod pa yin no/ /gas yang 'dir tshig rkang dang pos rgyal ba kun gyi yab yin par bstan la/ gnyis pa de'i yon tan gyi khyad par rnams bshad/ rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi ni/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ni sangs rgyas la ma gtogs gzhan la med pas/ sangs rgyas gang yin pa'i mtshan nyid yang ci snyam na/ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa zhes sgrol 'grel lo/ /tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis tshig rgyan ni dga' rgyan zhes bya ba/ tshig 'gal 'gal 'dra yang don mi 'gal te/ snyan ngag gi brda chad rags pa tsam chags na go mod kyis/ da lta chen por rlom pa rnams kyang 'ga' zhig ni —3—

tshig la rmongs/ kha cig don la rmongs/ gzhan dag na gnyis ka la rmongs pa yang mthong ngo / /'on kyang 'di lta bu'i bla ma la bstod pa mi mdzes sam snyam na/drang srong chen po nyi ma'i shing rtas/ rang gi rdo rje slob dpon 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa mi'i dbang po 'jam dpal grags pa la yang 'di ltar bstod do/ khyod ni rgan yang gzhon nu mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sras po yin kyang thog mar dang pos sangs rgyas khyod/ /bud med sbyor shing tshangs par spyod ldan mchog gi thugs rje nyid kyi 'jig rten gnyen te gzhin rje'i dgra/ khyod ni zhi yang rdo rje bzang po 'chi ba'i 'jigs 'phrog khyod ni rtag tu bdud kyi bdud/ khyod ni grol yang srid pa 'dir ni 'gro ba smin pa'i slad du grags pa khyod ni rab tu 'jug /ces dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud du gsungs so/ /gnyis pa mjug gi don la/ bskul ba po rtsom pa po/ rgyan ngos 'dzin khengs byung( skyung ka ba ste/ don tshan bzhi ni 'di ltar bskul ba po kun dga' skyabs grol gyi bskul ba'i phyir/ brtsam pa po tā ra nā tha yis/ snyan ngag gyi rgyan ni/ chung ngu la'ang chen por sgro btags pa'i phul phyung gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan te/ rang la mngon pa'i nga rgyal med mod kyang / gzhan gyis bskul ba'i phyir g.yar khral kho na nyid du smras pa'o/ /zhes pa ni bstod yul rang nyid kyis bstod pa 'grel pa dge slong bsod nams phun tshogs kyis bskul nas gnas rnying gzims khang du'o/ /maṅga lam//

dge legs ma bzhugs/oṃ swā sti pra dza khyuX phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /dam chos rgyal po'i dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rab dga'i ye shes snying po'i don gsal mdzad/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la rgisol ba 'debs/ /dngos kun lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin mchog /rgyal ba'i snying po'i mnyam nyid mngon gyur pa/ /mtshungs bral bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun gyi gtso/ /dga' chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' dag 'gro rnams byang chub snying por 'god/ khams gsum dbang phyug khyed la gsol 'debs/ /gang khyod mkhyen brtse nus kun dpag yas kyis/ /rab dga' rigs ldan ma lus zil gyis mnan/ /srid zhi'i snying po yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sku/ /sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog gsum ngo bo rdo rje slob dpon khyed/ /bslab gsum rnam dag pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs/ /sku gsum rang bzhin stobs bcu dbang bsgyur ba/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /skyabs mgon khyed kyi zhabs pad brtan pa dang / /gsung bzhin sgrub dang dgongs pa ji bzhin skyongs/ /rtag tu dgyes byed nam yang rjes 'dzin shog /gzhan yang 'gal rkyen —5—

pa'i don kun gegs med lhun gyis grub/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid dang mtshungs par sgo(ga /ces tā ra nā thas rang la bstod pa 'di ni/ sa skyong dbang phyug gzhon nu kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i gsung gis bskul nas nges par brjod pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis/ /

oṃ swā sti/ bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdom zhing mkha' dang mnyam par spel/ /chos nyid chen por ro gcig rtag pa'i ngang / /gdod nas 'od gsal chen por rgyas btab ste/ /snang grags thams cad ye nas chos sku'i ngang / /snang ba ma 'gags gzugs sku rang shar ba/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad/ /zung 'jug r+ṣa po'i ngo bor yongs su bsngo/ /gnas skabs kun tu bdag gzhan sems can kun/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'jug pa dang / /phun tshogs bde skyid legs lam kun ldan zhing / /ji ltar bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par shog /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag /bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas kun gyi zhing / /'od dpag med mgon smon lam las grub pa/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi rab bsngags shing / /smon lam las grub 'dod don dpag med dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyi rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /smon lam ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /sems can mtha' dag yongs su smin byas nas/ /zhing rnams thams cad myur du sbyangs gyur de/ /dag pa'i bde ba can du skye bar shog /zhing der skye ma thag tu ting 'dzin dang / /gzungs dang ye shes rnam thar kun grub nas/ /bla med mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs sprul te/ /rgyal ba thams cad mchod pas mnyes byed

ba'i don spyod pa'i/ /bsam yas mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /dag pa'i zhing mchog gang der khrid par shog /ces pa bde ba can gyi smon lam 'di yang /ta pa'i don can sa skyong dbang mo yid 'dzin dpal legs kyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas gting khobs gnyan yod du smras pa'o/ /ma rgol ma/ bkra shis/ /

ma zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/oX swā sti/ dpal ldan rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus nor bu rin po che/ /mtshan tsam dran pas 'dod dgu'i dpal stsol ba/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa bdag la thugs rje gzigs/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang / /rje btsun khyed kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /dal 'byor mi lus rnyed pa'i brgya lam na/ /dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba res 'ga' tsam/ /mi tshe stong par zad pa'i snying med po/ /nyams len byed snyam ngang la 'das pa na/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang / /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /'gyu ba'i dbugs kyang chad la nye ba dang / /kham gcig zos pa'ang dang gar mi ldong zhing / /rang gis rang la yid chad byed —9—

pa dang / /grogs dang gnyen la re thag chad pa'i dus/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang / /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /gshin rje'i skyes bus dbang med bcings nas khrid/ /dmyal ba'i me tshogs 'bar ba'i nang du lhung / /'jigs drang mtshon che'i char pa lus la phog /las ngan dbang gis tshe la 'byol du med/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang / /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /grang bas nyen nas brgya tshal stong tshal du/ /gas pa'i dus na mgon skyabs gzhan ma mchis/ /lo brgya'i bar du zas skom kham gcig kyang / /ma rnyed bkres skom 'jigs pas nyen pa'i dus/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang / /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /gcig la gcig za srog —10—

gcod bkol dang brdeg /skye rga na 'chi'i 'phrang ni nyams re nga / /mtho dman 'byor rgud mi rtag yi re 'byung / /'gro ba drug gi sems can snying re rje/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis brlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang / /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /ngur smrig gyon yang shes rgyud rtsub cing gyong / /dge sbyor kun yang tshe 'di'i che khar song / /chos skad 'grig 'grig smra yang sems ma thul/ kha dang lag len 'gal ba'i zog po la/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma'i sku yis byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma'i gsung gis byin gyis rlobs/ /pha bla ma'i thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /sprang chos med po la gzigs shig da lta byin gyis rlobs/ /chos med bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bla ma khyed dang 'bral ba med pa dang / /rje btsun khyod kyi go 'phang thob par shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyams rtogs rnams bskyed du gsol/ /byin rlabs rnams stsal du gsol/ /dbang mchog rnams bskur du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang skyor mo lung pa dar rgyas dpal 'byor gyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /

oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems gus ldan gyi slob ma khyed rnams la/ /snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye nas/ /don 'khrul med kyi gdams pa gsal por dgod/ /lar mi lus thob pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /chos rtse gcig nyams su ma blangs na/ /phyi lang ling chos kyis mi phan pas/ /blo nang du khug la nan to ma sgo/ /chos yod lo ngag gi stong zob 'dis/ /ma sems can thams cad bslus par 'gro/ /lus ngag yid chos dang mthun ma mthun/ /snying thag pas rtog dpyod yang yang 'tshal/ /mchog bla ma yin ring bsten pa yang / /las bsags pa rab la bdud rtsi yin/ /mi phal cher gdams ngag chos dred khyer/ /sems log ltas dkrugs nas dmyal bar 'gro/ khyed kun yang bla mas ci gsung sgrubs/ /de byas na 'dun ma rtse mor 'gro/ /phal gzhan gyi ngo dga'i dbang song na/ /tshe 'di phyi gnyis med sdug la skyel/ /sems nyams len nam mkha' ltar yangs la/ /phyi blang dor spyod pa zhib pa 'di/ /lar lta spyod 'dzoms pa dam pa'i mchog /rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa'i lam bzang yin/ /lus chos mas su zhugs pa'i rtsing spyod ni/ /nyams mtho yang gang la'ang mi phan pas/ /las tho chor ma song gnad du che/ /chos brgyud bcas kyi zhabs 'dren ma byas tsam/ /blo chags sdang zur mgo rags pa la/ /ming chos par btags kyang ga la phan/ /phung bdag 'dzin gyi mdud pa shigs kyis bshig /dbyings rtsol bral gyi ngang du lhod kyis glod/ /wol zas gos

don gnyer las med pa yi/ /skra bregs tsam gyi chos pa'i gzugs brnyan te/ /nang rang sems la ltas na yi mug ldang / /phyi skye bo'i mi kha dir re ba/ /lar dud 'gro dang khyad par mi gda' bas/ /zas zhim 'dod kyi sred pa spong ba dang / /gos legs 'dod kyi chos brgyad ma che bar/ /sprang dman cha bzung na legs pa yin/ /rang tshe gcig chos bzhin spyod pa na/ kha zhan zhan 'dra yang legs pa'i rab/ /nor cung zad bsogs kyang chos dang 'gal/ /de lha 'dre mi gsum la mngon lo 'phyar/ /dus nam zhig 'chi ba sleb dus su/ /nor mang yang ro nor ro gos shig /zas mang yang ro zas kham gang yin/ /rdzas longs spyod gzhan gyis sus thob byed/ /tshe phyi ma phan ched kyi gdeng med na/ /'phral bzang bzang 'dra yang de kha'i rgyu/ /gnas bsam gtan khang bur tshugs pa dang / /yid chos la dga' bde rnyed 13pa dang / /'phral chos mthun gyi 'tsho bas mi brel bar/ /pha bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thasagayu nang gi ri la sdod pa'i sgom mo zhig la gdams pa'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel/

bzhi pa yanā gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus zhag bsdo/gas/na mo gu sa rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ khams gsum na ni 'gran zla dang bral ba/ mthong thos dran reg tu gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon 'di nyid ni/ dang po lhums su gzhug pa dang / sku bltams pa'i ngo mtshar che ba rnams mtha' yas shing / brjod kyi mi lang bar gda' ste/ de la bdag rang rgyud che zhing / yul mi de skabs pa rnams dang / da lta'i rgyal rgyud byed pa rnams yid ches khungs btsun pa ltar yod cing / bcos ma ma yin pa nges shes 'drongs pa rnams yi ger bkod pa yin/༈ g.yon du brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang nas/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i gnas/ kha rag 'brang gi phu dang po rwa lo tsā ba chen po/ de'i brgyud pa rim par byon pa'i bsti gnas/ da lta chos 'khor steng du grags pa na/ sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho la sras bzhi byung ba'i khab tu/ yum rdo rje bu dga' lha mo bzhes pas de ni dge ba la dkar zhing sdig pa la 'dzems pa/ ngan slong la byams pa zhig yod de/ yum dgung lo bcu dgu la/ rje btsun 'di nyid lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs/ yum gyi rmi lam du nyi ma'i 'od las/ gser gyi rdo —14—

rje gru gang ba 'od zer 'phro ba gcig babs te/ 'od zer des 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gyur te/ yang 'od zer de rnams dang / gser gyi rdo rje dri ma med pa de/ yum gyi spyi bor thim nas yum sngar las kyang sku gzi mdangs dpag tu med pa rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang sku la dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang / rin po che'i khri la bzhugs pa la/ bud med gzhon nu ma lang tsho rgyas pa/ 'ga' zhig gis/ rin po che'i snod du zas sna tshogs cung zad bzung nas phul ba dang / phyag dang skor ba/ bsti stang bsam las 'das pa byed pa dang / mi nag po gser gyi ske rags bcing pa/ lag tu gri gug bzung ba gcig gi sgo bsrung ba dang / lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos nam mkha' nas sku khrus gsol zhing / mchod bstod byed pa dang / sku la rus pa'i rgyan dang / rin po che'i mas kyis brgyan pa la sogs pa'i rmi ltas bzang po ji snyed du ma byung ba rnams yum gyi mi rnams la 'di ltar rmi tshul bshad pas/ mi gzhan ma rnams kyis ni brjod ma shes par/ la las ni rmi lam de dga' rgyu med pas/ yum sku rims dang brtan bzhugs gang drag gyis zer/ yid mi bde ba tsam byung / sngags 'chang chen po tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes pa/ mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas pa/ yi dam gyi lha dang chos skyong gi grangs bsnyen mang du song zhing / yi dam gyi zhal gzigs pa zhig yod pa/ de nyid kyi zhal nas/ bu dga' lha mo'i rmi lam de rnams shin tu bzang bar gda'/ deng sang bdag la yang rmi ltas bzang ba mang du byung bas/ bu dga' lha mo la gtsang sbra che bar gyis/ mi gang gi bza' bza' sogs spong / de nas rmi lam sogs kyang su gang la yang ma bshad —15—

gsungs nas/ yum la shin du brtse bar mdzad do/ /de nas phag lo hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu'i snga zhogs nyi ma rtse shar la/ yum snyel ba cher med pa'i ngang nas/grod pu 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan yod pa zhig 'khrungs so/ /mes po rin po che de nyid kyis zhal nas/ e e nged tsho la rigs rgyud 'di ltar yong ba yin/ 'di yi zhal 'byed par byed pa la/ lcags dang zangs kyi rigs kyi zhal 'byed mi rung 'di ni nges par du shing gi lde mig gis sgo 'byed tshul/ thags 'thag pa'i 'u lu zhig gis zhal 'byed pa sogs byed dgos gsungs nas/ 'u lu dang shing gi lde mig sogs kyis zhal phye bas de'i nang nas khye'u sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ sku la sha mtshan khrag zhag gi thig le/ li khri'i tshangs skud kyi rnam pa yod pa/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan pa/ ga bur dang gur gum gyi dri mchog dang ldan pa/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i mchu 'gros dang / ut+pal mchog gi spyan ni phyogs thams cad la jig hrig gzigs shing / zhal nas lkoX ra ni nga ni hūX/ sogs kyi sngags lan gsum du mdzad pa zhig sku bltams so/ /lte ba gcod pa sogs ni ma dgos so/ /de skabs kyi sku 'khor ba rnams kyis 'di lta bu ni bzang ngan gang yin kyang 'di ni thams cad nas ya mtshan pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la/ skye ma thag tu lab lab shes pa zhig 'dug zer bas/ mes po drung gi zhal nas/ sha mtshan dang ltas shin du ngo mtshar che ba 'dug lab lab ni bsangs sbyangs kyi sngags mdzad par gda'/ dang po rje kun dga' seng ge de nyid kyi dgon pa 'dings pa mdzad dus/ sa dpyad dang rten 'brel gang la dpag kyang nged kyi mi brgyud kha cig nas rgyud sde thams cad —16—

kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gcig byon par gda' gsungs pa dang /'di nyid yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs rmi ltas bzang ba bsam las 'das pa yang byung ba dang / da nang gnyid ma sad gong du 'phags pa 'jam dpal yin zer ba'i/ skyes bu chen po mtshan dpes rab tu brgyan pa zhig gis/rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi po ti mang po/ deng rang gi mchod khang du spyan drangs nas 'di rnams kyi bdag po khyod rang yin gsungs shing / gsung rab de rnams la bu dga' lha mos bkur sti mchod pa bsam las 'das pa byed pa rmis/ 'di nyid rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams la mkhas pa'i mi gcig yong bar 'dugade ring gu ru rin po che'i dus bzang la byon pas 'di'i ming dar cig la sngar gyi chung sri zhig yod pas/ de gnod pa'i phyir dar cig la pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje thogs shig /de bas mtshan dngos ni/ byang chub sems dpa' kun zin pa zhig gis gnang ba 'dug gsungs shing / shin du dge ba'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/btsas ston kyang de'i nyin shin du rgyas par mdzad do/ /de skabs me tog ldum rar rgya men lnga tsam kha byed cing / kha 'bus pa yang mang du byung / nye 'khor gyi se ba rnams la yang me tog thor re ba shar/ kham bu dang lo ma snang zhing 'deb kyi skabs dang 'dra ba byung / 'khur mang gi me tog kyang de'i nyin rang la mang du shar/ nam mkha' la me tog gi char zhag bdun khor yug tu babs pa dang /nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i ngang nas 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang bzhi rim/ nyin mtshan du yod pa dang / bya bye'u rnams kyang skad kyi rnam 'gyur snyan par sgrogs zhing / dga' spro rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pa byed pa dang / ri dwags rnams kyang —17—

dga' ba'i rtse 'khor byed cing / thams cad yul der 'khor nas yong ba dang /da ltar bla brang gi sdum ra na/ se ba gzhan las stobs che ba/ me tog rgya mtsho'i mdog ting phor tsam dang / se 'bru mi rgan gyi mtheb bong las che zhing / ro kha ba dang / skyur ba dang / nus pa tsha ba yod pa 'di yang de skabs su skyes pa yin par 'dug lags/ shing de yang gzhan las ngo mtshar che ba yod/ byang chub ljon shing gi mtshan nyid yod pa ni/ dang po sku bltams skabs myu gu skyes/ rab tu byung skabs me tog shar/ bsnyen par rdzogs skabs se 'bru smin/ da lta yal ga lo 'dab bsam las 'das shing / da lta'i mi drag yin kun gyis se ba de'i 'bras bu me tog tsher ma shun pa rnams byin rlabs rten rdzas su zhus shing / thams cad ya mtshan du byed pa yod do/ /de nas mi nad phyugs nad mi 'byung zhing / mi rgan rnams ni tshe 'phel nas gzhan sha can du gyur pa dang / long ba rnams mig rang 'byed du gyur nas sngar las kyang gsal bar byung ba dang / mchog gi sprul sku'i 'di ni phyi nang gi mi kun gyi gces par gyur zhing / sku rdzi bzhi dang bcas nas bskyed bsrings so/ /sku lhums su zhugs pa dang / bltams pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //༈ de nas zhag bcu tsam nas/ khams pa smri ti long ba yin zer ba'i/ long 'khrid byed dgos pa zhig byung / nga lha sa bsam yas bskor bar yong ba yin te/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po zhig byon pa/ nga tshos srin po rir shes nas 'dir 'ong ba yin/ khyed kyi sras mjal dgos zer bas sku gces pas mjal kha ma gnang bas/ khong rnams bla —18—

brang la phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas smon lam mang du btab nas log song ngo / /zhal ngo yum sku 'khor rnams la kha ngan gtong zhing ma mgu bar gyur nas song ngo / /de skabs yul mi la las mo lan gnyis btab 'dug kyang / mo snga phyi tshang ma shin du bden par 'byung zhing / mngon shes dang ldan zhing dpyad pa kun la nyams rgyus che zhing ming 'dogs shes pa zhig byung / mo btab pa thams cad du de rnams la khyed bsod nams che/ byang chub sems dpa' sku bltams pas gnas chu btung bas ngan song myong mi dgos pa yin pa la/ khyed kyi yul du byang chub sems dpa' bltams pa yin pas bsod nams che/ 'dis ni sems can gyi don dpag tu med par mdzad de/ rtsang dbus kyi sde dpon bsod nams che ba rnams kyi bkur sti zhu bar gda'/ 'di la 'brel ba don ldan rang yin zer/ de rnams yum la mi rnams kyi 'di bzhin zer ba 'dug zhus pas mes po drung gi zhal nas/ de ya mtshan par gda'/ dang po bdag gi bla ma dbus smyon mjal skabs su/ bla ma de rten 'brel dang / mngon shes rang mdzad pa zhig gda' bas/ bdag la yang khyod la tsha bo sus kyang 'gran mi nus pa'i mthu rtsal shin tu che ba zhig 'byon gsungs pa na/ bdag gis bsam pa la rwa lo tsā ba'i brgyud pa la sngags 'chang bzang po los yong bsam pa byung tshe/ de yang bla mas mkhyen nas/ de ni khyod kyi pha mes rigs rgyud thams cad las lhag par 'gyur gsungs/ 'o na ci lta bu zhig 'byung zhus pas/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' skad gnyis smra ba/ rdo rje'i glu len pa/ snyigs ma'i ston pa zhig 'byon par 'dug gsungs yod pa dang / de rnams mthun par gda' gsungs so/ /de nas mchog —19—

gi sprul sku de ni gzhan gyi zla bskyed las/ khong gi zhag bskyed che ba tsam byung /zla ba brgyad nas thams cad la 'byon thub pa zhig byung / zla ba bcu gnyis nas smra brjod mkhyen zhing shin tu nas kyang sgom pa dang dbang po rab tu dwangs zhing klog klog pa dang 'bri ba dang / yi dam chos skyong gi mngon rtogs rtsa sngags/gtor chog rnams ni sus kyang slob pa'i rnam pa dang / dka' spyad gcig kyang ma dgos par rang shes su mkhyen pa dang / sngar gyi bris rnying gi thang sku gzhin rje dgra nag gdong drug 'char ka'i tshe bdag khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i bris thang du bas nag pa mang po yod pas/ sngar gyi yab mes rnams kyi thugs dam thang sku yin pas/ mos pa tsam byas nas bzhag pa ma ga༈zhes/ de dag lha gang yin dang / rigs gang yin su la yang rgyus med pa la/ mchog gi sprul skus ni thang sku de rnams zhal phye nas/ re re nas 'di lha 'di rnams yin pa gsungs nas de thams cad re re nas ngo mkhyen pa dang mes po drung gis mtshan pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje phul ba yin kyang / mi rnams kyi mtshan mgyogs bcos su byas nas/ dbon po sri gcod zhes pa byung bas/ mtshan nas bos pa'i tshe/ de la mi dgyes pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ nga'i ming ni bla ma 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog zer ba yin/ dbon po srid gcod su la zer ba yin/ nga la de skad ma zer zhig gsungs nas/ mtshan nas bos pa la mi mnyes zhing gsungs lan kyang mi mdzad pa byung / de skabs kyi mi rnams kyis bla ra ku/na das 'a grol mchog bya ba'i/ bla ma'i mawo ni sngar thos ma myong zer nas na ra tshar du gyur tho / /de nas mi rnams kyi dri ba zhus pas/ de rnams la thogs —20—

pa med par sku tshe sngon gyi gnas tshul dang / sbyin bdag grwa rigs dgon gnas/phyag rdzas kyi skor dbang rdzas/ rten rdzas la sogs pa gang na ci yod pa rnams dang / nye gnas dpal 'byor gyi phyag phyi zhus nas sna dkar rtser phebs pa dang /sde pa bstan 'dzin pas tshogs 'khor rgya chen po zhus pa dang / de nas rong rin dpungs phyogs ni mun pa nag por 'dug pa dang / 'bring gi kha ni 'od gsal che bar 'dug pas/ der nged gnyis kyi yong nas/ la khar sna dkar rtse'i 'khyos ma zos/ lhag ma rnams de khar sbungs nas bzhag yod/ de nas la babs nas 'ong ba'i tshe/ yum gyi ba phyugs la chu blud nas zur kha rgyab nas phar byon song ba na/ bdag rgyug nas yum gyi na bza' la 'jug nas yong ba yin/ nye gnas dpal 'byor grong pha gi la song ba yin/ gsungs nas phyag mdzub kyi ston pa sogs mdzad pa dang / bdag gi nye gnas gzhan ma/ drung kun chos pa dang mched grogs bzhung ma dang / pha ba la sogs pa'i grwa pa rnams dang / rta drel rnams chos lung byang rtse na da lta yod gsungs pa sogs dris lan gsung gleng zhib par gnang bas/ spyir rigs ni phu rags pa'i mi mthong ba dang myong ba chung ba kun gyi chos lugs yin zhing / khyad par 'brang phu'i mi rnams ni phu rag gi mi dang / phu rag gi chu'i dper song nas/ go shes chung ba dang ma bco sta pa'i bya ba lhug grol du gnas pa/ rdzi sang dang / rnam dpyod kyi dri mas ma gos pa med pa phu gong la dang / mda' them pa la byed pa'i dpe ltar mthong myong shin tu chung ba ni 'bring gi mi rnams kyi chos lugs yin pas/ gsung gleng de dag rnams thosam myong ba 'di ya re mtshar/ 'di lab lab mang lugs dang / sku skyed yod —21—

stangs gang la dpag na/ lha'i bu chen po gcig yin pa 'dra 'di nang gi phug tu gzhug la/ phyi la ma gtong zer nas/ nang rang du sbas thabs kyi sgo nas skyed bsrings so/ /de nas nam zhig 'tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang pa'i chos bzhi 'brang sna bzhi ru nas gnyer ba bzhi yod pa'i nang nas/ dpal gnas chos bya ba zhig gis khams cung zad mi bde ba'i khong gnyis 'brang phur sman zhu ba dang / rtsa dang chu spyan lam 'bebs par byung bas de skabs mes po rin po che dang / a khu lags kyi sman dpyad la mnga' shin tu brnyes pas/ khong jo gdan pa gnyis nang du bos nas gzhi len rgyas par mdzad pa dang / sman sogs gnang nas yod skabs mchog gi sprul sku ni rgyun du mi kun la chos kyi che ba dang / las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i chos dang / gzhan yang dbang rjes gnang sogs gnang gin yod pa de khong gnyis kyi mthong bas khong gnyis ni ya mtshan du gyur nas phyag 'tshal zhing byin rlabs zhus/ 'di ni rje btsun bla ma kun dga' grol mchog pa'i sku'i skye ba gsal bar 'dug /'di dbus gtsang gi sde dpon chos sde gnad che ba'i bla ma yin/ nged dge 'dun sgang pa rnams bla ma de la mi phyed pa'i dad pa yod/ bla ma de ka'i nged 'tshogs pa rnams la gsung chos mang du gnang ba yin/ nged gnyis pos kyang gsung chos mang du thob zer nas yab yum rnams la rje gong ma'i lo rgyus mang du zhus/'di'i bla ma 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i nged rang tsho bsod nams che zer nas song ngo / khong gnyis kyi rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi lo rgyus bshad du byung ba ma gtogs su gang gi kyang mi shes/ de nas yab phun tshogs rnam rgyal bya —22—

ba / yi dam gzhan rje gshed mtha' dag dang / bka' brgyad skor dang / phyag rdor rnams la 'dris shing / khyad par du ma ning la grangs bsnyen mang du song zhing / ma ning gi zhal yang yang gzigs pa nus mthu che ba/ mdor na drag sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yin pa la/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba mkhyen pa ma bcos pa'i khul dog pa/ bu dung che ba zhig yod pas/ de'i gsung nas/ nga'i bu gcig po 'di dpral ba'i mig dang 'dra ba/ 'di bla ma'i sku skye yin pa 'dug su gang gi zer ba byung na sku rgyab la gtor sgam rlang pa thul le ba zhig yod pa ngas mi rgyag na dkon mchog gsum/ nga'i bu gcig po 'di nged rang gi rgyud pa gser gyi 'phreng ba lta bu 'di zin pa/ chos rje kun dga' seng ge'i rdo rje gdan 'di dang sbyin bdag kha shas 'di rnams skyong dgos pa yin gsungs nas/thams cad la gsang nas bzhugs/ de nas zhag kha shas zhig nas nam zhig zhal ngo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams nang du gsol ba gcig gnang skabs yang lung nas yin zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa sku sha sngo sang nge ba sku la ras dang stag lpags kyi na bza' sa/sol zhing / mi thod rlon pa lag tu bzung ba ral pa'i thod bcing pa zhig sgo 'byed pa dang khyi bkag pa sogs ma dgos par nang du thal le byung bas/ myong ma shin tu 'jigs shing skrags pa zhig byung ba la/ mchog gi sprul sku ni shin tu dges par mdzad cing / rnal 'byor pa des kyang mchog gi sprul sku la phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar nas sngar 'dris pa bzhin gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing / gsung gleng de rnams kho rang dpon slob gnyis shin tu smra bar gda'/ zhal ngo 'khor bcas rnams kyi tshig 'khru gcig kyang ma go /de nas —23—

rnal 'byor pa de nyid kyis mchog gi sprul sku nyid la/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus chog cig phul/ lcags kyi phur bu gru gang ba zhig phul nas phur bu 'di slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ ye shes mtsho rgyal la gnang de nas sna nam rdo rje bdud 'jom gyi bsam yas su gter la gzhug ste/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis lung bstan nas bla ma g.yung ston pas gter nas bton dgra bgegs lan gsum bsgral nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi phyag tu yun ring du bzhugs pa yin/ 'di ni bgegs dang log 'dren gyis mi tshugs pa'i phyir sku la 'chang bar zhus nas phul/ de nas yum drung gis chang legs shig zhus pas rten 'brel legs gsungs nas/ mi thod rlon pa sha tshal gyis bkang nas nang mchod byin rlabs mdzad nas/ mchod pa spro bar gsol nas theg song ngo / /rnal 'byor pa de ni sgo phyi la thon pa dang mi mngon par gyur/ sgo thon nas mi sus kyang mthong tshod su la ma byung bar nga'i 'dir yang sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin 'dug phur bu de yang mchog gi sprul sku la bsrungs ba'i tshul du phyis mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho yi spyan 'dren la zhus kyi bar du sku la bcings/ de nas phur bu de 'brang phu dgon par bzhugs pa ni da lta mchod khang gi nang rten khrod na bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /gang ltar yang mchog gi sprul sku 'di nyid ni/ ngan long la byams shing / mi thams cad la kho rang rnams dang 'dra ba'i sgo nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos dang / sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag rang ston pa dang / byis pa rnams la byis pa rang dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa dang / mi rgan rnams la mi rgan rang dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa/ mi thams cad —24—

la rang rang dang mthun da bslab bya dang chos 'brel gnang ba zhig byung /sems can byol song rnams la snying rje chen po'i sgo nas byin rlabs dang srog las skyob pa mang du mdzad/ bzo dang gso ba rig pa la sogs pa'i rig gnas kyang mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes pa byung / mchog gi sprul sku de mi kun gyis ya mtshan du gyur pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //na mo gu sa sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang r+ṣa po/rig kun gyi bdag po mthong thos dran reg rnams kyi ded dpon/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ sgrol ba'i mgon po de ni/ dgung lo gsum dang zla ba phyed drug bzhes pa'i skabs nyin zhig nyi ma snga phyed tsam la/ chos rje bstan 'dzin pa'i bang chen yin zer ba'i grwa pa gnyis byung ste/ 'di na nged dpon slob kyi bla ma dam pa'i sku skye 'khrungs yod 'dug zer bas/ de yin min la gzigs par chos rje bstan 'dzin phebs kyin yod/ de kha'i khyed zhal ngo gang du'ang mi theg pa zhu zer ba'i sngon 'gros zhig byung / mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal nas nga ngos 'dzin pa'i skal ba kho la med de/ thog mar bstan 'dzin nyi ma bzang po bya ba kho bo la rten 'brel bzang bas shar re bdag gi rtsar thong zhig gsungs/ de nas nyi ma snga phyed tsam la dgon gnas mthong bar rgya gling dang dung dkar ga|rji gin byung bas/ de yang rten 'brel legs gsungs/ de nas khong dpon slob rnams bla brang du phebs nas/ kho rang la bzhugs khri che ba zhig byas mchog gi sprul sku la kho rang gi g.yas su sa gdan dang bcas pa'i bzhugs khri zhig gi steng du bzhugs phyag 'tshal ba ni ma byas/ ja yang kho rang sngon du —25—

gsol/ de nas chos rje bstan 'dzin pas mchog gi sprul sku la dri ba sogs gang sa nas zhus rung / mchog gi sprul sku'i nged bla ma yin/ kho nged kyi gra rigs su gyur pa tsam ni yin/ de las spros pa min pa la kho rang kham che rgyu byed pa ni/dga' mo min pa 'dug dgongs nas mi mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad nas bka' lung chen po mi gnang bas yang chos rje bstan 'dzin pas sgam chung zhig na tsan dan dmar po'i ḍā ma ru gcig bstan nas 'di khyed kyi ngo i shes/ 'di gang yin pa gda' zhus pas/ mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal nas de ngo los shes/ dang po nged rang gi yin pa la/ khyed kyi byang stag rtser bde mchog dus 'khor 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang zhus rten 'brel dang byin rlabs yin pas bdag la bla chas 'os rigs dgos tshul nan gyi byung bas de dus nged kyi bla chas zhig sbyin pa'i tsan+dan gyi ḍā ma ru de yin pa 'dug gsungs pas/ de gcig po yid ches nas phyag 'tshal/ dar ras kyi 'bul ba dgu tshan gcig phul yab yum la dar ras kyi lnga tshan zhig phul nas/ khyed kyi sngon chad gtsang sbra thon pa byung 'dug da rung gtsang sbras thon pa dang / skas kha sogs la sku babs ma byung ba mdzad dgos 'di nged kyi bla ma yin da lta spyan 'dren snga nas yod pa 'dug /bdag kha rag gi rdzong du rab gnas zhig la zhug kha cig sdod de nas chu bo ri dang / gong dkar phyogs la 'gro de tsho ru zla ba kha re sdod dgos shas che/ de nas slar sku drung rin po che yong ngo gsungs nas theg song ngo / /de ma thag tu yab drung pa ni shin tu mi mnyes pas/ nga'i bu chung lha phrug 'dra ba 'di la khong ma ṇi bar song bas za 'dod langs pa zhig yin nam gsungs nas 'bul ba dar dkar gcig gzan —26—

legs po gcig ras yug dkar yol snam dkar bub gcig rnams khur nas khong gi rjes la song nas/ chos rje bstan 'dzin pa phyis byon khar yab drung gi chos rje bstan 'dzin pa la 'bul ba mdzad nas/ nged rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi rgyud pa gser gyi 'phreng ba lta bu zam ma 'chad pa ni/ dgon gnas thabs shes zung du 'brel ba 'di sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin zhing / dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sbyin bdag rgya che bar yod pas 'di rnams skyong dgongs pa yod pas da lta nged rgas khog sha ba'i rwa lco 'dra ba zhig la rgyud 'dzin dpral ba'i mig ltar gces pa lta bu 'di ka yin/ gcig po 'di gong du zhu ba bzhin mi gnang ba zhu/bu chung gcig po de ni 'di khar dgos pa yod pas khyed kyi bla ma'i sku skye min pa'i 'phrog mi gnang ba zhu/ de'i zhu rten du 'bul ba 'di rnams mdzod gsungs pas chos rje bstan 'dzin pa'i gsungs nas khyed de 'dra mi gsungs ba zhu/ khyed kyi rgyud 'dzin da yo los yong sku gzhon par gda' ba da lta 'di ni rje bla ma dam pa'i sku skye gsal ba yid ches pa rang gda' 'di nyid rang tsho sku skyes min bya ba zer dgos med/ khyed rang zhal ngo rnams kyang phun sum tshogs par yong /'brang ba zhes pa'i phu 'di tsam zhig khyed yab yum gyi phyag tu bla ma dam pa'i sprul sku spyan 'dren pa'i blu yon du 'bul rgyu yod pa da lam bdag gi kha rag tu zhag mal zhig bsdad nas 'phral du gong dkar du phyin nas bla ma dam pa'i sprul sku spyan 'dren pa dang / blu yon mi zer 'di rnams kyi rgyu mtshan 'bul du 'gro dar cig la khyed rang gi thugs 'dod kyang yin lags dgos pa zhig 'dug pas bla ma dam pa'i sku skye yin pa phyi nang thams cad du gsang ba zhu nged rnams —27—

kyis kyang gsang ngo / /phugs su bla ma'i sku skye min bya ba gsang ba nged rang kun gye mi thub/ dar cig nged rang tshang mas gsang gsungs nas yab kyi phyag nas bcang bcang mang du mdzad nas thegs song ngo / /de bzhin kha rag rdzong du yang /khong rdzong dpon rnams kyis kyang sku skye nges shes 'drong mi 'drong gi dri ba mdzad 'dug pas/ yab drung dang gsungs chad mdzad pa ltar/ da lam bdag gis lam zhor la 'dug pa dang / rna thos la yang gsung chos dang dbang rjes gnang sogs bslab mi dgos par/ rang shes su 'dug zer ba'i snyan grags byung ba nas/ tshur lam zhig bltas pa yin kyang / de skyes bu chen po g.yin rang min pa 'dug gsungs nas thams cad la gsang nas bzhugs 'dug de kha'i dbus phyogs kyi sde/ dpon rnams dang / grwa rigs kun the tshom byas nas ngos 'dzin che 'don 'gyangs pa zhig byung / de'i ngang nas yun ring ba na/ mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho ngos 'dzin spyan 'dren zhu song zer ba kun la grags pas chos rje bstan 'dzin pa ni zhal skyengs pa/ spre'u shing 'bras gzhan gleng dpe ltar byung /khong zhal skyengs pa chen po byung ba'i stabs kyi/ de rje bla ma dam pa'i sku skye min no zhes pa'i gleng gzhi chen po bcug go /chos rje bstan 'dzin pa'i ngos 'dzin dang mjal dka' zhus pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //༈ na mo gu sa byang chub sems dpa' chen po lung rig rgya mtsho de nyid dpal 'khor chos sde chen po'i bla brang dkar po na bzhugs pa'i skabs/stag lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga gcig mdzad pa'i nub mo rmi lam du rje de nyid dang mjal zhing / dges pa'i —28—

'dzum zhal dpag tu med pa dang gsung gleng dngos su mjal ba ltar gyi dga' ba dpag tu med pa mdzad pa byung / tho rangs khar bud med rgyan gos mdzes pa la sogs mang po nam mkha' la dgyes pa'i gar bsam las 'das pa byed cing thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu dpal nag po spyod pa 'gro ba sems can gyi don la byon pa de ni/ lha'i yul gyi bye brag dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i 'du sa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i brten pa'i gnas kha rag 'brang gi phu nas byon yod pa lung rig rgya mtsho zhes/ rna 'on po mtshan ldan bla ma'i drung du myur ba nyid du gshegs par 'tshal/ zhes mgrin gcig tu zer ro/ /de ma thag tu mnal yang sangs bar byung ba dang / nam langs 'dug sku lus sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i bde ba chen pos gang ba dang / thugs dga' spro brjod mi shes pa zhig byung bas bdag gi bla ma de'i sprul sku de nyid cig byon yod pa thag chod 'dug /mdang rmi lam du byung ba'i bud med de rnams mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan pa zhig yin par gda' dgongs nas thugs dam grol ba dang / sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i sku bde tshor byed cing / rab gsal du phebs pa dang / nyi ma shar ba dang gsol dpon gyi ja khyer ba dang / sde pa sna dkar rtse bas bang chen zhu shog rten dang bcas pa 'byor ba mnyam du byung bas/ sna dkar rtse ba'i zhu shog la gzigs pas/ 'brang phu na rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi sku skye yid ches shing gsal ba nges shes 'drongs pa zhig 'dug pa sogs kyi rgyas bshad du 'dug pa khong bang chen gnyis kyang sku gzhogs su btang nas 'brang phu'i dri ba gnang nas/ khong gnyis kyi 'brang phu'i gnas tshul rnams zhus pas/ de dang po mkhan chen rang la zhal —29—

gdams dang / yul bkod pa shog khra zhig gnang ba dang mthun byung bas mkhan chen ni char 'dod bye'u 'brug sgra bzhin dga' ba brjod kyi mi lang ba ba spu g.yo ba bzhin du byung zhing mkhan chen gyi gsungs nas mdang rmi lam du yang bdag gi bla ma dang mjal ba yang rmis/ da nang rten 'brel sogs gang gi sa nas shin tu legs/ sde pa bstan 'dzin pa zhes pa'i ming bkra yang legs pa 'di dag dang / bdag gi bla ma'i lung bstan mdzad pa rten 'brel sogs 'di lta bu'i legs gsung shin tu dgyes par gyur/ de'i nyin rang rtsang byang gi grwa rigs sbyin bdag che gra rnams mi sna bskul ba'i pho nya bar btang / de dag rnams nas kyang mchog gi sprul sku spyan 'dren la mi sna rta pa lnga drug re dang / yab yum la 'bul ba dang bcas so so nas byung mkhan chen dpon slob dbu mdzad pa'i rtsang byang gi grwa rigs sde dpon so so'i mi sna dang bcas pa'i rta pa brgyad cu rtsa lnga tsam rang rang so so'i yo byad dang / 'khor bu rta mang po dang bos nas hor zla dgu ba'i yar tshes bzang po be'u spel gyi 'grub sbyor la rgyal dkar rtse'i dpal 'khor bde chen nas 'brang gi phu la mchog gi sprul sku spyan 'dren par chas/ sna dkar rtser zhag gcig mal zhig mdzad/ 'brang phur snga mgyogs su rta pa gnyis btang nas de'i nub yar gzigs su bzhugs/ khong snga mgyogs pa rnams kyang 'brang phur byon mkhan chen dpon slob rnams mchog gi sprul sku spyan 'dren du phebs kyin yod nged tshor snyan 'bul zhu ru yong ba yin/ de lam khong dpon slob shin tu rags bsdus mang po yod/ do nub yar gzigs su pheb rgyu yin/ sang nyin snga mor phebs yong / de ka'i gra bshom gnang dgos zer bas/ yab yum —30—

rnams ma mnyes shing / khong dpon slob mang po zhig 'ong nas nged kyi bu chung 'phrog rtsis i yin/ khong rta hrag mi hrag byas kyang nga'i bu chung ci la 'phrog rgyu yin pa khyed gnyis po yang song 'di tshor ma sdod cig /'phral du log pa dga' 'bang gi bu 'phrog pa byung na 'di las dgra che ba med khong rang dpon slob rnams kyang nged sngags pa'i dgra 'di mi dga' nged la chos skyong ri dwags la sha khyi las sbung rbad sla ba mthu glog dmar las myur ba zhig yod/ su gang yang brnyes pa ma byed cig zer khong rnams la khrims gtam mang du bsgyur nas/ da lta song zer zhing gos gong ba nas bzung ste phyir phud do/ /lung pa'i mi rnams kyang bla brang pa'i sras 'di 'khrungs nas yul 'di bkra shis pa byung / 'di ni phyir 'gro ru mi 'jug /'di phyogs gzhan la song na yul 'di ci 'dra zhig yong mi shes zer zhing sdug bsngal bar gyur/ yab yum rnams shin tu yid mug par gyur te/ mchog gi sprul sku ni shin tu mnyes pas/ lung rig pa nga'i grwa pa dam tshig dang ldan pa smon lam dang 'brel ba zhig yin pas 'di nga yi rtsar phebs su chug khong snga mgyogs pa 'di gnyis yang nang du khrid la lto sbyin zhig /yab yum rnams kyang de bzhin du sdug bsngal bar ma mdzad cig /bdag kyang bdag rang gi dgon pa dang grwa rigs rnams dang / dad ldan gyi 'gro ba sems can gyi don du chos zab mo zhig byas nas/ rgyal khams thams cad la 'gro ba sems can gyi don du nyi zla ltar 'gro 'o gsungs nas/ yab yum rnams kyi thugs gsol shing / spro sems gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas zhal brda mdzad cing / khong snga mgyogs pa rnams la zhu lan rgyas par gnang / sang mkhan chen lung rig pa la —31—

bsu chang gyis shig gsungs so/ /sang nyin de 'brang la ru phebs pa'i tshe mi lam rgyus shes pa rnams kyi 'brang phu zer ba 'di yin no/ /zer nas mdzub mo btsugs pas mkhan chen gyi phyag na sngon rje btsun gong ma'i zhal gdams phyag dpe shog khra sogs gnang 'dug pa dang i mthun zhal phye nas legs par gzigs pas/ 'di gnyis ni thig btab pa dang 'dra'o gsungs nas 'brang gi phyogs la phyag 'tshal bar mdzad nas thugs dgyes par 'gyur zhing / dang po bla ma de nyid kyi bdag la shog khra gnang ba de ni yul 'di'i khog shar gyi ri maṇ+ḍal ltar yod pa/ byang ri nag po gnam du langs pa 'dra ba/ nub gangs dkar po rgyal blon gyi tshul du yod pa/ me tog pad+ma kha phye ba 'dra ba/ rtsa ba chab gnas/ yul gyi chu bo thams cad dbus su 'bab pa/ ri klung thams cad sman ljongs dri zhim pos gang ba/ bya ri dwags sna tshogs pas mdzes shing / shing tsher ma can gyi nags tshal/ rgyab ri dar dkar gyi yol ba 'dra zhing / mdun ri dpa' bo chas su zhugs pa bzhin gnas gzhi bya ngang pa'i sgo nga 'dra ba zhig tu 'byon par mdzad pa yin/ shog khra zhal gdams gnyis ka nas 'di shin tu gsal bar gda'/ 'di lta bu thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'jig rten gyi khams na da lta zhal gsung thos pa 'di 'o cag tsho bsod nams che/ bskal pa bzang po yin/ na ning nas lha bdag po'i sku skye chu shel ba de nas spyan drangs zer ba de yang / yul 'di dang 'dra se ba 'dug pas bdag gis bla ma de khong rnams kyis bla ma'i ngos 'dzin byas pa min nam bsam sems ma bde ba 'byung zhing / bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ nub gcig nam mkha' la bdag —32—

rdo ge sde gi bla che ri/'i chos skyong yin zer ba'i mi nag po rta nag la bzhon pa lag na mdung dar nam mkha' gang ba zhig klad la bskor zhing / ha he'i gad mo 'brug sgra ltar sgrogs pa/ nam mkha' la me dang glog dmar rab tu 'byug pa zhig nyi ma dbus kyis phyogs nas mtshan ldan bla ma'i sprul sku bltams nas zhag kha cig song ngo / /nged skyed bsring pa'i bar chad srungs bar 'gro ba yin zer zhing sa dang bar snang thams cad g.yo ba zhig byung bas bla ma de dang mjal ba 'dug bsam nas blo bde ba zhig byung / khyad par nyi ma de ring nas mi bdag gi bsam don thams cad 'grub bo gsungs zhing dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po dang bcas te/ la babs nas phebs la dmangs kyi da la lta la snang spang 'bor grags pa'i mdun du phebs pa'i tshe chos 'khor sdings gzigs pas shog khra na yod pa'i bkod pa dang / sbu tsam gyi 'khrul pa mi 'dug /'di ltar gsal ba yod pa 'di thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzigs pa chen po yin pa 'dug /de ltar na kho bo yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig yin par gda' gsungs zhing zhal 'dzum mul gyi shor nas chibs bshol nas chos 'khor sdings la phyag mang du mdzad/ thal mo sbyar zhabs pus mo sa la btsugs ste maṇ+ḍal rgyas skyu zhig dang yan lag bdun pa lan gsum mdzad/ de nas chos 'khor sdings thug gi bar zhabs thang la phebs pa yin zhing / bkra shis brag tu phebs pa'i tshe bla brang nas bsu chang chang brdzi'u shin tu che ba lnga ja stibs rgyugs byung bas/ mkhan chen gyis gsung nas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel shin tu legs/ da ser 'phreng dang /ro' mo sogs gyis gsungs nas/ dung chen cha gnyis dang dung dkar cha gcig—33—

rgya gling cha gcig /mkhar rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo mang po'i sgra dang bcas chos 'khor sdings su phebs so/ /bzhugs gnas g.yul sa chen po sa gur dkar po bsam las 'das pa la/ yol gor phyi nang mang po dang / bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag dar lcog bsam las 'das pa ni/ lha'i yul rnam par rgyal ba'i zhing khams ltar longs spyod mnga' thang brjod kyi mi lang ba byung ngo / /rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku dang / chos rje mkhan chen gnyis ni gcig gi gcig la 'jus shing / dgyes pa'i gsung gleng zab mo 'chad cing / bzhugs khri chen po rgya dpangs mtho ba re la bzhugs so/ /chos rje mkhan chen gyi rje btsun sprul sku la phyag 'tshal gser zho nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gos dar sogs kyi dgu tshan gnyis phul/ de skabs me tog gi char bab cing / 'ja' dkar po gur phub pa sogs byung / de nas zhag po drug nas/ mkhan chen dpon slob rnams gong dkar sogs la zhag po bdun phebs nas/ mchog gi sprul sku rtsang phyogs la spyan 'dren gyi dgongs ba zhu bar thegs/ de skabs 'brang phu gong dkar ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad skabs lags/ yar phebs dus la nang dkar mo bya ba'i zhing khar gur phub nas der zhag po bdun bzhugs pa gnang / mchog gi sprul sku yang nyin re bzhin gur khang du phebs/ gur du phebs dus nam mkha' nas me tog gi char dang / 'ja' 'od dkar po dang / sil snyan dang / dung dang / pi waṃ dang / rnga chung rnams kyi skad snyan pa bsam las 'das pa nyin re bzhin byung / de dus yab yum rnams la gser zho lnga brgya/ rta pho ser po gcig byi ru spos shel bad gra gang / zangs lcags gos dar/ ras la sogs pa'i dgu tshan bcu gcig —34—
