'bul ba mdzad de/ sna dkar rtse nas sde pa bstan 'dzin pas/ sku rdzi ba gcigarta 'dzam gling rdo mgyogs zer ba'i rta gcig rta rdzi dang bcas pa mchog gi sprul sku la phul/ yab yum rnams la gser zho bzhi/ khro gcig ras dar gyi dgu tshan gcig /sa cha them skang nyi shu'i bka' bzhes dang bcas gnang / zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bzhi la rtsang phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur ba yin zhing / yul gyi mi mang po dang / yab yum gyi bkra shis brag mdo thug gi bar phebs skyel la phebs/bkra shis brag la yi ge rang byon sngar gcig las med pa la de'i nyin mchog gi sprul sku'i phyag gis reg pa rnams la da lta yang yi ge gsal bar yod/ 'di yang 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po ni yin/ bya bye'u dang ri dwags rnams kyang skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur dang / phebs skyel gyi rnam par byung / yul gyi mi rnams ni thams cad mkhyen pa la lta zhing / 'o dod chen po 'don te/ la la smon lam bzang po 'debs la la ni bdag lta bu sems can skal ba med pa rnams la thugs rjes gzigs shig zer zhing lus sa la rdeb/ la la ni nged yul mi rnams da ci 'dra zhig yong zer gdong mchi mas gang zhing smre sngags 'don pa byung / yul mi phal cher ba la thugs phyir 'brangs de thub bya ri dwags rnams kyis kyang phebs skyel la yong / dus de nas lo bcu gcig bar du/ mchog gi sprul sku'i 'byon skabs bzhin/ mi la shi chad med pa dang / lo phyugs dang 'bras bu rgyas shing/ bya ri dwags rnams kyang gong du 'phel/ mdor na yul de yang khyad par du 'phags pa byung / da lta yang mi rnams kyi gtam rgyud gleng zhing thams cad la rgyus yod pa mang po yod/ lhag par bdag kyang shin tu nges par —35—

yi ger bris pa yin/ de nas mchog gi sprul sku dpon slob shin tu mang ba dang bcas/ yar 'brog sna dkar rtser phebs sde pa bstan 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i dpon g.yog rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / spyan ras gzigs kyis sgom lung gcig gnang bas/ tshang ma kun gyi ha las shing / chung chung nas rnam spyod dang sbobs pa 'di lta bu zer zhing / dad pa chen po gus pas 'dud do/ /de nas zhag bco lnga nas rgyal rtser phebs/ thugs sras lha dbang grags pa dang rin po che rdo ring pa dang / rje kun dga' dpal bzang la sogs pa'i grwa rigs mang po dang mjal/ rgyal rtse bdag po zhal ngo rnams kyi yun ring du zhabs tog bsam las 'das pa zhus/ de nas thams cad la sngar gyi dri ba dang gsung gleng rje de tsho dang dngos su mjal ba ltar mdzad/ de nas sgra dang rtsis tshad ma rnam 'grel la sogs pa'i ma sto phyogs la sbyang pa mdzad/ bla ma yang rje brag stod pa dang / rdo rje ring pa dang / ye shes dbang po dang / kun dga' bkra shis dang / rje byams pa lhun grub dang / rje lung rig rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i bla ma mang du bsten nas/mdo rgyud thams cad la mkhas shing sku'i yon tan dang / mdzad pa 'phrin las gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa ni/ sa thog gi lha 'dre mi gsum tshang ma la rgyus yod pa de yin par 'dug /che brjod mi dgos shing rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rang gi mdzad pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam thar rgyas bshad du 'dug pas 'dir ma bkod/ 'di ni dgung lo bzhi pa yan gyi rnam thar gsal zhing nor 'khrul gtan nas med pa zhig yin/ 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la phan zhing 'gro ba sems can la phan bde rgya chen por gyur cig /ces rje —36—

btsun bla ma'i rnam thar chung ngu 'di/ /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor la sogs pa mi shes pas/ /'di la gzigs po rnams kyis bzod par gsol cig /dgung lo bzhi pa yan rgyus che ba'i snyan ngag sdeb spyor med kyang / ku su li'i yi ger bkod pa yin/ 'di ni skye yul ma ga bhā dang dbyer med pa'i 'phags yul 'brang phu dang da lta gnas nges med byed pa/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i ming gnang ba'i tshe bstan dar rgyas rdo rje pha mas ming btags pa tsit+ta zhes par gyur pa/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen la gnas pa bdag gi 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bsgrub gnas chen por yos lo hor zla lnga par bris so// //bkra shis shog /sarba maṅga laX/ dge'o/ /

gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge yid ches gsum ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs/'di la slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar rgya gar lugs zhes bya'o/ /oṃ swā sti/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge yid ches gsum ldan zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rgyal gsung chad pa mi mnga' sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho de yang res 'ga' slob dpon tshul bzung nas/ /dam chos 'od kyis phyogs kun 'gengs shing la lar bgrang yas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam par ston mdzad kyang / /nam yang 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs las g.yo med pad+ma 'byung gnas de la gus pas bshud nas ni/ /gang de'i gtam ni tshad mar gyur pa ji tsam rnyed pa de tsam mu cor spangs te bri bar bya/ /de yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'bras bu'i tshul lhag par dar ba'i skabs shig /yul gyi mchog ma ga dhar rgyal po de ba pā las rgyal srid skyong bar byed la/ dpal o ḍi yā na'i yul na rgyal po ha ya lī la zhes bya ba rgyal srid chos bzhin du byed do/ /de'i tshe rgyal rigs rig pa smra ba po dkon mchog gsum bla mar byed pa sra do zhes bya ba de au ḍi yā na'i skad kyi ming ste/ rgya gar skad du na sri ga dha ra ste me tog phreng ba 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /de la sras mtshan —38—

dang ldan pa kha dog dkar la dmar ba/ srin lag la pad+ma'i ri mo yod pa pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i mig dang mchu sgros can/ pad+ma ut+pal lcags kyu zhags pa la sogs pa sha mtshan dge ba'i ltas du ma yod pa zhig btsas te btsas ston la sogs pa cher byas/ bram ze rnams kyis ltas brtags pas 'ga' zhig gis rgyal srid byed par lung bstan/ 'ga' zhig gis khams kyi rgyal phran byed par lung bstan/ kha cig gis ni dur khrod na gnas shing rigs nyams par byed par lung bstan/ de ltar bzang ngan ma nges pa sna tshogs par lung ston pa las gcig tu ma nges pa la/ 'on kyang thams cad mthun par gzhan gyis thub par dka' bar lung bstan to/ /der legs par sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhig byung ba la dris pas/ 'di ni gsang sngags kyi sgrub pa po mchog tu 'gyur zhing /pad+ma'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid thams cad tshang bas na 'od dpag med pas byin gyis slob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir 'di'i ming ni pad+ma a ba bha si ste mtshams sbyar bas pad+ma ba bha si zhes thogs shig zer ba ltar byas so/ /de nas khye'u de ’cher skyes tsam na yi ge dang / brda' sprod pa dang / rtog ge dang / sman dpyad dang / bzo gnas rnams dang / brtag pa brgyad la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas phra mo thams cad la tshegs med par blo gros byang bar gyur cing / ṣaX rag ṣa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer gyi gtsug lag khang du 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhig las skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga blangs/ chos mngon pa dang mdo sde'i gzhus lugs mang du thos par byas/ slob dpon sngags mkhan shān+ti rū pa zhes pa la bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mang por dbang —39—

bskur ba zhus te me tog thams cad pad+ma'i rigs kyi lha kho na la phog go /de bzhin du tshong dpon gyi bu su kha de ba zhes bya ba grub thob 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang gnyis su med pa zhig dang / smad 'tshong ma su kha dha dī zhes bya ba u rgyan gyi gnas de nyid du byung ba'i grub brnyes chen mo rdo rje 'chang dngos la chos gsan pa de dag kyang bsten nas gsang sngags nang gi gdams pa yang thob par byas so/ /de nas skyed mos tshal zhig tu bsnyen pa dang / nyer sgrub dang / sgrub pa dang / sgrub pa chen po rnams byas pas/ dang por thug chom gyi sgra chen po dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs pa dang / tshal la me shor ba dang /khyim zhig pa sogs mi 'tsham pa'i ltas du ma byung yang / de dag gi dbang du ma btang bar bsgoms pas rig sngags grub ste de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa gtso bor gyur ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems mang po mnal lam du zhal gzigs pa dang / khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dngos su yang zhal gzigs/mkha' 'gro ma dang 'byung po phra mo rnams bran du 'khol lo/ /de nas mi ring bar khyim gyi bya ba rang nyid kyis mdzad par bab pa'i tshe/ yab kyi rigs kyi bya ba las bram ze mdun na 'don rnams dang spyod pa mtshungs par rgyal po'i pho brang du yang yang 'gro zhing srid kyi bya ba dang / skar rtsis sogs kyi lung ston par byed pa las/ dus de'i tshe rgyal po ha ya lī la'i bu a k+ṣa lī la zhes bya ba rgyal srid la 'khod nas mi ring ba zhig yin pas/ de'i rgyal srid dam pa'i chos la 'god par bzhed de rgyal po nyid kyang dge ba rgya chen po la bskul/rang gis kyang skyed mos tshal gyi dbus su lha khang dang dge 'dun gyi gnas —40—

byas/ mtha' mchod rten gyis bskor/ lcags ri rim pa mang po byas so/ /de'i tshe slob dpon gyi g.yog tu gyur pa gcig ni rgyal po'i yig mkhan byed la/gnyis ni blon por gtogs pa yod pas de rnams ngan sems skyes te/ yul 'khor 'di rnams rang cag gsum gyis bdag gir bya ba'i thabs bya'o zhes lkog tu bgros nas dus lan gcig yig mkhan des rgyal po la/ pad+ma a ba bha si 'di ni nges par rgyal srid byed par 'dod de/ 'di nyid dang 'di'i skyed mos tshal na gnas pa'i rab tu byung ba stong tsam yod pa yang dgra thabs la mkhas shing g.yul du dpa' ba kho na yin la/ skyed mos tshal de yang gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba yin no zhes brdzu bar byas mod kyi/ don du ni lcags ri brtan pos bskor ba sogs rgyal po dang 'thab pa'i don du byas pa yin no zhes byas/rgyal pos blon po rnams la dris pas kyang blon po gnyis po des bsgrags pa'i rkyen dang phrag dog gi dbang gis thams cad kyang de dang mthun par smra ba na/rgyal pos blon po de rnams da mag tshogs dang bcas pa btang ngo / /de skabs u rgyan na rgyal po rnams bram ze dang dge sbyong dang paṇ+ḍi ta gsod pa'i khrims ni med pas mdun na 'don khyod dang khyod kyi mchod gnas dge 'dun rnams yo byad bor la rang nyid yul gzhan du songs shig ces rgyal po'i bka' brjod pas dge 'dun rnams song ngo / /slob dpon yang de ltar 'gro ba la/ blon po rnams kyis 'di ma bsad na phyis rang cag la gnod pa 'ong zer nas gshed ma mang po btang / de dag gis slob dpon zhags pa dang lcags sgrog gis bcings pa'i tshe rig sngags kyi mthus zhags pa rnams bcad/ lcags sgrog —41—

rnams bcag mtshon cha rnams bsnun pas ni slob dpon gyi sku la gnod pa med cing mtshone cha rnams dum bu mang por chag me la bsregs pas kyang ma tshig chu la 'phangs pas bye'u zul byed cing song / g.yang sar 'phangs pas kyang ma gnod/ sa brus nas bskungs pas kyang thag ring por sa phug nas song ste bzung yang ma thub bo/ /de nas slob dpon grong khyer rnams su ma song ste/yul ga༈ gyi dur khrod nas dur khrod du rgyu zhing spyod la/ dur khrod kyi 'dre dang srin po rnams kyis grogs byas te/ sngar gyi rgyal po'i yig mkhan dang / blon po dang gshed ma de dag zhag bdun gyi khongs su la la khang khyim tshig nas shi/la la rang srog rang gis bcad de gcig kyang ma lus so/ /rgyal po yang sbrul gdug pas zin te dus las 'das/ de nas kyang slob dpon dur khrod de dag tu yun ring du gnas nas 'byung po dang srin po dang sha za dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs mthu chen rnams dang grogs bshes su gyur/ rig sngags kyi bzlas pa la brtson par byas pas khams gsum rnam rgyal dang gshin rje gshed la sogs pa rdo rje khro bo thams cad zhal gzigs shing gsung thos/ nag po chen po dang ma mo bdun sogs dang mi lab pa bzhin du byed/ klu dang gnod sbyin gdug pa can thams cad bran du 'khol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i drag sngags 'bum phrag brgya la dbang thob bo/ /de skabs mi ma yin mthu chen rnams dang lhan cig tu 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad yod pa rnams su yang sngags bzlas pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis yang yang byon/ de dag tu gdod nas grub pa'i lha'i slob dpon brgyad —42—

dang yang mjal/ thun mong gi dngos grub re re bsgrubs so/ /de yang dur khrod sgo ra an+ta ka ra na slob dpon dha nu khyu ta zhes bya ba gnas/ ral gri'i dngos grub bsgrubs/ dur khrod tshang tshing 'khrigs par slob dpon sa'i bu zhes bya/dngos grub ril bu'o/ /dur khrod 'bar ba 'khrigs par slob dpon nyi ma'i bu zhes bya/ dngos grub mig sman no/ /dur khrod 'jigs byed thod par slob dpon a mṛ ta pra bha/ dngos grub mchil lham/ dur khrod a sna sna ha sa na slob dpon shi baX ka ra/ dngos grub nad mtha' dag 'joms pa'i sman/ dur khrod dpal gyi nags su slob dpon ba ra ru tsi ste mchog sred/ dngos grub 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len/ dur khrod ca co can du slob dpon gcer bu/ dngos grub gter gyi bum pa/ dur khrod gtum drag tu slob dpon ngan spong / dngos grub gser 'gyur rtsi'o/ /de rnams thob pas rig pa 'dzin par ni gyur/ da ni spyod pa spyad de sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa la/ mnal lam du sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pas/ de kho na nyid ma mthong zhing mngon shes med par drag shul dpa' bo'i las kyis ni 'dod pa'i dngos grub la shin tu bar du gcod pa yin zhing / khyod kyi 'di tsam gyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub mi thob la/khyod kyi las 'brel yod pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal ye shes yin pas des bstan pa bzhin du sgoms shig ces lung bstan byung / bdag nyid kyis rnam par brtags pas kyang nus pa ni cher thob kyang de kho na nyid bsgom pa'i gnas lugs la phyogs bslad par rig nas yul dbus ma ga dhar byon/ de'i tshe yul ma ga dh+wa ra rgyal po dharmā pā las rgyal srid bskyangs te lo mang du lon/—43—

slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs grub pa brnyes nas slob ma skyong ba'i dus kyi mgo la sleb/ chos kyi myu gu'i dgon par mkhan po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad nas dge 'dun phal cher sde pa'i sde la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /'dul 'dzin gcig la 'dul ba 'bum sde lan gcig nyan pas don thugs su chud par mdzad/ der slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gsan pas lta ba nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ slob ma gzhan rnams dbang bskur zhu ba la dka' tshegs chen po dgos pa la/ slob dpon 'dis dka' tshegs med pa la dbang thams cad rdzogs par thob/ slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma sangs rgyas gsang ba la yang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du dbang bskur ba dang man ngag thob/slob dpon ye shes zhabs la 'dus pa dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang / zla gsang thig le dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / las kyi phreng ba ste nang rgyud sde lnga la sogs pa rgyud dang man ngag mtha' dag gsan no/ /der dbang gi ye shes ji bzhin du ngo 'phrod/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i rtogs pa la brten pa thob/ gnas lugs la reg par gyur nas/ da ni bdag gis ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ slob dpon ye shes zhabs na re/ shar phyogs bha ṅga la'i yul grong khyer ba ṇa ḍū ba'i byang ngos bar shi zhes bya ba'i nags kyi mthongs na ri de'u chung zhig yod pa der dpal he ru ka'i sgrub pa gyis shig /ces gsungs pa ltar der byon phyag rgya pad+ma can yang 'bad med du rnyed nas zla ba drug bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sgrub pa chen po nyams su blangs pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas —44—

mang po rtag tu zhal gzigs shing gsung 'dri bar byung / mi ring ba na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob/ rdo rje'i sku mngon du mdzad do/ /de nas da ni sems can gyi don ci rigs par bya'o zhes dgongs nas yul ti rā hu ti la sogs pa tha dra'i rgyal khams rnams dang / kā ma ru dang bal po la sogs pa byang phyogs kyi yul rnams su lo shas shig skal pa dang ldan pa ci rigs pa la chos ston pa dang / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang / bcud len gyi sman sogs kyis skye bo stong phrag mang po tshe bsring ba dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzad/ chu med pa rnams su chu dbyung ba dang / chu che ba rnams su sa 'og tu 'jug pa sogs mang du mdzad de/ tha dra'i yul dang / tsa spa'i phyogs dang / kha su sogs kyi yul kun na slob dpon 'di'i sgrub chu dang / chu sa 'og nas rgyug bcug pa sogs da lta yang mang du yod/ tsa skru rje'i yul na bha ti zer ba'i chu chen po zhig nyin lam gcig tsam sa'i sbubs su bcug pa gcig dang / tsha lam tsam re bcug pa gnyis yod/ dus de tsam na rgya gar gyi yul lho phyogs tri ling ga dang nye ba tri ma la tsan dan gyi nags na lak+ṣa mun gyi gnas dang nye ba na/ shrī bas thā na zhes bya bar dbang phyug gi liṅga khru gang tsam zhig rang byung du byung /nyin re bzhin srog chags mang po bsad pa'i khrag mchod byed dgos/ der mu stegs pa rnams kyis dmod pa drag po byas pa tsam gyis nang pa'i sde rnams la nad yams sogs mi 'tsham pa du ma 'byung ba zhig yod/ tri ma la de yul bzang zhig nang pa mang la/ dpal o tan+ta pu ri'i mchod pa phal che ba yang yul de nas 'byung ba yin/ de la rten rang byung des gnod pa che ba zhing byung /—45—

yang shar phyogs bha ṅga la dang nye ba ba len+t+ra'i lho nub na yul bā ga la zhes bya bar mtsho chung ngu zhig gsar du brdol zhing der mu stegs la dga' ba'i klu gdug pa can zhig gnas bcas/ mu stegs rnams kyis mtsho la mchod gtor phul ba tsam gyis gser dbul mu tig rin po che sogs dpag tu med pa rnyed 'ong zhing / yo byad de dag la brten nas pho/ra phyogs kyi yul tsho lngar mu stegs kyi grwa gsar mang po tshugs/ sangs rgyas pa'i sde rnams la klu de shin tu chos 'phrul che bas gnod par byung / ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i khab na shel gyi pha bong gcig la mu stegs pa'i lha bram ze'i rigs kyi 'byung po mang po gnas nas dka' bas sgrub mi dgos par mig mthong dang rna nyan dang mo rtsis kyi mngon shes ston pa zhig yod do/ /de rnams byung nas ring po ma lon pa'i skabs yin pas de dag 'dul bar bzhed de/ dpal rdo rje gdan du sgom khang mdzad nas/rig pa'i lha 'khor los sgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po drug zhal phye/ dpal he ru ka'i rig sngags kyis bsgrubs pas 'bar ba dang bzhad pa sogs grub pa'i rtags nyi shu rtsa gcig byung zhing / brtan pa'i phur bu gsum byung ba las khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phur bu slob dpon nyid kyis blangs nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yud tsam la lho phyogs tri ma lar byon/ ling ga dang nye ba'i shing sdong gcig la btab pas de skor gyi nags thams cad tshig ling ga'i phyed lhag tsam thal bar song / phyin ho nang pa la gnod pa ma byung / o to pu ri'i mchod pa nyams pa rnams gsos/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phur pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi gzungs ma rnal 'byor ma ngang tshul can zhes bya ba zhig gis blangs te yul bhang —46—

ga la'i mtsho de la btab pas/ klu 'khor bcas thal bar song / zhag bdun nas mtsho yang bskams/ mu stegs kyi grwa de rnams zhig chung ba de sgrub g.yog kā ma ru'i rnal 'byor pa rat+na shri la zhes bya bas blangs te rgyal po'i khab kyi shel gyi pha bong de la btab pas sil gyis shig /des kyang nang pa la phan par byung / de gnyis kyis kyang rig pa 'dzin pa grub ste mi snang bar gyur la/ 'dod na sprul pa'i lus kyis snang bar yang byed do/ /slob dpon gyi tri ma lar cung zad bzhugs te/ tsan dan las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhig bzhengs so/ /bi kra ma shrī lar sgrol ma'i lha khang chung ngu zhig mdzad/ dpal o rgyan du yang byon te skal pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma ci rigs par 'dus/ lha khang gcig kyang bzhengs/ de skabs o rgyan dang nye ba'i yul ka ru nang pa'i sde dar zhing bzang bar yod/ rgyal po yang dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gis byed pa yin pa la/ yul mo la tā na'i grong khyer pā ga da'i rgyal po ni stag gzig tu ru lko yin pas de'i dmag gis ka sne'i yul rnams bcom/ chos grwa 'ga' zhig ni khu shig /mang po zhig 'joms la khad kyi skabs su chu klung ni la'i steng na tshur dmag rnams gru dang rkyal gyi sbyor bas byung ba la/ chu tshur kha nas slob dpon gyis lta stangs dang sdigs mdzub drag tu mdzad pas gru che ba bdun dang shing gcig pa'i gru chung lnga brgya tsam dang rkyal zhing 'ong ba'i mi dang bcas pa thams cad chur byings/ tu rtsa rdzo dpa' bo thams cad shi'o/ /de phyin chad mi rabs mang por yul der tu rtsa'i gnod pa ma byung ngo / /de ltar na rab tu byung ba'i mtshan pad+ma ā ka ra ste pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i —47—

gsang mtshan pad+ma saX bha wa ste pad+ma 'byung ldan/ sngon dus o rgyan gyi skye bos bla dgas su btags pa ka ma la ku li sha ste pad+ma rdo rje/ de yang dpral ba na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i ri mo yod pas so/ /chung ngu'i dus su btags pa'i rigs kyi ming ni pad+ma a ba bha si ste pad+ma 'od zer ldan/ slob ma rnams kyis gus pas mtshan gsol ba ni shrī mahā su kha ste dpal bde ba chen po/ phyis o rgyan du byon pa'i skabs o ḍi yā na pa rnams kyis mtshan gsol ba sngon gyi dpal bde ba chen po pad+ma badz+ra dang mdzad pa mtshungs pas pad+ma badz+ra zhes grags so/ /rgya gar shar nub lho dang dbus rnams su gong du smos pa de dag gtso bor gyur pa'i 'gro don ci rigs pa tsam mdzad la/ de bas chu bo ga d+ma'i byang phyogs bal po phan chad 'gro ba'i don cher mdzad/ de bas kyang 'gro lding gi yul du 'gro don che ste yul khams de dang por 'dul bar mdzad pa po yin pa dang / gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba rnam dag da lta'i bar du shin tu mang bas so/ /de bas kyang bod khams su 'gro don che ste/ phyogs 'di'i sngon nas da lta'i bar gyi mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro bar gyur pa la dngos brgyud kyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa 'di nyid dang / mtshan 'di nyid rtags mtshan du byas te gdul bya'i zhing du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pa lta bur snang bas so/ /de dag kyang rnam pa 'di dang mtshan 'dis mtshon pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ gzhan du na zung 'jug thob pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i mtha' ni su zhig gis brjod par nus/ slob dpon 'di ni gtso bor mi ma yin 'dul ba'i 'phrin las can yin te/ sngon smos pa de dag thams cad las kyang —48—

rnga yab gling phran sogs su mi ma yin gyi 'gro don spyod pa ches cher rgya che ba yin te/ snga ma de dag ni yul nyi tshe ba skye bo nyung ngu la dus lo grangs brgya snyed dang stong snyed sogs yun thung du yin la/ phyi ma 'di la ni yul dang dus dang skye bo gzhal bar dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /de la 'phags yul gyi gtam rgyud la/ ri kha ba can gyi khongs su byon nas klu dang gnod sbyin gdug pa can thams cad btul/ rgyal po la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul gyis dad par byas so zhes pa tsam las bod du byon pa'i lo rgyus rgyas pa mi snang la/ de yang 'gro lding btul ba'i snga phyi gang yin mi gsal zhing / bod pa rnams bod yul nas srin po'i gling la byon par 'dod pa dang / 'gro lding ba rnams ni 'gro lding nas der byon par 'dod do/ /sku'i bkod pa gnyis cig car bstan par byas kyang mi 'gal mod/ 'gro lding du byung ba'i slob ma dang yang slob 'ga' zhig gis 'gro don mdzad pa'i dus dang bstun na bod du byon pa'i rjes su 'gro lding du byon par mngon no/ /de la bod du byon pa'i lo rgyus rnam thar dang thang yig tu grags pa rnams la mang po zhig snang yang re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag rnying ma bka' mar grags pa rnams kyi nang nas man ngag lta phreng dang / phur pa dang rta mgrin sogs kyi chos skor mang po zhig la lo rgyus spyi khog mtshungs pa yid brtan rung bar snang la/nang sel mi 'dra tsam ni shin tu mang ngo / /de yang slob dpon brdzus skyes su gleng ba dang / mngal skyes su gleng ba dang / 'dam khar gleng ba sogs ci rigs yod la/ bod du ji tsam bzhugs pa yang 'ga' zhig las lo gsum/ 'ga' zhig las lo drug gzhan 'ga' las lo bcu gnyis/ kha cig bco brgyad ces —49—

sogs yod la/ gter ma rnams las ni nyung ba rnams lnga bcu dang / phal cher las brgya lhag par 'chad do/ /de la don gzhan gdul bya snang ba dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor bsams na ni da ltar yang bzhugs shing / zhing khams kun tu sku'i snang ba cig car rtag tu ston pa'ang yin pas phyogs gcig nas tshad gang ltar byas kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang snga phyi'i dus sgrig pa sogs la ni de mi rung ste/ 'di la ni de skabs kyi mi'i 'gro ba phal pa rnams kyi spyi mthun pa'i snang ngor snang du rung ba zhig gi steng nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rgyal po'i bka' chems kyi yi ge rnam pa gsum yod par grags pa'i rba bzhed dngos dang / rba bzhed la snga dar gyi 'phro mthud cing / de la'ang bka' gdams phyogs pa zhig gis kha skong byas pa zhig dang / rba bzhed rnams mthong zhing /rgyal bzhed kyi don blangs nas bkod pa'i lo rgyus kyi yig rnying 'ga' re yang mthong ba las rgyas bsdus phran bu ma gtogs phal cher gtam rgyud ngo bo gcig pa kho nar snang la/ mkhas mchog dam pa kun gyis kyang de gsum yid ches kyi khungs su mdzad cing / de'i nang gi slob dpon pad+ma'i lo rgyus rnams ni snga 'gyur bka' ma pa rnams kyi lo rgyus phal che ba dang spyi 'gros 'grig par yang snang ngo / /dba' bzhed dpa rba bzhed yi ge 'don tshul tsam ste ngo bo gcig la/ 'ba' bzhed bya ba gzhan zhig yod zer na'ang de'i lugs 'di yin bya ba ma mthong la/ rba bzhed la yig nor byung ba'i gnas kyang srid do/ /'dir de dag gung spros te bshad na shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /de yang de'i tshe sprul pa'i rgyal po btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis bod yul du dam chos —50—

dar bar bzhed nas/ utswa rla bo dhi sa twa zhes grags pa zhi ba 'tsho zhes kyang bya/slob dpon dharma shān+ti sgo ṣa zhes bya ba spyan drangs te pho brang klung tshugs zhes bya ba'i yang thog dar gyi gur phub par bzhugs su bcug zla ba bzhir dge ba bcu rten 'brel bcu gnyis khams bco brgyad rnams las brtsams te slob dpon gyis chos zugad pas/ bod 'dre rnams khros nas pho brang 'phang thang chus khyer/ dmar po ri la thog brgyabs/ yul khams rnams su mi nad phyugs nad dang / sad dang ser ba cher byung bas/ bod 'bangs thams cad chos byas pas lan zer chos byar ma btub nas/ rgyal po rba gsal snang sogs chos blon lnga dang lhan cig utswa rla'i drung du song / gser phye bre gang yon du phul/ de 'dra lan gsum song nas 'di skad ces/ utswa rla re zhig bal po'i yul du bzhud la/ de bar rgyal pos bod mi rnams lha chos mi byed du mi rung bar gleng / rngan pa sbyin/ zhang blon rnams thabs kyis brid nas/ chos byed du btub pa'i tshe slar yang spyan 'dren no zhes zhus/ ā tsār+ya na re/ bod kyi 'dre srin gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba la sngags mkhan pad+ma saX bha ba zhes bgyi ba da lta sa steng na mthu rtsal che shos de spyan 'dren dgos gsungs/ gser phye khyor ba gang bal po'i rgyal po la sbyin dgos gsungs nas bsnams/ lhag ma btsan po nyid la gtad/ phyi ltar du bskrad pa ltar byas te yar bzhud do/ /lang gro sna ra dang /gsal snang gnyis kyis bal yul du bskyal/ slar ldog nas rba gsal snang chos kyi spyan par bsgos/ pho nya sum cus bskor te/ chos kyi don la rgya nag tu pho nyar phyin/ de bar zhung blon thams cad bsdus nas/ chos byed pa'i chad so —51—

grub/ slob dpon spyan ma 'drongs pa'i dus skabs der pho nya rnams la/ rgya rjes so sor bya dga' chen po dang / btsan po la dar yug khri phrag sogs skyes chen po dang bcas te sleb/ de nas yang gsal snang gis/ utswa rla gnyis po spyan 'dren du bal por phyin/ 'di'i skabs su rba bzhed las/ utswa rla bo dhi satwa dang / slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha ba dang / lha khang brtsig pa'i cha mkhan mkhas pa zhig ste gsum bod du 'byon pa'i grabs sob byas nas 'dug skad/ de nas utswa rla bo dhi sa twas gzhung lam la mgyogs par byon/ slob dpon pad+ma dang cha mkhan dang bal po'i rdo bzo ba sogs bsdebs nas phebs te/ yul so so'i mi ma yin 'dul ba dang / sa cha rnam rtog gin byon/ zhes 'byung la/ rba ba ched las/ utswa rla bo dhi sa twa spyan 'dren du phyin par myur bar 'gran bzang du byon/btsan po dang bka' mchid mdzad/ pad+ma sam+bha ba spyan drangs nas lha srin btul na legs zhes gsungs pa ltar rba mang rje gsal snang dang / seng mgo lha lung gzims g.yog lnga dang bcas pa spyan 'dren du btang ba/ slob dpon gyis kyang mkhyen nas mang yul du byon 'dug zer ba snang ba gang ltar yang mi 'gal mod snga ma 'thad par bya'o/ /de skabs skyid grong nas tshur byon dus bod kyi lha srin rnams kyis kha char drag po phab/ phan tshun gyi ri kha ltebs bar byung ba na 'khor rnams rjes su bzhag slob dpon sngon la byon te ri'i khong seng nas bzhud nas lha srin de rnams bcings shing dam la btags so/ /de nas bzung lam gyi mi ma yin thams cad 'dul zhing byon/ gtsang po la rdzing bcas te chu gzhung la spyan drangs kyin byon pa yang mang / 'o yug gi thad ka nas phar sdon/—52—

la 'di brgal ba na nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba mang po yod pas snying rje bya'o gsungs nas phebs/ chu tshan drag tu khol ba'i dbus na srog chags yod pa rnams la slob dpon gyis dgongs pa mdzad pas chu rnams 'jam gyis 'gro ba byung rnal 'byor ba'i byams pa'i nus pa bstan pa tsam yin/ lar myong nges kyi las la sangs rgyas kyis kyang mdzad du med gsungs/ dgongs pa bzhag pas sngar bzhin song / ru mtshams su'ang phebs/ gangs dkar 'jigs nas thag ring du bros/ gnam du phebs nas da ni thang lha 'dul dgos gsung de phyogs su chas/ zangs khal tshad ma zhig tu lug bong shi ba'i sha btsos pa dang / klu tsha zer ba'i mi tshan zhig na re/ 'di ci yin zer/ lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ ha ha byas gnod spyin 'dul ba'i thabs lta zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis gnod spyin chen po dmar thab 'tshal gsungs nas zangs la rdog pa brgyabs nas bskyel/der thang lha khros te gangs la thug tshom byung / sprin nag chags nas skye bo phal bas bzod par dka' ba'i 'brug dang ser ba dang glog rgyun mi 'chad pa byung ngo / /slob dpon gyis gangs ri la sdigs mdzub bstan pas gangs cher zhu/thang lha ya zhur du de nas grags/ snying drung du 'di na chos byed du mi ster ba'i klu gdug pa can zhig 'dug gsungs/ 'dul bar dgongs pa la klu de phyi'i rgya mtshor bros/ phug pa zhig tu dkyil 'khor lnga bzhengs/ zhug gsum dgongs pa mdzad pas gangs kyi thug chom zhi/ yul yang 'jam por gyur/ klu dang thang lha yang dam 'og tu chud cing chos la bkod/ gzhan yang gnam mtsho la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams dang / jo mo gangs dkar la sogs pa lha srin dpag tu med —53—

pa zhig de skabs btul lo/ /de nas la shod du byon/ 'phan yul la yul ngan lung pa rta ro kha phye ba 'dra gsungs dngos su ma phebs/ lha 'dre rnams dam 'og tu stsal/ stod lung gi g.ya' ral mo nas mar byon/ ri nyil ba la sdigs mdzub bstan pas log btsun mo 'phrang gi phrag mu stegs ral pa can bro 'drab pa 'dra ba 'di'i gong ma bcad na/ bod mu stegs kyis 'gengs gsungs nas bcad/ zhong par tshong pa kun la gro thob gsung ba la/ chu ma mchis zhus pas/ gseg shing sa la tham tham brgyabs pas chu mig bdun byung / zhong ba lha chur grags/ mkhar nag 'di klu btsan thu ba zhig 'dug 'dul byed cig bya gsungs/ brag la rdo rje sems dpa'i sku zhig mdzad/ bod kyi rdo la bzo e rung zer bal po'i bzo bos sha ba zhig kyang brkos/ de nas ngam shod la byon/zur mkhar mda' ru rdo'i mchod rten lnga bzhengs rab gnas mdzad/ de nas pho brang brag dmar 'om bu tshal du phebs/ btsan po dang mjal ba la pho nyas brda sbyar/ phyag ba ched zer ba la/ slob dpon na re/ nga yi phyag btsan pos mi thub gsungs nas pha bong zhig la phyag mdzad pas shag ter gas/ rgyal po'i na bza' phud pa la phyag mdzad pas thul gyis tshig der btsan pos slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag phul/ de'i gong du sang shig brag dmar 'gran bzang du rgya nag gi lha khang 'go'u de shan la dpe blangs pa zhig bzhengs ni grub/ zhal dro ni ma grub pa'i skabs yin pas/ slob dpon chen po der gdan phebs par zhus nas phebs/ rab gnas mnga' gsol gyi tshe rgyal po dang blon po chen po ni ma byon/ gnangs chen po dang gzim mal ba kun gyis blta bar 'ongs/ —54—

slob dpon gyis lha sku chen po thams cad mi la bya ba bzhin du byas nas/ ston mo byed pa'i sar spyan drangs song bas yid ma ches te/ nam phyed la de kun gyis mar me khyer nas bltas pas nang na 'jim sku gcig kyang med par stong sang nge 'dug dbyug skor gyis btsal bas kyang reg thogs mi 'dug pas yid ches/ nangs par sgo seng nas bltas pas sku gzugs thams cad sngar bzhin 'khod pa la/ slob dpon pad+mas mchod pa mdzad pa dang / lha rnams bshos gsol zhing gtam mdzad par dngos su mthong / de'i nyin mo spos dang mar me thams cad rang 'bar/ rol mo thams cad rang 'khrol/ cong rnams rang sgra sgrogs/ 'phan lnga btags pa lnga brgyar 'phel/ sder gcig tu rgun 'khrum snyim pa gang tsam zhig ka yod pa yang der 'tshogs kyi mi rnams kyis ci tsam zos kyang nyung du ma song / thams cad ngo mtshar skyes so/ /de'i nangs par gzim mal ba lha lung mtsho gzher gnyan legs zhes bya ba la pra rten byas/ lha mo 'od zer can ma'i pra se na phab smra ru bcug pas/ bod kyi lha klu mi srun pa thams cad kyi ming smras/ 'phang thang du chu thog 'bebs pa sham po/ dma' po ri la thog 'bebs pa thang lha/ mi nad phyugs nad gtong ba brtan ma bcu gnyis/ sad ser gtong ba bod kyi lha gnyan dgu yin no zhes sogs smras/de'i nangs par nas bzung nas kyang cho rigs bzang ba'i byis pa mang po la rgyal chen bzhi'i pra phab/ gnod spyin me lhas zhal mngon sum du bstan/ lha klu gdug pa can thams cad kyi ming dang gnas dang spyod tshul smras/ de nas rgyal blon sogs yid ches pa'i phyir du lha 'dre ma drangs pa rags rim zhig dngos —55—

su mi la phab nas/ bsdigs shing gzir ba dang chos bshad nas dam 'og tu bcug /rang rang gi srog sngags dang cho ga rnams slob dpon la phul/ des kyang ma thul ba rnams sbyin sreg mdzad pa sogs thabs sna tshogs kyis btul/de 'dra ba lan gnyis mdzad/ der slob dpon na re/ slan chad lha chos ci bder mdzod/ gtsug lag khang dgongs pa bzhin du rtsigs shig /sngar lha klu dam 'og tu lan gnyis chud lags te/ da dung lan gcig bgyid de 'tshal gsungs/ de nas pho brang zur phud rkyang bu tshal du yang phebs/ der bzhugs dus ma gro gzi can la sogs pa'i klu rnams btul/ ma gro gzi can na re/ sa steng na btsan po khri srong lde btsan che/ sa 'og na nga che/ nged gnyis grogs po bya/ rgyal po lha khang bzhengs pa'i gser phye dre'u khal bcu bzhi 'bul/ gser khung glang po snar len du thong zer ba bzhin gser rnams de kho na ltar byung /rgyal po pe kar yang btul te/ de yang khong 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub dus pe har gyis dkyil 'khor bltar 'ongs pas mig la phur bu btab/ sngags nyan pas rna ba la btab/ sngags zlos pa'i lad mo byas pas lce la btang/ de nas 'bros par 'dod pa la yan lag bzhi la btab pas 'gro ma thub/ da bsreg go zhes gsungs pas shin tu skrags te yang 'khor dam la btags/ de rjes yar lha sham po 'dul du byon pas/ slob dpon gyi thog tu khos chu phab/slob dpon gyis ber sna nas rdo rje gdengs pas chu gyen la log slar lha rdzing bam rdzing du blug /der rdo rje 'phangs pas chu khol te sham po'i gangs kyi sum cha tsam zhu/ der kho gangs kyi rtse la bsdad nas nga la de tsam du mtho 'tsham pa —56—

zer/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ khyod kyang nga la de tsam mtho 'tsham pa da phyin dam 'og tu mi 'jug na bsreg go gsungs pas/ der slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal bzhin du/ bdag nag po'i rigs yin pas chos bgyi ba'i rngo mi thogs/ da phyin chad gnod pa mi bgyi'o zhes dam bcas/ de ltar zla ba drug tsam gyi ring la mi ma yin phal cher dam 'og tu tshud par mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal srid dang bod 'bangs spyi la phan pa'i phyir sbyin sreg rgya chen po zhig bgyi'o gsung pa'i skabs shig dga' ston chen po zhig la btsan po'i dbu skra 'khru'o zhes yod pa la/ utswa rla bo dhi sa twas ri rab kyi byang ngos na chu mig rtag tu snang bya ba yod/ de nas chab blangs te btsan po'i dbu bsil na sku tshe ring /rigs rgyud 'phel/ myong srid chen po sha stag 'byung ba lags te gsungs/chab te sus len par rngo thogs zhus pas/ slob dpon sngags mkhan gyis nus gsungs/ slob dpon la zhus pas/ gser gyi bum pa'i kha dar dkar gyis bcad/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhag /sngags bzlas nas bum pa nam mkha' la 'phangs pas je mtho la mi snang bar song / zan za yun gcig tsam nas slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa khrongs kyis byung / der btsan po'i dbu khrus shig byas blon po kun la gtad pas/ kha phye ba'i nang na chu skya nyog ge 'dug nas blon po kun tshogs pa'i mdun sar brims pas/ 'di mon gyi smyo chu yin las che/ pho thong zer nas phyir pho/ de med par byas/ des kyang don med wo po byung / de nas rgyal po dang 'bangs skal ldan rnams la kri ya dang / gsang sngags nang gi dbang bskur ba yang mdzad/ rje 'bangs skal ldan mang po lo—57—

man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba gsungs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms dang / phur bu 'bum sde dang / gzhan yang sgrub thabs man ngag ci rigs pa ston zhing / yun ring por bzhugs nas bod khams thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par bya'o gsung pa zhig yod pa la/ phyis sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis rgyu byas/ nag phyogs kyi lha srin gdug pa can snying la zhugs pa'i blon po rnams kyis rkyen byas te ma 'grub bo/ /de yang bka' tshems kyi yi ge rnams na/ bod yul bzang por gtong gsung pa'i skabs de yan chad tsam ma gtogs ma bris pa ni gsang sngags nang gi lo rgyus tshogs su mi sgrogs pa'i dbang du byas par snang la/der dbang bskur ba la yang rim pa byed pa zhes gab tshig tu yod de/ sngon dus gsang sngags pa nang ma gtogs thun mong du dbang bskur ba'i mtshan don yang gsang ba'i srol byung bas rim pa zhes bya ba'i brda chad 'di yig rnying mang po na snang ngo / /man ngag lta phreng gi lo rgyus rnying pa rnams dang / 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu'i phur bu'i gtong thun dang / gzhan yang lo rgyus kha 'thor ba khungs ma rnams su sbyi khog de dang mthun par 'byung ba la/ rgyal po la rim pa mdzad pa'i tshe btsun mo tshe spong bza' me tog sgron dang / 'gro bza' khri rgyal mo btsun zhes bya ba phyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan jo mo byang chub rje zhes pa de sogs btsun mo mchog rnams kyis dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i gzungs ma byed par zhus pas/ de kun skal pa dang ldan pa kho nar yang mi snang gsung / mchims bza' lha mo btsan dang mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gnyis mchod pa'i gzungs ma byed pa'i skal ba can du lung bstan pas/ sa thag ring ba la ji ltar bgyi —58—

zhus pas/ 'di la tshegs med gsungs nas/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ yud tsam zhig na de gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' ru sleb bo/ /der ma zad de gnyis la lhan gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa skyes nas phyis 'jig rten gyi las spangs te sgrub pa la zhugs so/ /bka' chems kyi yi ge gsum las de gnyis gshone nu nas sgrub pa la gshe/gas pas phyag rjes lha khang med ces 'byung ba'i don yang der snang / de skabs dbang bskur ba grol ba na rgyal po'i gzim mal ba rma co co bya bas zhung blon rnams la bshad kyang yid ma ches par de tsam gyi nus pa med dam snyam pa'i skabs/ rgyal po'i lha khang gi sa 'dul mdzad pa'i dus dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i thig skud 'then pa la bod kyi yul khams kyi bu mo gtsang ma mtshar ba'i mthar thug pa gnyis dgos pa byung ba la/ bod tsam gyi yul khams che ba na mtshar ba'i mthar thug pa su yin mi shes pa'i skabs/ sngags mkhan la de'i nus pa yod zer bas bden na 'gugs par zhu byas pas/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ dar cig nas lcog ro bza' bu chung sman dang / lcog ro bza' lha bu sman gnyis gang nas byung cha med pa der byung / de la ye shes kyi lha phab ste thig sna ba byas so/ /phyis bod 'bangs kyi mi thams cad bsdus pas kyang de gnyis las mtshar ba ye ma byung skad/ der blon po rnams lkog tu bgros nas sngags mkhan 'dis bod 'bangs kyi ngo mtshar can rnams dang nor bzang po thams cad rgya gar la gtod dam zer/ yang khyung po stag tsha zer ba'i blon po gcig chos la shi ne tu mi dad pa des bsam pa la/ brag dmar 'gran —59—

bzang dang sngags mkhan 'di me la bsreg dgos par 'dug bsams nas slob dpon gyi drung du phyin pa zhig la/ blon po sogs skye bo mang po yod pa'i dbus der khyod 'di lta bu bsam mam zhes gsungs pas/ shin tu ngo tsha zhing phyir song nas mtha'i mon bu 'dis ci yang shes par 'dug zer skad/ yang dbas ldong gzigs zer ba chos la shin tu zhe gnag pa zhig yod pa la/ 'di mi ring bar dbang che bar gyur te chos dar du mi ster ba zhig yong ba 'dug pas tshar gcod pa'i dus la bab 'dug gsungs/ yud tsam zhig dgongs pa mdzad pas kho yang dus de rang du lus nas khrag zags las shi de yang snga phyir mi dang mi ma yin btul ba'i nus mthu rnams mthong bas/ blon po rnams rang rang gi bsam pa ngan pa dang / byed spyod ngan pa byed pa la slob dpon bzhugs pa shin tu bag dogs par gyur te slob dpon rgya gar du 'byon pa'i thabs kho na sems shing yod pa'i skabs/ slob dpon gyi gsung nas/ btsan po khyod kyi yul 'di bzang por bya/ ngam shod kyi bye ma tshal dang ne'u gsing du bya/ gra dang dol dang rta la dang yul po che tshun chad chab med pa rnams su chu dbyung / gram pa thams cad kyang zhing sar 'gyur bar byas la bod kyi 'tsho ba byas/ bai shra ma ṇa la nor blangs 'dzam bu'i gling gi dkor nor yod do cog gi lwa/nga khungs bod du 'byung bar bya/ gtsang po sbubs su 'jug /myong 'di bas che ba gcig kyang ngas sbubs su bcug pa yin gsungs pa dang / rgya dang hor la sogs pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyang bod kyi dbang du 'dus par bya'o sogs bka' mchid rgya cher gsungs pa la/ de ltar 'ong ngam nyams sad pa'i phyir mdzad par zhus —60—

pas/ dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas snga dro gcig dgongs pa mdzad pas brag dmar gyi skams shig tu chu chen po brdol/ ming klu rdzing du btags/ da dung mdzad dgos zhus pas/ brag dmar mtsho mo mgur sngar bye mar yod pa ne'u gseng du sngo cham gyis song / de'i phyir dro brag gla ba'i gdong du nags wo po skad cig la byung bas gla ba'i tshal du ming btags yang de'i sang nyin snga dro dgongs pa mdzad pas/ sngar zung mkhar la phu chu med pa la phu chu chen po nar gyis byung / da zhing sa gang du byed gsungs/ de ltar thams cad 'ong nges par 'dug pas/ blon po rnams kyis mdun sa chung ngur gros byas nas/ zhing dang na yar klung gis chog /sngags mkhan 'dis yul bzang por btang nas rgya gar ba la gtod 'dod pa yin/ de 'phro ba skums la mtha'i mon bu 'di rang yul la brdzangs pa legs zhes dbang che che rnams kha'acham nas btsan po la/ rje gcig lags/ mtha'i mon bu 'di mthu rtsal che/ btsan po thugs ni cho se la gtad/ myong srid ni rgya gar bas phrogs te 'gro bar mchis/ zhes sogs phra ma mang po dang / sngar gyi gsung re re la de ltar byar mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan log pa mang po bkod/ da ni ā tshwa rla sngags mkhan rang la bya dga' cher phul/ slar rgya gar du bzhud pas zhu dgos yang yang zhus/ slob dpon nyid la yang blon po rnams kyi de ltar zhu ba phul/ der btsan po thugs ma bde ste slob dpon la gser phye bre gang phul/ phyag dang bskor ba byas/ rang tshul rnams brjod pas/nga gser 'dod nas 'ongs pa ma yin/ bod mtha' 'khob kyi 'dre srin gdug pa can btul nas chos dar bar bya ba dang / yul bzang por bsgyur nas bod —61—

rnams bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir 'ongs pa yin/ gser 'dod na 'di ltar byas nas chog gsungs nas than kor gyis rdo la phyag reg reg mdzad pa tsam gyis gser du song / 'on kyang btsan po'i ngo bsrung ba'i phyir khyor gang tsam phyag tu bzhes nas/ rdo rje gdan la mchod pa zhig bya gsungs/ lhag ma btsan po nyid la gnang nas/ bzang sems byur gyi sna 'dren yin/ /snying rje rgas pa zhe sdang rgyu/ /rje yi kha lo blon gyis bsgyur/ /bod kyi blon 'dre gdug pa che/ /sems can las ngan spyod pa la/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi nus pa'ang rdugs/ /zhes gsungs te blon po rnams zer ba ltar chad so byas/ rgyal po'i yi dam du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lha lnga phog pa las phyis rgyal pos lha lnga'i nang gi rta mgrin grub/ urla pa lo'i gling gi rta mgrin gyis rta skad bton/ 'dzam bu gling gi gsum gnyis su thos par grags/ urla pa lo'i gling gi rta mgrin gyi sku 'dra de lar sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nas bshad pa der 'dug /de'i tshe man ngag lta phreng gi 'phro yang mdor bsdus te gsungs nas/ nga'i chos 'di lta ba chos kyi sku dang bstun dgos/ spyod pa byang chub kyi phyogs dang bstun dgos/ lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa shor na dge med sdig med kyi chad lta skyes nas phyis gsor yang mi rung pa/ spyod pa'i phyogs su lta ba shor na dngos po'i mawo mas bcings nas grol bar mi 'gyur/ nga'i sems phyogs 'di lta ba shas che bas/ ma 'ongs pa na tshig gi mdo ni shes/ nyams myong gi gdings ni ma rnyed nas 'dra min mang pos sems can gyi don byed par 'dod pa 'ong gsungs/ man ngag rnams kyang mthar rgyas ma rdzogs/ rgyal brgyud mnga' thang 'phel ba'i spyin sreg kyang —62—

mdzad 'phro la lus/ lha klu dam bzhug lan gsum yang ma grub bo/ /'on kyang ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pas slob ma rnams la drag sngags mang du gsungs/ drag sngags mang po dang chos kyi dpe mang po rdza la sbas/ spyir rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas chos dang nor gyi gter kha chen po yongs bsdoms brgya rtsa brgyad yul tha dad du sbas nas mthar 'di skad du/ bdag dang gtan pa med pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ /tshe rabs 'di'am tshe rabs g.yin yang rung / /'og min zhes bya'i gnas mchog dam pa sa /rnal 'byor theg chen 'bras bu spyod par shog /ces smon lam yang yang mdzad/ so so la zhal gyi gdams pa mang du gsungs nas/ glo bur du yar la gshegs te yar lam ru lag brgyud nas phebs/chibs 'khrid pa dang / lo ste dgu sna gong dang / zhang nyang zang zhes bya ba blon po dad pa can de gnyis kyis mang yul bar du skyel bar byas pa las/ blon po kha cig na re/ sngags mkhan de nus pa che bas ma bsad na bod la byad ma byas par 'ongs zer nas lkog tu gshed ma shin tu dpa' ba bco brgyad rta la bskyon nas btang / slob dpon mang gung du byon dus/ nangs par 'u cag la 'tshe ba byed pa 'ong gsungs/ sang nyin dong babs kyi 'phrang la byon dus/ gshed ma bco brgyad mtshon cha lag tu bstar te slob dpon la brdeg par gzas pa tsam la slob dpon gyis phyag rgya bstan pas/ thams cad lus 'jim gzugs bzhin rengs/ ngag smra brjod ma shes/ de'i bar la slob dpon skyel mi dang bcas pa phar gshegs/ de nas skyel ma rnams yul de'i la kha zhig nas tshur ldog pa'i skabs gsung las/ bod kyi 'dre srin lha klu gdug pa can rnams lan —63—

gsum 'dul dgos pas/ gcig 'phro la lus/ de ma lus na rgyal po sku tshe ring / chab srid che/ rgyal po'i rigs brgyud thams cad kyang mnga' thang che/chos yun ring du gnas pa las de lus pa de yid la gcags so/ /chos 'khor gcig lta 'byongs nas 'ong ste der 'khrug pa chen po zhig kyang 'ong / chos la sked nyag bag re 'ong / klu dang rgyal po 'di phugs zhe gnag par 'dug /rgyal brgyud kyang khrims la mi gnas par sil bur 'gro/ kha sang gi 'tshe ba byed mi rnams la 'di gtor zhes yungs kar sbar gang gtad/ lho nub mtshams su srin po 'dul du 'gro gsungs nas/ chibs kyi kha nas nam mkha' la 'phur te sprin gseb na yar chos gos sbur re gseg shang khrol le bzhud par thams cad kyis mthong / 'di'i sa yul ni bod rnams la gung thang la thog yin par grags kyang / dong babs 'phrang gi pha rol yin par bshad pas rgya bod mtshams kyi ri gcig yin pas nges so/ /skyel mi rnams tshur log /gshed ma rnams la yungs kar de gtor bas smra shes 'gro nus par byung ngo / /pho nya gnyis pos kyang slob dpon gyi gsung rnams slar rgyal po'i snyan du phul bas/ btsan po'i thugs la shin tu 'gyod pa gcags par gyur zhing / de skabs slob dpon gyi chos 'phro lus pa rnams gsan pa'i phyir phyis paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra dang / shin+taX gar+bha ched kyis spyan drangs pa yin par bshad do/ /de'i rjes su btsan pos lha khang brtsigs pa lta bur rba bzhed kha skong can nas 'byung ba ni tshig brjod tshul gyi go rim du snang ngo / sngags rnying mar grags pa'i yig rnying kun na ur+sha pa lo'i gling la slob dpon gyis rab gnas mdzad pa dang /—64—

chos 'khor bsam yas kyi sa chog mdzad pa mgrin gcig tu bshad par snang ba 'thad par yang sems la/ des na gong du lha khang brtsigs pa'i thig sna 'dren pa sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang urla pa lo'i gling gi yin par mngon/ rba bzhed na bod yul dbus su zla ba bco brgyad bzhugs bya ba dang / rba bzhed kha skong can na bod yul du zla ba bco brgyad bya ba dang / bla bzhed na zla grangs kyi gas la kha med cing / rgyal bzhed kyi don blangs te bris zer pa'i yig rnying rnams na/ bod yul dbus kyi brag dmar du zla ba bco brgyad bzhugs bya ba yod pas/ dus ring thung la 'dod lugs phra mo ma gtogs gtso bo'i don la mthun no/ /'on kyang sngags rnying ma'i lo rgyus yig rnying khungs che che mang por yang chos 'khor bsam yas yongs su rdzogs pa'i rab gnas kyang mdzad par bshad cing / mkhas mchog bus kyang de dang mthun par bkod do/ /rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas na de yang yin mod/ gdul bya ji tsam gyi snang ngo yin ni ma 'tshal lo/ /dus yun thung du tsam la yang yul thams cad du byon pa dang / de dag tu yang dngos su chos mang po ston pa dang / gter kha mang du sbed pa sogs dang / yul so sor byon pa dang / bzhugs pa dang gshegs pa sogs mdzad pa sna tshogs pa ston pa mi tshar ro snyam du ni bsam par mi bya ste/mtha' yas pa'i rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /phyis kyang skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag gcig gam mang po la yang sku dang gsung gi snang ba thun mong du ston pa dang / skal ldan gyi gang zag shas cher tshogs pa'i yul phyogs la lar dngos su byon pa yang srid de/ 'phags pa'i yul du bi ru pa dang / pū —65—

yi pa dang / dza lan+ta ri pa la sogs pa lan mang du byon zhing / phyis byung rang yang byon pa bzhin no/ /yang rgya gar lho phyogs nas nub drang thad du gru brgal te 'gro dgos pa'i sa rgya mtsho'i dbus kyi gling chung ḍā mi to dī pa zhes bya ba yod de/ sngon srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma nam mkha' la lding zhing 'gro ba kho nas gang ba yin pas ḍā mi to ste 'gro lding ngo / /dus de'i tshe yang bud med shas che ba zhig ni gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rig sngags sna tshogs pa byed pa'i phyir sngags 'chang ma zhes bya ba de 'dra yin la/ skyes pa yang 'byung po mi'i gzugs can mang po yod do/ /der slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas yul gyi skye bo rnams 'dul bar bzhed de gling de'i brag phug gcig tu bzhugs/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa btang pas/ yul de'i bdag mo ma mo drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sprul pa rgyal po'i btsun mo sngags 'chang ma drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pas de rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus dngos su bkug nas/ sngags dang phyag rgya drag pos gzir bas brgyal ba dang / rengs pa dang / tshor ba drag po gnad du phog par gyur/ da sbyin sreg gi thab tu bsreg go zhes bsdigs pas de rnams thul te slob dpon ci gsung sgrub par khas blangs so/ /de rnams la sngags 'chang ma'i gtso mo gzhan thams cad kyang bsdur bcug nas thams cad 'dus pa la chos bstan te dam bzhag dang po mdzad do/ /lan cig slob dpon grong khyer du bzhud pa la/ sngags 'chang ma mang pos 'dzam bu gling gi mi mang po khrid nas za bar gzigs te/ yang brag phug cig tu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs/mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang med du bkug nas bsdigs pas de rnams —66—

bros par brtsams pa la/ thams cad kyi yan lag la phur bus btang/ phyin chad 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams la gnod pa mi byed pa'i mna' bor ro/ /de rnams la sems bskyed phog ste dam ba 'ag gnyis pa mdzad do/ /yang dus gzhan zhig na mgron khang zhig tu byon pas/ de na bud med mang po snod mang por chu skol gyin 'dug pa ji zhig na chu rnams la la khrag tu 'gro/ la la tshil du 'gro/ la la thig ler 'gro/ la la sha chen du 'gro/ la la mar khur 'gro/la la bu ram du 'gro/ la la 'bru rman du 'gro/ la la chang du 'gro ba sogs gzigs nas de rnams la dris pas/ slob dpon yin pa ngo ma shes te/ 'di dag ni 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams kyi lus bcud zas bcud bkug pa yin zer/ khyod rnams kyis slob dpon pad+ma ā ka ra'i drung du mna' bor ba ma yin nam byas pas/ nged rnams kyi dpon mos mna' bor yang kho mo cag gis ma bor ro zer bas/ yang sngar gyi ri phug der dkyil 'khor gyis sngags 'chang ma gtso 'khor bsdus pas 'bum phrag bcu gnyis byung skad de/ thams cad kyi srog sngags dang sgrub thabs blangs/ gtso mo rnams dkyil 'khor du bcug/'khor rnams la sems bskyed phog /thams cad kyang mna' 'dor du bcug ste dam bzhag gsum pa mdzad do/ /gzhan yang yul de'i gnod sbyin dang srin po dang glu gdug pa can rnams kyang btul/ yi dwags pa rbu re zhes bya ba yul de'i rgyal po'i pho lha gdug rtsub che ba zhig yod kyang / rgyal po btul na de yang zhor la thul bar mkhyen nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i phyir/ mi rnams kyang 'dul dgos par dgongs te rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye ba'i nags zhig tu —67—

bzhugs/ der rgyal po'i btsun mo thams cad dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i gzungs ma'i don du ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus yang yang bkug pas/ rgyal pos kyang btsun mo rnams mi sdod par shes nas phal pa'i gzugs su bsgyur nas phyi bzhin du 'brangs pas/ de rnams slob dpon gyi mtha' bskor nas 'dug pa mthong ngo / /nangs par rgyal po dmag dang bcas pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te slob dpon/ 'joms su 'ongs pa na/ slob dpon gyis yungs kar gtor bas rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi go cha dang mtshon cha rnams ni tshig /mi thams cad kyang yan lag nas khrag 'dzag cing lus rengs/ ngag lkugs/ sems myos te zhag gsum lus/ de nas 'chi ba la thug pa na/ skye bo thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyis bum pa'i chus bkrus pas skad cig la thams cad bde bar gsos so/ /de nas rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis kyang zhabs la phyag btsal/ slob dpon gyi gsung bzhin bsgrub par byas pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa tshugs shig gsung / yul dbus ma ga dh+wa nas 'dul ba mkhan po dang / mdo sde mkhan po dang / mngon pa mkhan po spyan drangs/ bi dh+wa zhes bya ba dang / aṅgā zhes bya ba dang / su dh+wa zhes bya ba ste gtsug lag khang gsum bzhengs/ rab gnas slob dpon gyis mdzad/ sde snod gsum gyi bshad pa dang lag len rkang tshugs pa btsugs/ slob dpon nyid kyis ni yul der mdo lugs kyi theg pa gzhan ni cher ma gsungs/ rgyal po 'khor bcas la chos kyi gdams pa mang du gsungs/ skal pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma drug la rgyud drug bshad/ rdzogs rim dang las tshogs mang du gsung / slob ma drug pos kyang —68—

grub pa thob bo/ /yul so so na lha khang chung ngu lnga tsam bzhengs te thams cad chu tshod gcig la dus gcig tu grub pa yin skad/ de ltar yul der lo bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs nas mthar bla gos kyis gsho/ga pa'i tshul du byas nas nam mkha'i lam las gya gyur gshegs nas lho nub rnga yab srin po'i gling du bzhud do zer/ lo bcu gnyis zhes pa phyed lo yin nam snyam mo/ /deng sang 'gro lding gi gling na dpal zla gsang thig le'i rgyud la bshad sgrub byed tshad slob dpon 'di'i lugs kho na yin la/ de bzhin du rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen mo dang / phyag rdor dang / rdo rje gaṇ+ḍa ri/ gshin rje gshed dang rta mgrin dang / nag po r+ṣa po dang / ma mo bdun sogs kyi rgyud dang / rtog pa chung ngu mang du yod cing / yul de na mahā ga ni zer ba'i sde gcig yod par snang ba slob dpon ye shes zhabs kho na'i rjes 'brang yin zhing / ye shes zhabs thugs sras bzhi dang bcas pa'i gsung kho na la rtsis su che bas/ de rnams la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lugs srol dges rdor dang / dpal mchog dang po dang / gong du smos pa de rnams shin tu dar bar yod/ rgyud de dag dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag kyang slob dpon 'dis mdzad yod par snang ngo / /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dam gzhag dang po mdzad pa'i gnas de la ma pas+thā zer/ brag la phyag gis bcos pa'i me thab yod/ dam gzhag phyi ma gnyis mdzad pa'i gnas la u lpa sna zer te/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phur bus btab pa'i phur bu'i rjes stong phrag tsam dang / grub pa'i phur bu de rnams skye bo phal ba'i spyod yul du mi sdod pas gzhan rnams —69—

yal kyang / gcig ma 'ongs pa'i sems can yid ches pa'i don du ye shes pa slob dpon gyi sku la bstims nas rdzas kyi phur bu bzhag pa yin zer ba rgyu rdo shing zangs lcags sogs gang du yang mtshon du med pa/ bcos ma mi 'dra ba'i rang byon lta bu che khyad mi'i bongs sum 'gyur tsam zhig yod cing / de yang dang po shing la bcos pa'i phur bu chung ngu re yod pa la/ de 'grub pa'i dus rab tu 'phel zhing che chung blos gang byas su 'gro ba 'gro 'ong dang gsung gi snang ba sogs lha dngos dang 'dra ba/ 'bar 'phreng 'khrigs pa zhig tu gyur la/ de skabs phra men sngags 'chang ma'i gtso mo zhig lus ri rgyal tsam du bsgyur nas bros par brtsams pa la/ phur bu de yang ri bo tsam du gyur nas btab/ slar ye shes pa slob dpon gyi sku la bstim pas 'od 'phro ba dang me 'bar ba sogs zhi nas lhag ro lus pa'i tshul du de ltar gyur skad do/ /de ltar slob dpon 'di'i gtam rgyud grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i gsung rgyun sogs 'phags yul na grags pa thor re ba dang / de las kyang zhib cing rgyas par 'gro lding gi slob dpon lha'i 'byung ldan las brgyud pa de gnyis kyi dngos slob rnams kyi zhal las dngos su thos pa rnams dang / bod du 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshul yig rnying khungs ma mang po zhal mthun par byung ba rnams mchog tu yid ches par bzung ste bkod pa yin la/ 'gro lding gi yul las byung ba rgya gar mkhas pa las brgyud nas slob dpon 'di'i gdams ngag sna re tsam yang thos shing / lo rgyus kyi yi ge ni 'phags yul las byung ba bdag cag gis dngos su mthong yang kho bo cag gi bla ma paṇa grub de rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gtam rgyud kyi yi ge —70—

gtogs pa dang / 'gro lding gi yul du chos dar ba'i gtam rgyud kyi yi ge sogs kyi nang na yod pa'ang mang du gzigs shing / mkhas grub skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gsung sgros dri ma med pa rnams gung bstun pa ste/ de ltar na gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di la dbri zhing dor bar bya rgyu cung zad kyang med la/ ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud bden pa'i don can bsnan par bya rgyu ni mang du 'byung ngo / /'phags yul gyi gtam las kyang slob dpon 'dis hu ra mu dzu zhes bya ba'i gling dang / si ko dha ra dang / dha na ko sa dang / drag ma la sogs par yang byon te 'gro ba'i don mdzad do zhes 'byung yang de dag gi lo rgyus ma rnyed pa dang / bod kyi chos gdams ngag so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i don dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar che ba mang po'ang mthong mod kyi 'dir ha cang mang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ma bris pa bzhin no/ /'dir smras pa/ blo chung 'ga' res blun dad kho nas 'gro rnams dad pa spel phyir rang bzo gtam rgyud mang po sbyar/ /skye bo phal cher shin tu rmongs pas bden min tshig don legs pa min la'ang dad pa 'phel srid mod/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis mthong thos gyur tshe khrel bdas byed cing de yi rgyu las chos dang skyes bu ni/ /rnam dag kun la'ang the tshom zar 'jug 'di ni bdud kyi las yin 'di las gnod pa che ba'ang gang / /deng 'dir ngo mtshar gtam la yid gnyis spangs shing ha cang thal ba'i che ba brjod pa'ang ma yin mod/ /gtam gyi sbyor ba nyung ngu 'dis kyang rang bzo'i glegs bam chen po'i gtam dag lan brgyar zil gyis mnan/ /'di bris dge bas bdag kyang mgon po —71—

de yi go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun thar par 'dren gyur cig /gsal dag yid ches gtam 'di smra ba'ang nges par mgon de'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa kho nas so/ /'jig rten grags rjes 'brangs dang phra ma snga btsan can/ /de rnams tshul 'di mos snyam bdag la re ba'ang med/ bdag dang bdag tshig rjes 'brang rnams kyi dad pa'i rkyen/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyi yid dang rna ba'i bdud rtsi yin// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa yid ches gsum ldan zhes bya ba 'di yang / rang dang lhan cig gnas shing rgyu ba gtsang spyon kun dga' dpal bzang zhes bya bas bskul zhing rang nyid kyi dad pa'i gsos su 'gyur bar bsams nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu so drug pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ /

rnam par rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oX swā sti pra dza khyuX dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mgon po stag lung ba chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma mchog gi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus thams cad du brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ dpal ldan mchog tu rtag brtan gzhom med sku/ /brjod bral sgra dbyangs kun la 'jug 'gyur gsung / /lhun 'grub bde stong ji snyed gzigs pa'i thugs/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad khyod phyag gi gnas/ /rab brtan byang chub sems kyi gzhir/ /rmad byung phan bde'i lo tog dag /mtha' yas bskal bar mi zad pa/ /bskrun mdzad bla ma mchog 'di rgyal/ /e yig kun ldan stong pa'i khrir/ /waX yig bde chen rang rgyal po/ /zung 'jug lhan skyes rang bzhin dngos/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud/ /thog med rdzu 'phrul bsgrod pa can/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin dpag yas kyi/ /'phrin las kun khyab gar yang son/ /sgyu 'phrul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gags med gzhom du med pa'i tshul/ /brjod bral sgra dbyangs thams cad pa/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin 'jug /'gro mgon gsung la phyag bgyi'o/ /rang bzhin dag pa rnam mi rtog /lhun 'grub 'bad rtsol bral ba'i —73—

dbyings/ /ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs/ /rje btsun thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'gro kun dga' ba'i ba spya shis chos sgo rab gsal thar pa'i rgyal mtshan dpūl ldan snying rje baṭīng sto can/ /kun nas dga' bas mtha' bral stong nyid ba spya shis lam mchog rgyal ba'i mtshan gyi dpāl 'bar kun tu bzang po'i lam/ /skal ldan kun la dga' bzhi'i lam ston bkra shis bdud las rgyal ba'i mtshan mchog srid zhi'i dpal yon baṭīng bho pa/ /kun tu rab dga' ba grwa shis rtsibs stong rab bkra zhabs bzung chos kyi rgyal mtshun skye 'gro'i dpāl gyur bzung stor 'dud/ /chad pa med pa'i dus kyi mtha' yang mngon par byang chub zag bral 'gyur med dus kyi nges pa ste/ /slar yang nges par mtha' yas khams su ngo mtshar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed mdzad pa rgya chen dang / /gzhan du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dang kha cig tu ni nyan thos de bzhin rang byang chub pa'i tshul/ /'phrog byed mes po sred med bu dang mi sbyin rgyas pa dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo bum pa bzang / /tha dad yi ge dang ni rigs byed sna tshogs rigs sngags gzhan yang chu bo gzing dang zam pa sogs/ /'byung ba 'byung 'gyur sems can khams te mtha' dag gzugs kyis sprul pa sgyu ma'i drwa ba mdzad pa 'dir/ /rtog ge'i blo gros sna tshogs tshig gis 'jug pa'i go skabs nam yang ma mchis tshangs sogs lha rnams kyang / /byol song nyid bzhin lung dang rig pa'i khengs ldan dag kyang mu cor rang bzhin byas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /de slad bla ma mchog rjes bzung gang khengs btang ste/ /rab tu ye shes bdud rtsi cung zad rnyed gyur na/ /gnas 'di yon to rgya —74—

mtsho yin zhes shes gyur gyi/ /rang bzor dpyad pas nyams pa'i ri bo 'di dag rmongs/ /gang gi drin gyis bskyed pa'i chu skyes dga'/ /tshig snyan ze'u 'khru rgyas pas nyer brgyan mod/ /log pa'i kun rtog ge sar rdul rgyas pa'i/ /thugs mtsho rnyog byed de yang mgon khyod kyi/ /thugs rjes byang chub bar du rjes bzung nas/ /gnod pa las kyang bde ba'i 'bras 'dir mtshar/ /blo zhan phan chen btags pa'ang 'bras med de/ /dam par gnod pa'i lan yang phan par spyod/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshul 'dzin pa/ /'dren pa 'dren mchog rnams kyis gus btud cing / /blo ldan blo gros chen po'i lam ston pa/ /gsung mchog gsung gi bdag po khyed la bstod/ khyod kyi yon tan 'phrin las ni/ /bsam mi khyab ces 'dir ston gyi/ /re re nas brjod ngal ba ni/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis ci phyir brten/ /de la kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa don gyis slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun dam pa a nan+da maṅga la zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa 'di nyid ni/shes dang shes bya gcig pu'i sku/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi bdag nyid/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin sku bzhi'i ngo bor/ ye shes lnga'i rnam rol/ rgyu drug gi 'gro ba sgrol bar mdzad pa/ 'jig rten bdun las yongs su 'das pa'i zhing khams can 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ston pa/ yan lag dgu dang ldan pa'i gsungs rab kyi sgra sgrog pa/ sa bcu rnam par gnon pa'i dbang phyugabaden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / de nyid rnam par bcu drug zung du 'jug pa/rnam pa nyi shus mngon par byang chub pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus nye bar brgyan pa/ rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor spro ba/ bsam gyis mi —75—

khyab pa mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snang brnyan chad pa med pa'i zhing rnams su mu mtha' med pa'i bskal par brjod du med pa'i tshul gyis 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /tha snyad kyi tshad mas ni gzhal mi spyod do/ /'on kyang cung zad thos pa dag cig gleng na/ grub mchog stong gis zhabs zung nyer mchod pa/ /mchog gyur mkhas pa lnga brgyas gus pas mchod/ /phyogs bzhis mu stegs pham mdzad mkha' la gshe/gas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par bzung / /'jam dbyangs rang nyid 'jam dbyangs sras po'i tshul/ /srid gsum sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa'i lha/ /byang chub sems dpa' lam bzang spyod pa'i mchog /srid gsum phyogs bcur gsal bar mdzad ces thos/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi sras 'jam dpal nyid kyis sprul par grags pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha zhes bya ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyis mu stegs thams cad btul zhing / mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis theg chen gyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad cing / rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad de zung 'jug 'ja' lus kyi sku brnyes pa des/ gangs ri'i khrod du yang srid bzung ba'i tshul mdzad pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal yin te/༈ dal 'byor nor 'dzin lhag bsam ljon pa'i brgyan/ /byang chub sems kyi yal 'dab phyogs bcu rgyas/ /don gnyis 'bras bzang mngon par brdol ba 'dis/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba thams cad mgron du gnyer/ /dam pa 'di ni bdag bas gzhan gces kyi thugs bcos ma ma yin la chung ja'i dus nas mnga' zhing /gzhan gyis ma bstan par pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'jug pa la sogs pa byang —76—

sems 'phags pa'i chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sogs pa so so skye bo phal gye mthun snang du grub par mnga' ba/ lung rig smra ba'i dbang phyug yin zhing / rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i tshul mdzad de/ lo rgyus rgyas par gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yongs su khyab pa'i rnam thar rnams su shes par bya'o/ / gzhan yang theg chen chos kyi rgyal po yang / dam pa 'di nyid dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan don rtags dang bcas pa mang du snang ngo / /gang 'di sa chen dam chos dang / /srid kyi phun sum tshogs mdzad pa/ /'di lta gzhan ni ma mchis te/ /theg chen chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ /de tshe 'jungs ldan chen po 'gas/ /rang gi rdzas kyis rang nyid bcom/ /gang 'di chos 'byor 'phel ba dang / /yun ring 'tsho zhing bzhes pa lags/ /de ltar rim par brgyud de slar yang dbu ru byang phyogs 'dir/ rtogs ldan bsod nams dbang phyug ces bya bar skye ba bzhes te/mgul gyi ngos la dpa' bo'i rtags mtshan rme ba dmar pos mtshan pa las dpag te/ skye bo rnams kyis byu ru ske zhes bla dwags su mtshan gsol ba zhig ste/de ni grub lung gi ri khrod du gtso bor bzhugs pa/ shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing / myur mdzad mgon po dang mi lab pa bzhin yod pa/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing / sgrib pa med pa'i mngon shes kyis lung ston pa sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ shes cher mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i bya rog dang lhan cig rtsed mo mdzad cing / nyid kyis mda' chung ngu 'phen par mdzad par bya rog gis gshog pa brkyangs nas len par mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar gyis rol ba mtha' yas pa ston pa yod par snang ngo / /

dpag yas rdzu 'phrul rol rtsed la/ khren tu ngo mtshar 'gyur ba ci/ /sgron me gtams la 'od gsal ba/ /spyi lugs 'di la ci zhig dpyod/ / 'on kyang thugs rje'i ri mo rnam bkra ba/ /ji bzhin lta byed dag pa'i mig 'di mtshar/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes yis kyang gzhal dka' ba'i/ /rnam thar mthong ba 'di yang de yis mthu/ /༈ de nyid nas sku yi skye ba bar ma chad pa byon pa ni rje btsun 'di yin no/ /rnam 'dren gser gyi 'dab rgyas stong gis rab brgyan pa'i/ /zhing bzang bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho mi ma rjed ces grags pa/ /gang 'di'i rgyun gyur go tam rigs 'khrungs shākya'i sras/ /legs 'khrungs 'dzam bu'i sgra ldan dbyig 'dzin snying po 'di/ khres bya'i gnas la thogs med mthu ldan dang / /dngos grub lang tsho rgyas pa'i skal bzang can/ /rgyu skar grangs kyis nye bar mi dpog pas/ /lan brgyar phyag byas srid gsum ma lus pa/ /kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur mngon mchod cing / /rig sngags 'chang gi 'khor lo bsgyur gcig pu/ /bde chen lam gyis mngon par byang chub pa/ /sa bdag mi dbang iṇ+ḍa bhu ti ste/ /ma rig spyod pa'i 'dam rdzab las ring du/ /rab grol bsod nams gzi 'od brgya 'bar 'di/ /rgyal srid legs byas dbang gi ring mo nas/ /srid pa'i nags su 'bad rtsol bral bas rnyed/ /rgyal po chos bzhi spyod pa'i tshe/ khang bzang rtse mo nyer brten pas/ /dgra bcom dge slong mchod 'os rnams/ /bla gos 'char ka'i snang ba yi/ /zhing 'di'i mun pa kun 'joms shing / /phyogs grol bde ba'i lam yangs las/ /'ong zhing 'gro ba mthong ba na/ /sngon bsags legs byas shing rta —78—

yis/ /yid mkhar dad pa'i 'od stong drangs/ /de nas rgyal la dad pa yis/ /mchod bcas gsol ba btab par gyur/ /mngon shes drug gi spyan ldan gang / /srid 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad kyis/ /nyer brgyan 'khor bcas lha yi lam/ /go skabs dman pas nyer byon tshe/ /mchod pa'i ya mtshan ci yang sprul/ /gnyis med gsungs la mi dbang gis/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyu zhes pas/ /sa bdag rab tu byung nas ni/ /bslab gsum rin chen zung zhig gsungs/ /de zhus bskal pa brgya yis ni/ /don chen 'grub la ngo mtshar ci/ /bcom ldan gyis ni 'bad gyur na/ /ri rgyal thal bar byed ces mchi/ /zas gcod bsnyun dang gtar dpyad sogs/ /ngal ba 'bum gyis nad bsal yang / /grags pa'i 'byor pa dman pa des/ /sman dang sman pa nyid tshor byas/ /'bad med bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /bdud rtsis 'bras bu nad 'phrog byed/ /rigs sngags kho nas nad 'joms sogs/ /sngags dang sman 'di ya mtshan rmad/ /goms pa'i sems ni bzlog dka' bas/ /rgyal ba khyed ni thams cas da mkhyen/ /de phyir 'dod pas byang chub mchog /thob 'gyur gang yin bdag la gsungs/ /de nas ngur smrig thun mtshams kyi/ /dmar 'od rnam par nyams las slar/ /dpag yas dkyil 'khor 'od dkar brgya/ /rab spros gang sku'i zla ba ni/ /rig ma ri bong mawo mas 'khyud/ /rig 'dzin rgyu skar tshogs bcas shar/ /des der mi bdag dbang bskur nas/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes ze'u 'khru rgyas/ /mtha' dag gsang sngags mdangs bkra ba'i/ /rig 'dzin 'dab rgya'i g.yogs pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang ba de yis ni/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i gsang sngags mdzod/ /mtha' dag bzung zhing mngon —79—

bstan pas/ /mi dang mi min kun grol te/ /grog sbur rdo rje 'dzin thob na/ /de las gzhan pa ci zhig gtam/ /phyi nas yun ring 'das pa'i 'og /o rgyan zhes pa'i yul mchog der/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po ste/ /slar yang mi bdag tshul bzung nas/ /lwa ba'i zhabs dang mtsho skyes zhabs/ /lhan cig sngags kyi lam ston zhing / /mtha' yas skye bos dngos grub thob/ /de nas phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /slar yang mkha' 'gro'i gling mchog der/ / sa bdag dbang po'i blon gyur nas/ /rdo rje theg pa rgyas bstan te/ /sngags rgyud mkha' dang mnyam par byas/ /de ltar na dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang ba gsang sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i slad du/ mi yi bdag po'i tshul bzung iṇ+ḍa bhu ti zhes pa'i mtshan 'chang ba lan gsum byon pa lags te/ de nyid shin tu snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba dmu rgod rnams 'dul ba'i slad du/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal po zhes grags pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i skur nye bar bstan pa ste/'gro ba'i mgon po nyid kyis/ rjes thang pa rin po bkra shis dpal la bka' bstsal par yang / iṇ+ḍa bhu ti gsum byung ba la thog mtha' gnyis nga yin/ bar ma khyod yin/ lar gsum ka ngo bo gcig ces gsungs te/ de'i phyir 'gro ba'i mgon po 'di'i rnam par sprul ba ni/ ji skad du/ rgyud las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /zhes pa ltar/ bdag nyid kyi drung du gnas pa chos las 'khrungs pa'i sras kyi thu bor mngon par dbang bskur ba 'gro mgon stag lung thang pa chen po bkra shis dpal zhes mtshan yongs su —80—

grags pa 'di nyid yin te/ 'di nyid gcig pur ma zad/ dpal stag lung thang gi seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi gnas brnyes pa mtha' dag kyang sprul pa dang yang sprul dang sum sprul dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprul pa'i tshul gyi sku tha dad par bstan pa tsam ma gtogs ngo bo tha dad par mi bsam mo/ /de yang ye shes chen po gcig pu gnyis su med pa'i zlos gar las/ 'gro ba'i don rgya cher spyod pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa mchog gi tshul bzung ba so so'i skye bo rnams kyi snang ngor zhing dang gdul bya tha dad par snang ba can/ gzhal bar mi spyod pa'i snang brnyan/ brgyud pa nas brgyud par rang byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin lags te/ nam mkha' zla ba gcig pu shar ba'i tshe yul dang gnas tha dad pa'i chu bo/ rgya mtsho rdzing bu/ ldeng ka snod kyi chu tha dad pa rnams dang / sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'i chu thigs gcig tshun chad la yang de nyid kyis gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin no/ /des na bdag cag gi rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di yang / mnyam med thang pa chen po nyid dang thugs gnyis su med par nges shing /de nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'am/ rgyal po chen po iṇ+ḍa bhu ti dang mi gnyis pa'i rang bzhin can dang / yang gcig tu na/ skal bzang gi 'dren pa stong gi thog ma bde bar gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig nyid yin par yang gyur te/'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo grub pa nyid kyi bka' yang dag pa'i tshad mas grub pa nyid yin no/ /der ma zad rgyal sras zhi ba lha ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis rnam par sprul pa yin pa dang / dpal stag lung thang pa chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis rnam 'phrul te/ rgyal ba'i sras po chen po thogs med bzang —81—

po dpal de nyid kyang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ye shes chen po'i rnam 'phrul du grags shing grub pa'i phyir kho bo cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs spyi'i gzugs rgyal ba'i sras po gzhon nu'i sku 'chang ba 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / thugs rje chen po phyag na pad+mo can dang / gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje gsum char gyi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul gcig pu ste/ de dag mi 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan yang /rigs gsum gyi sems dpa' 'di rnams lhas sbyin dang mchod spyin ltar rgyud tha dad pa ni ma yin te/ dus gsum gyi bde bar zugashegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi spyi gzugs chen po yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdo rje gang yin pa de nyid gsung dang thugs kyang yin pa'i phyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas 'dir ni/ rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas/ mchog tu gus pa chen pos chad pa med pa'i dus kyi mthar/ zhing gi rdul snyed du rnam par sprul pa'i lus kyis phyag 'tshal bar rigs kyi mkhas pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis/rtog ge'i rig pas 'jug pa ni nyag phran gyi rtse mos chu gter gyi gting mtha' tshol ba bzhin no/ /smras pa/ chos rnams rang bzhin mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /ye shes rang bzhin mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /sgo gsum mdzad pa mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /rnam 'phrul 'jug pa mkha' 'dra gzhal du med/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gnas 'di la/ /bdag cag dad pas rtogs bya yi/ khres rab dman pa'i me khyer gyis/ /mdzad pa'i 'jig rten ji ltar gsal/ /srid gsum 'jig rten —82—

bdun la sogs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams rang bzhin ni/ /gnyis med brjod bral bsam du med/ /rnam pa ma 'gags cir yang snang / /rang bzhin gsal stong 'gags med phyir/ /rang bzhin 'bras bu mngon gyur pa'i/ /rnam thar brjod bral bsam yas 'di/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i rgyu/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /nam mkha' las byung nam mkha'i dngos/ /phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' bzhin/ /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /'byung ba 'di dag bsam med cing / /'bad rtsol med pa phyogs bcu yis/ /sems can kun gyi nyer 'tshe dang / /rang rang las la ma 'dres 'jug /ji ltar sa rdul tshad med pa/ /rang rang ma 'dres bya ba la/ /rnam rtog med cing 'jug gyur pa/ /mgon khyod 'phrin las de dang mtshungs/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho rlabs g.yo ba/ /chu rlabs rnam 'gyur tha dad cing / /rang bzhin rgya mtsho gcig pur 'jug /rgyal khyod rgya mtsho dang mtshungs te/ /mgon po kun gzhi gnas gyur brnyes/ /rang bzhin mi shes byis pa rnams/ /chu rlabs rgya mtsho ji bzhin du/ /dbyings dang rnam 'phrul so sor rtogs/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig khar bas sa gzhi ri bcas kun/ /cig car snang bar byed gyur cing / /las rnams sna tshogs byed gyur te/ /lo thog smin par byed pa dang / /skem dang rgyas dang 'ju ba dang / /pad+ma la sogs kha 'byed pa/ /'di la rnam par rtog pa med/ /pad+ma'i mtsho dang zhing sa dang / /nyi ma'i 'jug bya g.yin dang g.yin/ /gang rnams de dag kun la ni/ / 'od zer gcig 'jug tha dad med/ /nyid kyi ye shes 'jug pa yang / /gcig pu 'jig rten 'dir shar bas/ /mos pa so so'i sems can gyi/ /bsam pa tha dad sna —83—

tshogs 'jug /bsam gyis mi khyab gnas 'di la/ /'ju ga sel dbyig gi snying po dang / /ral pa can yang phyugs dang mtshungs/ /pa na ta pa na ta gzhon nu dang / /rgyas pa grogs mkhar i gi ras/ /mi byin ser skya mar kan ṭi/ /ne tso 'od srung kā ta'i bu/ /de dag rgyu ma'i shin tu 'khor/ /mgon po khyod kyi gnas 'di ni/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba kho nas mkhyen/ /sa 'di rgyu dang mi rgyu kun/ /rten zhing gnas pa'i gzhi yin pa/ /de bzhin brtan g.yo thams cad kyi/ /bskyed ma gzhi ni mgon khyod lags/ /yon tan thams cad bskyed mdzad pa'i/ /zla med sa gzhi khyod la 'dud/ /mgon po khyod mtshungs phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ste/ khyod nyid rgyal ba lags pas dpe ma rnyed/ /dpe med mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku/khyab bdag rdo rje sems khyod phyag gi gnas/ /'di dag ni sngon gyi sku'i skyed rabs la brtsams te dam pa'i yon tan ci rigs pa bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te dang po'o //da ni sku'i skye ba 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshul so so'i skye bo dag la thun mong du snang ba zhig brjod par bya ste/ de la gang du sku'i skye ba bzung ba'i yul ni/tha snyad 'jig rten gyi gtsug lag la/ yongs su grags pa'i dge bcu'i lus yongs su rdzogs shing / khyad par du yang bde ba 'byor pa skye bo mang pos yongs su gang ba/ yul tha dad pa'i skye bo mtha' yas pa'i rang rang gi zong dang 'dod dgu'i longs spyod thams cad mngon par thogs te lang long tu rgyu bas ra ba dang srang thams cad mdzes par byas pa/ skye bo thams cad kyang gcig tu dge ba la mngon par dga' zhing / sku gzugs dang / mchod rten dang / glegs bam dang /—84—

dge 'dun dag la lta ci smos/ ngur smig gi rtags cung zad tsam 'chang ba la yang bdag cag gi yon gnas dam pa'o/ /zhes lan brgyar phyag bgyid pa sogs dad pa'i nor gyis phyug pa/ yul 'khor thams cad chos smra ba 'khor dang bcas pas yongs su gang ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khud pa/ 'phan yul rigs pa'i 'byung gnas sa'i cha/ spras zhes bya ba'i yul 'jig rten gsum gyi dge legs thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen po ste/ der dam pa 'di'i yab tu gyur pa ni/ dpal stag lung thang pa chen po'i dpon gyi rigs/ rigs sngags 'chang ba rnams kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ chos bzhin pas sa skyong ba'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' chen po bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di nyid kyang lhag pa'i lha bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje dang / rdo rje phur pa sa lugs dang /bde mchog lhan skyes dang / mahā ka la tsa shun bhu dza'i bzlas brjod kyi mthar son zhing / skye 'gro gdon gyis gtses pa la sngags 'debs pa dang / byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis nad gdon ma lus pa zhi bar 'gyur ba sogs byin rlabs kyi gzi byin lhag par rgyas pa/ 'bangs rnams thams cad bde bar bskyangs bas thams cad kyis kyang pha ma'am/ mkhan po'am/ slob dpon mchog gi bzhin du gus pas blta ba/ 'thab pa dang rtsod pa med par byams pa'i ngang tshul kho nas 'gran zla thams cad kyang gus pas 'dud par byed pa zhig ste/yum du gyur pa ni sde pa chen po dga' ba'i sras mo bde skyid byā 'dren zhes bya ba ji skad bshad pa'i bud med kyi skyon thams cad ni spangs/ yon tan thams cad kyi mngon par brgyan pa ste/ rigs dang / gzugs dang / blo gros dang / 'byor —85—

ba dang bsod nams kyi dpal dang ldan pa sgo gsum shin tu bsrung ba'i rang bzhin can zhig ste/ yab yum gnyis la sras lnga dang lcam gnyis te/ mched bdun gyi rting ma bdun pa ni dam pa 'di yin te/ me pho sprel 'u'i lo la dge mtshan thams cad kyis mngon par spras te sku bltams so/ /de yang rje 'di nyid lhums su zhugs pa nas brtsams te/ chang 'og thams cad bde zhing lo legs pa dang / dge mtshan gyi ltas 'ga' zhig gong nas gong du mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur zhing / sku bltams pa na yang yum la gnod pa med cing / me tog gi char 'babs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas gzhal du med pa 'jig rten 'dir 'byung ngo / /༈ sum rtsen gnas pa'i dge mtshan kun/ /sa steng 'jig rten 'dir 'phos pa/ /bsod nams— mthu las mngon 'grub kyi/ khyu gzhan dag gis ga la zhig /mdongs mtha'i 'dab mas mchog tu legs brgyan pa/ /mar gad zhi ba 'khyil 'dra'i nor 'dzin nam/ /srid gsum mdzes pa'i yon tan kun mdzes te/ /skyon med gnas kyi mdzes sdug thams cad 'phrogs/ /ljon shing bu mo gnyen lcug lo 'dab bgos/ /rab 'bar me tog mchog dga'i mig gi zer/ /phyogs kun zur mig g.yo ldan bcud bzang 'bras/ /nu rgyas 'dod pa'i longs spyod dag gis mdzes/ /rnam bkra grong khyer ba dan brgyan spras pa/ /nyi zla skar bcas sa la 'khod pa snyam/ /'phrog byed dga' ma'i dbyangs kyi rjes snyeg pa/ /sgra 'di khyad par 'phags phyir sum rtsen grong/ /mkhar nyal rnams ni bag med chang gis myos/ /legs byas bdud rtsis rol pas 'di nyid mchog /rgyal khyod —86—

dgyes rol 'di nyid 'og min te/ /gzhan nas tshol ba'i ngal ba deng 'dir zad/ /rgyal ba yum kun shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dmigs med thugs rje gang yin deng 'dir yab/ /rdo rje'i sku la srid pa'i pha ma med/ /'gro ba'i mgon po sprul ba'i sgyu ma mdzad/ /de nas sku bltams ma thag dpal stag lung thang pa chen po rje rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi snyan du phul zhing mtshan gnang bar zhus pas/mchog tu dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal dang bcas/ bkra shis don 'grub zhes mtshan don dang ldan pa gsol zhing / bsrung skud dang gtor ma'i byin rlabs sogasakyang zab rgyas su bstsal/ ma ma rnams kyis gtsang sbra'i spyod lam dang ldan pa'i sku bskyed bsrings pas mtsho'i nang gi pad+ma 'am/ char chu rgyas pa'i chu bo'am/ zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gang sku'i lang tsho mchog tu mngon par brtas par gyur/ de nas smra mkhyen tsam na yang sku'i rtse grogs gzhan dag gi srog chags la 'tshe ba sogs sdig pa'i las la spyod pa dag che thang du bzlog par mdzad cing / ma ṇi bzlas pa la sogs chos spyod dang dge ba'i rim pa la bdag nyid rtsol zhing gzhan yang bskul bar mdzad pa dang sku chas phra mo tshun chad kyang so so la sbyin par mdzad pa dang / skabs gzhan dang gzhan du sa stegs dang khri'u dag la mngon par 'khod nas/ chos 'chad pa dang dbang bskur ba ltar mdzad pa dang /res 'ga' ni sku lus gnad dang ldan pas nang la mchog tu gzhol ba ltar yang mdzad nas/ mdor na 'di ni ma bstan par spyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang /don mthun pa dang / don spyod pa sde bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la 'jug pa zhes/byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos yin par —87—

'phags pa rnam par 'phrul pas zhus pa'i mdo las byung ba bzhin yin no/ /gzhan yang mdzad pa thams cad chos kyis mdzad pa 'ba' zhig gi bag chags sad pas/ bskang gso dang / gtor bzlog dang / sgrub mchod kyi tshul mdzad pa dang / 'khor tshogs kyi skye bo mang pos bsti stangs dang bcas pa'i tshul du zhugs par mdzad pa sogs byung ste/ mdor na de dag kun ni phyis kyi 'phrin las kyi rten 'brel du gyur pa 'dra zhes shes ldan rnams kyis gleng ngo / /de na so so skye bo rnams kyis rang gi blos rgyas bkab kyis sku'i spyod lam bsrangs su 'jug pa'i bsam pas nan shun gyi tshul du 'bul bar byed pa na/ de skad du ngam shod phye ma'i dkyil na mi mo zhig /rgyal blon rgyal srid skyong ba'i bya ba las/ /ma smad 'khrug pa bsdum nas byar dga' 'ong / /rgyal blon blo re chung zhes zer ba thos/ /zhes pa'i dpe dang 'dra' 'o snyam du sems so/ /de skabs su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dngos su byin gyis rlabs pa'i 'khon rigs dam pa mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi dbang phyug bdag chen rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug dang / gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgrub brgyud 'gran zla dang bral ba dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gtsug gi nor bu rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug mtshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho dang / 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs sogs skyes bu dam pa du ma la dbang skur mang po dang / yi dam chos skyong so so'i bka' bsgo rjes gnang gtor dbang sogs bgrang bar mi dpyod pa gsan pa'i snyim pas bzhes shing / khyad par mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chen po/ dbang lung man ngag du ma'i 'byung gnas —88—
