rin po che ma lus pa dkon mchog grags pa la yang bka' chos kyi 'brel ba mang du gsan zhing / gzhan yang mkhas pa dang rnal 'byor ba ku sa li tshad dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la dbang dang byin rlabs ci rigs par gsan/ khyad par du rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan pas/ rta mgrin gyi gtor dbang zhig phul dus/khro rgyal rta mgrin gyis zhal gzigs gsal ba'i mthar thug pa byung ngo / /de skabs shig bskal pa gzhal du med par tshogs gnyis rgya cher bsags pa yang smon lam rgya mtsho'i stobs kyis rgyal ba thams cad kyi bskyed pa'i yum du mngon par sprul pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i bdag nyid de nyid bsnyun gyis btab pa la sogs pa'i phyi rol mi 'tsham pa'i rkyen gang yang med par rang gnas mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing du bde bar bzhud do/ /de nas mi ring bar khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar dgongs shing / bla ma rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi bka' 'phebs pas kyang nye ba'i rkyen byas te dgung lo bdun pa chu pho stag gi lo la/ skyes bu dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhing khams/ dpal stag lung thang gi chos grwa chen por phebs shing dang po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dang mjal/slar bde bar gshegs pa rin po che bkra shis rnam rgyal dang seng gleng du mjal ba yin gsungs so/ /dgung lo brgyad pa la chos grwa de nyid du/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa nyid/ mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par skur bstan pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya —89—

mtsho'i sde'i drung du mkhan po zhug shing / zhu ba'i yul dge slong sdom brtson du ma dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ tshigs snga ma dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / bar ma yang dag par blang ba gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par nod pa mdzad de/ mtshan ni kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gnang ste/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i mtshan de ka yin no zhes bka' bstsal lo/ /༈ phra zhing gos med 'od stong bdag po'i 'od/ /gangs dang sreg za la yang mngon 'bab ste/ /nyi ma'i zer la tsha grang dbye ba med/ /de bzhin 'dir yang bdag gis legs par 'khums/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sprul pas 'gro ba'i don/ /nyi 'od bzhin du kun la khyab spyod pa/ /'di la khyim nas rab tu 'byung ba zhes/ /bzang ngan dbye ba ci zhig blo ldan rnams/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin lhun 'grub tu/ /mtha' yas skye bo'i nyer 'tshor spyod pa la/ /ngur smig tshal bus g.yogs pas ci zhig 'phags/ /lha rdzas 'bu/ma phrag brgya yis nyes pa ci/ /bi zlar 'od 'phrog ka shi'i gos mchog gis g.yogs rin chen za ma tog tu stsol/ khreng drung rnams ni bzhi mdo rgyu'o de 'dir cir mi rung gang rin chen brgyan/ /reg 'jam 'ja' 'od mdangs bkra'i g.yogs mas legs g.yogs srid gsum rin chen gcig pu 'di/ /nor bu gos mchog gzhan gyis spras pa mngon par btang nas ngur smig tshul la brten 'di mtshar/ /gang gang bzang por gyur ba de dag ni/ khren tu sbas shing mchog tu brgyan 'di la/ /'gro kun la son yid bzhin sgo bu 'di/ /rgyan byed gzhan med phyir na rgyan spangs —90—

bzhin/ /blo ldan yin yang 'dod la sred pas 'khyams/ /de dag rnams la gdams ngag mdzad pa'i phyir/ /srid gsum phun tshogs sku la yongs bzung nas/ /bung ba'i mdangs can gtsug phud bcad ces grags/ /ku mud 'dzum zhal kun dga'i zla snang can/ /bkra shis dge mtshan bdud rtsi'i zer 'phro bas/ /dpag yas 'gro kun chos kyi mgron du gnyer/ /'di yang khyed kyis thabs mkhas 'ba' zhig lags/ /de ltar na khyab bdag 'di ni ye shes kyi rang bzhin gcig pu'i phyir/ khyim na gnas pa rnams dang mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i bye brag med mod kyi/ 'di ltar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bstan pa 'di yang dang po'i lus can rnams 'dod yon la brkam pa'i byang chub thob dka' bar gzigs nas/ nyes dmigs can gyi khyim spongs la thar pa'i grong khyer du 'jug par byos shig /ces gdams ngag mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges par 'byung ba'i tshul bstan pa las brtsam ste ci rigs par bsnyad pa'i sde tshan gnyis pa'o// //de nas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sprul pa'i sku chen po mkhyen pa dang brtse ba dang / nus mthu gzhal du med pa/ rin po che ngag dbang rnam rgyal bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yun ring du bsten par mdzad pa dang / lho pa slob dpon du grags pa gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i bzlas pa dung phyur lhag cig mdzad pas/ lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis rlabs pa'i rtags mtshan thams cad mngon du gyur pa nus mthu'i mnga' bdag de nyid las bslabs par bya ba'i gnas che phra thams cad dka' ba med pa'i —91—

thugs su chud par mdzad cing / sku na tshod shin tu phra ba de skabs kyang thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba 'jigs med grags pa'i bka' srol gyi rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du ma la phyag len mtha' rgyas su sbyong bar mdzad pas/ phyi nang gi de nyid bcu'i mnga' bdag tu gyur zhing /zhabs 'bring ba 'ga' zhig dang lhan cig tu dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson par gnang bas/ snga gong cung zad ljags mi bde ba'i rnam pa'ang de nyid kyis rang grol zhing / gzhan ngor tshul bstan par snang yang lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kyis mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas pa yin zhes zhal snga nas dngos su thob bo/ /lan gcig bcom ldan 'das dpal he badz+ra lha dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi sgrub mchod ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa zhig gnang skabs/ spyir byang phyogs sa khang bsil zhing / sgos su'ang de dus dgun grangs sgang rang yin snang bas chu rnams 'bab 'phro la rno ba'i dngos po 'dzin skabs yin na'ang / bum pa la dkris sogs gang yang med par yang bum chu ma 'khyag pa tsam du ma zad/ nyi ma gcig gnyis la bum nang nas ljang bu ring po thon pa 'byung zhing / de nyid lo grangs mang po'i bar du mos rten du bzung nas yod par snang ngo / /des na chung ngu nas sngags kyi nus pa rnyed pa'i tshul yang rgya cher bstan/ de nas rim pas snga phyi lan mang por 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo la/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul phyogs med du gsan par mdzad de/ sa bka' jo zhal shangs lugs bka' gdams sogs dbang lung man ngag gzhal du med pa gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad pas/—92—

ris med pa'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag por gyur pa yin no/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi drung du/ 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' srol rma med pa rnams dang / khyad par du 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam sprul dpal stag lung thang pa chen po nas nye bar brgyud pa/ stag lung bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags pa'i smin grol gyi lam mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par gsan pa dang rjes su 'brel bar kar 'khrug 'bri gung ba sogs bka' brgyud pa bzhi'i gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad nas/ khyad par brgyud pa'i bka' srol 'di ni rtogs pa don gyi brgyud par bzhed pa yin la/ khyad par rje btsun dam pa 'dis ni chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs gdod ma mngon sum du gzigs pa yin zhing / gnas skabs gdul bya gzhan ngo dang bstun nas de skabs bla ma'i zhabs drung dang /dben gnas rnams su nyams len sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad de/des na da lta nyams len zla ba gcig tsam ma byas par/ byin rlabs don gyis 'phos pa yin no zhes stong skad kyi rbad khams 'thag pa'i rdzun po che/ longs spyod dang mnga' thang la mngon par zhen pa/ g.yo sgyu gdul bya chen po 'grub pa'i rgyab bsten du zhen pa gting nas log pa la zang zing longs spyod char ltar 'bab pa yin no/ / zhes pa'i lung tshig 'dren par byed pa 'di dag ni/ rje btsun mi la dang / rje dwags po rin po che la sogs pa mnyam bzhag la rtsol ba dang / 'du 'dzi spangs pa rnams/ dbang po rtul zhing zhen pa ma log pa yin la/kho bo cag ni dbang po rno zhing zhen pa gting nas log pa yin pas rtsol ba med —93—

pa'i lhun 'grub tu bsgom skye shing / 'du ba 'di tsam 'byung ba yin no zhes don gyis smra bar snang ngo / /༈ ma lus srid pa'i snang ba 'di/ /'od gsal chen por ro gcig gyur/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba la/ /bsgom dang ma bsgom mnyam nyid gyur/ /snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di/ /rlung sems rten 'brel ma 'gags rtsal/ /rang bzhin byar med brjod du med/ /me long gzugs brnyan lta bur gzigs/ /nang du rang rig 'dzin pa'i sems/ /bde gsal snang ba rgyun chad med/ /snang bzhin byar med dbyings su 'dres/ /phyi nang ro gcig phyag rgya che/ /gdod ma rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /thog med dus nas mkhyen lags kyang / /'dir yang 'bad rtsol du ma yis/ /mngon du gyur ba'i tshul yang bstan/ /yang skabs shig /mchod khang rtse nyid du gdan phab nas nag po chen po tsa shun bhu dza'i phyi nang gsang ba'i 'khrid kyi rim pa rnams bla ma mchog las nyams 'khrid du gsan pa'i tshe/ ji skad du bshad pa bzhin gyi rtags mtshan thams cad mngon du gyur/ khyad par las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi sprul pa mngon gsum du zhal gzigs shing / gzigs snang de yang shin tu brtan zhing yun ring du gnas pa zhig byung / de yang zhal mang po can khro zhal rnams gsal bar mngon du ston zhing / bya rog gi gdong dar nag gis g.yogs pa'i rnam pa can du 'dug gsung ngo / /spyir ni chos dang ldan pa thams cad la chos skyong rnams kyis bu bzhin skyong bar mdzad pa yin na/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog 'di lta bu la lta smos kyang ci dgos/khyad par rje 'dis gzhan ngor bsnyen sgrub kyang ches mthar son par mdzad pas —94—

'phrin las thams cad ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis rtsol med du sgrub par mdzad pa ni bdag cag rnams kyis kyang mngon gsum du mthong ngo / /de yang sgrub yig rnams su 'byung ba bzhin rab la dngos su zhal bstan nas las byed pa dang /'bring la mi nag po'i gzugs kyis las byed pa dang / tha ma la'ang sprul pa'i bya rog gi gzugs ston zhing las byed par gsungs ba las/ bdag cag shin tu bskal pa dman pa rnams kyang snang ngor yang phyi ma 'di gnyis mngon sum du gyur pa ni zhabs 'bring du cung zad re 'khod pas kyang sgro btags med par rtogs par gyur pa zhig go /rje de nyid kyis gsan pa rgya mtsho lta bu ni gsan yig tu shes par bya'o/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shur son pa na/ rje bde bar gshegs pa rin po che bkra shis rnam rgyal nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad de/ ji skad bshad pa'i mngon 'gyur bcu'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po bsnyen par mdzad nas bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag por gyur pa yin no/ / 'di skabs mtshan yang / ngag dbang kun dga' legs grub bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gsum pa gsol lo/ /sngon dus ngur smrig gi rgyan bzhes pa tsam nas bzung bslab pa'i gnas phra zhing phra ba la yang spyan gyis 'bras bu ltar dgongs pa'i gces spras su gnang ba yin na/ 'di phyin chad du ni lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ ngur smig 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu sku gsum thugs kyi ngang tshul zhi ba dang / dul ba dang / nges pa dang / legs par gdams pa'i tshul 'di gcig pus kyang / da lta'i chen por grags pa thams cad kyi yon to ma lus pa zil gyis gnon pa 'di yin no/ /de nas rje rnam rgyal —95—

bkra shis de nyid dben pa la thugs lhag par gzhol ba'i ngang tshul gyis kun spangs kyi rnal 'byor mdzad par dgongs nas/ dam pa 'di nyid dang/la 'jig rten gyi mgon po thang pa chen po'i gdan sa mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khrir rgyal tshab tu nye bar 'khod de/ sngar rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi dus su mchog tu bca' khrims dam par yod pa rim pa bzhin du gdan sar byon pa rnams kyis kyang spyir bca' khrims thams cad yar ldan du mdzad pa lags kyang / dus kyi dbang gis cha shas nyams par gyur pa dag sor chud par mdzad de/ chos rje'i rnam thar bcu gsum tshogs kyi bca' ba bcu gsum/ gling gi 'dul khrims bcu gsum rnams rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyis skabs nyid spar btab pa bzhin mdzad cing / de yang shing mo bya lo zla ba dang po la gdan sar phebs pa yin zhing / khri thog tu phebs nas mnga' dbul bgyid pa'i skabs/ me tog gi char pa babs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma/ khyad par nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms pa dang / phu chu'i 'khyag pa thams cad zhu nas brag chur 'dre ba sogs byung ste/dpal stag lung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i rten 'byung ya mtshan can rmad du byung ba'o/ /der stag lung lha sde'i mnga' zhabs bod 'brog sde dang bcas pa/ snga srol gyi phyag rgyun bzang po khrod pa ltar/thams cad phyag tu gnang ste/ mdor na stag lung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi mnga' bdag tu dbang bskur ro/ /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams tshad med na/ /ji snyed mtha' yas mgon gyi rgyal khyod la/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'byor pa kun bcas te/ /sras kyi gtso bo gcig pu khyod dbang bskur/ /'gro ba kun la —96—

srid ci'i dga' ston 'gyed//ba spya shiXs rgya lda cu phyogs brgyar bsgreng bzhin du//mtha' dag skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho 'dren pa khyod//rab brtan seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod//de tshe phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa sras bcas rnams//kun nas rab dga'i thugs kyi lha lam la//ba spya shis lan brgyar brjod cing me tog char//ci yang phab pas phyogs kun nye bar 'gog/bstan 'dzin kun gyi dbus nas dga' ba'i tog/ba spya shwes dge mtshan brgya yi mngon 'bar ba'i//mtshungs med bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu la/yang yang bsam bzhin snying nas dad pa skyes//zhes pa 'di ni rgyal tshab tu mngon par dbang bskur ba las brtsam ste bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te gsum pa'o////de la kho bo cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di ni/dpal stag lung gi gdan sa'i rabs ji snyed byon pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang /lugs gnyis char gyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa la/rje rin po che 'di ni 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no//de nas mi ring ba'i skabs shig na karma pa'i bu chen/kar lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang na mchog tu mkhas par bkur ba/chos rje dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bar grags pas kyang /rje rnam rgyal bkra shis 'i gus pa'i spyi bos zhabs kyi pad+mo la nyer bar mchod par byas shing /khong grags che bas stag lung dge 'dun rnams kyis chos ci rigs par gsan snang /phyir phebs kar rje 'dis rnyed bkur la spyan 'dren par mdzad 'dug pas/bzhugs gral grol nas thugs kar rje 'di nyid la gus pas thal mo sbyor bzhin pas/sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje bskul bzhin 9ga sku tshe brtan pa dang 'phrin las rgyas

par gsol ba btang nas thegs song zhes zer/ de ltar na rgyal po rnams kyis lhag par bkur ba'i stobs kyi che thabs la shin du brtson pa'i dregs ldan chen po mchog tu grags pa re re las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten shas cher la yang 'dud pa dang bral ba dag kyang 'di ltar thugs rje'i zil gyis cher mnan nas gus pas 'dud na gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas gtsug lag khang gi gser tog ga sgyur ra chen mo khru bzhi bcu'i tshad tsam gyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba 'di nyid bzhengs par bzhed pa la/ bal po'i yul nas bzo bo tshan che ba sku drung du lhags shing / bzo phud la 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i sku brnyan dngul sku rkang gang ma zhig grub rjes/ gser tog chen mo nyid bzhengs par mdzad cing / 'di yi byug gser la gser 'dul zho dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa lnga song zhing / gzungs gzhugs yang gdung sha ri raX yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring srel dang / gzungs sngags 'khor lo la sogs pas nye bar gtams pa/ mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes mthong ba brgyud pa ma nyams pa ltar gnang zhing / rje rnam rgyal bkra shis kyis gzungs gzhug rnams kyang phyag ltar bar mdzad cing / rab tu gnas pa'ang shin du rgyas pa dga' ston blo las 'das pa dang / bzo ris pa rnams la bza' btung dang yon gyi gnang sbyin dpe bral blo 'das kyis mgu ba bskyed par mdzad/ 'di'i snga phyi thams cad du kun spangs rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis nyid kyis bstan pa spyi dang bye brag thams cad dar zhing rgyas pa dang /rje 'di'i bzhed don thams cad 'grub pa'i smon lam yang yang mdzad pas/phyis rten bzhengs sogs rlabs po che'i mdzad pa thams cad gegs med du —98—

'grub pa'i rten 'brel thams cad legs par 'grigs pa yin no zhes grags so/ /de nas rim gyis dus gzhan dang gzhan du gtsug lag khang chen mo'i bad dkar po'i khyon rnams dang / lha khang mthil gyi logs rnams su bris sku mthong ba don ldan gyi sku'i bkod pa gzab bris su mdzad pa dang / bskal bzang gi de bzhin gshegs pa stong gi sku brnyan gyi rgyud ris dang / thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku brnyan sogs gtsug lag khang chen mo rgya khyon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i logs bris shas che ba yang grub par mdzad/ bris thang yang mgon khang rnying mar bzhugs pa'i mgon thang chen mo dang / rnam sras kyi gos thang chen mo/ bde mchog /dgyes rdor/ 'jigs byed/ las mgon gnyis dang bcas pa bzo ris mkhas pa'i gzab bris su mdzad pa dpe bral de rnams kyang legs par grub cing / rab gnas kyi bar gyi mtha' rgyas kyang brtsal/ de nas ring por mi thogs par/ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po kun spangs rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis de nyid chos kyis dbyings su zhi bar gzims pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ zab yang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po gzhal du med pa'i bkod pa dang / sku gdung rin po che de nyid sa gzhi byin gyis rlobs pa dang / mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams la thar pa'i sa bon mchog bskrun pa'i slad du/ dngul gyis gdung khang bya bar bzhed de/ gser rkyang zho nyis brgya lhag pa sogs rgyu tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rin po che'i phung po chen po'i 'di nyid dang /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sku brnyan bar chad kun sel du grags pa 'di nyid la dngul srang stong brgal ba dang / gdan dang rgyan bkod la gser —99—

zho bzhi bcu'i skud gser btang ba dang / nang bzhugs su byin rlabs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan byin rlabs can dang /gser dngul las grub pa'i gzungs sngags rnams rgyud sde rin po che nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar slob dpon mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes ltar gzungs bzhugs kyi gtams par mdzad cing dngul gdung rin po che 'di nyid bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam rten sogs byin rlabs rten blo las 'das pas gang ba yin na'ang / yi ge mang bas 'dir ma brjod/ de dag gi rab gnas la/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo spyan 'dren par mdzad de/ dngul gdung gi gzungs bzhugs kyang rje btsun ma chog pa cung zad kyang ma byung / lam gyi dka' ba thams cad khyad du bsad nas chos lung byang rtser phebs pa'i tshe/ sgrub gnas dam pa der bzhugs pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis phebs bsu'i bkod pa mdzad pa na/ nam mkha' la me tog gi char sngon chad sus kyang mig lam du ma phebs pa dag kyang byung zhing / khyad par me tog bzung du rung ba yang du ma byung ngo / /der dkar me rgyun sbar dang / mchod rdzas mchod pa'i thebs sogs blos gzhal bar dka' ba sogs 'bul bar gnang zhing / bstan 'gro'i don du smon lam rgya chen po gnang bzhin du zla gcig skor bzhugs ring rnyed bkur rnams ni dpon drung tshe dbang 'phan dar bas dang bzhes su mdzad/ g.yas ru byang nas chos rgyal kun dga' rin chen yang mjal bar phebs shing gus pas zhabs la gshugs/ de nas slar yang rim gyis gzhung lam brgyud nas phebs te gang dang gang du phebs pa der/ bla ma slob dpon skya ser che phra thams cad kyis zhabs la —100—

gsags shing / chos dang zang zing gi 'byor bas tshim par mdzad de/ rang gnas thang pa chen po'i gdan sa nyid du phebs nas dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su bsti bar mdzad do/ /de nas 'brug lo'i nang du zhwa dmar nag gnyis 'dus kyi sgar pa 'bri gung nas 'phan yul brgyud/ dpal stag lung thang gi gdan sa mjal bar phebs shing / zhag bdun tsam bzhugs/ rnyed bkur dang 'bul ba'i gnang skyes rgya cher gnang zhing / gling gi dge 'dun byings kyis kyang rnyed bkur 'bul ba dpe bral mdzad/ zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa dkon mchog yan lag la bka' 'brel tsam gsan/ de'i phyir lor rje drung zhwa dmar bas/ rje 'di nyid sbyan 'dren gnang bas yangs can du phebs pa'i tshe/ sgar gyi grwa tshang so so'i dge 'dun rnams kyis ser 'phreng dang / phyag mdzod sku mched sogs drung 'khor rnams kyi chibs hrag gis phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya cher mdzad/ sgar chen gyis lo gsar smon lam dang bcas pa dus 'grigs pas/rnyed bkur bsam las 'das pa byung / gan rdo la'i mchod bshams su grags pa rnams kyang zhib rgyas su gzigs pa phul/ skabs 'dir rje zhwa dmar ba la rka kaX tshang gi chos bka' yod pa thams cad gsan/ rje 'di nyid la tshur rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin po che ma nu hu'i zhal bu sogs khyad nor gyi 'bul ba rngams su brgal ba byung bla ma g.yung sogs bu chen rnams dang phyag mdzod sku mched/ sde pa nas rin pa sogs sgar gyi drag zhan ma lus pa yang mchog tu gus pa thob ste/ chos 'brel ma thob pa gcig kyang med/ de nas pho 'do'i sde pa don bzang ba gshegs par nye ba'i bang chen gyis bskul te/ stag lung du phebs/ mi —101—

ring bar 'khon rigs dam pa grub pa'i dbang phyug bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bsam 'grub dpon slob rnams stag lung du phebs/ yang dgon du spyan 'dren zhu bar mdzad/ rdo rje phur pa la sogs pa zab chos mang du gsan/ rnyed bkur 'bul ba dpe bral gnang zhing bdag chen rin po ches kyang gser dmar las grub pa'i dril bu bzo khyad ches 'phags pa phyag tu 'bul bar snang / sku rim gtor bzlog phyag len mtha' rgyas kyang gzigs yul du phebs/ yang lan cig byang rigs la phebs dus/ gnyan chen thang lhas mchod pa dang 'dud pa'i gzigs snang cher byung bar snang bas/ spyi mthun mthong snang la sgra dang 'ja' 'od dang / me tog gi char babs pa sogs dang / khyad par 'ja' tshon la bkra shis rtags brgyad shin tu gsal bar byung / de nas skye rabs brgya rtsa'i gzab bris thang ka bzhi bcu tsam la grub pa zhig bzhengs par gnang zhing / rab gnas yon rdzogs sogs kyis bar thams cad mtha' rgyas su 'grub par mdzad/ de nas lcags pho rta'i lo la/ bal yul bzo rigs mkhas pa'i mthar phyin pa/dpon mo che dzā ti pā la sogs sku gzhogs su 'byor ba la/ rten thog mar bzo phud du bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku rgyab mtho gang ba zhig bzhengs par mdzad/slar thub chen mthong ba don ldan nyid bzo dbu 'dzug par mdzad de/ ring por mi thog par gegs med du mthar phyin 'di ni sku tshad ches che drags pas mchod khang du ma shong bar zhal ras lha khang gsar du bzhengs dgos byung zhing / 'di'i nang bzhugs su thub pa chen po'i ring srel rnam bzhi sogs byin rlabs brjod las 'das pa bzhugs/ rten bsgrigs gnang bas rgya mtho bzhi bcu zhe lnga byung —102—

zhing / rab gnas dga' ston yon rdzongs kyi bar du thams cad mtha' dag tshang bar gnang ngo / /'di dag gi skabs shig dpal ldan a ti sha'i bshad sgrub kyi bka' srol skyong ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba/ dpal ldan sa skya ba'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi snying po/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi rnam 'phrul du grags pa/lo pa spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos grags pa ched kyis spyan 'dren pa mdzad de/ bka' gdams kyi chos skor mtha' yas pa gsan zhing thugs su chud mdzad cing / ji skad bshad pa'i bla ma dam pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mnga' ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa mchog de la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gus pa dang / rnyed bkur dang / yon 'bul dang / phu dud du bya bar mdzad cing /spyan snga rin po che 'di de dus dgung lo brgyar nye bar bzhes pa'i skabs yin la/de ltar sku che'i dpal brnyes pa'i rten 'brel du dgongs nas phyir phebs dus tshe dbang brgya rtsa zhig kyang gsan/ de nyid kyis rten 'brel las bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba yang 'debs so/ /de nas bar skabs su chos kyi bar du gcod pa cung zad la brten pa'i zhal ngo nas kyang rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'dir cung zad thugs 'dzer bag can du mdzad pa 'byung zhing / de ka'i rgyab zhing 'bri khung nas mdzad pas lo shas shin tu thugs sun par byung la 'on kyang rje 'di nyid kyi dam pa'i chos kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che la ni bar du gcod pa ma nus te/ lha chen bzhengs pa'i sgang nyid la dus 'khrug cher byung 'dug cing /nyin gcig gi bzo tsam yang ma chags par rab gnas zhal gro'i bar tu mthar phyin pa/ rten 'brel gyi sgo ma lus pa rang 'grig ste/ ha hor gyi rgyal khams kyi —103—

las sgo bzang po 'di lta bu longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po legs par brdol ba yin no/ /kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang bo'i thugs dam rten gyi gtso bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje rgya gar ma las kyang bzo khyad bla lhag tsam du mngon pa de nyid/ gtsug lag khang mes bzhes dus/ sku ngo bo la skyon ma byung yang /nang zungs rnams zhugs bzhes 'dug pa/ slar yang byin rlabs kyi rten dang nor khyad 'phags mang pos 'gengs par gnang nas legs par gsos/ gnas bcu lha khang gi logs bris dang sku 'bum gyi zhig gsos dang / mchod snying gi zhig gsos/ bstan srung dge bsnyen chen po'i rten khang logs bris sogs kyang rim pas gnang ngo / / 'dir smras pa/ gang gi mdzad pa dpag yas gzhal du med/ /'di la blo ldan gyis kyang dpyad du med/ /'khor ba'i khams la 'phel med 'grib pa med/khyed kyi 'phrin las 'di la chad pa med/ /mkhas kun mngon par dga' ba'i legs bshad dang / /skye bo mtha' dag ba spya shis dge legs can/ /chos kyi rgya lda mtshan srid mthar bsgreng la mkhas/ /'gro ba'i dpal gyur mdzad pa bar+bhang bho can/ khyed ltar srid 'dir gzhan ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gnas mgon po khyod/ /bskal brgya'i bar du bzhugs gsol zhes/ /bdag ni rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che las brtsams te/cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te bzhi pa'o// //dam pa 'di snga phyi lan mang por hor stod smad kyi mnga' zhabs byang rigs kyi sa'i khyon thams cad du phyag phebs cing / dbyar dus gnam chu shin du —104—

che ba la ko gru sogs yul gyis gshes nas gtan med kyang phyag nas 'thor ba tsam mam/ thugs dam gtor ma re tsam gnang ba kho nas 'phral du chu bri nas/byis pa chung ngus kyang bde blag tu brgal bar nus pa tsam du 'gro zhing / dpon slob rnams phebs grub ma thag tu sngar lugs bzhin du chu brub nas 'gro ba sha stag byung bas/ mtha' yas pa'i skye bo thams cad shas cher rdzu 'phrul la yid rton pa'i phyir/ mchog tu gus pa'i thal mo lan brgyar sbyor bar byed do/ /gzhan yang ji tsam paslu skye bo'i tshogs che ba 'di tsam sku drung du rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba la/ 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa cung zad dam/ rim gyis btab pa'am/gnag phyugs sogs srog chags ji snyed cig 'bul ba 'byung ba la yang /phyugs nad kyi rnam pas btab pa sogs ni grong 'khor ches rgan po rnams kyis kyang gtan mi dran/ ja gos dar go khrab rtsi bcud rta nor sogs de ring kho na dngos po'i 'bul ba mang snyam pa nyag gcig rtag par yod cing / skye bo tshogs chen rnams la bsnyen gnas sems bskyed yig drug gi sgom lung sogs yi dam dang chos skyong gi dbang dang rje gnang so so gang la gang 'dod 'tsham par stsol ba dang / zang zing gis skye dgu thams cad kyi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad cing hor stod smad sogs 'thab rtsod 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar snang bas/ thugs snying rje chen pos byin rlabs kyi mthus/ rje 'di'i bka' stsal phebs pa la/thams cad kyang zhi ba'i sems kyi nyan shes dang ldan par gyur zhing / sems can thams cad bde ba'i thabs la dgongs nas/ phyag rdzas rngam che ba kun yang so sor stsol bar mdzad do/ /phyogs lhung spangs pa'i gzi yig gis bcad de —105— zhe

dam bzhag gnang ba la brten/ lo bcu gnyis tsam mam lo grangs ci rigs par dus khams shin du bde bar gyur ba zhi tshe yin te/ phyi rabs kyi chen po 'ga' zhig ltar gyis dus 'khrugs sdum pa ltar bcos te nor gyi bya dga' sogs kyis 'phral gnyis thad nas mi mgu ba med tsam la/ phugs su rang phyogs ches nga rgyal bar byed pa'i g.yo sgyus zhal lce gcod pa 'di lta bu dang /gzhan dag sdum pa'i zol gyis gnyis bar nas bdag nyid kyi dbang thang longs spyod kho na yid la brnags pas sgrub rtsol byed cing / gzhan thes med du byas nas rang gis thob brtsi ba sogs skyes bu dam pa yin no zhes rlung ltar grags pa rnams la yang dam pa ma yin pa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bur bying ba'i skyon dag mthong ba'i tshe/ bdag nyid kyi don thams cad khyad du bsad de gzhan bde 'ba' zhig bsgrub par dgongs pa khyod la zol med snying thag pa nas dad pa'i yid kyis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid gdung rigs kyi mchog 'di lta bur sku / skye ba brnyes shing /lugs gnyis kyis mngon par mtho ba 'di tsam gyis mngon par brgyan pa dang /mkhas btsun bzang bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan 'phrin las blo las 'das pa 'di tsam du bzhugs kyang thugs khengs pa'i dri ma thams cad yongs su bral ba dang / zhabs drung du mi lo bzhi bcu tsam nye bar bsten pa dag gis kyang rang bstod bdag nyid sgrogs pa'i tshig gcig kyang gsungs pa ma tshor bar snang zhing / mu to ba tshun chad la yang zhe sa dang bcas pa'i tshig gis bsti stangs mdzad pa las brnyas pa'i dri ma tsam yang mi mdzad cing / dge ba'i las bgyi ba —106—

cung zad dang ldan pa'i skye bo gas thams cad kyis 'phya zhing smod par byed pa'i gnas kun la yang / bdag nyid las ches lhag par bsngags par mdzad cing /sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi cha shas yig 'bru tsam mam/ mchod rten zhig ro tshun chad dang dge 'dun gyi cha shas ngur smig gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa kun la yang mchog tu gus pa chen pos thal mo sbyar ba sogs mthong te/ skyes bu dam pa las kyang ches dam pa'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyod ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /yon tan chu bo stong gis khengs mi mnga'/ /blo chung snod ngan sa yi bum pa dag /rnyed bkur chu thigs gcig gis khengs shing 'jig /'gro las rgyal slad gzhan 'phrul bdag po yis/ /sgyu thabs sgyu can rnams la dbang phyug dang / /'byor ba'i rkyen byas chos bzhin spyod pa rnams/ /chad pa sbyin 'dis bdud rtsis lam chen bkum/ /srid pa'i chu mtshor sgyu can chu skyar 'ga'/ /bshes gnyen yid 'ongs sa dkar ltar bsdus nas/ /'bum phrag skye bo'i nya rnams bslu brid kyis/ /ngan 'gro'i mya ngam thang la za bar mthong / /bdag don tsher ma'i khur po bor gyur nas/ /gas don shing rtar 'jug pa'i kha lo ba/ /gya gyu spangs te drang po'i lam ston mkhan/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gcig khyod la bdag yid gus/ /de nas bya lo'i nang du 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstan pa'i srog shing chen po rin po che bstan 'dzin grags pa nyid kyang dpal stag lung thang gi chos grwa chen por gzigs dgos shing spyan 'dren gyis kyang mtshams sbyar nas phebs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de la 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po —107—

nyid kyi rang lugs las 'ong ba'i/ phyag bzhes rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mang por dbang bskur gsan zhing / khrid tshul mtha' yas 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i nye lam chen po sbas don kun gsal sogs chos tshul mang du gsan/ rnyed bkur dang 'bul ba'i dngos po gya nom pa'i tshogs kyis mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid slob mar bcas pa ches dgyes pa chen por bskyed nas thegs/ de skabs shig sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams thog rer bzhugs shing /bar skabs shig mi tshan bcu gsum gyis nor rdzong byas pa drangs bzhi rdzong zhes pa/ phyis bdag med du lus pa zhig byung 'dug pa de/ stag lung gi sa gnad shin tu che bar dgongs nas/ thog mar gzim khang dang bcas pa mthar thon gnang ste/ chos rdzong rnam rgyal rab brtan du ming 'dogs snang / 'di ni 'jig rten dngos kyi sa gnad tsam ma yin pa/ sa chu nam mkha' gsum shes rab e gru gsum gyi rnam pa can dang / rdzong ri nyid waX yig gi tshul du gnas pa dang /gzhan yang phyi nang gi rten 'brel sa dpyad ming 'dogs sogs dpal stag lung thang gi bstan pa rin po che la lhag par gal che ba zhig /ye shes kyi gzigs pa sgrib med kyis gzigs nas gnang 'dug pas/ ring por mi thog par mngon du gyur pa 'di yin/ yang skabs shig thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa/ bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul pa'i sku 'chi med 'od zer yang rje nyid mjal du phebs/ zhabs kyi pad+mo la nye bar gshugs nas kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos phyag len gyi dkyil 'khor mang po'i dbang bskur dang / thugs dam zab chos mang du gsan te/ mchog tu thabs —108—

gus pa wo pos rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad do/ /de nas shing pho khyi lo la/ bal po'i lha bzo brnya pa la sogs bzo tshan lnga pa zhig zhabs drung du 'byor bas nye ba'i rkyen byas te/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po mi tshad ma dang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug /ha shangs dharma ta la rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan thams cad kyang sku tshad mda' gang tsam pa bzo khyad phul du byung ba legs par grub cing / skud gser la gser zho brgya phrag lnga lhag gcig song snang ba/ rgyu'i khyad par gzhan rnams des dpag par nus so/ /'di la gzungs bzhugs kyang thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel shin du tshogs che ba dang / stag lung bka' brgyud nyid kyi bla ma gong ma rnams gtso bor gyur ba'i byin rlabs kyi rten mang po dang / gser dngul gyi gzungs yig bsgrang bar mi dpyod pa dang bcas pa phyag len dag pas gzungs bzhugs gnang / 'di'i gtso bo bzhengs pa'i zhal lta gnang nas/ hor stod pa'i spyan 'dren pa bzhin phebs nas bzhugs sgar shel rje'i rgyud du gnang skabs/ phyag nas gnang ba stag lung nyid du nyin par skye bo mang po'i mthun snang du grub par gtso bo'i sku gzugs kyi sku 'phang du nam mkha' nas me tog mang du phebs pa brdzun med yid ches 'drongs par byung snang zhing / de yang gzhan dag ltar mtshan mo'i dus dang lkog tu mi nas thogs pa dag sbed pa la sogs pa'i g.yo thabs dang / skal ldan 'ga' re'i mthong snang la byung skad pa dang / ston rgyu med bzhin du dpon dbang gi phyug dag gis 'byung ngo zhes dbang che'i tshig gis rjes su 'brang ba tsam ma yin par mngon sum du skye bo thams cad kyis spyi mthun du mthong ba yin no/ /—109—

'di yang drang por brjod pa tsam yin gyi mi ma yin grub par dang bon po sogs la'ang thun mong gi yon to ston rgyu yod de 'di tsam gyi rtags la 'dren pa mchog ga la re/ thugs dul ba dang btsun pa dang mkhas pa dang lhag pa'i thugs stong nyid snying rje snying po can mnga' ba sogs thun mong ma yin pa mchog gi yon tan gzhal du med pa mnga' ba 'di nyid skyes bu dam pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin no/ /de dag dang stabs gcig tu/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sku dgos 'dod kun 'byung gser zho lnga bcu li byugs gser can phul du phyung ba'i nang bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di nyid kyang bzhengs par mdzad/ rab gnas kyang rje nyid rigs pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang bcas pas gnang /rab gnas legs shing shin tu bkra shis pas 'phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad las legs par grol ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs rigs byed pa rnams la yon rdzong bcad thang las brgal ba'i dpe bral blo 'das dges pa chen po dang bcas te gnang bas/ khong rnams kyang gzhan du lo bdun las kyang 'dir ha lam rnyed pa bzang ba byung zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mgu ba thob/ de nas me pho byi ba'i lo la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gan shog la rin po che'i khu bas bri bar gnang ba/ lo de nyid la glegs bam brgyad cu rtsa drug la na bza' rten khebs bzang bsgrigs tog dkar zhal khebs sum brtsegs ma/ bzang gos kyi glegs thag dang glegs shing sogs rnam pa thams cad nas dpe dang bral ba legs par grub cing / bzo ris pa nyis brgya bud tsam kun la yang nam mkha' mdzod las yid bzhin gyi char phab pas mchog tu tshim pa thob bo/ 'di —110—

skabs su mda' dar 'bul dbon grags pa 'od zer ba dpon g.yog sogs yul phyogs la 'bul sdud du gnang ba rgyal po chen po a dan khan gyis gus pas bshud de/ rgyal po'i gser yig dang bcas lhan cig tu gdan sa chen po stag lung du 'byor/ gser dngul gos dar ja ras rta dre'u rnga mong sogs kyis 'bul ba'i sa steng khyab par phul zhing / de skabs 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo'i sku dbon po/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku jo nang kun mkhyen chen po'i seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod pa/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang po zhes sku btsun zhing grub pa dang byin rlabs kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ bdag nyid chen po de yang mjal bar phebs te/ dpon slob thugs nang gtsang ba'i shin tu dgyes pa chen por gyur/ zab chos rmad du byung ba mang bo phan tshun du gsan res gnang /lo 'di nyid kyi nang du dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse 'phrin las kyi ngo bo rgyal dbang sprul pa'i sku stag lung rin po che 'dis kyang gdan sa chen por phebs pa'i thog ma yin zhing / phyi lo dbyar sos nor rnams kyi dus 'khrug gi sdum la byang rgyab tu phebs/ legs par sdum pa'i skabs shig ma rung ba'i sems can 'ga' zhig gis mi bzad pa'i las mngon par sgrub pa ni 'di ltar te/ nyin gcig bzhugs sgar na 'khor tshogs mang po'i zhabs 'bring dang bcas nas bzhugs skabs shig bka' stsal nas/ mi nga la ni mngon sum thabs su phyag tu yi ge rgya can zhig 'bul ba byung bas/ the'u rme'i kha ris la rje btsun mi la'i sku zhig snang / yi ge'i nang na'ang zhag bdun nas mi 'di bzhin byung / mi 'di lta bu tha na gos lham kyang 'di bzhin du 'ong zhes sogs —111—

don 'di bzhin 'dug ces gdug sems can gyi mi de dang de yi ming mi gsal tsam ma gtogs ma sbas lhug par bka' stsal gnang / de ji ltar bka' stsal gnang ba bzhin zhag bdun gyi mtshams nas gsol zas ngan pas sku bsnyel zhing / dbon pad+mas mi de rnams kyis ming gang yin bka' stsal gnang dgos zhes nan cher zhus 'dug na'ang / de kun la gnod pa byung bar dgongs nas ye bka' stsal ma gnang / sku khams shin tu dub pas na re zhig gdan sar phebs pa gnang ma thub par/ dbyar ngos de sa phyogs de nyid rang du bzhugs shing /sman pa mkhas po rnams kyi gso dpyad rnams rim par phul/ de dus zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag yangs pa can du bzhugs skabs yin zhing / rin chen ril bu khyad par can sogs gsol sman khyad par can/ phal che ba'ang zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa'i phyag nas 'bul ba gnang / ston gyi dus nas sku khams rim gyis bde nas gdan sa nyid du phyag phebs so/ /da ltar gyi bar du yang rje nyid zhal zas ngan pa gsol bas gdug pa can de kun la ched du dmigs nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che bsgom par mdzad cing / 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du phan bde'i rgyu 'gyur ba smon lam yang dag par thugs thag pa nas gnang ba ni bdag cag gis kyang yang yang mthong ste/ sngon dus rje 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo grub pa la yang 'di bzhin 'byung ba/ 'gro ba'i mgon po'i gsung las/'di ngan song du mi gtong ba'i gnyer kha kho bo la yod pa lags/ zhes gsungs pa yang rnam thar 'di las gzhan du med de/ des na gang dag gnod pa cung zad byed pa'i dgra la yang yul 'bud pa dang / chad pa gcod pa dang / yon bdag —112—

dang / rgyal po gzhan dang gzhan nas/ sdug las ci thon byed bzhin du/ phyi mar sems can rnams 'khor ba las 'dren pa'i smon lam byed skad de/ pha ma'i mgo gcod bzhin du/ ri dwags chus khyer ba la snying rje zhes zer ba dang 'dra'o/ /des na rang gi longs spyod mnga' thang la cung zad gnod par mthong na/ yon bdag dang rgyal po du ma bskul nas gtsug lag khang du ma mes sregs pa dang /khyim pa dang rab byung brgya stong g.yul du gsod pa sogs mthong ste/ de dag ni bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu lta ga la zhig /bdud sdig can dge slong ga gzugs zhes bya ba yang 'di las gzhan du med cing / de lta na sku la bsdo bar byed pa de lta bu mngon sum mkhyen bzhin du mi gsungs zhing / gzhan rnams las kyang ches lhag par thugs brtse ba'i yul du mdzad pa 'di lta bu sngon gyi dus su mang du byung mod kyi da ltar gyi dus su ni bdag cag gi 'dren pa 'di gcig pu'i mdzad pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ gzhan bde dge ba cung zad tsam la yang / /bdag don ma lus gtong ba rgyal sras lugs/ /'gro la snyoms par brtse ba nyid lags kyang / /gnod byed rnams la lhag par brtse 'di mtshar/ /'di na dam par khas 'che chen po 'ga'/ /nad dang bcas pa'i dge slong gzhan mchod nas/ /yun ring bdag la byams shing bkur ba yang / /brtse med sems kyis chad pas gcod pa mthong / /dpa' bo mi bsrun dge slong stag gi tshul/ /zas nor sgyu ma'i khrag la snoms pa ni/ /nyes pa ci la'ang dga' ma'i srog gcod ma/ /'di la gzhan dag bag yod cis mi 'ong / /'od gsal ngur smrig gdengs ka'i nor bu —113—

can/ /gdug rtsub yan lag khong du rnam par sbas/ /gya gyus 'jug cing snyan 'jam phud kyi sgras/ /'dri byed lag 'gro'i tshul can 'ga' med dam/ /'gro kun dag byed thugs rje'i 'od dkar can/ /bdag la brtse bral ri dwags kyis gnag pa/ /ngan spyod mtshan mo'i mun par 'khyams pa'i mgon/ /gdung sel bkra shis gcig pu 'di na shar/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad spyod khyad par can 'ba' zhig las brtsams te cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan de lnga pa'o// //de nas 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo shar ba na stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ji gir gan gyi rgyal rgyud ma nyams pa/ swog po'i rgyal po rnams kyis spyan 'dren nan zhus byung ba'i tshe/ phebs par dgongs pa gtad cing gzhir bzhugs drag zhan kun dang / yon bdag sde rigs kun gyis kyang nan tan gyis bzhugs par zhus kyang / cis kyang phebs par thag chod gnang /de kha'i stabs kyis chos 'brel zhu ba dang / sku gzhogs su don gcod par 'ong ba'i rdzongs bkod gnang dgos sogs lugs gnyis kyis thugs brel shin du che ba'i ngang nas kyang mchog gi sprul sku rin po che la nye bar mkho ba'i bzhes kyi dbang bskur mang po dang / rjes gnang zab bsdus mtha' yas pa dang bka' rgyud gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum phal cher gyi bka'i glegs bam rnams kyi bka' gtad kyang gnang zhing / lha sar jo bo rin po cher mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa dang bcas smon lam gnang bar phebs skyi shod kyi zhal ngo rnams dang ser 'bras dge gsum gyi bla ma che phra thams cad rje 'di nyid mjal bar phebs shing gus pas btud/ phal cher gyis bka' chos kyi 'brel ba re yang zhus/ skyi —114—

shod zhal ngo rnam pas sgo la'i bar du phebs skyel la phebs shing / myur du phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ slar yang gdan sa nyid du phebs te cung zad gdan chags/ rje drung karma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes kyang / bka' rgyud chu bo'i 'byung khungs dge legs dag byed chu bo'i rgyun/ /sa gsum khyab par mdzad mkhas las chen bzhi dang grub chen brgyad/ /kun gyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan stag lung thang pa chen po yis/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la bzhugs bzhin bkra shis dge legs can/ /zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang / de tshe sku gsung thugs 'khor dang / /'phrin las bzang po'i 'od zer gyis/ /mtha' yas mun rub rab bsal nas/ /dbu gtsang chos kyi rgyal khams su/ /byams pas skyong zhing brtan pa dang / /bstan la rim 'gro bgyis pa dang / /gnas skabs mthar thug legs byas la/ /skye dgu mtha' dag 'god par 'tshal/ /de dang de yi mdzad 'phrin la/ /gegs bral smon lam yang yang 'bul/ /zhes sogs bzhed don 'grub pa'i smon lam 'bul skyel dang bcas pa dang / 'di skabs smon lam gyi mjug tu/ dag pa'i 'jig rten dag tu rgyal ba'i mdzad pa dang / /skal bzang tshe na legs lam ji snyed mchis pa gang / /ma dag dus 'dir dge slong skad kyi ngo mtshar can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i mdzad bzang bzhad par stsol/ /zhes bskal bzang sangs rgyas yin pa'i bsngags brjod gnang 'dug go /de mthun rje zhwa dmar bas kyang / bde bar gshegs pa'i rang lugs rmad byung ba/ /chos kyi rgyal bo thang pa chen po yi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi dus 'dir 'grub gyur nas/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sogs kyi —115—

gsol 'debs zhu yig bzhugs gdan dang bcas pa 'bul bar byung / hor zla bzhi pa'i nang gza' skar sbyor byed thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin gcig sgar grwa chen po bsgrigs par gnang / de nyin me tog gi char 'babs pa dang /'ja' 'od la dge mtshan gyis ltas rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa'i rnam pa ji snyed dang bcas pa shar bas/ swog po'i mi rnams shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur/de nas rim gyis gdan btegs te/ snying drung dang 'dam sogs brgyud de hor smad pa'i sar phebs/ yang byang lam brgyud de 'bri chu la rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas sgrol te/ 'bri tshwa khar swog po'i phebs bsu ba rnams kyis slebs kyang rim gyis phebs pas/ cha rgan 'u su zhes pa'i sar swog po'i rgyal po a rbal gyis mjal zhing mchog tu dad pa thob/ snga sor gyi snyung res yang yang bsnyel ba yong gin yod 'dug la yon mchod rten 'brel khyad par can zhig gis yin snang ba/swog yul du phebs tsam nyid nas dwangs/ dbu'i tshwa mtsho'i 'gram du rgyal po chen po a ba dan gyis spyan drangs pas kyang 'byor/ thog mar rgyal bo a rbal gyi brgyud pa yod pa'i sar phebs te/ rnyed bkur dang 'bul ba gzhal bar dka' ba byung zhing / slar yang gdan 'dren pas bskul te/ gu gu no'i mtsho 'gram du sprul pa'i rgyal po a ba dan khan dang mjal/ spyir ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang /snga sor rgyal po nyid kyi mnal lam du mtha' 'khob 'dul ba dang rgyal po nyid rjes su bzung nus pa'i bla ma zhig yang yang lung bstan par byung snang yang / sku'i dbyibs sogs rgyu masno du mas/ rje rin po che 'di nyid yin par yid ches/bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi don mdzad bzhin bzhugs pa la/ lho nas wa shul —116—

'bum skyabs dar gyis nan gyis spyan drangs pa bzhin phebs pas/ 'khrugs pa bsdums pa dang dam pa'i chos kyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa byung / khyad par phyogs de'i dge 'dun bgrangs ba las 'das pa/ 'dus pa la chos 'khor rgya chen por bskor/ yos lo sar nas/ or rus pa'i be thu rgyal po dang / 'dzam thang ba'i bu chen karma bla mas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya byung ba bzhin/ rma chen spom ri'i gangs kyi mgul la sngon gzhan sus kyang ma bgrod pa'i lam zhig la rje nyid kyis cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang bcas byang phyogs la phebs/ rgyal po chen po al dan dang mjal dpal de bzhin gshegs pa stag lung ba chen po zhes mtshan gsol/ 'ja' sa ka 'o ming las zhwa las gos dngul srang brgyad cu gya lnga las grub pa'i tham ka /gzhan yang dngul stong phrag mang po 'bul ba sogs 'byung zhing / rgyal po chen po de nyid kyi sar 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul du grags pa/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ sprul pa'i sku thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpon slob kyis sgar du spyan drangs/dge 'dun 'dus pa dpag tu med pa'i bsu ba dang mjal 'phrad phyag mnyam sogs kyi legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa dang / rgyal po chen pos kyang mjal/'phrad gzigs rtog mdzad cing / snga sor phyogs ris kyi brjod pa ci rigs pa thams cad ris med du zhi nas rgyal po chen po yang dad pa chen po sngar las kyang tshes bla lhag tu skyes/ de nas rim gyis chings kha bsgyur/ khri shor rgyal mo'i mtsho dang nye ba nas shar tsong kha'i cha la stag lung la gsar zhes zi ling nang sos spyan drangs/ drangs ti lnga mchod pas kyang spyan drangs shing zhabs tog phul du byung ba —117—

bsgrub/ rim gyis zi ling mkhar mo cher phebs/ rgya nag gong ma chen mo wan li'i bka' rtags kyi las ka 'dzin pa'i rgya'i mi dpon rnams kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i zhabs tog gis ri mor byas/ 'dzu lam cong rong du grags pa'i chu bo chen po la ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa dang bcas te dpon slob bde bar sgrol te/rgya'i mi dpon zhig gis 'bul ba dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung bo bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstabs/ rim pas o rus be thu dang karma bla ma sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhabs tog dpag tu med pa mdzad/ swog phrug bcu phrag tsam rab tu byung nas zhabs 'bring du 'ong / gser dngul gos dar rta nor sogs dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi dngos po tshad gzhal bar dka' ba phul/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa/ rigs ldan sprul sku kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po'i rang lugs 'dzin pa/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug rlabs chen spyod pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba/ sprul pa'i sku chen po rje btsun rgyal ba seng ges kyang ja zhus 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas legs so'i skyes dang 'dzam thang phyogs su slar yang phebs dgos pa'i snyan zhu tsam byung na'ang phyis phebs ni ma thub/ yos lo'i ston khar al dan rgyal pos dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya las grub pa'i dngul bzang / gzhan yang dngul spyad gtso bor gyur pa'i 'bul ba dpag tu med pa dang / gos dar gyi dos chen po bcu bzhi tsam 'bul ba sogs mu mtha' med pa'i mtshod rdzas phyag tu phebs/de skabs rgyal po yab yum snyen ra bcas la rgya bod du dam pa'i chos ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus dang / las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dpag tu med pa nyin re bzhin —118—

gsungs pas/ sa skyong 'di lhag par dad de 'di phyi thams cad du skyabs gnas bslu ba med par shes shing / dpal kyai rdo rje la sogs pa bla med kyi dbang bka' mang pos smin par mdzad/ rjes gnang dang bka' lung grangs med par stsal/ rje 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma ches mchog tu 'dzin no/ /de nas dpon slob rnams or rgyus kyi rgyal po se chen shud tha'i tsis zhabs tog mu mtha' med par rgya chen mchod bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ rgya'i nang mi chur phebs mi dbon chen po kam chu du'u thang gis spyan drangs te rnyed bkur dpag tu med pa dang bcas/sngon rgyal po go dan gyis btab pa'i pho brang lang gyur phebs khyad par 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul cho se rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khu dpon gyis btab pa'i shar phyogs sprul pa'i sder zhabs kyis bcags te/ de dang nye ba'i lho dbang sde/ nub pa tsho sde/ byang rgya mtsho'i sde/ zhes pa rnams su mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas gtib par mdzad slar yang karma lha khang nas 'bul nod rgya chen po dang / or rgyus rgyal po'i dngul srang lnga brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal sogs 'bul/ mos pa dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya wo po bskor/ shing kun mkhar sogs mjal bar bzhed pa byung na'ang / tshad pa sogs kyis dgag dgos la brten nas ma phebs shing / de skabs kam chu du'u thang gi zhu ba la sprul pa'i sde'i gtsug lag mes bzhes pa'ang legs par zhig gsos grub pa dang /gzhan pa zla'i sde la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di rnams sa paṇa khu dbon gyi dus nas yin zhing / bla ma khyed kyang sa skya'i rang lugs 'dzin pa la nye ba zhig yin par snang bas/ dgon gnas 'di rnams lha 'bangs dang bcas pa phyag tu —119—

'bul bas cis kyang bzhugs par zhu zhes nan gyis zhu ba byung na'ang / bod yul gyi bstan pa la dgongs nas bzhugs par ma gnang / rim pas zi ling mkhar phyogs su phebs pas/ mkhar chen krong nang zhes pa nas 'ja' lam brgyud nas/ rgya'i skye bo che phra rnams la so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing thar pa'i lam la bkod nas/ rim gyis la gsar du phebs/ stag lung 'bum dpon gyi sar bzhugs pa'i skabs sde ba lhun 'grub rdzong pa 'di phyogs su 'das pa ye shes kyis gsal bar mkhyen te/ 'khor rnams la bka' bstsal/ de nas rim gyis dbus pa'i gdan 'dren rnams kyang 'byor/ rgya dang swog po'i skye bo mtha' yas pa chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de la spyir gong ma rgyal po tho gan the mur gyi rjes la bla ma rnam gnyis kyis ma byon phan chad du swog po rnams ni srin po'i spyod yul 'dzin pa dang / phyis ni rgya'i nang kun kyang mu stegs pa dang mthun pa'i thrin shing dang / stod hor stag gzig gi lugs sogs chos log mang zhing / bod nas dge ba'i bzhes gnyen rnams gzhan ma byon pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i phyogs kun yang chos tshul ngan par yod pa/rje 'dis bstan pa'i srol rma med pa la bkod/ swog po'i yul kun du ni bsnyen gnas len pa dang / srog gcod spangs pa dang / dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa len pa sogs dpag tu med/ rje 'di nyid kyis don gsungs shing swog po'i pag shi mkhas pas/ za ma tog bkod pa sogs mdo sde mang po dang /gzhan yang rnam thar dang sgrub thabs mang po swog po'i skad du bsgyur zhing / las 'bras spangs blang gi gnas la mig phye bar mdzad do/ /'brug lo zla ba gsum —120—

pa'i tshes gsum la swog yul gzhi nas phyag btegs te/ de nas rim gyis byang lam brgyud/ gdan sa chen po stag lung thang du phyag phebs/ dbus gtsang gi dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad la sku skyes kyis tshul du mang ja dang / 'gyed bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pas dge 'dun rnams yid mgu ba thob par mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag spyan 'dren par mdzad de 'bul ba'i dngos po gya nom pa blos gzhal bar dka' ba dpag tu med pa stobs par mdzad cing / dam pa des kyang rje 'di nyid kyi drung du paṇ+ḍi ta chos mchog gi thugs dam rten phyag bzo mar grags pa'i thub pa'i dbang po'i sku li ma ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig 'bul bar mdzad/ phan tshun thugs lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dpe bral du bzhugs so/ /༈ rgyal ba bskyed mdzad khyed kyi gsang ba gsum/ /nam mkha'i rjes 'gro 'di la ci zhig brjod/ /'on kyang thugs rje'i 'od brgya shar ba las mtha' 'khob sdig pa'i mun pa drung nas phyung / /klog dang bsam gtan tshul khrims ldan pa yis/ /rnam par gang ba'i sngon chad log lta'i yul/ /da ni rgyal ba'i zhing gi khud par gyur/ /ya mtshan 'di ni bla ma chos rje'i mthu/ /mtshon dang me char 'bebs ldan mchod 'os 'joms/ /'di dag rgyal ba'i 'phrin las can yin na/ /yid srub pho nya su zhig blo ldan dpyod/ /rje 'di kho na'i 'phrin las 'gro ba'i don/ /ces pa mtha' 'khob 'dul bar bstan pa sogs kyi mdzad pa las brtsam ste cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te drug pa'o// //

de nas lcags mo sbrul lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i yar tshes dge ba zhig la srid 'di'i phun tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas ra sa 'phrul snang gi lha khang chen po'i/ gtsug lag khang / dbus ma jo bo rin po che nyid bzhugs pa'i steng gi gser phibs chen mo la zhig gsos bya bar dgongs nas/ gza' skar bzang ba zhig la dbu gtsugs/ zangs leb rnams thad brdung dang / gad brdar dgos pa rnams dang / phal cher gsar bzhengs su mdzad dgos pa dang /mda' yab sgor ma 'brug mgo bzhi dang bcas pa thams cad gsar du brdung te/kun dril ba gser phibs chen mo 'di'i skud gser 'ba' zhig la/ gser zho stong phrag lnga kha 'thor ci rigs pas brgyan pa dang / dngul chu de'i drug bskor dang bcas pa shing cha thams cad gsar pa rjes tshon rtsi sogs dang / gtsug lag khang gi byang phyogs kyi 'khor phibs thams cad zhig gsos gnang ba dang /gzhan yang steng shod kun na zhig gsos mdzad dgos shin du mang por yod snang ba thams cad rdzogs par gnang zhing / 'di'i rgyu sogs gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dngul chu 'ba' zhig gi rin la'ang gzims dre'u nyis brgyar nye ba gnang ba sogs/ don gyi gtso bo sems can rnams mgu bar byed pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsgrub par bya ba yin pa ltar/ rin la brtseg pa dang / rgyu thabs kyis mgo bskor nas rang nyid tshong rgyal bar byed pa sogs gtan nas mi byed pa'i bka' khyab phyag g.yog so sor gnang nas rin yin lugs bzhin las kyang ches lhag tsam stsal ba sogs thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad du chos mthun 'ba' zhig gis bsgrub par gnang ba yin te/ sems —122—

can bslus nas sangs rgyas la mchod kyang bu bsad pa'i sha pha ma la drangs pa ltar rgyal ba mnyes pa'i lam las gol ba yin pa/ rgyal ba 'dis mkhyen zhing gzigs pas yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa yin te/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis kyang 'di bzhin du byos shig /de skabs su bal bo nyi shu lhag cig dang / ri mo ba/ shing bzo ba/ rdo bzo ba/ ja lag— pa sogs bzo pa nyis brgya skor gyi chas phog mar gnang zhing / grangs su ma btab pa'i longs spyod ni gzhal du med/ thugs rje'i mthus de bar 'thab 'khrug na ba sogs cung zad med pa/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du phal cher grub nas/ thub pa'i ring bsrel dang gzungs bzhugs 'khor lo sogs nang bzhugs khyad par can rnams kyis phyur bur gtams pa/ gañdzi ra lngas yongs su mdzes par mdzad/dpal ri bo dga' ldan gyi khri thog pa dang / dge slong sdom brtson bsnyen pa song ba brgya phrag mang bo'i 'khordo ra dang bcas nas rab gnas zhal gror bcas pa mdzad/ kyi shod pa'i zhal ngo'i thog drangs/ dpag tu med pa la dga' ston rgya chen po dang / rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon nas brtsam gang la gang dgos thams cad la gnang sbyin dpe bral du stsal/ khyad par bal po rnams la gser 'dab kyi yon sogs bzo bo rnams la gnang sbyin blo 'das dang / lha sar sde bzhir ja dang tshwa'i sgo 'gyed sogs lha sa'i zhig gsos 'di'i skabs su ji lta sra gnang ba'i rnam gzhag rnams zhib mor brjod na ni nyin zhag mang pos kyang rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni da ltar gyi dus na rig sngags dang g.yo thabs dang tshul 'chos la sogs pa ngan thabs thams cad kyis longs spyod rgya cher —123—

bsgrub nas/ bdag dang gzhan bag med pa'i rgyur sbyor ba'i log 'tsho dang /zhing ma yin pa rgyal po sdig can rnams lag 'gyangs kyis mgu bar byas nas rang phyogs su bsdu bar byed pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gis mi sbyin mi spyod par rnam par 'a tums shing gnas pa dang / kha cig ni longs spyod gya nom pa thams cad 'dre rgod mi srun pa dag la musdi par gtad de/ rang phyogs 'phel ba'i phyir de la snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab pas/ des kyang de dag gla rngan du bzung nas skal ba dman pa rnams kyi sems rgyud bskul te/ de'i phyogs la nye bar sbyor bar byed pa tsam zhig la snying por byed pa sogs log pa'i 'tsho ba lhur len pa rnams la khrel bsdas chen po mdzad pa'o/ /'dis ni bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad 'phral du nye bar zhi nas/dpal stag lung pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa zla ba yar ngo ltar 'phel rgyas su gyur pa 'di yin no/ /der skabs dang mthun par klu sgrub kyis phyag bzo'i lhan dho la ngo mtshar can de la/ tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i dri gtsang khang phyung ba'i zab brkos dang bcas pa legs par grub cing / slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i thugs dam gyi thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan bla med legs pa'i rtser son pa de nyid nang du bzhugs par mdzad/ 'di ni da ltar yang sku dang 'bral med du phyag mchod kyi rten du bzhugs pa lags/ swog yul nas phebs 'phral stag lung gi dge 'dun spyi la/ gling gi zhig gsos kyi thes su gnang sbyin sbung che bstsal 'dug pas/ 'di las nges par gling 'di la lcags ri zhig grub na legs zhes thams —124—

cad blo gros gcig tu gyur pa nas/ stag lo hor zla bzhi pa'i gnam gang gza' skar dge ba la zhabs kyis bcags shing phyag nas gnang / phyis rim pas legs par grub ste shin tu rgya che ba 'di tsam la'ang de dang der nyes skyon gyi rnam pa cung zad tsam yang med par rgyub pa yin no/ /lo 'di nyid kyi dbyar smad du bdag gis gsol ba btang cing spyan drangs pas phebs pa'i lam du/ hong stod pas rnyed bkur 'bul nod kyis mchod rim gyis lam du 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po dang bcas te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang chen po chos lung byang rtser phyag phebs/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten ngo mtshar ba bsgrang bar mi spyod pa bzhugs pa thams cad la kun du bzang bo'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bus mchod par mdzad/ de skabs don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas dang / rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo rje grub chen rin po che lha dbang grags pa dang / rje drung rin po che kun dga' dpal bzang po dang / bstan 'dzin sprul sku rin po che sogs bla ma che dgu mkhas shing grub pa zad mi shes pa zhal 'dzoms shing / thams cad kyis kyang dam pa 'di nyid la phu dud du bkur ba dang / bka' chos kyi 'brel ba re gsan/ rje 'dis kyang rje btsun rdo ring ba chen po kun dga'i mtshan can la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang sogs dang / rje thub pa'i dbang phyug la yang 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs dang / ras chung snyan brgyud kyi chos skor ma lus pa dang / dpal mgon drag shad kyi skor sogs mtha' yas pa'i chos sgo gsan — —125—

zhing / gzhan yang bdag cag der 'dus pa kun la ni chos dang zang zing gi 'byor pas nyin mtshan kun du 'da' bar gyur te/ bdag gis kyang rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po zhus shing / dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i bar gyis bka' drin nod do/ /gzhan yang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba dang / so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun pa'i chos zhu ba sogs dam pa'i chos kyi 'gro don gyis la stod kyi phyogs thams cad khyab par mdzad do/ /rim pas ri khrod chen mo mjal ba la jo mo nang du phebs pa na/ chos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis myos pa'i sgrub pa mo rnams kyis phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te spyan drangs/ der bzhugs kyi sgrub pa pho mo thams cad dang / dad 'dun gyi skye bo stong phrag mang pa la chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ slar yang 'jeng / rta nag shings sogs phebs lam gyi yul thams cad du dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa la chos dang 'byor pas tshim par mdzad/ gang dang gang du phebs pa de dang der 'di nyid kho na mi tshogs che zhing mos shugs che la/ chos kyis 'gro don yang de tsam du che'o snyam pa sha stag byung ngo / /de nas slar yang gdan sa nyid du phebs shing / de'i phyir lo gtso bo yang dag 'jog gnang zhing bar bar du 'gro ba'i don yang rgya cher mdzad/ spre'u lo swog po'i yul du dad can rnams kyis phul ba'i gos chen la sogs pa swog po'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dge ba las kyang dge ba srid mtha'i bar du bskrun par bzhed nas/ sprul sku sman thang pa blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs dang / 'bras sbungs sogs nas gos sku bzhengs pa la bzo ris mkhas pa rtser son pa sha stag bsdu bar gnang / phyis kyi —126—

gos chen las bzang thag chod pa 'ba' zhig la/ gos yug bcos med stong dang brgyad brgya tsam thog mar 'don pa gnang zhing / de dag gi sder lus ci rigs la phyis gzhan dang gzhan yang bsnan te/ mdor na zab chen yug stong phrag gnyis tsam las bsgrub pas thub chen gyi gos sku lha mgron mang po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rtse mchod khang gi gtsug lag khang chen mo las kyang ches dpangs mtho zhing / zhing du'ang de mtshungs su yod pa 'di nyid bzhengs par gnang ba'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ba dang / rje 'di nyid khu dpon 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes te/rab gnas kyi me tog gtor ba gnang ba'i skabs me tog gi char yid ches mngon rtags can phebs pa yun ring du byung / bkra shis dge mtshan dpag tu med pa'i gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs par snang ngo / /༈ kun gnas ngo mtshar rab dga'i bsti gnas mchog /ba spya shis 'phrul snang dge bar spyod pa las/ /mi mthun g.yul nas rgyal ba'i rgyas cu brnyes/ /'gro ba'i cu gyur bya dwo khyod nyid kyi/ /'gro don 'phrin las pha mtha' bgrang yas 'di/ /mngon 'gyur rnams la'ang gzhal bar mi nus na/ /lkog tu gyur la su zhig tshad 'jal byed/ khyod nyid kho nas khyod kyi rnam thar mkhyen/ /zhes pa khyad par gyi mdzad pa 'ba' zhig las brtsam ste cung zad bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te bdun pa'o// //bla ma de nyid kyi thugs rjes gos sku snga phyir bzhengs par mdzad pa thams cad la skya ris la spo len mi dgos pa dang / gos chen bsgrig pa'i tshe dang —127—

tshon yig sogs mi dgos par yid tsam gyi 'grig pa sogs ya mtshan nga pag tu med pa byung ngo / /de nas shing mo bya lo la/ stag lung ma thang du grags pa dpal ri bo che nas spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya ba rnams kyis kyang bskul te/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chen po rgyal tshab tu mngon par dbang bskur nas/ dpal ri bo cher phebs pa'i sgar grwa bsgrig par mdzad cing / mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyis phebs skyel la phebs/ myur du slar phebs pa'i rten 'brel du phebs skyel ba rnams la chos drug yid bzhin nor bu'i mgo btsugs tsam gnang / lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya mthil phyin dang myur du phebs pa'i zhal bzhes kyis dbug dbyung rim pas hor stod smad dang a grags sogs kyi ri khrod brgyud nas/ dpal ri bo che dang nye bar phebs bsu ja 'dren snga phyi rim pa gsum tsam dang / de nas nye bar sde pa mgon po rdo rje dpon g.yog gis chibs bsu dang / mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu rnams kyis mdun brdar te phebs bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu/ 'dren pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ma nyams pa gcig pu ba/mkhas btsun bzang pos mthar thug dngos grub mchog gi gnas brnyes pa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rin po che mtsho skyes rdo rjes nyid kyang gtsug lag khang gi sgo drung du phebs bsur phebs shing / mjal ba tsam gyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres te/ shin tu thugs phebs pa'i dgyes pa chen pos gtam gyis mtshams sbyor te/rje 'di nyid kyis kyang sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhal snga nas la/ rje rin po che sangs rgyas dbon grags pa dpal gyis bka' 'bum pod — 128—

chen bdun gyi lung dang / de ka'i nang na bzhugs so cog gi dbang bka' byin rlabs rje gnang rab 'byams 'byams klas pa dang / stag lung bka' brgyud/rgya gar gyi grub chen dzñā na ta pa'i gdams ngag sogs khrid bka' dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa dang / khyad par stag lung bka' brgyud nyid kyi gdam ngag rje bkra shis bla ma man chad du stag lung ma thang na yang mi bzhugs pa ji snyed gcig sa/san zhing / rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor yang dpag tu med pa gsan/ rje 'di nyid kyis bla ma dam pa de nyid la yang / gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis bzhed srol bla med kyi dkyil 'khor mang por dbang bskur pa dang / gzhan yang stag lung ma thang nas brgyud pa'i zab chos dpag tu med pa gnang / dbon rin po che sku phra mor bzhugs pa'ang rje 'di nyid kyi sku drung du dbu skra bsil/ spyir rje drung rin po che mtsho skyes rdo rje de nyid/lugs gnyis char nas dgongs pa'i rgya mtshor bzhugs pas/ dpal stag lung ba'i gdan sa gong 'og gnyis chos brgyud kyi khungs 'dod pa gcig pa tsam du ma zad/ thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi chos thams cad thig gcig spar gcig tu bzhugs mod/ rje rin po che bkra shis bla ma nas bzung bde gshegs rin po che rnam rgyal bkra shis kyi bar du gdan sa yar mar ha cang thugs 'brel che ba ma byung 'dug pas kyang / rang lugs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa la rang rkang tshugs par ma byung zhing / dus tshod 'di skabs na rje drung rin po che nyid kyang sku na tshod smin pa dang / dbon rin po che yang sku phra ba sogs kyi rje rin po che 'di nyid ma phebs na rim pas grwa rigs gsar pa kun ni nyi ma gang dro dang gong gang che'i —129—

rnam pas/ kar lugs sogs la 'gyur ba'i gnas kyang yod par dgongs nas/rje 'di nyid ched kyi spyan 'dren par yang mdzad pa yin snang la/ gzhan yang bka' ba3nya pa la/ ma thang gi gtsug lag khang mes bzhes pa sogs kyis da lta byin rlabs rten sogs ri bo che nyid ches bkang bar bzhugs pas/ bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam rten sogs gtos che ba 'bul/ zhes gsungs shing / de ka bzhin phyag tu 'bul bar mdzad pa yang / thang pa chen po nyid kyi thugs dam 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa'i dngul sku khri rgyab can dang / rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi thugs bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung bkra shis 'od 'bar sku yal rin po che rin chen mgon po sogs kyi/ dngul sku rgyab yol can phyag nas ma mang po/ klu 'jim gyi mdzad brgya/ rdo rje 'chang gi dngul sku rgyab yol ma grub thob brgyad cu'i tshogs kyi sku'i bkod pa can/ 'dzam bus gling na bzo bkod legs pa'i dper bzhag pa sogs thugs dam rten bris 'bur gyi tshogs ngo mtshar ba can mtha' yas pa dang rje btsun mar pa nas brtsams brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi dbu skra dang na bza' sogs byin rlabs kyi rten cha tshang ba/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi bka' 'bum tshar gnyis dang / gzhan yang phyag dpe dkon pa mang po dang /dwangs shel gyi spos phor/ gzi yon chen gyi gsol khrab sogs khyad par nor mang po phyag tu phul/ bar skabs shig tu zur mang dang karma pa'i phyogs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis spyan drangs/ khong rnams kyi blo dang mthun par karma kam tshang gi zab chos mang po'i 'khor lo bskor bas sems can tshim par mdzad/ sgom sde nang chen pas spyan drangs/ 'bul ba'i dngos po rgya cher phul/ tshogs bdag —130—

gis chos skor sogs blo dang mthun pa'i chos mang du gnang / slar yang dpal ri bo cher phebs te/ stag lung gi gdan sa yar mar gnyis chos dang srid kyi 'phrin las thams cad sgo gcig tu 'gyur bar bka' bgros/ 'bul nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas/ phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i thugs lhag par 'phreng bzhin pas phebs skyel gyi bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas rim pas yar phebs/ phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer lnga la stag lung thang du phebs shing / ri bor cher gsan pa'i bka' chos rnams dang / zhal thang sogs byin rlabs can mang po mchog gi sprul pa'i sku la skyes kyis tshul du 'bul ba gnang / dpal stag lung thang gi gtsug lag khang chen mo'i steng gi gser phibs snga gong nas rim pas phal cher grub na'ang / lhag ma rnams skabs 'dir zhabs mjug rdzogs par gnang zhing / byang rā sgreng du phebs skabs shig /de nyid du bzhugs pa'i thugs dam pa bgres po zhig gis rang gi rdzas gang yod gser du bsgyur ba'i gser zho kha shas gcig phyag tu phul nas/lha khang ka gnyis ma'i gser thog gser gdan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan phul bas nye bar thugs bskul te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams gnas mchog de'i gnad kyi snying po/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku dngos byon sogs byin rlabs kyi gzi byin mu mtha' med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang ka gnyis ma'i gser thog de nyid sngon dus skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gis cung zad mgo rtsom par mdzad kyang 'phror lus nas phal cher ma grub pa la yongs su rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i zhal bkod —131—

gnang nas ring por mi thogs par legs par grub/ 'di'i skud gser la yang gser zho drug brgya lhag gcig song zhing / de ka'i yon dang rab gnas kyi bar du rgya cher gnang ngo / /'di na gang gi mdzad pa bgrang yas kyang / /thams cad gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig lags/ /ris med mchod pa'i yul rnams mchod pa dang / /ris med dam chos rgya cher spel bar mdzad/ /dam chos bdud rtsi nub par nye ba rnams/ /mgon po khyod kyis shin du dar bar mdzad/ /dbyar dus chu bo rgyas la ngo mtshar ci/ /dkon pa tsam du rin thang che zhes grags/ /bzang ngan mi dpyod rang phyogs kho na zhes/ /snying la brnag pa'ang gzhan lugs skyon med dag /smod byed chen po dag gis yid 'jigs nas/ /skyabs gnas skyabs mchog khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas par mdzad pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig las brtsam ste bsnyad pa'i gtam ste brgyad pa'o// //glang lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang rnam rgyal kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyang / rje 'di nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad cing / slob dpon du 'os pa gnyis dang / grib tshod pa dang dad pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga bzhags par mi 'os pas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de skabs su sog po'i rgyal bo a sbal gyis nan ches kyis phebs par gsol ba btab pa'i pho nya ba'ang sku drung du bcar sdod du yod cing / spyir sku na wo smin pa dang sog yul —132—

thag ring zhing bgrod dka' ba sogs rgyu mtshan du mas/ grwa bu slob yon bdag sde dpon so so thams cad dang / bdag cag phyogs mtha' ba thams cad kyis kyang me phebs par bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab kyang / rje nyid dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis chos thams cad sgrib med gcig char du gzigs pa'i bka' las/ da lan cis kyang sog yul du 'gro dgos yod cing / lo gsum nas nges par nyes skyon med par 'khor 'ong zhes zhal bzhes bzang pos bdag cag re ltos bcas thams cad la dbugs 'byin par gnang / hor zla drug pa'i nang du dpon slob rnams gdan sa nyid nas phyag btegs/ hor stod nas dpon sas mjal bar phebs/ lam gyi sems can rnams kyi don rgya cher gnang nas byang lam bsrang nas phebs pas 'bri chu shin du rgyas pa la phyag nas gnang ba tsam gyis chung ngu song nas dpon slob rnams nye zho med par phar thon/ de bzhi du rma chu la yang phyag nas gnang bas de bzhin du byung zhing / dpon slob rnams chab kyi pha kar thon 'phral chu ni sngar lugs bzhin rgyas nas 'dug zer/ chu bo chen po gcig la nyag gcig yong bar 'dug pa chad nas gzhan rnams kyis ci byar yang med pa gcig byung 'dug pa/ rje nyid kyi dgongs pas dpyad de lam sna gnang brgal phebs 'dug pa thams cad bde bar thon de/ slar yang de ma thag chu'i gting bltas dus rab tshugs pa'i sa gtan med par 'dug /de nas rim gyis dab phyi thu ru sog po'i gdan 'dren pa rnams kyang slebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho zhing brdzes pa'i gtam byung bas phyag g.yog rnams sems 'jigs pa la/ rje nyid kyis rang re rnams la nyes skyon med ces —133—

dbugs 'byin par mdzad pas yid bde ba la bkod/ de nas mtsho skya rengs dang sngo rengs gnyis kyi bar gyi lam bzung nas phebs pas/ chal phyi zhes pa'i bar rim gyis phebs shing / thog mar a sbal gyi dpon mo mjal du byung / slar mi phyed pa'i dad pa can gyi rgyal po a sbal nyid kyis spyan drangs/ rgyal bu nyid bro tshabs chen po zhig gis btab nas yun ring po lon pa sman dpyad sogs gang gis phan par ma byung snang ba/ rje rin po che nyid phebs nas khrus chog dbang bka' sogs gnang ba dang / bka' bstsal ltar gyi zas spyod bgyis pa tsam gyis nad tshab chen po yang 'phral nyid nas je drag la song / phebs skor 'di la sngar gyi yon bdag rnying pa thams cad kyis kyang sngar srol gyi lugs kho nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gus pa chen pos mchod cing / bod char gtogs pa'i a rag gi sde rnams su yang 'phrin las kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing /stag lo'i nang du tho ye shes kyi rgyal po chen po al dan gyi tsha bo pe chen khan gyis spyan drangs/ rgyal mo kha thun sogs thams cad kyis mjal/ mchog tu gus pa chen pos 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / rang rang so so'i blo dang mtshungs par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ 'di skabs kyang tsong kha'i sa cha stag lung la gsar lha khang du / mda' dar 'bum dpon gyis spyan drangs shing rnyed bkur byas/ sa phyogs de rnams su chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ sog po'i rgyal po gu yeng tsong chi des ching gis spyan drangs nas chos 'brel mang du zhus/de nas rim pas o rus ju lang rgyal pos spyan drangs/ snga ma bzhin du 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa byung / 'brug gi lo la tho mis kyi rgyal po 'khor lo ching —134—

bas ngur gyis spyan drangs/ phebs bsu'i tshe mchog tu dkar ba'i rta mchog bcu gsum dar dkar yug gi mthur mda' dang bcas te phul/ mjal ba tsam gyis mchog tu gus pa chen po thob nas chos mang du zhus shing / dngul gzhong mang por mar me sbar nas 'bul ba sogs mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa blo las 'das pa byung / rje 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma mthar thug tu 'dzin zhing mi phyed pa'i dad pa g.yin dang mi mnyam pa thob/ de nas dus skabs bde bar byung na/ sog yul mthul gyi rgyal po gzhan dang g.yin dag kyang sbyan 'dren pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu yod par snang bas/ lo mang po'i bar du phebs thub pa dka' ba 'dug kyang rje nyid kyi ye shes kyis gzigs pas bka' stsal phebs pa de kho na bzhin yin par snang bas/ rgya dang sog po 'thab dgos pa'i stabs nas/ rgyal brgyud so so gzhan dang gzhan dag gis sku gzhogs su ja 'dren myur du 'byor zhing spyan 'dren sogs 'phral sleb ma byung ba'i bar la yar phebs pa'i dgongs gtad gnang ba phyag thog tu khel thub ste/ 'di ni 'o skol kha ba can pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthu'o/ /yar phebs pa'i lam du yi ge sba khom zhes pa'i sa char sgar byings rnams logs zhig na yod cing / gzims gur cung zad 'gol sa zhig na yod pa/ nam phyed tsam zhig gi dus sku gzhogs na mi su yang med pa la/ bka' bstsal mang po zhig gnang gin 'dug pa/ de dang nye ba na mchod g.yog pas thos te/ bla rdol gyi gsungs yin nam snyam du sems nas snyan du phul bas kha rog sdod gsungs/ phyi rol tu bltar song bas/gzims gur gyi logs na bya shin tu che ba gshogs sgro re la'ang 'dom gnyis —135—

re tsam yod pa zhig rje rin po che'i phyogs la 'dud par byed pa zhig 'dug pa mthong ba na/ drung du btud pas 'phur thabs la mi snang bar song ngo / /nang du 'ong bas de nyid mkhyen te/ bya de'i drung du khyod kyis btud pa ma legs/ khyed rnams kyis byar mthong ba yin gyi/ rma chen sbom ra 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir 'ong nas chos gtam 'phel bdo pa'i skabs yin pa la/ de la chos gtam gyi bar chad cung zad byung gsungs/ de nas rim gyis byang lam brgyud nas myur shar du phebs pas/ rim pas 'bri chu gos gong la ru phebs pa'i tshe/ gnyan chen thang lhas phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po'i gzigs snang byung bar snang /byang lam brgyud pa'i stabs sa yang mtho rab tu phebs/ 'brug lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang yin na'ang / nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs shing sa chu dros song ste/ 'byags pa'i zhun chu la mi thar pa tsam byung zhing / gdan sa chen po stag lung du phebs pa dang / thang pa rin po che'i dngul sku phyag nas ma'i rgyab yol/ rgya khyon bzo bkod rgyu tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa de nyid legs par grub pa'i rab gnas dga' ston dang 'dzoms/ mchog tu bkra shis shing rten 'brel 'grigs so/ /༈ yul gang dam chos snang ba rgyas mdzad nas/ /slar yang kun tu dga' ba rdo rje'i gnas/ /ba grwa shwes rnam par rgya lta ba'i khang bzang mchog /lhun po'i spo la mgon po mchog nyid bzhugs/ /dus gsum shes bya'i gnas la ye shes ni/ /rnam bkra'i gzugs la mig gis blta ba bzhin/ /ma nor mkhyen pa'i bka' stsal mngon sum gyur/ /mi shes yid kyi ri mor 'bri ba ni/ /mkhyen ldan —136—

rnams kyis mchog tu 'grel ba'i gnas/ /'on kyang blun po rtag tu rang blos spyod/ /'di yang shin tu rmad byung 'ba' zhig lags/ /zhes pa 'phags pa'i bka' mchog tu mi bslu ba las brtsams te bsnyad pa'i sde tshan te dgu pa'o// //sog yul du phebs pa'i bar la rje 'di nyid kyi lcam du gyur pa dpon sa rnam rgyal dpa' mo gshegs pa'i nang rten du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bden gnyis zhal can gyi sku brnyan mi tshad chung tsam zhig /bal po'i bzo bo mkhas pas lag 'phru/la las sngags sku gser zangs las bzhengs pa la mtshar ba'i dper thon pa zhig bsgrub par mdzad/ gzungs bzhugs la sogs pa'i rim pa thams cad gzab rgyas su gnang / de nas rim pas 'khor lo bde mchog gi gser sku/ rje btsun ma de nyid dang sku tshad mnyam pa zhig dang / slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang 'gro ba'i mgon po a ti sha 'brom ston chen po rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rnams kyi sku brnyan mi tshad ma re re bzhengs par gnang zhing / gzungs bzhugs dang rab tu gnas pa'i bar zab rgyas su gnang /de dag gi bar du yang hor dang bod kyi 'gro don mdzad pa ni dpag tu med/ de nas 'brug lo'i nang bdag cag stod phyogs na yod pa'i skabs shig sgro rong nas gzims dpon nam mkha' 'bod mir gnang byung ba bzhin/ sku gzhogs su 'byor/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bka' drin du zhus pa yang bstsal/ de nas sog yul du phebs pa'i skabs dad can rnams kyis phul ba'i gos yug shin tu mang ba phyag tu bzhugs pa rnams/ snga ma bzhin 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi rten bsgrub par bzhed te/ gos sku snga ma'i skabs las kyang —137—

ches rgyu tshogs bzang po'i gos sku khyad par can bsgrub par dgongs shing / 'di skabs kyang gos yug chen po stong phrag skor song zhing / jus gsar rnying sngo ljang mchin kha sogs gser ma ches shin tu bzang ba rang yang dpag tu med pa 'don par mdzad 'du byed pa sprul sku sman thang ba sogs kyang bka' bstsal gyis bsdu bar mdzad de/ rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi nub phyogs kyi sa khad snyoms pa zhig tu/gza' tshes dge ba la sprul sku sman thang bas skya ris btab nyi ma gnyis tsam la skya ris rnams yongs su rdzogs/ de 'phral du rtse'i mchod khang zhig gi khyams su bzo pa rnams kyis bzo btsugs te/ zla ba gcig lhag tsam nas yongs su rdzogs par 'grub/ 'di yang sngar gyi gos sku r+ṣa mo'i 'khor gyi tshul du/'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug /rgyal chen bzhi/ ha shang / dharma ta la/ gzhan yang lha chen 'ga' zhig dang bcas dkyus kyi ring thung gos sku chen mo dang mnyam zhing / zhing ni gnyis kar la phan tshun 'dom drug tsam yin pa/ bzo khyad mtshar ba'i phul du phyin pa byung / gza' tshes bzang ba la bdag la rab gnas gyis zhes bka' stsal te/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye zhing / rab gnas kyi cho ga byings rnams legs par grub pa na/ gtsug lag khang gi byang dngos su legs par bkram ste/ 'dren pa khu dbon gnyis gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad kyis brtan bzhugs shis brjod dang bcas te me tog gtor/ de skabs nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim rim brtsegs mang po dang / me tog gi char 'bebs shing nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang po byung/ de —138—

nas slar yang mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la chos kyi rje rin po che nyid bzhugs pa la/ bdag cag rnams kyis shis brjod mnga' gsol bgyis/ rje btsun bla ma sku tshe brtan pa la sogs pa'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'grig par nges shes skyes/ nyin phyed tsam la bstan pa'i gtso bo rje btsun khu dbon rnam gnyis sku chas shin tu zab pa sogs kyis mthong ba tsam gyis mchog tu zil che ba'i sku'i rnam cha rin po che'i khri la zhabs zungs brtan par mdzad/ phyag phyir bdag dang mkhas pa'i dbang po dus zhabs pa chen po byams pa lhun grub pa dang / drung pa ka drug pa dang / drung pa dkyil srang ba dang / drung pa 'ol ba sogs/ bla ma slob dpon shin tu mang ba dang / lha bzo ba gnas brtan chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho ba la sogs pa bzo ris pa thams cad dang / grwa nang gling gsum gyi mi sde la sogs pa'i drag bsdus 'ba' zhig pa la grwa pa lnga rgya tsam byung zhing / lha khang shod go mtshams med par gang ba'i ston mo'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtsang zhing gya nom pa/sngon thub pa chen po 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ lha dang mi yi rgyal po rnams kyis bsnyen bkur ba'i rnam cha la yang 'di lta bu'o/ /zhes rjes su dpog par bskyed cing / bdag cag rab gnas bgyi ba rnams nas brtsams gang la gang 'os kyi yon rdzongs gnang spyin gzhal bar dka' bas gtsug lag khang chen mo de nyid kyang bun long du gyur zhing / phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan nam mkha' la reg par gyur to/ /de dus bdag gis kyang sku drung du zla ba bzhir nye bar bsdad cing / bka' bstsal nan gyis gnang ba la brten nas/ bdag lta bu la 'bul ba'i nus pa gtan med kyang / bla ma'i bka' bstsal de nyid byin —139—

rlabs kyi sgo yin par bsam nas/ dgongs bzhed kyi chos thams cad 'bul ba'i lugs su bgyis/ de dag kyang bsam mi khyab kyi yan lag bla ma sgrub pa/phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po ye shes 'char ba/ dran pa gcig pa/ sgron me gcig pa/yan lag drug la/ dzā lan dha ra'i do he'i skor/ sems kyi phyag rgya yi ge bzhi pa/rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa dang / rngon pa'i gdam ngag /phag mo sna tshogs mdog /phag mo keng rus la bzhugs pa/ rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma/khams gsum dbang bsdud kyi spyan ras gzigs/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rigs gsum tsam/ phag mo ca co sgrogs ma/ bdag med ma dang ba'i rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams dang / rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang / bka' babs bdun ldan gyi skor rnams te slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pa nas brgyud pa rnams dang / sa lugs kyi dmar mo skor gsum la sogs pa mang du phul/ bdag phyir 'ong khar brtan bzhugs zab rgyas su phul nas/ myur du mjal bar smon lam btab nas stod phyogs la 'ong zhing / dus 'di skabs phyin chad nas phal cher rnam rgyal rab brtan nyid du yang dag 'jog nyid la gtso bor bzhugs shing / rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi mdun ngos kyi ri de la sa dpyad la/ rdo rje phag mo dang / gu ru pad+ma sam bha wa dang / nor bu dga' 'khyil gyi gzugs brnyan 'dra rung du yod pa de rnams dngos su ye shes kyi gzigs pa'i gsal snang la yang yang shar/ 'di ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams gnas chen byin rlabs can gyi tshul du yang sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par bshad pa bzhin/ ji lta ba'i dngos gnas kyi gnas tshul gzigs pa yin gyi nyams kyis snang ba tsam ni ma yin —140—
