'bag dang bcas pa bzhengs pa gnang / rab tu gnas pa gnang nas ye shes pa bzhugs nges pa'i zil can du gyur/ de skabs jo nang gi che bgres rnams kyis rje nyid kyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma gcig bzheng zer/ rgyu dar zab sman bzang drugarin po che'i phye ma sna tshogs pa bsres pa las grub pa/ nang gzhug sku gsung thugs kyi rten gzungs sngags/ ring bsrel sogs dpag tu med pas bkang ba 'di bzhengs nas/ rab tu gnas pa rgyas par gnang nas 'du khang du bzhugs su gsol/ rta lo sku mtshams dam par gnang yod pa'i skabs dbyar sos bsam 'grub rtse nas dpon sa bdag mo'i drung chos bros mdzad nas phebs/ de nas myur stabs su sde pa kun spangs drung sku mched kyang myur shangs su phebs/dpon sa rin po che nas gtsug phud bzhes dgos tshul nan zhus byung na yang /sku mtshams stabs nas su la yang mjal kha ma gnang / 'on kyang bka' bkod gnang ba'i zhal ngo mthun grub kyi sgo nas dbu bsil gnang / sde pa sku mched kyis kyang 'bul ba rgya che ba mdzad nas phyir thegs/ lug lo rje dbon drung mnga' ris la rnam rgyal chos sde'i mkhan por rdzong ltar gnang / de nas spre'u lo lo gsar dbu legs nas kyi zhabs phyir chos lung sgrub sde ba nyi shu tsam gyis kyai rdo rje chos lung sgrub pa byin gyis bde mchog lha lnga/ jo nang cho ga shes pa rnams kyis dus 'khor jo nang lugs/ dgon pa bde chen pa rnams kyis dus 'khor bdag chen lugs/ brag ram pas kun rig /dkar po bas kyai rdor sgrub mchod byed mi rnams tshes drug la 'dzoms thig btab/ bdun pa sta gon tshes brgyad rgyal phur 'dzom pa la dngos gzhi ste/ dkyil 'khor yang dus 'khor ras bris —194—

dang / gzhan rnams rdul tsho ni las bzhengs/ rab tu gnas pa gnang bas/ ston pa dus 'khor/ kun mkhyen rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rnams kyi skus me tog bzhes shing / nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim phub pa kun gyis mthong bas dad mos ngo mtshar dpag med du gyur/ rab gnas dga' ston yang tsā dra'i bza' ba rgya che dpangs mtho ba dang / de skabs gzhis rgyang byang gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i khri snar gting skyes sogs/ so so nas 'bul ba rgya che ba 'byung / de nas rig byed pa rnams la ja gos dar gtso bor gyur pa/ dpon slob so sor gang la gang 'tshams blo yul las 'das pa lta bu'i gnang sbyin gnang bas yid mgu ba bla na med pa thob cing / rje nyid kyis bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par gnang ste/ stag lung gtso bor gyur pa'i dad pa can rnams kyis phul ba'i dngos po rnams chud mi zos par song zhing thugs bde bar gyur/ de nas zla ba gnyis sku mtshams gnang ba grol mtshams/ gnas rnying nas rje gsang ba'i drung bka' chos gsan pa la ched gtad phebs pa la/ tshe dbang khrid bcas/ sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skor rnams dang rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs kyi lung sogs bka' chos mang bar gnang / de nas dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mkhan rin po che lung rig pa dpon slob rnams chos lung byang rtse'i rten mjal dang / rje nyid du bka' chos gsan pa la phebs byung ba nas/ jo nang du spyir bka' chos mang ba dang / khyad par ras chen dpal 'byor nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang gnang bas/ tshe mda' 'phel ba'i rten 'brel byung bas shin tu thugs dgyes par gyur/ rje nyid kyis kyang dus 'khor lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal —195—

'byor gsan nas/ mkhan chen pa dpon slob phyir thegs/ dgun khrid grol nas sku mtshams rgyang tsam gnang / bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gtso bor gnang nas ltas khyad par rnams brnyes/ de mtshams khri khang nas yum grongs song bas dgongs rdzogs la spyan 'dren byung ba nas/ chos lung dang jo nang gi sgrub sde drag bsdus dang bcas phebs/ snga dro mi 'khrugs pa dang /dgong mo rnal 'bya mor ma'i gsung chog mdzad pa'i sgo nas rjes su bzung / grol khar dge 'dun mang dag 'dus pa'i dbus su bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ bya rgod gshongs kyi mkhan chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa/ khro phu gdan sa pa shag tshal 'bum ram pa sogs mang dag la ni gu'i khrid lung dang bcas pa dang / rjes gnang 'ga' shas gnang / byang pa bdag pos rma bya shug khrod kyi logs bris rab gnas la spyan 'dren zhus nas phebs/ rab gnas zhag gsum gnang / me tog gi char 'babs pa sogs ltas kyang legs par byung / der sa skyong chen po sku gzhon pa yid bzhin nor bu'i drung la tshe dbang lha dgu/ grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa sogs gnang nas ngam ring rtser phebs/ der yang bka' chos mang bar gnang nas/ rngod la brgyud gdong dgar phebs/ zhag 'ga' yar song dus nub gcig gzim chung gi lho nub mtshams su thog babs/rje nyid kyi zhabs sus g.yas pa'i bzhugs gdan nas song bas/ nang so bstan pa legs sogs zhal ngo thams cad thugs 'tshabs pa'i ngang la phebs byung bas/ nged la ci yang gnod pa ma byung 'og tu gzigs gsungs/ gzigs pas mi gnyis la me lce gnod pa byung na yang phugs skyon ma byung / de'i sang mdang —196—

dgong grub pa'i rtags dngos su ston pa mdzad pa'i sku la nyes skyon med pa'i dga' ston yin gsungs/ karma gan kar gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba rlabs che ba byung / der tshe dbang dang mgon po'i bka' bsgos sogs gnang nas/ lha rtse brgyud jo nang du phebs/ de thams cad du ngam ring sde srid dpon blon/ gzhis ka zhabs drungs/ khri snar/ gting skyes sogs phyogs tha dad nas grub pa'i rtags mngon gyur du ston pa gnang ba'i dga' ston gyi 'bul ba rgya che ba dang /bstod bkur bsngags pa'i 'phreng ba phul lo/ /de nas dgun khrid 'dzug pa gnang / sngon 'gro'i skabs su dus 'khor chos 'byung sogs spyi bshad rgyas pa dang mchog dbang gi skabs las can 'ga' shas kyis rje nyid rdo rje shugs dngos su mthong ba yang byung / dngos gzhi'i skabs khrid zhu ba phal che ba la rtags snang ci rigs su shar zhing / chos lung du dus chen la phebs/ grol 'phral snar thang nas spyan 'dren byung ba bzhin/ dpon sa yum zhing brjes pa'i dgongs rdzogs su 'dug pas zla phyed tsam bzhugs nas mi 'khrugs pa'i gsung chog dang / mthar mtshan byang bzhu ba tshwa tshwa'i bar du grub nas/ snar thang tshogs su sa dge gnyis 'dus kyi dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/bcom ldan rigs ral gyi bzhugs khri'i steng nas bsngo ba shis brjod kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa gnang / yar lam chu mig gi rje btsun ma la phyag mchod gnang nas ri khrod chen mor phebs/ dbyar chos la smar khrid sbyor rtsa ma gnang /de nas dbon drung rin po che'i gdan 'dren dang bstun chos lung byang rtser phebs/ sgrub sde la ni gu'i khrid rgyas pa dang / smon gror zhal ngo rnams la tshe —197—

dbang brgya rtsa sogs gnang skabs/ byang nas bdag po rin po che bkra shis stobs rgyal phebs/ bka' chos dgos gsungs nan skyed che ba nas dgongs bzhed dang bstun tshe 'dzin dkar po'i rjes gnang thog mar gnang nas/ de rjes tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ tshe khrid tshe dbang lha dgu mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs bka' chos mang dag gnang nas/ jo nang du phebs/ sgrub sde la snying po don gsum gyi khrid mi tru dzo ki'i rnam thar/ bu ston chos 'byung gi bshad lung sogs gnang / byang stag lung sogs dbus phyogs nas sngar nas spyan 'dren snyan zhus mang dag byung zhing / de skabs spyan 'dren nan che nas shar phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur nas/ snar thang bsam 'grub rtse khri khang sogs su bka' chos rim par gnang nas/ rong ral lngar zhabs drung steng zhal mjal/ tshe dbang kyi rdor gyi dbang / dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid rjes gnang 'ga' yang gnang /ngur smig tu sgrol ma gsungs 'byon la snyan dar zhal gser phyag mchod dang /bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i phyag rjes la phyag mchod smon lam gnang nas rong grags sar phebs/ tshe rta sbrags ma sogs gnang / rim gyis rong chen brgyud de dpal der phebs/ der yang bka' chos mang bar gnang / gam pa la la phebs nas chu bo ri'i shan la brgyud nas/ gdan 'dren dang bstun nas smyug la/chu shul gye re/ 'tshar sa sna ljangs snye thang rnams su rim pas phebs/ gang la gang 'dod kyi chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher bstsal/ lam bar na yod pa'i gnyos sangs rgyas ras chen gyi sku lder phyag nas ma sogs gyi re'i lha khang gi rten gsum rnams dang / snye thang 'khor gyi jo bo'i gnas rten rnams dang / chos rdzong —198—

gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bzhugs gnas rten gsum sogs thams cad la phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par gnang / de nas chos 'khor lha sar phebs/ jo bo rin po che sogs 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad kyi gtsos pa'i rten byin rlabs can rnams la zhal gser/ snyan dar dkar me phyag mchod rgyas pa dang /gser ston rgya che ba gnang / dpon sa chos skyong dbang mos spyan drangs/ yer pa lha ri snying por phebs/ gnas thams cad zhib mjal gnang zhing bka' chos shin tu 'phel/ de nas glang thang du phebs tshogs pa la mang ja dang chos 'brel gnang / shar ba 'bum pa dang / po to sogs mjal nas stag lung du phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te phebs/ rje rin po che rtse ba khu dbon dang mjal thog mar tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang / de nas tshe dpag med lha dgu brgya rtsa/ grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ tshe khrid rgyas pa/ sgrol dkar gyi khrid/ dmar po skor gsum/ ku ru ku lce'i gsang khrid ni gu'i khrid 'bring bo chos drug so so'i bka'/ ye shes mgon po'i bka' ni gu'i rnam thar dang khrid yig sogs po ti gnyis kyi lung / dzam dmar tshe ring mched lnga bo dong ba'i lugs kyi thugs dam lha lnga'i rjes gnang rnams dang / tshogs chen la bka' gdams glegs bam dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar gyi lung dang / smra khrid rnams gnang / so so'i 'dod chos gang la gang 'tshams su gnang / stag lung pa dpon slob thams cad kyi zhabs tog 'bul ba mtha' yas pa mdzad/ byang rwa sgreng du phebs/ jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje la zhal gser snyan dar sogs mchod pa dang /gnas mjal zhib pa dang / de thams cad du smon lam rgyas par gnang nas lcang —199—

lung chos sding du phebs/ rten rnams la dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa dang /mkhan po dbu mdzad tshogs pa la chos 'brel mang ja 'gyed bcas gnang / chos 'khor rtser paṇa chen rdor rgyal pa'i nang rten la zhal gser snyan dar/ tshogs pa la mang ja zhu mi gnang nas lha sar phebs/ zhal gser snyan dar sogs 'bul ba rgyas pa gnang / yar rgyab nas sde pa dpon chen yang der phebs pa dang thugs mjal bar phebs byung zhing chos 'brel gnang / phyis yar rgyab la phebs dgos zhu ba byung yang phebs ma thub/ gung thang dang mtshal gyi rten mjal gnang nas/ shel gro lum pa sogs brgyud nas drang srong srin po ri'i rten mjal mdzad/ sbyan 'dren byung ba bzhin gong dkar du phebs/ sras yum la bka' chos gnang / gam pa dang dpal de nas grags sar phebs/ tshe dbang lha dgu dang brgya rtsa sogs gnang / bdag gis rab tu byung ba'i bka' drin mnos/'jam dkar dang mi ḍā rjes gnang yang sa/nang / pho brang rin po che skrungs par phebs/ zhabs drung steng zhal sras bcas su/ tshe dbang kyai rdo rje'i dbang /mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang nas bkra shis rdzong dkar phebs/ tshe dbang sogs gnang / gnyen yod gser mdog can gyi chos grwar chen por dge 'dun tshogs chen gyi ser sbrengs zab rgyas kyis spyan drangs/ bla brang chen por phebs/ mkhan chen zla ba bzang pos kyang phebs bsu sogs srid zhu dpag med mdzad/ der tshogs chen la mang ja 'gyed bcas/ bsngo rten gzabs ma/ dngul gdung rin po cher gos yug /rje btsun byams pa la dar yug gi snyan dar/ sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu la zhal gser byams khang lam 'bras lha khang / mgon —2tshi—

khang kun mkhyen don yod dpal 'byor sogs so sor snyan dar/ mar me mchod rdzas phul zhing / phyag mchod smon lam dpag med gnang / ka drug mar mkhan slob/ bka' bcur rab 'byams dpon chos mdzad/ rags bsdus la paṇa chen rin po che'i rnam thar/ khrid brgya dus 'khor bsdus rgyud sogs kyi lung dang tshe dbang / tshogs chos su 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang gnang nas pho brang bsam 'gru/ba rtser phebs/ sde pa zhing gi bsnyen bkur zhabs tog zhus/ snar thang shel dkar sogs su 'dod chos gnang nas ri khrod chen mor phebs/ dbyar tshes la blo sbyong 'gro mgon dpal ye'i yig cha ltar gyi khrid dang / rgyab chos su legs bshad kun 'dus sogs kyi lung gnang nas/ mtshan ltas 'tshub tsam byung nas tshe sgrub kyi sku mtshams shin tu dam pa gnang / zla ba gcig lhag tsam song ba'i tho rangs kha cig gi mnal lam na/ glo bo'i rma bya shug khrod kyi lung pa kun me tog gser gtso ma'i mdog can gyis khengs par byung bas/ de tshe sgrub kyi ltas su legs par bshad 'dug khri /sa tshe mthar phyin yod pa yin nam gsungs ba byung / de nas smon gror phebs/ zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs nas chos lung du phebs/ dngul gdung rin po cher snyan dar mchod 'bul gnang / rje drung rdo ring pa dang mjal thugs snang dag pa'i sgo nas bla ma gong ma'i lo rgyus sogs gsungs gleng zhib par gnang / rje rdo ring par bka' 'bum 'dod 'jo'i lung phul zhing / tshur kun spangs rin po che'i rnam thar dang / bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang gsan/ slar jo nang du phebs blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum gyi lung dang bcas pa gnang / de nas jo nang skyid phug tu zla ba —201—

gnyis lhag tsam sku mtshams gnang / tho rangs shig gi mnal lam du rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal/ phyag dbu thog tu bzhag nas lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang nas/ tshe rabs kun du 'bral ba med gsungs pa'i snang ba byung bas/ mnal sad nas thugs dgyes pa chen po 'khrungs/ sngar ltar dus khrid gnang ba grol/ rje nyid dgung lo re drug tu phebs pa sa pho stag lo shar/ de lo rje btsun rin po che dag pa'i zhing du phebs nas lo skor gcig tsam song ba'i dus mchod chen mo yin pa nas/ dbon drung rin po ches gdan 'dren gnang ba bzhin chos lung byang rtser phebs/ dus chen steng du rje nyid kyis kyai rdo rje/ rje rdo ring pa dpon slob gyis bde mchog nag po pa/ bstan 'dzin rin po che dpon slob kyis bde mchog nag po pa/ rin po che brag stod pa dpon slob kyis rnal 'byor ma/ pha dre bo dpon slob kyis phag mo/ dgon pa dkar po pa rnams kyis kyai rdo rje/ chos lung sgrub sde byin gyis bde mchog lha lnga dang rnal 'byor ma/ rma bya shug khrod sgrub sde ba rnams kyis rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga gnang ste/ so sos rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams nas sgrub mchod dang mchod 'bul rgyas par mdzad/ de skabs rje nyid kyi phyag nas dngul gdung rin po che la gos dar yug ring gis gtso ba'i na bza'/ mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bla ma che chung thams cad la 'bul ba/ tshogs pa rnams gral 'gyed bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa gnang /de bzhin du bla chen gzhan rnams kyis kyang mchod rdzas bsnyen bkur 'gyed bcas dang / der ma phebs pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i dngos slob phyogs na —202—

bzhugs pa'i che phra mang dag dang / sbyin bdag tu gtogs pa'i sde dpon thams cad kyis/ dngul gdung rin po cher gos dar yug gi gtsos pa'i snyan dar/mchod rdzas/ bla ma so so la 'bul ba tshogs pa la bsnyen bkur dpag med 'dug cing / khyad par smon 'gro nas zhabs tog /rkang len rgya cher mdzad/ de dag gi skabs su nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ltas ya mtshan pa mang du byung / rje nyid kyis pha dre bo'i sku skyes gtsos pa'i drag bsdus la kyai rdo rje'i dbang / byin rlabs khog phub kyi bka' gnyis kyis sgo phye ste ni gu'i khrid rgyas pa chos drug so so'i bka' dang bcas pa/ phyag drug pa dkar nag gnyis rjes gnang / ni gu'i brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang yig rnying mang po'i lung / rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung sogs dang / dre bo sku skye sku rkyang la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ lha dgu'i dbang / nag po gzhung drug rnams gnang / bla ma gzhan rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi blo 'dod dang mthun pa'i chos bshad gnang / de ltar dus mchod rgyas pa gnang ba grol nas/gting skyes nas rab 'bums pa bstan pas gtsos pa'i spyan 'dren nan can rang byung ba ltar/ jo nang / gdong dga'/ rma bya/ dpal rtse/ byams gling sogs brgyud nas lam du yod pa'i sde dpon/ bla ma slob dpon rnams gang 'tshams kyi bka' chos gnang nas/ gting skyes sde srid kyis gtsos pa'i phebs bsu/ ser sbrengs rgyas pa dang bcas mkhar chen rtser phebs/ sde srid bcas la thog mar sgrol dkar khrus chog dang bcas pa/ tshe dbang grub rgyal lha dgu/ rnam 'joms/sme brtsegs/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ sngon po/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ dmar —203—

ser/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ rnam sras/ mgon ser sogs dbang rjes gnang khrus chog mang bar gnang / der drung rdo ring pa yang phebs/ rgyang tsam bzhugs pa gnang / rje nyid kyis mkhan po/ rje drung rdo ring pas las slob gnang ste bsgrub bya bzhi bcu tsam la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / de nas mdo khar mchod yon gnyis kas phebs/ zhag shas song mtshams chu spe gsar 'debs shig byed dgos 'dug pas/ gang du chu brus na legs/ bslab ston dgos zhu pa la/de nas dpon slob rang thugs nyams che bas nged kyis tshul 'bul mi dgos pa phebs pas/ byin rlabs kyang yod zhing / sang gza' skar bzang bas zhabs 'chag tsam gnang dgos zhus nas sang nyin phebs/ sde pa dpon blon rnams kyis dmigs gtad kyi sar rje nyid kyis gsungs bkod ma gnang bar rlan cher med pa'i sa khad mtho snyoms pa zhig tu phyag mkhar 'dzugs pa gnang nas 'dir dgyes pa 'dug /nang so chos rab sogs byings rnams cung zad the tshom du gyur kyang / sde pa rang dad mos che bas bka' phebs 'di kar brus gsungs zhag mang por brus kyang rlan tshad ye ma byung bas/ chu thon mi thon thugs dam brtag pa zhig gnang dgos zhu bar/ rje'i gsungs las/ brtag pa ni mi dgos par mchis/ sang nyin gzhi bdag gtor ma zhig byed gsungs ba byung / de nas zhag gnyis nas pha bong zur can zhig 'dug pa de thon/ dkon mchog gis mi bslu gsungs/ pha bong thon 'phral rdzong ngos nas chu bzang po thon/ de dam pa rnams kyis chu phud 'bul du byung skabs/ sde pa dpon g.yog thams cad thugs shin tu dgyes/ sku gzhogs su 'bul ba mang du mdzad/ de nas tshur phebs pa'i bka' —2slo—

bkod gnang bas/ chu spe mthar thon gyi bar bzhugs pa'i phyag nas gnang dgos zhes nan zhus che ba nas chu spe mkhar las grub kyi bar bzhugs/ de skabs nang so mgon tshe bas rtse chen du phyin pa'i skad cha la/ rje btsun tham cad mkhyen pa'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rje tā ra nā tha'o dbus phyogs su sku bltams pa'i gtam snyan/ sna dkar rtse nas rgyal rtse brgyud pa'i skad cha dang / de mtshungs smon gro nas kyang gtam snyan 'bul ba dang spyan 'dren pa byung / chu spe yang mthar thon gyis phyag nas mdzad/ lce lung nas spyan 'dren byung / der dgongs pa ltar gyi bka' chos thog ma gnang / rim pas brgyud ri khrod jo nang du phebs/ de nas sprul sku rin po che spyan 'dren la rje nyid phebs te/ de dang chab gcig par rje drung rdo ring pa/ rin po che brag stod pa/ dbon drung 'phan/ ngam ring nas mi sna drag sbrel dang bcas nas dpal 'khor chos sder phebs/ der mjal kha zhus/ shin tu thugs dgyes pa chen po dang ldan par gyur/ rgyal rtse nas mchod yon gyis gzhi len rgyas par zhus/ mkhan chen po la thugs 'dod kyi chos gnang / rtse chen khri khang bsam 'grub rtse/ snar thang brgyud ri khrod chen mo jo mo nang du phebs bsu rgyas pa dang bcas spyan drangs/ zhabs tog rgyas par zhu ba gnang zhing 'ga' shas bzhugs/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i zhabs drung du bkra shis kha btags gser srang gang / hor dkar chag med/ gos ber/ chib bzang ba sogs nyi shu rtsa lnga tshan dang / rje rdo ring pa/ rje brag stod pa sogs so sor yang 'bul gnang mdzad do/ /dregs ldan sa skyong 'bum gyi ral pa yis/ /yongs su phyes pa zhabs —205—

sen nyi ma'i 'od/ /'bar yang zhu dul zla 'od mi 'gog pa/ /phul du byung ba'i khyad chos yongs su gzung / /rdo rje'i brag yang 'gog nus gnam lcags lces/ /sku la brdzi bar ma nus mtshar ci zhig /rdul snyed bdud sdes 'phangs pa'i mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /zas gtsang sras la me tog char du gyur/ /thugs rje'i nyi 'od dang 'grogs dam chos kyis/ /bdud rtsi zil char dal bur babs pa na/ /skal ldan rnams la ye shes lnga'i rang gzugs/ /'ja' 'od gsal ba'i rtags bcu mngon du gyur/ /skad cig gcig la gling bzhi ther 'bum snyed/ /myur zhing sdang bar sems pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bsregs las dus mtha'i me bas ches dpa' ba'i/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis 'phrin las bsgrub/ /skyon med bsam gtan gyis bsgrubs lha mig gis/ /gzhal tshe ji snyed dngos po'i rang gzugs rnams/ /gsal bas shin tu rtogs ka'i sa phyogs su'ang / /dal 'gro'i gter chen yod pa dgongs te bstan/ /thugs rje'i stobs can gang gis skam po'i sar/ /chu rgyun phyur la ngo mtshar ci zhig yod/ /'di yi zad par chu yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /stong gsum chu yis 'gengs la dka' ba med/ /the'u rang bsgrubs dang mig mthong rdzas 'phrul la/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul du re'i chen po 'ga'/ /mthong gin grub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon gyur pa/ /nyer ston rje btsun khyod la snying nas dad/ /de nas rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen/ dag pa'i zhing nas slar yang zla ba bzhin/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i snang brnyan shar ba la/ /gus dang mchod pa'i rgyun gyis spyan 'dren mdzad/ /de nas sprul sku rin po che dpon slob kyang smon gro brgyud chos lung byang rtser phebs/ rje nyid kyis sku mtshams zla ba —206—

gnyis tsam gnang ba grol nas dgun khrid gnang / de nas chos lung byang rtser phebs/ gza' skar dge ba la rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku la thog mar tshe dbang phul/ de nas dbang lung rjes gnang mang bar 'bul ba gnang nas smon gror phebs dus dbang rnams gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ bde mchog nag po'i gsungs bsnyen zla ba bdun gnang / legs par grub nas kha gso'i sbyin sreg gnang skabs nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang / me tog gi char babs/ ltas ya mtshan pa byung / bka' bkod la 'di'i bsnyen pa byed pa 'phyis 'dug yang yang bka' phebs pa zhig byung / de mtshams khri khang nas sde pa don grub la dzāgashegs nas spyan 'dren nan can byung bas/ pa snam lhun grub rtser phebs/dgung zhag gi bar la mi 'khrugs pa dang / rnal 'byor ma'i gsung chog mdzad/mtshan byang bzhu ba grub rjes/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ sgrol dkar/mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ ma cig bka' po ma'i khrid lung dang bcas pa gnang / de nas rgyu dang bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshogs khro che ba gsang blugs gnang / shis brjod mdzad nas zhal dro'i tshul du mang ja 'bras 'jam sogs gnang / de nas sku mtshams rgyang tsam gnas skabs tho rangs shig bud med gzhon nu'i rnam pa g.yu'i thor tshugs dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa/ dar gyi gos lhab lhub tu gyon pa/ lag na me long dang mda' dar 'dzin pa 'khor dang bcas pa zhig byung nas/ snyan pa'i glu len zhing rin po che'i snod bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ nged la chos kyi sbrang rtsi'i zim char spel ba'i legs lam yin zer byung ba'i ngang la mnal sad/ de nas —207—

kyang sgra de snyan lam na lhang nge 'dug gsungs/ de nas dus kyi dgun khrid la phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon/ cha lung sgrub chen ma sogs chos don gnyer ba phyogs nas kyang mang du byung ba la sbyor drug rgyas pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/kun spangs chen po'i khrid yig chos rje phyogs rgyal pa'i sngon 'gro thog mtha' bar dge /ngo sprod gsang don rab gsal gyi khrid lung gnang / de nas khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sbrul lo'i dus chen la rje drung rdo ring pa gting skyes nas phebs longs ma byung bar/ rje nyid la sbyan 'dren byung bas chos lung du phebs/ bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub mchod gtso bo gnang / grub sde la bsnyen bkur gzabs ma bstsal/ de skabs sde pa bka' bzhi nas tshul khrims 'gyur med phebs/ thugs 'dod bzhin gzhung bka' nyer lnga dang 'brel ba'i ni gu'i khrid rgyas pa lung dang bcas pa gzhan yang tshe dbang rnam grangs mang ba sogs gnang /slar jo nang du phebs/ de lo'i dbyar chos la grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs lung dang bcas pa gnang / de nas de lo rmi ltas 'tshub pas mtshams dam par byed gsungs bcad rgya dam par mdzad/ rgyang tsam song nas smon gror dpon drung rin po che sku khams bsnyel bas/ 'phral du chos rje lha mchog pa phebs pa la/ sa skya bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung / tshe dbang tshe khrid sogs bka' chos mang du gnang / de nas gting skyes nas sa skyong ngag dbang rnam rgyal yab sras kyis spyan drangs/ mkhar chen du phebs/ sde pa yab sras rnams la tshe dbang lha dgu/ grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa tshe khrid/ gzhan yang sgrol ma dkar sngo/ 'jam dbyangs dkar ser mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs —208—

dang / byings rnams la yang 'dod chos dpag med stsal nas tshur phebs te/byams gling dpal rtse/ gdong dga' rnams su rim pas phebs shing so/ mo'i 'dod chos rnams gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ der rje dbon rin po che yang glo bo nas phebs te/ rje dbon dang / tsha rong grags pa blo gros sogs drag bsdus la shangs chos rgyas par gnang ste/ rtsa ba ni gu'i chos drug sdong po phyag rgya chen po/yal ga lam 'khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'chi med 'chug med rnams kyi khrid dang lung / gzhung bka' nyer lnga dang 'brel bar gnang / der bdag gis kyang mjal bar slebs te/ mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs thob/ smon gror phebs pa'i phyag phyir bdag kyang dkris pa'i tshe dbang sogs gnang / slar bdag gis kyang ngam ring gi grwa skor 'khor nas smon gro dang jo nang sogs su tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ tshe khrid tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang sogs dbang lung khrid mang bar thob cing / thugs rje chen pos brtse bar bskyang / yang skabs shig jo nang dbyar chos la dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid gnang zhing / lo phu gdan sa ba sogs la yang khrid brgya mang bar gnang /de nas lha rtser spyan drangs nas byang pa bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po steng zhal la/tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang dang / grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa khrid bcas gnang / slar jo nang du dus tshigs kyi dgun khrid/ bya gshongs mkhan chen pa sogs la gsung chos mang bar gnang / dgun khrid grol nas chos lung du dus chen la phebs/ rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku mjal/ tshe dbang lha dgu sogs 'bul ba gnang / rje rdo ring rin po che dang bka' chos 'bul res —209—

gnang / dgun khrid grol nas chos lung / smon gror bka' chos thogs ma gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ sa skya gong ma rdo rje 'chang mus chen rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i ril bu ma lta gnang nas/yi dam kyai rdo rje la brten nas bdud rtsi ril bu phyag len bzhin du bsgrub pa gnang nas/ lde gu'i skabs nas dri bzang rgyang ring por tshor ba dang / ril bu 'phel shin tu che ba byung nas/ byang stag lung ngam ring / gting skyes sogs gnang 'os rnams su gnang / de nas nged rang khams bzang skabs jo nang gi gdan sa 'di mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'bul thub pa zhig ci nas kyang byed gsungs/ ngam ring steng zhal du zhu ba gnang bas khrol dka' ba byung na yang /'bul chas gang drag dang bcas nan skyed zhu ba gnang bas khrol nas phebs bsu gzabs ma dang bcas gdan drangs/ bzang skar dge ba la khri thog tu phebs/shis brjod kyi me tog 'bul ba dang mnyam du sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ dbang rdzas rol mo'i rigs/ ja gos dar/ gser dngul/ byu ru spos shel ras cha sogs sku chas gang yod sprug pa'i 'bul ba rgya cher gnang / der zhag nyi shu skor bzhugs par zhabs tog gang zab dang / bka' chos sbyor drug gi khrid/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi lung / ni gu'i mgyogs khrid sogs 'bul pa gnang / de nas rje dbon drung mnga' ris la rdzongs lhar mdzad do/ /chos dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin mang du gnang ngo / /zung 'jug sgom pa'i gom stabs gcig nyid kyis/ /bcu gsum sa yi them skas nges bgrod nas/ /bde chen 'khor lo sdom pa rgyal srid la/ /dbang —210—

bsgyur de tshe sgrib pa'i stobs ldan bcom/ /gang la sa gsum mkha' 'gros ga ma ka'i/ /dbyangs dang lhan cig bdud rtsis mchod par byas/ /dad pa'i blo can yid skyes rnam mang gis/ /gzhal bar dka' ba'i zang zing dngos pos kyang / /gang dang 'brel bas srid mthar bde ba'i rgyun/ /skyed byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa ches 'phyur ba/ /mdun du rgyu yang don gnyer med pa yi/ /skye bo 'ga' dang 'ga' yang byung bar gyur/ /rnam par rtog pa med bzhin res bral la/ /gang 'dod bsam par mthun pa'i mchod sbyin che/ /spro ba dpag bsam shing dang mtshungs bsam yang / /de ni sems med khyed thugs rnam kun mkhyen/ /yon tan gyis lci bla ma'i zhabs pad zungs/ /'degs la khyab 'jug stobs kyang pham bgyid pas/ /nor bzang sems dpa' che dang nā ro pa'i/ /bla mar mos pa dag kyang zil gyis mnan/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis snying myos pa'i/ /grub pa'i gar gyis zhing 'di bkang ba na/ /grub dbang gzhan gyis go skabs thob min zhes/ /dag pa'i zhing khams gzhan du bzhud pa bzhin/ /rin chen du ma las grub mtshan dpe'i gzugs/ /de la gang thugs ye shes rjes zhugs pas/ /de dang mtshungs par rgyal ba'i ye shes kun/ /'dus pa lha mi'i mchod gnas mchog tu gyur/ /lha ldan gtsug lag khang na zas gtsang sras/ /rjes mtshon sku de 'gran zla med snyam pa'i/ khengs pa gzhil phyir byon pa yin no zhes/ /cung zad 'dzum pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa snyam/ /de nas myos byed ces pa shing mo lug gi lo rje nyid dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum bzhes pa'i hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du sku grib la brten pa'i cung zad sku khams bsnyel ba byung yang /—211—

sku rims dang lha rje gsol sman gyi 'phrod bsten phul bas zhag shas nas sku khams bde bar gyur/ de nas nyin gcig nyi ma phyed yol tsam la/ khar sang nas khyed rnams kyis rje rdo ring pa zhing brjes pa nged la gsang 'dug pas/ da lta rang 'dir sgrub sde la mang ja/ sku 'bum lha khang so sor dkar me snyan dar phul/ chos lung byang rtser dngul gdung rin po cher mchod rdzas na bza'/ mang ja sogs thongs gsungs nas/ phyag g.yog rnams kyis de rnams 'phral du bsgrubs/ der bla ma mchod pa rgyas pa re mdzad mtshams/ nged rgan po rnams dus gcig la 'gro ran gsungs pa byung nas/ yang sku khams mi bde ba'i tshul ston pa gnang / hor zla gsum pa'i nyer bdun gyi snga dro/ da nangs tho rangs su rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku'i snang ba byung gsungs/ de nas thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams mdzad rjes mthar ni gu'i 'pho ba gnang ste/ gzim chung 'gag na yod pa rnams kyis thag ces pa'i sgra byung ma thag nang du phyin dus/ zhal ras zil pa khrom me ba dang dbu gtsug 'phar zhing rlangs 'tshub yod pa mthong zhing /mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de ma thag nam mkha' g.ya' dag me tog gi char babs/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs grags pa phal cher bas tshor/ der chos lung sgrub sde'i drag pa rnams dang / jo nang nyid kyi grub sde'i drag pa rnams kyis sku gdung sku gzhogs su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod byas shing / rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bsam sdings su bzhugs pa myur shad du spyan 'dren btang nas spyan 'drongs/ chos lung / jo nang / ngor pa/ bde chen pa/ brag ram pa sogs chos sde mang po phebs te/ dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phyes nas zhag mang po'i bar du —212—

sgrub mchod rgyas par mdzad/ de mthun gser mdog can sogs dbus gtsang gi chos grwa dang / thub bstan dar rgyas gling sogs mnga' ris smad kyi chos grwa rnams su mang ja 'gyed bcas rgya cher bsgrubs/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i nyin sku chas drag kha gang yod rje btsun rin po cher phul/ gzhan bla ma slob dpon dge 'dun gyi sde der tshogs thams cad la 'bul ba'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul te/ thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su bskongs par mdzad do//༈ 'gro blo'i re ba yongs su skong la dpag bsam shing yang ming gi zol/ /yid kyi gdung ba 'phrog par byed la lto phyogs me yang zil gyis mnan/ /kun la mkhyen brtse'i bsil zer 'gyed la 'od dkar can la tha mi dad/ /de phyir mdzad pa'i cha shas 'ga' la'ang dpe dang 'gran zlas dbul bar gyur/ /snying rje'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba de/ /'dzam gling gdul bya'i ku mud bzhad mdzad nas/ /lto gling mdzad pa'i chu mthong rdzogs so zhes/ /nub phyogs bde ba can der gshegs par rtsom/ /de tshe de yi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i 'ja' tsho ni gdugs mdzes dang / /me tog char dang pi waX sogs thogs nas/ /spyan 'dren slad du zhing 'dir lhags par gyur/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i dngos kyang 'ga' zhig gis/ /rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo mun 'joms so zhes/ /rab zhi'i nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin la/ /mchog tu bzhugs pa'i ting 'dzin mngon du mdzad/ /de tshe zhing 'di'i skye dgu lhar bcas la/ /mya ngan me lces snying gi dngos bsregs shing / /mchod pa'i dud sprin 'ja' wo sna lnga sa /'thul bas phyogs kyi yangs pa 'gengs par byas/ /chos —213—

dbyings gdod ma'i nam mkha' rnyog bral la/ /sprul pa'i zla tshes 'gog pa med 'char bas/ /bdag cag gdul bya'i blo mtshor brnyan pa'i gzugs/ /cir yang rtsol zhes gsol gdab dbyangs su tsher/ /'ga' zhig bla ma dam pa grub pa'i dbang / /'di la gshegs dang bzhud pa mi mnga' yang / /rang cag blo yi me long rnyog pa la/ /'di ltar snang 'di byis pa'i blo zhes smra/ /de nas smon gro nas zhal ngo rnams kyis gdung rten gser zangs las grub pa thog so tsam gyi tshad longs ba/ bal po bzo bo mkhas pas bzhengs te/gzungs rdzogs phun sum tshogs pa phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa mang pos rab tu gnas pa bgyis te/ 'du khang chen mor mchod pa'i yul dang tshogs gsog pa'i rten du bzhugs so/ /de ltar na rje btsun bla ma mchog 'di gzhon nu nas rab tu byung /thos bsam mdzad/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs sras kyi gtso bor gyur/ de brjod 'dod tsam yin min ni/ rje gong ma'i rnam thar rnams la bltas pas shes par nus/ gtso bor sgom pa la thugs gzhol dngos po la 'dzin pa mi mnga'/ tshul khrims yongs su dag gnod byed la bzod pa tsam du ma bzhag gnod lan phan pas 'jal ba sogs pha rol du phyin pa drug la spyod pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che sku nyams su bstar/ nges don zab mo'i chos 'khor gtso bor bskor/ rgyu mtshan des na sgrub sde jo nang yang 'phel rgyas shin du che zhing / sgrub pa mo gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub chen thugs dam gyi rtsal 'byongs pa/ nyams rtogs phul du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/nges don gyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa 'di ni lhun gyis grub pa dang /—214—

rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las su gyur zhing / rnam par thar pa'i snying lnga'o/ /rigs brgya'i gtsun rgyan 'jam mgon kun dga'i mtshan 'chang gi /byin rlabs rin chen sna lnga'i srad bu mdangs gsal ba/ /gang thugs shel gyi dpal be'ur bzhugs pa'i mod nyid la/ /ye shes kha dog sna lngar 'bar ba'i gtam bzang po/ /bsgrags pa'i dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ khyab bdag bla ma gang des rjes bzung nas/ /'bral ba med par chos la spyod par shog /tshul khrims dag pa'i nye ba 'khor dang ni/ /byang chen spyod la kun tu bzang po dang / /rgyal ba'i chos tshul rdo rje theg pa'i don/ /'dzin la gsang ba'i bdag po dang mtshungs shog /klu sgrub yab sras bzhed pa'i lta ba dang / /thogs med mched pa'i rgya chen spyod pa'i srol/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bzhed pa'i rim gnyis kyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par byed nus tha(ga /tshul khrims dag pa'i gzhi la legs gnas shing / /sde snod rgyud sde'i tshig don shes pa dang / /de don rgyud la 'byor ba'i nyams len gyis/ /dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub la brtson par shog /de nas lam lnga sa bcu ma lus pa/ /mos pa'i goms stabs gcig gis bgrod byas nas/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba gang de'i go 'phang che/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis myur du thob par shog /ji srid nyi mas snang ba'i bya ba byed pa dang / /bsil zer byed pa bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar spro byed pa/ /de srid rnam thar ut+pal bzhad pa'i chun po 'di/ /dad ldan rnams kyi rna ba'i rgyan du gnas gyur cig /ces rje btsun bla ma don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te kun dga' dpal bzang po'i zhal snga'i —215—

rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gser gyi rnga bo che zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid kyang mos rten du rnam par thar pa zhig 'bri bsam yod pa la/ slar gting skyes nas sa skyong mi'i dbang po'i gsung gis bskul bas rkyen byas te/ rje nyid kyi sku'i dbon glo bo mkhan chen rin po ches mdzad pa la gzhi byas/ der mi gsal ba cung zad rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar nas kha bskangs/ rang nyid kyis mthong thos su gyur pa cung zad kyang bsnan te rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing / gsung gis bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i dge slong klog pa ba dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde zhes pas mnyan yod gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o// // bkra shis/ /—216—

yan lag drug gi lam gyi zab gnad dag bzhu / gas/༈ dus kyi 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs pa/ dpal ldan bla ma thams cad pa/ /dam pa'i shes rab ye shes che/ /'gyur med bde ba lhan cig skyes/ /ma lus 'dod pa'i lha stsol ba/ /dngos po kun kyi khyod la 'dud bgyid na/ /'dren byed g.yo ba'i phyag rgya dman dag la/ /mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin bgyis rdo rje yis/ /sad rmi gnyid 'thug bzhi pa'i 'brog dgon du/ /rnam par 'khyams byed khyab bdag rdo rje bzhi/ /byang chub rnam bzhi'i khyim du bde ba ches/ /dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul rgyal po mgron gnyer shig /mahā su ma stu sarba dza ga taX/ rang lo gas drug pa la'o/ /༈ yan lag drug gi lam gyi zab gnad ni/ na mo brnya bo dhi satwa kro da ra dza yā/dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so sor bsdud pa'i dhu ti yi/ /yas snar srog rlud bsdud par byed/ rka) /bsam gtan gyis ni bstan par byed/ 'a /'di ni rtsa lam sbyong byed yin/ 'a /mtho ris snang ba'i 'jug ngogs las/ /rlud sngags mi phyed yi ge gsum/ /lhun grub rdor bzlas snying kar byed/ 9) /srog thur bsre byed che nya/ /kun ra nang du kha sbyor pa'o/ /srog rtsol srog 'gog lte bar byed/ rka) /'dzin pa 'khor lo drug ka sa khams drug

thig le srog bcing bas/ /spro bsdu dag pa'i sku sgrub byed/ 9) /stong gzugs phyag rgya'i pad+ma yis/ /mi 'gyur bde ba 'dren par byed/ 9) /phyag rgya gzhan yang thabs yin te/ /de 'dra rjes dran yin par shes/ 'a /de yi stong phrag nyi shu dang / /rol brgya'i dkar dmar steng 'og brtsegs/ /rlud thim de nyid bde bar byed/ 9) /dkar dmar brtsegs pa'i dkar dmar ni/ /brtan pa 'dzag bder bcas 'joms byed/ rkan /dhu ti'i sna gnyis gtso che'o/ rka ska /ji ltar ngo yis rang nyid mi snang zhing / khams zad byed bzhin byang chub sems bcings pas/ /phra rags rdul 'jigs khu rdul tshogs pa 'joms/ /ji srid tshogs pa de srid 'gyur pa yin/ /bde chen kun da'i rgyu las byung mod kyang / /bde bas brten pa'i 'brel ba rdzogs tshogs 'jigs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la rdul gyi khams med do/ /tshogs pa zhig na mi 'gyur bde chen thob/ /bskyed rim yan lag bzhi yis rgyud smin byed/ /phra thig bde stong rgyas 'debs gnad du che/ /dang po stong gzugs bar sgrub dhu tir bcug /dbu mar mi 'gyur bcing dang thim pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen po 'grub ces gsal bar shes/ /de dang sbyar ba'i lhan skyes bde stong des/ /don ni 'pho ba gcig thim ma reg par / /bden 'dzin nyon mongs sgrib bral byed par go /rlung dang thig le bzhi dang tshogs pa bcom/ /phung khams kun yang mi 'gyur bde chen dang / /stong gzugs lus sems zung 'jug ting 'dzin 'di/ /'dzag bde'i bag chags gnyis snang phra mo 'joms/ /gza' skar 'gros dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ khren du phra ba mdo rgyud gzhan na med/ /de kun lus la dus sbyor rlud la sogs/ /skyes gnas —218—

'jigs srung 'di las rgyas pa su/ /dgos pa sbyang gzhi dang ni lus kyi gnad/ /rtogs phyir nyid yin de shes rim pa gnyis/ khren tu rgyas pa'i gnad kun bde bar rtogs/ /phyi ma shes pa snga ma rag las shing / /dang po'i gnad kun zhib par rtogs sla'i phyir/ /skar rtsis rnams kyang gsal bar gsung pa yin/ /phyi nang nges pa'i lam gyi sgrib spong dang / /yon to bskyed tshul 'bras bu'i gnad kun shes/ /lam dang lam min 'byed la spobs pa rnyed/ khyud don ma lus nyams len la dril nas/ /lam gyi srog ni de ltar shes de mkhas/ /de ltar mi shes gza' skar lung ston tsam/ /thugs la bzhag nas rim gnyis la byol dang / /lam gnad mi shes blun po glu sgyus mkhan/ /ri mor bris pa'i mar me ngo mtshar che/ /bdag ni log pa'i lam du mi 'gro'o/ /'di ni rang lo bcu dgu pa la brag stod ye shes kyi pho brang du/ kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas so// //bkra shis/ /dge legs 'phel/—219—

mchog tu gyur pa sham bha lar 'gro tshul gyi lam yig 'phags pa don yod lcags kyus ga sdo/ngas pa bzhugs/rgya gar skad du/ ka lā pa a wa ta ra/ bod skad du/ ka lā par 'jug pa/'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i mgon po thabs dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshe/gas la rab btud/ nas/ /gang gis dga' ba'i gnas 'thob 'gyur/ /thabs de 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa ni/ /thugs rje ldan pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal sras stong phrag brgyad dag dang / /lhan gcig 'dir ni rab gshegs nas/ /dbang chen zhes bya ri bo chen po ni/ khar dang nub tu chu gter zab mo gnas/ /gang gi phyogs gnyis me tog 'bras bus brgyan/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi rol pa'i gnas der bzhugs/ khres bya kun la ma thogs pa'i/ /spyan dang ldan pa 'jig rten dbang / / rgyal sras bye ba'i tshogs bcas la/ /gnas skabs de ni de gshegs nas/ /lha dang lha min 'byung po'i dbang / /lto 'phye'i bdag dang klu yi gtso/ /skal bzang mthu dang ldan pa yi/ /mi dang mi rnams der 'dus la/ /gang gi bla na med pa mchog /gzi brjid chen po'i theg mchog ste/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i chos kyi gtams/ /yang dag bsgrog nas rab tu bstan/ /bha ta'i dum bu 'dzam —220—

gling skyes/ /ko sa la dang yangs pa can/ /lus 'phags mi thi la dag na/ /skal bzang gcig cig de dag yod/ /blo gros che ldan lnga brgya'i ni/ /de 'dra'i gtam ni yang yang thos/ /gzhan la phan byed rig pa'i blo/ /rmad byung mang po skyes par gyur/ /dka' ba brgya phrag 'bad pa yis/ /dbang chen gyi ni ri la song / /gzhon nur gyur pa mi snang nas/ /phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs la btud/ /yang dag mchod nas rab dris pa/ /tshangs la sogs pa lhas brgyud cing / /'gro ba drug la mnyam par brtse/ /thos nas bdag cag 'dir 'ong lags/ /gang gi zhabs bkru'i chu 'thungs pas/ /bde med bde ba ldan gyur zhing / /'dod pa dang ni thar pa 'grub/ /lha yi'ang lha khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag dang ni chos la sogs/ /'ga' yang ma gzigs dmigs su med/ /'on kyang mi zad thugs rje yis/ /kun la skyob mdzad 'di re mtshar/ /'dir 'ong 'di dag la brtse bas/ /don chen 'ga' zhig zhu 'tshal ni/ /phyi ma'i dus 'gar phan pa'i slad/ /yang dag gsungs pas bshad du gsol/ /ma 'ongs pa yi dus na ni/ /rigs sngags smra ba khas 'che zhing / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mi shes pa/ /de dag phyin ci log tu blta/ /gang phyir 'di dag yongs dag pa'i/ /lam du nges par 'jug 'gyur pa/ /ji ltar phyugs la dbyug pa lta'i/ /thabs de gang la rnyed par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan snying rje che/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi 'di skad gsungs/ /'gro rnams mang la phan 'dod pas/ /'dri ba 'di ni legs so legs/ /dbang chen ri la mchod 'osda pa'i/ /gzhon nur gyur pa sngon bshad de/ /don 'di yang ni legs par bstan/ /mnyam med sems can don byed —221—

pa'o/ /skye bo 'di la phan byed phyir/ /sngags 'dzin ral pa gcig ma longs/ /snying rje ldan pa don yod pa'i/ /lcags kyu khyod ni mthu chen ldan/ khyod bdag phan tshun bsgros pa yi/ /don chen 'di ni smra bar gyis/ /stobs bcu ldan pa'i bstan pa la/ /phyi ma'i dus na don cher 'gyur/ /'jam dpal rjes su 'jug pas ni/ khyod kyang smra ba'i mthu dag ldan/ /de skad gsungs nas 'jig rten mgon/ /stong pa nyid kyi gnas la bzhugs/ /de nas yang de'i tshe 'phags pa'i gtso bo don yod lcags kyus gsungs pa/ phyi ma'i dus na sna tshogs pa'i/ /blo gros ngan pa bskyed pas na/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul sras kyis bstan/ 'un tu nag po'i dri mar byas/ /brjod pa sna tshogs tha dad de/ /skye bo tha dad spyod la bsngags/ /de phyir de ltar spyod rnams la/ /dbang po med par rnam par 'khrugs/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub kun/ /nam yang thos pa med de ni/ /gzhan yang dka' bas 'a sdo/ba pa dang / /ngal ba 'ba' zhig bskyed par byed/ khren du sgrib byed kyis bsgribs pas/ /yi dwags sogs kyang lkog gyur na/ /lha rnams smos kyang ci dgos te/ /rtog ge phran tshig 'jug shes nyid/ /de tsam gyis kyang grub par blta/ /'phags pa'i skye bo yid kyi lus/ /mthong ba'i spyod yul nam yang ci/ /don mchog 'dod pa'ang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /'di ni byang gi phyogs cha na/ /ke la sha yi ri bo'i ngogs/ /grong khyer ka la pa zhes yod/ /rtag tu bde zhing 'byor ba yin/ /de na rgyal ba'i sras po mang / /mi bdag gtso bo mchog 'phags te/ /de na rtag tu chos dang ldan/ /g.yo sgyu med cing phra ma med/ /rigs dang rigs min dbyen med de/ /gzugs ldan stobs dang ldan pa yin/—222—

skye bu'i bgrod pa dpag tshad bcu/ /rta yi nyi shu po ldan gyi/ /lnga bcu'i lam de nyin gcig la'o/ /yams dang nyer 'tshe yongs med de/ /'phrog byed lag na rdo rje sogs/ /nyin re rtag tu bsrung bar byed/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i bstan bcos ni/ /phyogs de dag tu rnam par rgyal/ khres rab pha rol phyin mdo dang / /mdo sde'i lang ka'i grong du 'jug /dgongs nges nges par ston pa dang / /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs kyi sde/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel ba yis/ /mngon du byed pa'i dkon mchog sprin/ /bden pa'i le'u mchog gi rgyud/ /drag shul stobs dang ldan pa ni/ /sor mo'i 'phreng ba'i ched gsungs dang / /sdong po brgyan pa la sogs pa/ /thams cad yul de las rab 'byung / /'od dpag med pa'i 'jig rten dang / /mngon dga'i bkod pa gsal ba dang / /rnam snang mdzad pa'i zhing khams ni/ /rgyan gyi bkod par bcas pa dang / /stug po bkod pa'i mdo sde dang / /dbang phyug chen po'i bshad pa ni/ /gnas gtsang chen po la sogs par/ /rdo rje snying po'i bshad de ni/ /phal po che yi mdo sde rnams/ /thams cad de na rnam par dpyod/ /gang la dpe ni 'bum drug gis/ /gsal bar byas pa phyi ma'i rgyud/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams snying po'i don/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gtam yang yin/ /pha rol phyin pa drug gi mdo/ /stong phrag lnga bcur ldan pa yod/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ni/ /'bum phrag nyi shu der spyod de/ /de dag rjes su 'jug pa yin/ /nges par bstan pa 'bum phrag brgya/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyud kyi rgyal/ /dngos grub nges par bstan pa yi/ /dge bas rdo rje chen po dang / /rjes su rigs pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /bde gshegs kun gyi 'dus pa ni/ /stong khrag nyi shu —223—

rtsa lnga pa/ /dam pa dang po sangs rgyas rgyud/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nyer gnyis pa/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnam dbye ba/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi/ /rnam par phye ba brgyad po rnams/ khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag ni/ /gcig steng drug brgya'i lhag pa'i lam/ /lhag pa'i brgya phrag mang por ni/ /phyogs der mngon gsum spyod pa'o/ /phyag na rin chen blo yi bdag /spos kyi glang po ma pham pa/ /bde ldan dbang phyug nam mkha' mdzod/ /rdo rje gzi brjid rdo rje snying / /gnod sbyin gtso bo la sogs pas/ /de rnams rjes su 'jug pa yis/ /tshig rnams du ma rnam par phye/ /nan tan chen pos gtad pas na/ /ma log don chen 'tshol ba rnams/ / gangs ri'i dbang po der song nas/ /mi bdag grub pa rnams la dris/ /gdon mi za bar don 'grub nyid/ /de nas 'phags ma rdo rje srin mo ral gcig mas zhus pa/ kyai rgyal ba'i sras po ma 'ongs pa'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la/de bzhin gshes pa'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams kyang / mu stegs can gyi gsang tshig 'tshol ba la mngon par mos pas mchog tu gsang ba'i don las phyir phyogs pa de dag yang dag pa'i lam la gzung ba dang / mchog gi skal ba gang dag rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyur grong khyer ka lā par 'gro ba'i thabs de yang dag par bstan tu gsol/ dge bsnyen rnam par mi rtog pa zhes bya ba dang / bzang po sbas pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa lnga brgya po 'di rnams kyi dngos grub mchog gi don dang / phyi ma'i dus kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod la zhugs pa mang po dag gi bde bar 'gyur ba dang / phan par 'gyur ba dang / grub pa mchog tu grub pa bla na ma mchis pa'i slad du bshad par gsol/ rab tu —224—

bshad par gsol/ legs par bshad du gsol/ don yod lcags kyus gsungs pa/ sngags rig rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ khyed rnams legs par mnyan pa dang / /lnga brgya'i tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /phyi dus don chen 'dir 'byung ngo / /'dir sgrub pa po gang zag gi legs pa'i lam la gnas pa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/rig nga 'i cho ga shes shing / dam tshig la yang dag par gnas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa'i rgyud la mngon du phyogs pa gsal ba/ yid gzhungs pa/ shes pa dang ldan pa des/ dang por 'dod pa'i lha mnyes par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gyur ba'am/ rmi lam du mthong ba yin kyang rung ste/ 'dod pa'i lha las nan du gnang ba thob par gyur na/ ke la shar 'jug pa'i thabs la brtson par bya ba'i gzhan du na kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur ro/ /rab tu mi gsal bsam gtan dang / /bzlas brjod stobs kyis dman pa dang / /mtshan ma'i dge bas bor ba gang / /'dod pa'i go 'phang grub pa med/ /ngan pa'i lam gyi khengs pa dag /cho ga tsam gyi 'grub par lta/ /byis rmongs 'jim pa'i gong bu la/ /'dzegs nas zla ba 'dzin par 'dod/ /ci ste gnang bar gyur na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying po 'bum phrag brgyad bzlas shing / u dum wa ra'i sbyin bsreg kyang khri phrag brgyad bya'o/ /bgegs rnams 'joms pa'i don du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rig pa 'bum phrag bzla zhing / sbyin bsreg kyang khri phrag gcig go /sdang ba thams cad rab tu 'jigs pa'i don du khro bo chen po rab tu mi bzad pa gshin rje mthar byed kyi rig pa 'bum du bzla zhing / de nas thog ma —225—

nyid du keng shu ka'i sbyin sreg stong phrag gcig 'bul lo/ /de'i 'og tu bā ṭa'i shing gi stong phrag bcu'o/ /de'i 'og tu ni tsan+dan dmar po dang / a bha ra'i khu ba la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang sbyin sreg stong phrag bcus mnyes par bya/ de thams cad du 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdabs par bya'o/ /sgrub po gang zag gi cho ga rnams brtsams shing / rang nyid dngos grub mchog gi don dang / lho phyogs kyi skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ grong khyer ka lā par 'jug par 'dod pas/ sdig med cing g.yo sgyu med pa de dag ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rim pa 'dis/ nges par der phyin par 'gyur gyi/ bar ma dor nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te bdag gi tshig 'di brdzun par gyur na bdag gi mtshams med pa lnga byas par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste mchog 'khrul ba'am/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa gcig yin na ni/ klu phran nam/ lto phye'am/ gnod spyin nam/'byung po'am/ lha gang dag gtum po rnams kyi chad pa thob pa 'gyur gyi sgrub pa ni nam yang ma yin no/ /'di grub pa ni dka' ba min/ /'byor ba'i khyad par gzhan dang gzhan/ /sngags dang rlud gi las rnams te/ /rgyud kyi bgrod pa gzhan yin no/ khren du nyams chung 'di mi 'grub/ /sgrub po nus ldan 'grub 'dod pas/ /ma grub de lhar legs thob 'gyur/ /rig pa'i cho ga 'di yis so/ /de nas sgrub pa po des/ gang du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i shing a shad tha la mchod pa stong gis yang dag par mchod nas/lam du 'jug par bya ste/ gling 'di'i nub phyogs kyi rgya mtshor rat+na swā ga ra zhes —226—

bya la/ ded dpon mchog dang lhan cig gru la zhon pas byang phyogs su bgrod de/gling si ko dha ra zhes bya ba dang / dha na ko ṣa zhes bya ba'i gling du bgrod par bya'o/ /gling de'i nub phyogs na kla kle'i grong yod de/ sgrubs pa po der 'gro bar mi bya zhing / shar gyi phyogs la nye bar brten pa'i grong khyer du zla ba drug sdod par bya'o/ /de na bde bar gshegs pa gser thub kyi mchod rten yod de/ de la bskor ba stong phrag lnga byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa 'don par bya'o/ /de ni 'di yin te/ na ma ste yā dhī ka nāX/ ta thā ga tā naX/ sarba dra a pra ti hi ta/ bi lta dharma tā ba li nāX/ oṃ a sa ma sa man+ta to3/ a nan+ta bā sti shā sa na/ ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa/ mi ga ta rā ga /brnya dharma te sa ra sa ra/ sa ma ba la/ ha saha sa/ dra ya dra ya ga ga na/ mahā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la swā ga re swā hā/ dad pa stobs zhan de dang des/ /nam yang 'grub pa yod ma yin/ /cho ga mi smod gzhan la min/ /lha dang chos la 'phyas mi gdags/ /nges par 'grub snyam yid brtan dang / khren tu dad pa'i shugs stobs kyis/ /'byor ba dang ni grol ba ste/ /dge chos 'joms la nam yang min/ /de nas sgrub pa po de gru'i bgrod pas/ bha ra ti'i dum bu 'di nyid du 'ong bar bya ste/ gas du na nor gyi ma sgo ces bya ba'i gling de nyid las byang gi phyogs la nye bar brten pa'i/ gling gzhan dang yul mtha' gzhan mang po dag ni legs par spyod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrub pa po kun du 'byams par 'gyur ro/ /de la gling 'di ni chu klong sngon po zhes bya ba'i mtsho dang 'bab chu dag dang shar nub tu thad mnyam pa yin te/ de'i phyir dbang po'i phyogs bor nas sgrub pa po dbang ldan gyi phyogs su 'gro'o/ /grong khyer drag ma dang / rā pa ri dang / ka ṭi ki la/ ma dhu wān dha la sogs pa/ byang phyogs nas —227—

byang phyogs su zla ba drug tu bgrod par bya ste/ de dag gi pha rol na chu bo chen po sa tru zhes bya ba dang / ka ri/ ka kā ri zhes bya ba gangs kyi ri yod de de dag las kyang brgal bar bya'o/ /yul 'khor de rnams na gnas pa'i mi rnams ni/ drang po'i rang bzhin can gyi phyir/ bgrod par dka' ba ma yin zhing 'jigs pa yang med do/ /ri de la ru dza na ya zhes bya ba'i sman ro mchog tu mngar ba dang / tī la ka zhes bya ba shin du kha ba ste/ de dag kyang 'o ma ltar 'dzag pa dag yod do/ /gang gi me tog nyi ma 'char ka'i mdangs ltar rab tu dmar ba/ de'i 'dab ma yang dgra stu'i so lta bu/ tsher ma rnon po can/ lho ngos su mngon du phyogs pa'i brag las 'byung ba de ni ru dza na ma yin no/ /ngam grog dag gi ngos la/ 'phyangs zhing 'phyang na ma he mo'i nu ma lta bu'i me tog dkar po dang ldan pa ni/ tī la ka'o/ / de dag gi phyogs bzhir/ rdo rje srin po stobs po che'i rig sngags lan bdun bzla bzhin du/ shing ba ta la'i phur bus btab nas/ de dag gi ba thag dbyung bar bya'o/ /zhag bdun du de dag yongs su skam par byas nas/ brag gi phug par bdud rtsi thal sbyor bzlas pas bsrung zhing sba bar bya'o/ /phyogs de na btsag kha dog lnga po yod de/ dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang nag po dang ljang khu dag ste/ de dag blangs nas gangs kyi chu bos khrus byas nas rdo leb dkar po zhig la lha mo 'od zer can ma'i sku gzugs bri bar bya ste/ mdog gser btso ma lta bu ka ra bī ra'i me tog ltar dmar pa'i spyan gsum pa/ g.yas kyi zhal dmar po/ g.yon gyi zhal ni phag gi gdong nag po rab tu 'khros pa/dar sngon po'i ga sha 'phyang ba/ nam mkha'i phyag rgya cung zad gsal bar byed pa'i lha dang lha ma yin dang dbang phyug rnams dbang du byed pa/ phyag dang po gnyis —228—

kyis me tog gi mda' dang gzhu 'gengs pa/ bar ma gnyis kyi khab dang skud pa dang mya ngan med pa bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga lte ba'i g.yas g.yon du 'dzin pa/ phag gi steng na sdang ba dang gdug pa can thams cad yongs su gnon pa/ 'di lta bu bris nas cho ga ji lta bus mchod pa dang bzlas pa bya'o/ /de la sngags 'di yin te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ ta du thā/ oX ba tā li ba dā li/ ba ra li ba ra ha mu khi sarba ྅spyin pra du yan ban+ta ban+ta mu khaX swāhā/ zhes pa 'di a sho ka'i shing dang me tog dmar po brgya phrag lngas spyin sreg bya'o/ /snying po'i sngags 'di yang khri phrag bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra ste tā li huX phaṭa/ tshangs par spyod la legs gnas nas/ /snying rjes sgrub pa legs pa ste/ /gdug la gdug pa nges sbyor la/ /rtag tu byams pa'i yid kyis so/ /gang gang 'dul ba de dang de/ /sngags pa'i rab sbyor de de'o/ /nyon mongs spyod las nam yang min/ /nang gi bdag nyid dul bas so/ /de'i 'og tu bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i sman de dag btags te/ gangs kyi ba men dag gi 'o ma lhung ba yongs su bskol nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i spyan sngar bzhag par bya'o/ /snying po'i mthar bdud rtsi thigs pa sgrubs shig ces spel bas/ lan stong du bzlas par byas na/ lha mo yang dag par mchod de dngos grub blangs nas sman btung bar bya'o/ /phyis nas sku gzugs de yang byang phyogs la bltas te bzhags la/ me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs pas sba bar bya'o/ /des ni bkres pa dang / skom pa dang / ngal ba dang /dub pa med de/ lha mo'i mthu las bar du gcod pa thams cad kyang bdag gi dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang phyogs su bltas nas nyin lam nyi shu rtsa gcig tu 'gro bar bya ste/ lam de la ni rtswa yang med/ shing 'gel ba yang med/—229—

chu yang med do/ /de'i pha rol na nags 'thug po dag yod de/ sbrul dang stag la sogs pa gnas pa'i 'brog dgon pa'i lam la nyi ma bcu gnyis 'gro bar bya'o/ /de'i pha rol na ri'i rgyal po gan+dha ra zhes bya ba yod de/ dpangs su dpag tshad nyi shu'o/ /ri de ni sman sna tshogs kyi gang ba yin no/ /de na ni seng ge gshog pa can dag gnas te/ nyi ma re rer yang srog chags mang po dag gsod par byed de/ der ri dwags kyi khyad par zhig lus bsgyur ba zhes bya ba yod do/ /de lus kyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs par bsgyur pa yin te/ de seng ge des bsad pa'i khrag las/ rdo leb nag po la srin mo man de ha zhes bya ba/ rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba'i lus can/ kha dog 'bar ba mi yis pags pas smad dkris shing / lag pa g.yon pa na ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa na ba lang gi pags pa gsar pa'i nang du sha khrag dang snying gi gang ba 'dzin zhing za bar bris te/ snod dag tu sha khrag gi gtor ma bshams par bya'o/ /bdag nyid gshin rje mthar byed mi bzad pa dbyug pa dang zhags pa thogs pa ma he la gnas par byas nas/ oṃ khyiXkā la ru pa huX khaX swāhā/ kri ka re kri ka re/ ma rje ha rak+ṣa sī/ ā ga tsā ā ru khyiXdza zhes stong phrag bcur bzlas nas/ de mngon du 'ong bar 'gyur la/ khrag gi mchod yon dang sha'i gtor ma dag sgyin la/ thod pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ khro bo chen po'i stobs kyis gzir bar bya'o/ /des kyang sgrub pa po ci 'dod ces smra bar 'gyur ro/ /kyai srin mo bdag sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pas bde bar 'dod pas/ grong khyer ka lwa par 'gro yi/yul stong pa 'di rnams su kha zas 'byor bar gyis shig /des kyang de bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas de mi snang bar gyur te/ shing ar 'ju ni'i rtsa ba la/ rab tu —230—

chags pa me tog kun+da ltar kha dog dkar ba'i bcud ro sbrang rtsi 'dra ba dag /nyin mo dang nub mo gnas pa'i sa dag la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang phyogs su gangs can chen po zhes bya ba'i ri yod de/ dpag tshad brgya phrag gsum gyi khor yug can de na gnod spyin rnams dang / dka' thub can rnams dang / grub pa rnams dang / mi'am ci dag gis yongs su gang ba yin no/ /ci ste sgrub pa po pha rol gnon pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa yin na ni/ der song nas dga' bar bya/ rtse bar bya/ longs spyod dag kyang bya ste/ de nas mthar gyi de dag gi phrag pa la thog nas grong khyer ka lwa par yud kyi phyin par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste pha rol gnon pa'i stobs re med na ni der 'gro bar mi bya ste/ rlung gi phyogs kyi lam chen po rab tu gsal ba la nye bar brten te myur bar 'gro bar bya'o/ /srid gsum gnas kyi rgyud rnams ni/ /bsod nams chung yang 'grub par sla/ /tshangs 'joms de yis grogs kyang byed/ /che ba'i che ba'ang rnyed ma yin/ /rtag tu dge ba'i stobs dang ldan/ /bdag med don gyi de nyid rig /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /mchog gi rig sngags de yis 'grub/ /gangs ri de la shar dang nub tu chu bo rab tu 'bab pa'i gzhi la lu ma chen po stong phrag brgyad cu dang yongs su 'dres te/ mtsho ltar snang zhing rgyu ba yang mi mngon pa kha dog dkar po snang ba yod do/ /de la chu bo si ta zhes bya'o/ /chu klung 'di ni dkyus su dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang gsum pa/ shar dang nub tu rgya mtsho dug can pa la sogs yongs su 'jug pa/ zhing du dpag tshad tsam mo/ /chu 'di ni shin tu grang ba yin te/ dmyal ba'i 'gro ba ma gtogs pa/ bya dang nya chu srin la sogs pa srog chags 'ga' yang med do/ /chu bo de'i tshur 'gram na zangs kyi mdog ces —231—

bya ba'i ri/ phug pa stong dang ldan pa dag yod de/ shing ri ṣa ka dang / ku lu ma ka dang / ta ma ru dang / de ba da ru dang / shug pas yongs su gang ba yin no/ /ri de la ni srin mo glog 'gyu ma zhes bya ba gnas te/ de'i cho ga la yang snga ma dang mtshungs pa la sa/ lag na ni gshun shing 'dzin pa/ glang po chen po'i lus la za ba/ char sprin gyi mdog can te/ gañdza dang / ha ri na/ nags kyi ba langs dang /glang po che'i khrag rnams kyi bri bar bya zhing / gtor ma yang de dag rnams nyid do/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor ni khro bo gzhin rje gshed po/ zhal drug pa dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhabs drug pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa ral gri dang /dgra sta dang / gri gug dang / ga dā dang / 'khor lo dang / tri shul la la rnams g.yas na 'dzin pa'o/ /gshin rje'i dbyug pa dang / dus kyi zhags pa dang / kha ṭāX ga dang / lcags kyu dang / thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang / sdigs mdzub rnams ni g.yon pa na'o/ /rnam pa 'di lta bu las sngags 'di yin te/ oṃ sarba dug za ya huX/ na dī wā ra ṇi ku mā ra skruṭa ru pi ṇi ban+ta ban+ta sa ma ya ma nu sa ma phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /bi yu tsa la tsa la/ pra tsa la pra tsa la/ birlu dzi swāhā/ sa ha pra mu kha/ sa ha pra ba ha be/ ra ra ra ra rak+ṣa si sbyoXsbyoX a kar+ṣa ya dzaX zhes pa ni srin mo'i sngags so/ /de nas sgrub pa po lam ston cig ces brjod par bya ste/des kyang chu bo si ta la lam ston par 'gyur te/ chu klung de'i rab tu grang bas ni/sa'i steng gi gangs dang rlung reg pa thams cad kyang zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/dgun zla 'bring po la yang chab bro ba chags pa med na/ srin mo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ dbyar zla dang po'i yang chab brom shin du brtan par chags nas sgrub pa po 'jigs pa med pa nyid kyis chu bo'i pha rol du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /chu bo 'di —232—

ni bha ra ta'i dum bu zhes bya ba/ gling 'di'i phyed kyi dbus la rgyu ba yin te/ lho dang byang du yul chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug dang / dgu bcu rtsa drug dag gnas pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang shar nub tu ni byang phyogs lhag par yangs pa yin no/ /chu bo de'i pha rol na shing ke ta dang / be+e la dang / ka bhi ta dang / pa ru ṣa dang / ba da ra dang / ka si ta dang / ar dzu na dang / ta la'i nags tshal dag yod de/ der zla ba gcig tu ngal gso bar bya/ rtsa ba dang 'bras bu dang lo ma dang me tog dag ni bcud dang ldan pa dang mthu dang ldan pa dag yin no/ /der lha mo skul byed ma'i rig pa sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs pa/ yi ge dgu pa'i gzungs sngags stong phrag lnga bzlas pas/ sgrub pa po rang gi yan lag las khrag nag po nag por snang ba dag zag par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste rmi lam du de ltar gyur na yang rung ste/ lus nad med cing stobs dang ldan pa dang /shin du yang bar 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig rnam par spong dang bla ma smod/ /dus min 'chi dang dmyal ba brgyad nga ra 'gro/ /dkyil 'khor ma mthong dbang bskur dman pa yang / /rig sngags sbyor ba nam yang grub pa med/ khengs shing nga rgyal khro la mi bden pa/ /dngos grub thob ces rgyal bas mi gsungs te/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa'i don sems pa/ /mi de dag ni myur 'grub 'phags rnams gsungs/ /rigs dang gzungs dang nor bu dbang phyug dang / /chos dang rig pa sngags kyi myos pa spangs/ /rmi lam gzugs brnyan dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /byed po bya ba dang ni las rnams mthong / /ma chags dul dang yang dag mnyam pa'i sems/ /mchod dang spyin pa bzod dang brtson 'grus bskyed/ /bdag dang bdag gis spong la mngon dga' ba/ /de dag dngos grub mchog la reg par —233—

'gyur/ /yang de nas nags tshal de las kha dru dza'i 'bras pu gser gyi mdog dang mnyam par dag blangs te/ lam rgyags su 'khur bar bya'o/ /'dir ni sgrub pa po rang nyid kyis ci tsam len nus pa de 'khur bar bya ba'i nam yang lcid kyis non par mi 'gyur bas/ mi theg par dogs pa mi bya'o/ /nags de nyid bar mtshams med par gangs kyi ri chung ngu dag gral du bsgrigs pas shar nub kye rgya mtsho'i bar khyab pa yin no/ /de dag las chu 'bab pa thams cad kyang lho phyogos kyi ngos su 'babs pa yin pas/ de dag tu chu mang po can no/ /ri de dag las brgal nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad lnga bcu tshun chad na ni 'thung du rung ba'i chu med pa yin no/ /'on kyang sgrub pa po de lus stobs dang ldan pa dang yang pa'i phyir/ zhug bdun du thang chen po'i pha rol du phyin par 'gyur la/ kha dru dza'i 'bras bu de zos pa'i bkres pa yang med/ skom pa yang med do/ /thang de 9sdodas pa na/ sngon mang du khyer du zin yang rung ste/ 'bras bu de yang zad par 9 khyur ro/ /de'i nub kyi mtshams na ri bo shin du dkar ba nags tshal yid du 'ong ba du mas mdzes pa zhig rgyang ring mo nas mthong bar 'gyur mod kyi/ sgrub pa po tsho der 'gro bar mi bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srin mo zangs kyi mchu can lnga brgya dag gnas te/ lha ma yin gyi pho nya mo de dag gi sgrub pa po la 'tshe bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na byang phyogs drang po'i lam po che bzung nas 'gro bar bya'o/ /nyi ma gcig gis ri bo ki te ra phyin par 'gyur ro/ /de yang kha dog nag cing dam pa 'jigs pa bskyed par byed pa/ ka ba btsugs pa lta bu dpag tshad rnga cu'i dpangs dang ldan pa yod do/ /ri de'i nang ni gser dngul 'ba' zhig gis gang ba yin te/ de'i phyogs bzhi na ni pad+ma dang ut+pa la'i mtsho/ ngang pa dang tsa kra bā —234—

ga dang / ka rwaṇ+ḍal sogs pa/ chu la rgyu ba'i 'dab chags gzugs dang kha dog mdzes pa skad snyan pas gang ba dag yod do/ /ri de la 'jig rten skyongs ba 'phags skyes po dus dus su dga' zhing brtse bar byed pa yin te/ lha min gyi lang tsho ma dag dang / gdug cing gtum pa'i klu rnams kyi bu mo sdug gu stong snyed kyis mchod par byed do/ /de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i yi dwags mthu che zhing /sdug bsngal che ba mang po dag kyang yod de/ der sgrub pa po ci ste 'byor bar gyur na ni/ rtsa mdang 'bras bu rnams dang na ri ko lo'i 'bras bu rnams dang / sha dang nya sha dag gi gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag bya'o/ /ci ste 'byor ba ma gyur na thams cad yid kyis bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ bi bi bi bi bi ru dha ka sa pā ri wa re khyuX khu ni khu ni pra to ta glu pa ta i mam pa li gro hā gro hā sa ma ya mu sma ra hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du spos dkar dang thang chu dang sha'i bdug pa dag kyang spyin par bya'o/ /de nas ni des srung ba byed de mi'am ci dang / lha min dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gnod pas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /'ga' zhig rnam thar gsum gnas g.yin ni brtse ba'i bdag nyid dpa' bo dang / /byin rlob rim pa phan tshun rgyu dang 'bras bus mkhas pas rig pa bya/ /'dod pas dpung 'joms de las dag pa'i lam ste grub pa rjes su 'jug /mun pa nyams dang dga' ba'i rgyu las rab bde ci phyir thob ma yin/ /de nas sgrub pa po byang phyogs su song na/ mi ring ba na me na ko zhes pa'i ri bo chen po yod de/ de ni tsam pa ka dang karko la dang / ma ra ka dang / ke ru ka dang / ki sba ka dang / nā ga su spyi dang / tsan+dan sa mchog rnams kyi nags kyis bskor ba/ ri'i de khrod na srin mo'i bu mo rta'i gdong pa —235—

can/ lha min mo dag dang / klu phran gyi dag gar dang dbyangs dang rol ces sna tshogs bas rtag tu rtse bar byed pa dag yin/ der sgrub pa po bud med de dka la chags par yang mi bya glu dang rol mo dag la yang dga' bar mi bya'o/ /gzhan du na bsod snyoms dag blangs te 'gro bar bya'o/ /de'i pha rol na chu bo chen po shar nas nub tu 'bab cing / rba klong 'khrugs pa shin tu bgrod dka' ba yin te/ chu klung de'i ming ni sa twa lo ta na zhes bya'o/ /de la ni nya rnams kha dog sna tshog1sa pa dang / gdong rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag yod de/ stag dang / seng ge dang / gung dang / ba lang dang / spre'u dang / ne tso dang / kha dang / mi'i gdong pa la so gos pa'o/ /chu klung de'i skabs 'ga' na ni/ rdo las skyes pa'i n+ya gro dha'i sdong po yal gas phan tshun gyi 'gram du khyab pa dag yod de/ shing de la brten nas bsgru ba pa po 'gro bar bya'o/ /yang na ni nya'i stobs kyis 'gro bar bya ste/ phyogs de dang nye ba na/ lo hi ta zhes bya ba'i ri dmar po chung ngu mang po dag yod de/ de dag la ni swa li dmar po dang / mud ga dang / man ru ba dag ma rmos par skye ba yin rte// de la blangs nas zan du btsos te phyogs su shing las sbrang rtsi mang po ltung kyang blangs shing / de dag bsres te nam mkha'i mdzode ces bya ba 'phags pa'i sngags kyis yang dag par spel zhing sbyangs la sngags 'di'i nya'i tshogs rnamatha sdo la gtor mar sbyin no/ /oX maX maX maX maX maX ma ta gya rā dza/ ma ta gya ga ṇa sa hi ha bhañdza ho bhak+ṣa ho/ sarba mahā phya de wa ta i mam ba li gro hā gro hā ka ra ka ra/ ki ri gi ri ku ru ku ru ma ra ma ra mi ri mi ri mu ru mu sa ma ma kā t+yaX swa dha ya/ sarba brnyu ā dzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ de ltar lan lnga brgyas gtor ma spyin zhing / 'dod pa'i rnga lnga rtsal gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /der nya rnams kyi rgyal po sgrub pa po'i mdun sdo’ 'ong —236—

ba la/ sgrub pa po'i smras pa/ kyai nya'i rgyal po/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don du kho bo ni grong khyer ka lā par 'gro yi/ chu bo'i pha rol tu bsgral bar mdzod cig /gnas 'di la ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbang ba'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas nya'i rgyal po des sgrub pa po rgyab tu khur nas chu bo'i pha rol du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ka ka ri'i gangs kyi byang phyogs nas chu bo 'di'i bar gyi lam gang yin pa de dag ni/ mi'i 'gro ba gnas pa med do/ /gang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba dang / gnod sbyin gtum po mi bzad pa dag gnas pa yin no/ /'on kyang lam 'di dag gi shar dang nub tu dpag tshad lnga brgyas bcad pa'i pha rol na ni/ grong dang grong khyer dang grong brdal dag kyang yod mod kyi lam de dag nas song na ni lo brgya phrag gis kyang grong khyer ka lā par phyin par mi 'gyur te kun tu 'khod par 'gyur ro/ /chu klung sī ta'i byang phyogs de'i bar mtshams thams cad ni ri kha ba can mang pos kun du gang ba yin no/ /'on kyang gangs kyi ri bar bcad pa ni med do/ /de nas chu klung de yongs su brgal ba'i byang phyogs na ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi byang phyogs kyi grong khyer rnams yod de/yul dang grong dang grong khyer dang grong brdal dag gis gang ba/ rab tu 'byor ba dang bde ba dang lo legs pa yin no/ /gang la snying rje'i bdag po ni/ /mig gsum gzugs kyis gnas pa ste/ /de yis gnas kyis mtshan pas na/ nga la zhes rab tu grags/ /seng ges mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /seng ge'i rgyal mtshan rab grags ltar/ /gang la sham bha las mtshan pa/ kha lha'i yul zhes de la brjod/ /gang la kla klo med pa dang / /bden smra brdzun pa ma yin dang / /mun pa'i stobs ni nyams gyur —237—

la/ /snying stobs yon tan rgyas pa yin/ /chu bo de dang gel sha'i/ /bsde sde dodage chabar gyi yul—ni rnam pa mang po ste/ nya zhes bya ba'i yul dpag tshad nyi shu'o/ /su min rta tsho zhes bya ba dpag tshad nyi shu'o/ /bha ṭa phye na zhes bya ba dpag tshad brgya'o/ /smi myo zhes bya ba dpag tshad stong ste dbus kyi cha la'o/ /bar do zhes bya ba dpag tshad brgya'o/ /ku ru zhes bya ba dpag tshad brgya'o/ /bha dra ka zhes bya ba dpag 'di lnga bcu'o/ /de dag gi pha rol na/ gan+dha ra zhes bya ba dpag tshad nyi shu'o/ /ka sha zhes bya ba dpag tshad nyi shu'o/ /bha dra zhes bya ba dpag tshad nyis brgya'o/ /ma hā tsi na zhes bya ba dpag tshad stong ste dbus kyi cha la'o/ /rda ra rdo rje zhes bya ’na pag tshad brgya ste ri'i ngos la gnas pa'o/ /bṛ ki ka zhes bya ba dpag tshad nyis brgya'o/ /de dag gi yang pha rol na/ ma hi ṣa ka zhes bya ba dpag tshad nyis brgya'o/ /ma hi la ko zhes bya ba dpag tshad stong ste dbus kyi cha la'o/ /rnga rna ra zhes bya ba dpag tshad nyis brgya'o/ /su tā pha la zhes bya ba dpag tshad lnga brgya'o/ /de dag gi pha rol na/ ka ṭu ka zhes bya ba dpag tshad lnga btsu'o/ sku ra zhes bya ba dpag tshad lnga ste dbus kyi cha la'o/ /ko spa dzi zhes bya ba dpab/ tshad brgya'o/ /de dag gi shar dang nub kyi char dag la yang / yul 'khor da rnga ri grong khyer gzhan dag kyang yod do/ /de dag chu ni mang po dang / /mtsho dang mtsho lha thun du mas brgyan/ /gangs kyi ri dang ri bo bzang / /sman ljongs nyams dag 'ge du ma dang / /nags dang kun dga' yid 'ong dang / /sman rnams dag gi spru/nga ba yin/ /rgyal po'i pho brang sna tshogs dang / /tshong 'dus dang ni tshong khang nga ni nga / /zong rnams rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /yo byad rab tu rgyas pa yod/ /de na 'a ngegs pa 'ga' yang med/ /nyam ngar gyur pa yod ma yin/ /'on kyang de la mi/ blta —238—

ste/ /srid pas sgrub po'i gegs byed do/ /grong khyer mchog ni ka lnga pa/ /'ba' zhig bsams te 'gro bar bya/ /rgya yul rgya yul chen po dang / /ba yi la ko kha ra rnams/ /byang nas byang du bgrod bya ste/ /lam ster shin tu ring pa yin/ /stong phrag mang po de dag kyang / /sngags kyi shugs 'chad de yis ni/ /zhag bdun zla ba phyed la sogs/ /zla drug las gzhan lhag pas min/ /de rnams las kyang rab brgal na/ /'byung khungs rnam pa sna tshogs yod/ kha gcig la ni dug gi rgyun/ khyad par khyad par ldan pa 'bab/ /gser gyi rdul brtsegs ri bo dang / /de bzhin dngul dang zangs kyi ste/ kha cig lcags dang a bha dang / /rang ga bhang ga de bzhin no/ /de dag sa 'di 'thug po dang / kha cig la ni dug gi rgyun/ /bye ma rdo bas g.yogs pa yin/ /gseg ma rnam pa sna chogs dag kha cig rin chen du mas khyab/ /yul de dag gi sa phyogs na/ /rtsa dang ljon shing rnam par spangs/ /nor bu dzi ban+ti dang ni/ /byu dra rnam pa du ma skyes/ /gser las 'chi bar byed pa'i chu/ /smyo bar byed pa dngul las te/ /gzhan ni sbu dang pags pa ltung / kha cig du ma'i nad rnams so/ /'byung khungs dag nas dpag tshad gsum/ /'das ni dri bral chu nyid de/ /sgrub po sngags kyis mthu yis ni/ /de kun yon to byed pa yin/ /gser gyi tshe ni ring po ste/ /dngul gyi de bzhi mdangs bzang ba/ /lhag ma gang rnams de rnams kyi/ /nad kun 'jigs par byed pa yin/ /yang dag brgal pa'i pha rol na/ /rigs lnga pa zhes bya ba rin po che du mas brgyan pa/ shing a rda dang / sa l+la la/ sha sma li dang / swā la dang / ta ma la dang / da shā ma dang / ni gi ra dang / a mra dang / ka ra bī ra dang / shing lin dang / ba ku li dang / gan+ta mo da ha dang / mo da dha ma la sogs pa ljon 3ngo —239—

rigs brgya phrag du mas gang ba yin no/ /ri de la ni mi'am ci dang/ rdze rtse ge pa sde mi 'am bye rdzo dag 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs kyi brtse bar byed cing / rtag tu dga' ba'i gnas pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi sgrub pa po la 'drid par byed pa'i phyir/ za ri ba tu snyan pa'i glu dang rol mo byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sdigs pa'i phyir 'a:sdogs pa'i sgra 'byin pa'am gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur ba dag kyang yod/ ra btu skyo ba'i phyir/ dud mo la sogs pa sna tshogs pa sbyor bar byed do/ /de dag la sgrub pa po chags par mi bya/ 'jigs par mi bya/ skyo bar mi bya ste/ g.yin du zu/ stong pa nyid kyi gnas pas zil gyis mnan te 'gro bar bya'o/ /gal te rnam pa de lta bu las gzhan pas 'gro ba ni/ sgrub pa po la sdug bsngal chen po ster ro/ /de nas ri bo de yang 'das pa na bho ṭa dang / su da bho ṭa dang / pra bho ṭa zhes su tsho ba'i yul chung ngu dag yod de/ de dag na ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dag mi'i bu mo rdzu 'phrul can gyi rnam par gnas so/ /der sgrub pa pos zhag bdun du gnas/ par bya zhing / gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas de rnams kyi smras pa/ kyai sgrub pa po khyod la ci zhig dgos/ sgrub pa pos smras pa/ bdag grong khyer ka lā par lcu‘/ra du bgrod par mdzod cig /de nas mi mo rdzu 'khrul dang ldan pa gcig gis/ sgrub pa po phrag pa la thogs te dpag tshad bzhi yi mtho ba'i gangs kyi ri bo che/na po dang / gangs khrod kyi lam dpag tshad brgya phrag lhag pa yang / chu skrudi rnga ka cig gis mngon par mgrod nas/ /ri bo tsan+d+ra ka la zhes bya ba shing hin ta la dang /ma ta la dang / ko la ka dang / rdo wa ra dang / ma gu ma la dang / dwa rgyu dang ri / so ma wadhe dang / sa ma na dang / ni tsu lad dang / bi du rma dang / tin tu la tre rgogs pas yongs su gang ba/ sman ljon shin tu nyams dga' ba dang bcas pa de za ri phyin —240—

par 'gyur ro/ /sgeg pa'i gzugs la'ang dga' min te/ /cha byad 'jigs pa'ang de bzhin no/ /rdo rje mig dang ldan de dag /dge bar spyod la dges par grags/ /de dang sdig ldan rnams la yang / /snying rje ldan rnams mnyam par byams/ /sgrub po rang nyid sdig pa ni/ /zad pa'i bde ba snang ba yin/ /ri bo de ni sham+bha la'i yul mtha' yin te/ phyogs te 'phags pa hri ku ṭi thor tshugs gcig ma bzhugs so/ /de la me tog kun rda dang ku su lha'i me tog gis sbyin bsreg stong phrag brgyad 'bul nas/ dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba btab ste 'gro bar bya'o/ /de las gangs kyi puṇ+ḍa rī ka gcig dag blangs te/ oX shwe ta shwe ta dz+wa ṭi ni shu ti smi ti bi dza ye bhaX swāhā/ zhes pa'i rig pa lnga stong du bzlas nas spyi bor bcings ba tsam gyis gnon sbyin gtum po mtha' dag dbang du byed pa dang /thams cad la 'jug pa'i shes rab thogs pa med pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang phyogs su song ste/ me gha ke tu zhes bya ba'i yul lo/ /bi bi dza la zhes bya ba/kha di ra dang / tsan+dan gyi nags chen po dag yod de/ de yang bgrod par bya ba dpag tshad brgya pa yin no/ /de'i pha rol du ljongs chen po sam su kha zhes bya ba yod de/ gang 'dzam bu'i gling na yod pa'i shing gis rigs gang yin pa de thams cad yul de na yod de/ ma lus shing lus pa med pas brgyan pa'o/ /de'i pha rol na kun du dga' zhes pa'i nags thod de/ de yang 'das pa'i pha rol na grong khyer ka lwa pa yod de/ der sgrub pa po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi bdag gi rnam pa 'dzin pa de las chos nyan pa thob par bya ba'i phyir/ pho brang chen po ka lā pa de'i phyogs bzhi kun nas phyag 'tshal bar bya/ bdug spos kyang btul bar bya/ me tog dag kyang gtor bar bya ste/ bskor ba dag kyang bya —241—

ste/ yang na ni zhag gcig /yang na ni zhug bdun/ yang na ni zla ba phyed/ phya/ge sde chang ri sbya ni zla ba gcig go /de ltar sgrub pa pos nyid kyi ji ltar sdig pa zad par ‘yā/ra ba de ltar de ltar mi bdag byang chub sems dpa'i bka' yis gnang ba sbyin te/gang gi zhabs kyi pad+ma'i drung du 'khrid par byed do/ /gang gi tshe sems :na pa' chen po mthong ba de'i tshe/ sems shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa dang / g.yo nga med pa dang / dang ba'i sems kyis dbyug pa 'gyel ba lta bu'i yan lag brgyang / dang ldan pas rab tu 'dud pas/ lan brgya stong du mar phyag bya'o/ /rin po che'i me tog dag kyang gtong bar bya'o/ /gal te sgrib pa shas chung ba zhig yin na ni/de'i zhabs la mgo bos yi tsho/ pa tsam gyis 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa gzhan ni byang chub sems dpa' de'i bka' las 'dod pas dngos grub tu 'gyur la/ de bzhin du gzhan yang dngos grub phra mo dag dang /shes pa dag kyang thob par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs su skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du nges par bsam pa yin na ni/ de'i thabs gang yin pa de yang dri bar bya zhing / des ci skad bstan pa de ba'i na du sgrub na de kho na bzhin 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub pa pos yu pa gyi mchog dang mchog de dag blta bar bya/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i glegs bam dag kyang mngon du bya/ gtsug lag khang rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang /mchod rten rnam pa du ma de dag la phyag 'tshal bar bya/ smon lam kyang spru/dab par bya'o/ /yul de zlum bor mnyam pa ste/ gangs dang ldan pas bskor ba yin/ /'byung po yi ni phyogs cha na/ /dpag tshad lnga bcur 'phags pa ni/ /mchog dang grags pa rab ldan pa/ /'byung po'i dbang po mgrin sngon gyis/ /—242—

rtag tu brten zhing dge ba'i sa/ /ri dbang ke la sha zhes bya'o/ /sna tshogs rig pa sman gyi las/ /sgyu rtsal dbye ba gzhan dang gzhan/ /bzo rnams du ma mtha' yas pa/ /nyin dang nyin la rtag tu sbyong/ /pho brang mchog ni ka lā pa/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub cing / /gru bzhi lham pa'i gzhi la gnas/ /lha yi bzo bos byas pa ste/ /grong khyer de yi g.yas ngos na/ /tsan+dan a dkar nags kyi khyab/ /dwangs shing gsal la yid 'ong ba'i/ /yid kyi mtsho dag yod pa yin/ /gang gi yul de'i dbus na ni/ /de bshad de dag gnas pa'o/ /nags rnams dang ni ljongs dag gi /phreng ba rim pa gsum gyis mdzes/ /grong brdal nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /yul phran du mas rnam par brgyan/ /phyogs mtshams kyi ni lam dag na/ /rtse mo brgya dang brtsegs pa yang / /de rnams la ni go bgos pa'i/ /srung ba po ni 'bum phrag yod/ /gangs dang ri bo de dag la/ /glang chen spos kyi glang po dang / /mche ba drug pa mu tig can/ /nags tshal ri dwags du mas mdzes/ /gdong lnga pa dang rkang brgya pa/ /glang po'i gdong dang bya tshogs dang / /'dab chags skyes bu'i lus can yod/ /dbus las rgyab kyi phyogs cha na/ /rgyang grags tshad kyi ri bo bzang / /tshar du dngar ba bcur yin te/ /bzang skyong lhun po rtse 'dzin dang / /sa yi snying bo gtsug phud 'dzin/ /ha la ha la sgrogs mdzod pa/ /lcang lo'i bdag po skra can ma/ /don dam yang dag 'phags de bzhin/ /bcu pa ma rgyal ba las rgyal/ /de dag rnams kyi brten pa ste/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i chos kyi gnas/ /rtag tu byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /stong phrag bcu bcus brten pa yin/ /kai la sha yi 'gram ngogs na/ /mkha' khams rdo rje nam mkhar gnas/ /stong phrag brgyad kyi sman rnams dang / /mthu ldan srog chags du —243—

ma dang / /me tog 'bras bu khyad par kun/ /denas rtag tu spyod pa yin/—/zlu tig zla ba chu shel dang / /dmar po iṇ+ḍa nī la dang / /mar ta ka dang g.ya : sa su 'khyil/ /put+pa rā ga byu dra'i sde/ /ad+ma gar+bha gser la sogs/ khams gsung 5 sna tshogs mtha' yas yod/ /dngul chus khyad par mang pos gang / /pa ru sha ka be+e ḍār+ya/ /de na rnyed par dka' min te/ kha zas ro bcud sna tshogs pa/ /de da rnga ka mi 'byung gang yang med/ /sna tshogs gos phyir khyad par ni/ /bsam pa ji bzhin bgo byed de/ /dge min las kyi lam bcu po/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i skye bo nyu ༄ / /phal cher dge la gnas pa yin/ /theg pa gsum gyi lam gnas pa'i/ /drang srong dpag tu med pas brten/ /thams cad lha yi skad du smra/ /de na gnas pa pho khro mi rnams ni/ /tshe ni lo brgya las mi thung / /dus min 'chi ba nyud ba yin/ /rta rje ka tu 'dod la dga' bar spyod/ /'on kyang dge ba las mi nyams/ /chos dang 'dod pa de bzhin gzhan/ /nor dang thar pa'i don zhes pa/ /rdzogs ldan bzhi ni du rab spyod de/ /'di mtshungs gzhan ni yod ma yin/ /rgyal po'i bu ni gang btsas par/ /nor bu rin chen 'ong 'gyur la/ /zhag bdun 'od bzang 'phro gyur pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpar shes/ /gang gi sngon du ma mthong pa'i/ /me rtog rab tu rgyas pa che/ khyim du mngon par skye 'gyur ba/ /de ni lha yi yan ‘5ga ma'o/ /mi bdag yan lag mar bcas pa/ /rgas pa med cing na med de/ /'a grwam po'i khrims kyis rtag tu 'tsho/ /'khor los sgyur dang mtshungs pa yin/ /rtab/ tu byang chub sems dpa' dang / /drang srong sngags kyi spyad pa can/ /yang dag ‘ ngeg pa nyid ston gyi/ /rtog ge'i bgrod med de min tsam/ /las rnams rnam nga/ sna tshogs dang / /grub pa brgyad la sogs rnams dang / /gang gzhan dngos grung/ sna —244—

tshogs dag /der ni mngon sum rnyed dka' min/ /zla ba re rer sgrub pa po/ /'di de 'dod pa'i dngos grub ces/ /chos kyi dga' ba'i gtam chen pos/ /rtag tu ngo mtshar dga' ba yin/ /chags bral byed dang dga' ba dang / /spyod pa gcig tu dge ba'i blos/ /dag pa'i sems ni mnyes gshin pa/ /sbyin dang bzod dang dul ba dang / /mi 'tshe ba dang rtse gcig dang / /rig dang shes dang legs par thos/ /bsam gtan bzlas dang mchod de bzhin/ /yang dag de nyid bsgom pa'o/ /de skad gsungs pa'i 'dus pa ste/ /thams cad rjes su yi rang gyur/ /skal bzang ldan pa lnga brgya po/ /yang yang 'dud cing bskor ba byas/ /de nas brtse ldan 'jigs rten mgon/ /rab tu bzhad cing legs so legs/ /skye bo mang po grol don du/ /don yod lcags kyus 'di bshad do/ /'khor rnams kyis ni 'di bzung nas/ /rtag tu byang zhing chub par gyis/ /blo gros ldan pa lnga brgya po/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs thob nas/ /grong khyer drug tu yud kyis song / /theg chen chos ni rab bshad nas/ /rim pa'i cho ga 'di nyid kyis/ /grong khyer ka lwa par song ngo / /de las brgya phrag bzhi rnams kyis/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub chen po thob/ /gang ming rnam par mi rtog pa/ /de sogs lhag ma gang yin te/ /zab dang rgya che'i tshul rtogs nas/ /grong khyer drug tu slar yang 'ong / /don yod zhags pa'i mdo sde ni/ /stong phrag lnga bcu gcig pa dang / /rig pa mchog gi 'bum sde sogs/ /gzhan yang rig sngags sna tshogs dang / /ral ba gcig ma'i cho ga dang / /'jam pa'i rdo rjes rtogs pa ni/ /stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa ste/ /cho ga du ma rgyas par byas/ /gang zhig ka lwa par 'jug pa'i/ /thabs 'di bris pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro ba drug tu 'khor ba rnams / /—245—
