zhes bya ba/ theg pa chen po'i thabs chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed pa rdzogs so// //rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bal po'i dpe las bsgyur ba ste/ don da ka' ba dka' ba rnams bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta kriṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba la dris shing gtan la phang/ ste zhus dag byas pa'o/ /zhus so/ /dge legs 'phel/ /sarba maṅgalaX//

gser gyi phung po zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru khyoX rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor dang / /gnyis med khyung po rnal 'byor la/ /bsad nas gang de'i man ngag gis/ /gsang ba cung zad bshad par bya/ /'dir bde ba lam byed kyi skor mkhas grub khyung po nas brgyud pa la da lta bka' ma chad pa 'di snyed cig yod de/ ni gu'i gzhan lus dang / su kha'i lugs dang / mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi dgongs 'dus dang / me tri ba'i/a dwa ya badz+ra kyi man ngag ste lnga'o/ /dang po la/ gtum mo dang 'brel ba dang / sgyu lus dang 'brel ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ rang sems bde ba bsgom pa/ rlung gi lam sbyangs ba/ sbyor bya yum gyi mtshan nyid/ brten tshul dngos te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ chos drug gi rang lus/ thabs ldan gyi gtum mo lam khrid legs par sbyang ba zhig gis bsgom ste/ rang bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum du gsal bas lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum gsal btab/ yas snar haX dang mas snar a yang gsal btab ste/rlung bum can bzung / a dmar po cung zad zhu ba khro chu ltar tsha ba'i rak+ta'i 'khor lo bzhi mas rim gyi gang / haX zhu thig le dkar la bsil ba'i yas rim gyis gang / gnyis po 'gros 'ded lta bu la sems gtad/ thun 'jog khar dkar cha haX la stim/ dmar cha a la stim te dmigs pas nor bu'i nang du huX —247—

sngon bo zhabs kyu phyir thon pa pad+ma'i lte bar su yig ser po/ de gnyis kyi lhab pa kyu lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba/ yab kyi dbu ma thig le dkar po'i 'phreng ba rnga ning /yum gyi dbu ma thig le dmar po'i phreng bas bstims pas/ snyoms par zhu kas shing bskyod pa'i lhod tsam dang lto ba phyir phul tsam gyi bzung / de nas thur sde sprel 'phul 'then dang / a a a zhes stod 'dren drag po dang / yang rngub ste rlu ri gi bgang 'dren drag po gnyis la lan gsum spel te 'dren/ bgang 'then drab/ po gnyis byas pa'i rang gi nor bu'i nang gi hūX bcas drang / rdo rje dang dbu ma rtswa/‘ ma zlog tu song / spyi bor thon par bsam/ skrug 'grems dang / 'bebs chung mang du byas te/ de la yang rlud bgang ba 'bud pa yang yang spel/ dmigs 1skor gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni bum pa can gnas bzhin pa'i skyil krung gyen thur/ se2ri ge 'gying snol/ 'gying bag bcu pa/ zla dpyad phrag sgang ltar 'gying ba/ glang 1bzhi gnang sor/ dgra ba'i mtha' ste/ 'khrul 'khor bcu'am/ bcu gnyis bya/ /byad par gser chos kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi ni thogs la/ la la ring bar rngub lte the sdog tu kha sbyor drag po bya/ de nas bgang 'dren 'dar thon pa dang / bgang ga rnon drag po 'phongs su srig gru bzhur drag po mnan/ de nas lto ba bcar te drab/ tu bus/ rgyu zhabs su stong gnon lan gsum nas nyer yang tsog pu'i ngang nas :sreg por rngub la mdun rgyab mnyam por rdeg /de nyid stod du sgril ba 'dar tho5/ pa dang / de lan bdun spel/ de nas 'phongs btegs shing rdeb/ 'dom 'ja'/ gi mthar gru mo rtsegs/ sgal tshigs srang / 'phongs stegs pus mo dgrad/ two nyir —248—

bus de ka ba btsugs la gsang rtsa 'then/ yang drag tu rngub la steng mnan lan gsum dang / gyen du 'phar zhing 'og tu rdab pa lan gsum bzhi byas nas sbrag 'grem drag po bya ste/ 'dren 'grems so/ /yang tsog pu stod dkyil byas la/ pho bar kha sbyor drag po bya/ stod sgrim smad glod/ yang rlung smad du sdig /smad sgrim stod glod/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzu5 bya/ lto ba ldir byas la rlung bus/ ma nang gi gru bzhud las/ gyen 'then dang / gyen du 'phar/ mthud gnon dang 'phong rdeb pa bstun lus sgrim zhing stang ba de 'dra lan lnga bya/ dbug shugs la 'ong du bcug nas/ lte 'og drag tu mnan la sprug pa dang / ha zhes stong sprug bya ste/ 'dzin 'dren 'grems pa dang dngas snyams 'byed pa bzhi char dus gcig 'byung ba ste gcig rdzogs so// //yang ha zhes rgya mtsho'i bcir la ka ba btsugs/ stod sgrim la stong 'dren dang / smad sgrim la stod gnon byas/ 'og sgo 'then/ de 'dra lan gsum nas gru bzhud las bgang 'dren bgang byon lan gsum dang / bgang sprug dang stong sprug bya/ lto ba bskyed pa'i bgang 'dren 'dar thon pa dang / bgang gnon gru bzhed drag po bung bskyed ba'i/ nad sogs 'og sgo nas thon par bsam te/snyigs ma dang skyon 'don pa dag byed de rlung thim/ 'dren 'grems gcig rdzogs/ dag byed bzhi po 'di la/ tshogs 'khor re dang / gser gyi me tog gi bcad thang mdzad pa yin par gda' 'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyor bya yum gyi mtshan nyid de/ spyir bshad tshod mang yang 'dir de mi ga mo/ /sdo la bu mo lo bcu drug nas sum cu so lnga tshun chad la bde sni —249—

ba 'phel nus/ lus dang bzhin mdzes pa/ skra bzang ba/ mkhur tshos la me tog— yod pa/ kha dri zhim pa/ 'phongs zlum pa/ smad drod che zhing dam la yang dog ran pa dang / bde ba dang 'dod chags che ba/ nor yul phyogs zas gos dgra gnyen gyi zhen pa dang rnam rtog chung ba/ mang po'i dbus su spyod lam mdzangs zhing sngags kyi spyod pa'i skabs ngo tsha chung ba/ snying rje dang nges 'byung dang dang/ pa rnams rang bzhin gyi che na rab/ ma byung na yang gsos btab cing sgom tu ba byug na skye ba'o/ /mtshan nyid gzhan rnams rnyed dka' zhing dgos pa chung gsung / /༈ bzhi pa la gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ yid du 'ong ba'i bu mo la sbyor bar bsam pa gsum pa'i skabs ltar bya ba ste/ yid kyi rig ma'o/ /gnyis nga/ ni/lag sor la sbyor ba ste/ lag pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dwangs snyi:kas 'byed pa las rtsa rnams dwangs snyigs dbye ba ste/ rtsa'i stong ra che chung byed rnga/ la bslab pa dang / rlud dwangs snyigs dbye ba la gsum gyi dang po ste ba'i (sbos 'byung thig ler bcas pa la rlung thim par bsam shing / steng rlung thur du mdzo nan/g.yas lcog g.yon lcog sprug rdig rnams bya/ sor mo bskum la gru bzhur bya/༈ gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma ka ling 'dra snying ga'i thig le la thim par dzo smos te/ rlung rngub ste 'og rlung dang sres/ 'phral du drag tu bus te stong 'dren gyi ngang nas g.yas lcog g.yon lcog sprug rdig bya'o/ /'di gnyis la tsog bu bya/༈ gsum pa bar rlung rgyang te lus stang ba'o/ /de dag phyag rgya la 1spyor ba'i sngon du thun re zhing bya'o/ /thig le dwangs snyigs dbye ba ni/ gzugs spre glu dri ro reg bya la bslab pa spyi dang 'dra ste zhor la 'ong zhing gnad kyang chung gsulha ri sa/—250—

de nas thog mar rang skyil krung gi pang du rig ma bzhag la lus yi dam yab yum mkha' gsang dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs dran tsam bya/ rdo rje pad+ma ra bcug te dar cig klod/ de nas dal bus bskyod cing / bde ba mgo g.yos pa la skyod 'phro bcad kyin bzung dgos te/ 'og sgo klod pa'i bzung stong 'dren bgang 'dren gru bzhud drag po rnams kyis drangs/ sprug 'grems re byas la 'khrul 'khor bzhi pa dang bcu pa dang / kha bub 'phongs klod rkyang skum rus sbal 'gros/ /rkang gzhib lang 'dug lan gsum mthur gnon yin/ /nor bu bsdams te bgang 'then kha ching yin/ /so sprig sgra bcas 'bud skrug si sgra'o/ /zhes pa'i thim bzhir grags pa 'di yang bya ste/ 'di thog mar rang du legs so/ /de nas rim pa'i bslab pas/ thig le gsang bar 'dzin pa'i tshe zin dka' na sku gsum gyi thig bu steng nas brdab/ bya rog srog thums 'og nas brdab/ drug theb logs nas btab par bya/ zhes te dri aṅga li dang brnying ba dang / srin por byang ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /de nas sems dwangs snyigs 'byed pa ni/ bde ba phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa'o/ /de dag ni gzhan lus kyi gtum mo'i gdams pa'o/ /༈gnyis pa ni/ sgyu lus sbas don zhes bya ste/ 'di la rlud sbyang ba bum pa can kho na dang gzhan snga ma dang 'dra bas/ 'dir 'khrul 'khor dngor gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dbab pa'i zhabrul 'khor rnam gsum ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung lan gsum 'deg /rdo rje khu tshur thur du mnan/ /bya snyong bya zhing lan gsum rdig /bzung ba'i 'khrul 'khor rnam gsum ni/ /lus gnad mnyam bzhag sa —251—

gnon la/ /rlud gnad bla ma'i zhal las shes/ /zlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor khe sde rnaskyo pa gsum ni/ /lus gnad rus sbal kha bub la/ /huX gnyis re mos bshang ‘pam zlog /'gram pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam gsum ni/ /gcan zan rgyal po'i ste rdo sprug steng dang / /spyang mo sdug dang rgod ldang bya/ /mi chen 'dug kyang gnon par bzhed/ /dang po ni/ rdor dkyil lag gnyis dpyi thad par btsugs spre rdob/gnyis pa ni/ sems dkyil pus mor khu tshur gan rkyal nas/ rlung bzung tsur drangs brla yi rtsa bar mnan/ gsum pa ni/ khur tshur rlar bzhag pus btsunas 'phar rdeb bya/ 'then riganon dang sbyor zhing de gsum la mgo bkug /mig rmen du zlog /lce rkan la sbyar/ dmigs pa haX la gtad do/ /bzhi/ lnga/ drug pa gsum ni/ sems dkyil steng mnan 'og rlud rang sa la/ /g.yas gcu ga/yon pa mnyam bzhag g.ya sa sa gnon/ /de nyid go bzlog dbu la gnyis sa gnon/ /nye bar sems btod mig sogs gong dang 'dra/ /bdun/ bsdi spyod/dgu pa gsum ni/ rkang ngar lag ngar sar btsug lus rgur la/ /lag sor rte dze / zhe5 la mgo dgur huX rangs bus/ /mgod gyed rngub nas huX thung bgang 'a1tren dang / /po gang lam gyen zlog bgang stong 'dren gnyis so/ /bcu pa ni/ ’ rkang lag sor mo sar btsug sder bzhi bsgrad/ /g.yas g.yon dbus su lcog /tseng sprug pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ khu tshur bcing te sug bzhi 'dzug pa tre tho/sa gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /de gnyis la rjes 'phongs rdeb cing rlud 'bud cing ji / ga 'grems bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni langs te rkang sgrad lags pa sked ga sbor bya/ /dpung pa g.yas g.yon lcag byas mdun du 'phar/ /sgyid pa sdem byas sngo snyud —252—

btang sprug sprug pa'o/ /bcu gsum byed na spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni gzhan dang 'dra ba las rang dang rig ma phyag rgya snang stong sgyu mar shes pa dang / lha sku gsal stong du rgyas thebs bzhin pa'i/ gzugs mdzes pa lta ba me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang stong dang / 'khrig tshig dang dga' ba'i sgra sogs brag cha ltar grag stong dang / 'byud pa dang rdo rje pad+ma ra reg pa sogs kyi bde ba myongs yang 'di yin bzung du med pa/ sems bde stong dang / rdo rje pad+ma ra skyod pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa ngos bzung du med pa blos dpyad du med pa/ tshig gis brjod du med pa sgyu ma sgyu 'dzin dang bral ba la snyoms par bya'o/ /'dir rtsol ba rab gtum mo rang lus la 'bad pa rnams gzhan lus sgom dus lam gyi rkang tshugs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gzhan lus gtum mor rgyas par bstan pa yin/ kha cig gtum mo mi lcog par sgyu lus man chad sgom pa'i so so'i dge sbyor bzang rab byung ba la/ rlung phyogs bsdus tsam bstan nas gzhan lus kyi nyin par dang / rmi lam dang 'od gsal gsum la bogs 'byin pa ni sgyu lus sbas don gyi go ba ste/ chags lam rgyas bsdus gnyis khrid kyi gzhung shing gcig la yod pas rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /'di ni slob dpon a yi seng ge dang / gser gling pa bkra shis dpal gyi yig chung las zhal gdams snyan rgyun gyis rgyan pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ shing ston chen po'i yig chung yang don 'di kar 'dugaphyis su ro snyoms rdo rjes zin bris la ni/ lhad che zhing lhag chad gnyis ka yod do/ /'di lag len khrigs chags su gsal bar bkod pa'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i gsang lam bshad zin to/ /—253—

༈ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi ri bong dbab bzung la ni/ ra zhe rtegasum ste/ rig ma brtag cing dgug pa/ sta gon sbyang ba/ las la sbyar ba 'phros dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo dpral bar sme pa yod pa sa gi'i rigs/ dmar mo lte bar sme ba yod pa dpral bar rtse gsum yod pa rin zur rigs/ dkar la dmar ba mgrin par sme ba can skyes pa'i reg na mi bzod pa pad+ma'i rigs/ sngo sangs nu phrag dog pa rna ba g.yon pa la sme ba can las kyi rigs/ sngo sangs snying kha la sme ba can thugs kyi rigs yin no/ /zhes su kha sirnyi gsungs so/ /dung can ma gnas lnga po gang rung du dung 'dra ba'i ri mo sku de/ pa/ glang chen ma der sme ba smug po yod pa/ pad+ma can la thig le'i ri mo yod pa/ri dwags can ma la ri mo dgu po rgyab sprod du yod pa/ ri mo can ma la ri mo ’rdung po gsum/ lcug phran ma la lnga/ chos 'byung ma la gru gsum 'gyung ba'o/ /de rnga / ga la bde ba myur ba dang / stong nyams che ba dang / bde ba rgyas pa dang / bde ba 'bring dang / thig le 'dzin sla ba dang / gsal nyams che ba dang / bde ba shugs che ba rnams kyi dgos pa yod do/ /zhes gang ga bhā ra gsungs so/ /ji5nga kha'i mchu las bha ga brtag /mchu mthug na bha ga sha rgyas/ kha che chud rdel bha ga che chung yod/ bha ga lo dgu la sor lnga/ bcu drug la khyud gang / nyi shu la sor skyu༅ gnyis che tshad yin te/ de las dkyus ring ba ni mi brten no/ /bde ba che rdo spying mig la brtag ste/ mig dkyus ring shing mig 'bras nag ba sri ga dang / :/ga 'dzum yod na bzang / skra dang nu ma legs na bdag po la gus te/ skra li narab/ ser na 'bring / nag po rkyang pa tha ma'o/ /nu ma 'bur shing zlum pa za ri ba/—254—

rno ba 'bring / 'phyang ba tha ma'o/ /ol mdud dang snying sbu 'dug na gsang thub par yod/ bha ga yang sbu med pa dang / sbu nag po mthug po dang / ser kham gsum rab 'bring tha ma'o/ /bha ga phyi dkar nang dmar ba dang smug pa dang / sngo ba rnams spyir sha mdog dkar ba gzhir bzhag pa la rab 'bring tha ma ste/ lce dang snying las bha ga'i kha dog dang / mchan khung gi sbu las de'i sbu brtag dgos te/ de dang de dag mtshungs par 'ong ngo / /zhes kun du bzang mos gsungs so/ /dgug pa ni bu mo de'i chu rdul gyi sa la gzugs brnyan bya/ snying gar gi haX dang pad+ma rak+ta'i ming rus bris pa'i shog dril gzhug /dgug gzhug bya/ zangs kyi ling ga'i khab kyi bha ga 'tshag cing / a ha ra ni sa/ rnye mo/ khug rnam shes brang brang dung dung bdag gi dbang du bsdus a ha ri ni sa/ zhes zhag bdun bzlas/ sngags de bzlas pa'i bza' btung byin na dbang du 'dus so/ /yang mkha' 'gro su kha sirnyis gnyan ston la dngos su gnang ba'i dgug pa zab mo ni/rdzas sbal pa'i nang du ming rus bris la gzhug yungs dkar bdun nang du gzhug bdun sbal pa'i khog tu bcug /rang phag mo'i thugs ka nas pho nya mo dmar mo mang po spros khams gsum dbang du bsdus par bsam la ngag bcad de/ swahā bhas sha khol tsag tsag dung dung 'dur yed yed rnye mo/ /tsit+ta dkrug bdag gi dbang du gyur cig /ces sems ma yengs par rab theg gcig /'bring gnyis/tha ma gsum na rmi lam du bud med 'du ba/ khrom 'tshogs pa/ gter rnyed pa sogs 'byung ngo / /las sbyor ni nyi ma dmar thag chod ba na rdzas la sngags stong tsam zlas/ rab phyes nyung dkar gtor ba/ 'bring sha la slan pa tsam dang / tha —255—

ma'ang sbal bas lus la theb na the tshom med/ lus 'khyor ba dang/ sems ri ṣeganas pa yong nyen yod/ de la 'dod pa spyad pas sel/ dgrol bar 'dod na/gangs chu grang mo lus la rgyab/ sngags mgo mjug zlog /sbal ba bar 5gaming rus spos chus khrus byas pas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rtsa 'tshol ba ni/ spyi bor/ gla rtsi/ tsan+dan dkar po/ til dmar gsum sres pa'i mnye/ sga shing shegang du mkhal snol dang shing leb dang / ske rags bsdam/ bshang lam du 'be lto 'phyang bu bcug pa'i/ bha ga'i mkhur sha nu ma 'dra bar 'gro/ rtsa'i rtse mo zag ba rib 'ong / yang na bcos ma'i rdo rje'i phyi nas cig nang du skor ba'i rtsa yod rnga/ra 'phrad pa la 'khun zhing sngangs yod pa 'ong / rtsa sbom na pad+ma dkar po'i rtsa ba dgos te/ bod du mi rnyed pa'i ug chos me tog rtsa ba dang bcas pa ba dpo/ra mo'i 'o ma/ ka ra/ mar gsar/ gang sba lam/ da byid smug po'i tshil sbyar ba byug pa'am/ chang dang sbyar ba pad+ma ra blug pa'i phra bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya tshos kyi khu ba chu rtsa'i me la skol/ spang rgyan me tog btab pa btung pa dang / gnyer po ce mir gser gyi me rtsa byed pa/ bha ga chu lcag dang / 'phongs tshos la ber ka'i dal sdo/ra rdung ba sogs ni srid rgyun skem pa'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa can la brtan po sgom pa yin na/ 'khrul 'khor ra rnams las la sbyar ba'i skabs su dgos na'ang / da lta nas sbyang dgos pas thams cad la rlung khrab sngon du gtong nga shes par bya'o/ /'dzin pa la gsum gyi/ rnga) nga po klod pa ni/ lus sems khong klod/ srin zhal phan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho bcer ba sogs 'gyur ba bzhi'o/ /gsum pa sems kyi 'khrul 'khor te —256—

bde ba'i ngo bo la ltas nas klod pa'o/ /bzlog pa lnga'i dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje ji thal mo 'then la stong 'dren byas la sems nam mkha' 'phang langs te lan gsum skyed cing stod 'dren byed/ gnyis pa ni/ pus btsug rdo rje khu tshur mdun du bcug la hag hig hog ces/ snying ga/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su drang ngo / /gsum pa ni/ rtsal sprug gi mthar/ steng rlud phyir 'phang thur sel mthen/ skyil krung rdo rje khu tshur brla rgang la bcug ste rgang 'dren bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems dkyil stod skyil yang bcas nas smad kyi rlung khong 'dren dang stong 'dren bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ lag pa g.yon rkyang g.yas dpung bar khu tshur bcing / rkang pa rta la g.yon zhon byed tshul gyi g.yon nas rgang 'then bya/ de nyid go bzlog re'ang bya'o/ /dgrams pa la dgu las/ dang po ni/ langs te slar bsdad thal mo rtsegs/ lag pa brkyang mgo bo la thal lcags re mos su rdeg pa dang 'phags cing lag pa'ang sprug go /gnyis pa ni/ dgur la rkang lag re mos su 'khrab bo/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil krung lag gnyis dpung 'dzin pho khar snol/ bzhi sprug byas nas mchan khung rdeb cing 'phags pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung dang rdo rje khu tshur mkhal ma'i thad du btsug la pho ba skor/ gsang kha lcog cing g.yas 'then g.yon 'then bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ lang la lag gnyis sprug drug pa ni/ cung zad rgan rkyal sug bzhi phu ba'o/ /bdun pa ni/ sug bzhi btsug la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bteg cing 'then no/ /brgyad pa ni/ gdung sna sogs la 'jug te brkyang skum bya'o/ /dgu pa ni/ gan rkyal dang kha bub rung sus/ bzhi phyogs bzhir brkyang nas bcud la bor ro/ /de dag las 'dren kun —257—

la smad sgrim stod klod rgya mtsho bcer ba sogs ga pa 'grub dgos/ 'grem/rme —kun la kha sbyor lus lhod cing 'chun dang ldan pa dgos/ kun khyab tu seng ge rnam rol yang bya'o/ /de dag la sdom 'di skad ces bya ste/ /klod dang 'gyur rnga/zhi gzhom pa ste/ /'dzin pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /rdo rje thal mo khu tshur ji a btsug dang / /rtsal sprug khong 'dren rta zhon tshul/ /'dren pas 'khrul 'khor skru/ ma lnga'o/ /dgram pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam dgu ni/ /dang po mgo lcog 'phar sprug bya/ /gnyis pa rkang lag re mos 'khrab/ /gsum pa dpung 'dzin bzhi ji ga rdeb/ /bzhi pa mkha' mnan pho ba skor/ /lnga drug lag sprug gan rkyal 'khrab/ /bdun pa sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then/ /brgyad dgu brkyang skum gan rkyal rgyangs/ /'di dag mkha' 'gro gsum gyi man ngag gung spros pa yin no/ /gsus pa ni/ dbab bzung zlog dgram rlung dang bsre ba/ ye shes chen por sre ba'o/ /de dag kyang su kha sirnyi 'dod yon lnga la rim slob mi bzhed/ ga ṅga rda ras/ ro la bslab pa nas reg bya spyi dang rdo rje pad+ma ra reg pa yan chad sdom pa la thun gcig tu mdzad pa yin/ kun du bzang mo ni/ glu snyan pa dang / gzugs la lta ba dpa /ku re byed pa dang / lus kyi rtsed mo dang / lag bcing dang / 'o dang / 'byud nga/nga so dang sen mos 'debs pa dang / bde reg byed pa dang / phyi rol drud pa ste drug /phyis reg bya la bslab pa dang / snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ chags snre de bdun du bgo do/ /de la rdo rje pad+ma ra cung zad gsor zhing / nor bu hūṃ nag po mgo gyen bstan gyis bkag par bsam/ 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa'i 'dzin pa yin/ zin dka' na hūṃ gi phul nas thig le ba thag lta bu spyi bor lhan —258—

lhan thim par bsam la/ hūX 'dren drag tu bya'o/ /de nas lus kun sprug cing glang bzhi 'phang ba dang brkyang bskum bya'o/ /yang dang por dal bu dang mthar drag tu srub pa'i rang dang rig ma gnyis ka'i thig le zhu bar byas/ de nas mi srub par rgya mtsho sbyar te hū ཾ ༷ 'dren drag po byas la bu mo 'od du zhu nas rdo rjes drangs te rang lus khyab pa'i mdangs rgyas par mos/ de'i shes rab mas pad+ma ra grags sing ba dang khyur khyur drang ba'i nyams dang / bde ba zug dang bcas pa mi bzod pa byung na 'dren thub pa'i rtags so/ /su kha'i lugs so/ /yang sha chen dug phyung ba ba dmar mo'i 'o mar btsos/ shing kun dang kha ru tshwa btab pa bsten mchil pa'i sha dang / da byid kyang btang / lug sha dang / chang 'jam po zung te brten/ ra mo sha'i khan+da dang / zho ma skrog pa bza' ba'i bdag dang rig ma gnyis ka'i lus zung skyed/ rtsa ring na rkang pa brkyang / thung na rig ma'i rkang pa 'phrag par bkal nas skal la spyod/ pad+ma'i nang gi g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu rdo rjes drud pa'i rtsa btsal/ rig ma'i kyang 'og rlung bskum steng rlung gnon pa'i rtsa ster bar bya/ thig le 'byung ba snyam byed na 'phongs bsgrad/ mig gyen du blta/ shes rab ma'i sked pa nyags btang la rlung gsang gnas su phul bas zin yod la/de nas drang / yang bde ba yal du mi 'jug par bskyod cing 'beb 'phongs bde ba'i sgrad nas 'byed mi thub na/ lag pas dbye'o/ /ga ṅga rda ra'i lugs so/ /phal cher de dang 'dra ba la mig gyen du gtad/ pus mo la lag pa bkab/huX ring gi mthar hig gi 'dren yun ring sbyangs nas/ lcam pa'i rkang 'jam po rdo rje'i bu gar cung zad 'jug cing mthar rtsa bar lhan gyi gtong ngo / /de nas de —259—

'dren pa la bslab/ de nas mdun mnan te de go he 'phongs 'byed 'dzum gyi dbyung ba la bslab/ de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug /'dzin pa la sems kyi thim bu ste 'khrul 'khor gsum pa dang rting bas dra ba dang / brdegs pa'i gnon pa kho7 na yin no/ /kun tu bzang mo'i lugs so/ /de nas thams cad la yang rus ྅/la 'gros kyis phab/ so so'i man ngag gis phyag rgya la sbyor bzhin pa'i ngang zu/ sa bzung klog gang 'grub bya/ de nas 'dren lnga dang 'grem dgu po de rnams ci rigs pa bya/ thams cad la seng ge rnam rol gang mang bya ste/ zlog pa dang 'u mob par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa can gang mang bsgom te rlung dang bsre'o/ /ye shes chen por skyel ba ni sgyu lus sbas don dang 'dra'o/ /ma rgyud spyi'i rdzogs lnga / ma mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gsang lam bshad zin to/ /'di la gzhung shing yig rnying kho na las phyis yi ge gsar pa'i bsre nā/da med cing / phyis kyi yi ge 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa dang nyer gcig zer ba gnyis gda' na'ang / gzhan nas rkus shing khungs med la/ phyi ma rnams 'di yang ni gu'i gsang khrid yin zer ba ches 'khrul lo/ /'di la yig rnying yig chung sdog yod do/ khri/ shubhaX/ /༈gsum pa ni mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i las rgyas man ngag ni/ bde ba bzung ba dang / bde ba skyed pa dang / bde ba sbyang ba dang / bde ba gnas nga/'i thabs so/ /dang po ni/ gtum mo dang phyag chen la gom par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la mthar skyes kyi grong du zhugs te mtshan ldan gyi rig ma btsal ba da:pa /'gyur ba bco lnga'i rlung la rab tu gom pa dang / spyor ba la mkhas pa'i rab tu —260—

gom pa dang / sku bzhi'i bde ba skyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rigs dang mthun pa dang / rtsa dang ldan pa dman pa'i rig ma'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar sham mo rdo rje'i rigs/ ser skya mo rin chen rigs/ dmar smug mo pad+ma'i rigs/ sme ba can ma las kyi rigs/ sngo sangs ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /gnyis pa ni/dung can ma rtsa rtsegs pa'i rtse mo lta bu/ pad+ma can mkhal ma bzhib pa lta bu/ glang sna can thung zhing gug pa/ li ri can thag bcus kyi rtse mo lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs gsum spang / dmangs rigs nga rgyal chung ba'i shes pa'i yul du phan 'dogs che ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'gyur ba bco lnga ni/ 'dug stangs lnga/ skad lnga/ dmigs pa btod pa lnga'o/ /de dag la 'dug stang dang skad dang dmigs pa re re sbrags te sgom dgos pa'i/ dang po ni/ gcer bu'i 'dug stangs / tsog bur 'dug nas lag pa brang la snol/ sgra glang chen haX skad kyis 'dren/ dmigs pa lte bar btod/ dang po'o/ /gyad stobs po che'i 'dug stangs/ rkang pa'i rting pa 'og sgor gtad lag pa dang pus mo sa la btsugs/seng ge'i ngur skad khyung khyung phaṭa kyis sgras drangs/ sems snying khar btod/gnyis so/ /drang srong bstan ma'i 'dug stangs/ rdor dkyil lag mgo 'phongs tshos kyis mnan hig 'dren/ mgrin par sems gtod gsum pa'o/ /rigs ngan gyi 'dug stangs/ tsog bu pus 'phyud dang / gcan gzan snom skad sna nas 'bud/ smin mtshams su sems btod bzhi pa'o/ /sgegs po 'gyur ba'i 'dug stangs langs te yang rkang ngar sa la btsug khu tshur mchan khung du bcug /wa skad 'don pa lta bu wa mo'i bzhad sgra kha nas 'don/ spyi bor sems gtod —261—

do/ /gsum pa sbyor ba la mkhas pa las/ gdan dings (gding pa ni dngul lam gzha' tshe'i rigs kyi snod phug ron gyi sgong nga tsam sgong gzugs ma kha dang ldan pa/ khab shul tsam gyi bu ga mang po nang du cung za'i phye hros dang ba'i 'o 1skol blug pa'i rnam lnga'i kha bcad de la'ang khab shul gsum btod/ thag pa btaka de sked pa la gdag la de nyid 'phongs su chud tsam bya'o/ /sku 'dren pa ni ba'i/ gyi bgang rdur gyi 'be lto phyag rgya'i skur bcug /chus 'chang ba'i bcing ba ni 8 kyi ma dang mchan khung bsdam pa'o/ /rgyab yol bre ba ni/ ras 'bol dkyus la ma1sbo do zheng du mtho gang yod pa sked pa'i 'og tu 'jug pa'o/ gdugs 'bug pa ni ras de tsam zhig 'jing 'og tu 'jug pa'o/ /rtsa gso ba na rig ma la 'jam 4skal btang / de rjes ba'i 'o ma sum cha tsam skams skams su bskol bar byas la/gur gum a kar nag po/ li shi gsum btags la btab de btang / ra rngon chu ser bton pa sogs tshad brten du 'jug go /de ni rgya gar gyi dbang du bya tha sdo pa ste/ bod yul gyi zas spyod dang bstun dgos so/ /rtsa blang ba ni bur dkar dang bdud rtsi sres la snyug sbugs bkang / rtse mo rtsa la rags tshod btang te bha gar blugs pa'o/ /rtsa mthu skyed pa ni chags spyod sna tshogs kyi g.ya' blang ba'i 'khrang por byed pa chang gar ma/ phul gang tsam blang ba'i ngo bzi tsam byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa rgyu bzhi'i bde ba skyed pa ni/ rtsa dang sprad pa te dung can ma yin na rdo rje pad+ma'i gting phyin par 'bur/ pad+ma can ma la bshang lam phyogs nas rdar te pad+ma ra bcug /pad+ma'i nang rdo rje krug nas gting las sor gnyis tsam tshur 'the'u ni pa btsal/ dung can ma la rgyab 'phong phyogs la bzhan nas bcug /li ri ca zu/ la ri'i —262sgro

steng te bya lce'i 'og tu drud do/ /des rtsa dang 'phrad 'ong / spyir rigs bco lnga yod kyang rtsa spro ba bzhi las med gsung /gsum pa bde ba sbyang ba gsum ste/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob dang /shes pa gsal btab pa'o/ /dang po la dbab pa dang zlog pa dang / dkyil ba dang / spar pa ba'o/ /dang po la ting nge 'dzin dang / 'dug stangs dang / rdo rje cung zad skyod pa'i dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni bha ga'i nang gi dbus nas 'od dmar po byung / nor bur zhugs dbu ma'i lam rgyud spyi gtsug gi thig le zhu gsang ba'i bar du phyin par bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shes rab ma la lhag por ras 'bol dpangs sor bzhi rgya mtho gang btang / bu mo'i rkang pa thabs kyis brla steng nas btang rgyab tu 'phyud ldem bya/ dpa' bo rkang ba pa dgra med bskyang ba'o//gsum pa ni/ rus sbal 'gros so/ /gnyis pa zlog pa ni gsum ste/ rlung dmigs kyi zlog /lus cha sgrims pa'i zlog /rig ma'i rlung gi zlog go /dang po ni 'gyur ba bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la go bar zad la/ gsum pa ni/ rig ma'i rlung gsang bar sdig pa'o/ /rtsa rnyed na hūX dgur 'gyur lan drug gis mar cha drang la dkyil ba dang gnas thabs bya'o/ /gsum pa dkyil ba ni 'gyur ba bco lnga'i sgra skad rnam gsum btud pa'o/ /bzhi pa/ spar ba ni ro rtsa ba'i kha zas bza' bud med mdzes ma la lta ba dang / rgod pa dang / 'byud pa dang / 'khrigs thabs byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes thob ni dpa' bo'i yul gyi zhen pa zlog la sgom pa bya ba/ 'dod yon bzang po la ma chags par rol ba'o/ /chags pa'i yid kyi lta ba'i sgom bya ba/ bud med thams cad la 'dod chags skyes te —263—

dbyings su bsre ba'o/ /snang ba thug phrad du sgom pa bya ba thams cad la bde ba 1 sarde'adebs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mnyam rjes khyad med par stong pa dang bde bas rgyas btang pa'o/ /bzhi pa/ bde ba gnas pa'i thabs ni/ bum can dang phyag chen dang rnam rol bsre ba'o/ /yang yig rnying gcig na sbyang ba dang / dkyi95 ba la bcas pa lus kyi gnad dmigs pa'i gnad rlung gi gnad de gsum tshang dgos zhes pa yod de/ 'gyur lnga gsum bco lnga nyid do/ /dgyes mdzad/ 'dus pa/ bde mchog gsum gyi man ngag mnga' bdag mai tri ba'i gsang lam bshad zin to/ /dge'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ mi tri ba'i slob ma'ang yin mod/ gdam ngag gzhan mang pos thugs rgyud 'chug pa mi mnyam rdo rje'i khol po zhes pa'am/ a tu la dwa sa badz+ra gyi chags lam 'di la mnyam par sbyor ba'i yul dang / snyoms 'jug dngos so/ /dang po ni/ gzhan brtag thabs spyi da/nga mthun/ pad+ma brgya byin gyi mig 'dra ba rdo rje'i rigs/ shin du yang ba rin chen rigs 'di gnyis rlan cher 'bab pa'o/ /ran zhing drod che ba rnam snang gi rigs/ shin du dam pa pad+ma'i ri kas/pad+ma chags pa'i rlung gi sgra 'byung ba las kyis rigs so/ /rim pa'i bya lce yang khro bo'i sna ltar rtog por 'gril ba dang / srab cing che ba dang / srab cing myad ba dang / sdigs mdzub ltar sgreng ba dang / sna rtse ltar rno ba'o/ /yang rim pa ltar rnam 'gyur gyi dbang du byas na/ rig ma'i thabs la 'o 'khyud so sen 'debs sogs rang shugs su 'chor ba dang / spyod lam btang snyoms su 'dug pa lhanang /gzhan mi 'byung bar dam du 'khyud cing yar 'degs kyi sgul skyod sna tshogs byed —264—

pa dang / reg pa mi bzod cing / pad+ma 'dzum sdeb 'byung la rgod pa dang / sngangs shing mkhun che chung 'don la gtam tshig mi go bar smra ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ dbab/ dkyil/ zlog drangs gnas su skyal lus la dgram yan lag la spro ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rig ma la dal bu'i srub cing / sbyor ba dang rig ma la mi bsam/ shes pa dbyings su gtad la yengs su gzhug /gnyis pa ni/ des thig le rdo rje'i rtsa bar bab/ bde ba rgyas/ thig le 'chor tshad pa la ma shor ba'i skabs der/ mig gyen la zlog /'og sgo sdams/ rgya mtsho bcir/ nya bzhi sgrim lag pa'i sor mo gsum 'jib/ dbugs rngub ste bsdams rlung sems snying khar bsdus la bzhag /'di skabs skyod 'phro bcad la rdo rje pad+ma g.yo 'gul med par bzhag /de 'dra dbugs thengs gsum btud la bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas kyang rdo rje pad+ma ma phral ba nyid du sbyor ba drug pa gzhan dang 'dra ba la/ hal zhes pa'i hi ri ri zhes 'dren/ de'i bde ba yal la khad song ba na/ yang dbab skya snyel zlog pa sogs gong bzhin sbyang / de ltar lan gsum bzhi bya/ bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje pad+ma phral te/ de 'phral sbyor ba drug pa huX sgra dwangs ba'i lan gsum brgyud mar drag tu drangs/ dmigs pa rtsa dbu ma rnyog sbu tsam gyi nang na yar thig le skya chil li li song / spyi bo'i haX la sib sdib thim par bsam mo/ /'di skabs huX dang hig dang khrir sogs rang gang mos yin la/thams cad byas kyang yong / de gsum kar sna nas 'bud pa gtso che gsung ngo / /hūX la nges par kha sdam par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni lnga ste/ dang po thig le sgra can dang 'dra ba la aX zhes drangs pas/ gsang ba nas lte bar sleb par bsam/ /—265—

༈ gnyis pa tsog pu pus brang sbyar/ lagasor gru mor 'jus/ lagang ra pus mor 'phyud la sgom thag gi phyag rgya bcas/ rlung nang du drangs/ 'og 9ri then pa dang gre bar ngur ngur gyi sgra lte ba nas snying khar sleb par bsam/ gsu 5 pa dkyil krung rdo rje khu tshur lte khung gnyis su btsug /stod sgur la hag ha ka ces drangs pa'i snying ka nas mgrin par sleb par bsam/ bzhi pa skyil krung 'e rdo rje thal mo kha bub rla g.yas g.yon gyi steng nas gnon zhing 'dren pas hi hig ces mgrin pa nas spyi bor sleb par bsam/ lnga pa dkyil krung lus srang rdo rje khu tshur mchan khung g.yas g.yon du bcug /dbugs rngub pa sgra gdangs 'og rlung 9 ri then brang skyed mgrin pa dgug pa'i spyi bo nas gtsug tor tu drangs bar bsam mo/ /༈ drug pa ni/ seng ge rnam rol/ ༈ bdun pa ni/ lang la mgo dang rkang lag lan gsum sprug ldan nas kyang de bzhin dang / gan rkyal las kya nga de bzhin bya'o/ /las rgya'i gdams ngag bod du 'gyur ba gcig la 'di las zab pa med ces grags la grub thob zhing chos sang nas brgyud pa yin no/ khri/ba chen mi mnyam rdo rje'i man ngag las rgya'i spyor ba bshad zin to/ /ka phywa ṇa bi su ‘spe/༈ lnga pa ni/ slob dpon ra hu la las rlung la bum pa can dang rlud 9khor lo bcing grol dang / phyag rgya 'ching grol zhes pa rnams rang lus kyi gdams pa kho na yin pas/ 'dir mi 'chad la/ 'dir shing rta can bshad par bya'o/ /'di rlung bzung ba dang / sgom pa dang / bogs dbyung ba gsum mo/ /dang rje rdzo/ ni/dben par dkon mchog mchod pa dang / smon lam btab/ bdud rtsi lnga re chu tshan dang / ba'i 'o ma skol bas ba byung lnga dang bza' ba bdud rtsi lnga sres ba'i —266—

khrus bya/ a ru ra/ 'o mar btsos pa mur ci bder 'dug pa zhag lnga'am/ bdun bya/ khri'u khru do ba brnyan po gnyis gzhu snyi ba gnyis chang bzung mar bstan la g.yas g.yon du bcing / dbus kyi steng du shing gcig gnyis gsum gang 'os btang la bcing / rje btsun ma dang mgon po gtso bor gyur pa dang mkha' 'gro lnga la gtor ma bzang du phul/ tshogs mchod rgyas par bya/ nang gtor ma bsdus pas skabs su slob ma shing rta la skyon/ rkang pa'i phrang ba'i gzhu'i chang zung nam tsam bya/ lag gnyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar la rkyang / lus khong stong gi dkyil gyi dbu ma nas sems thig le 'u ru ru thon tshangs bug rgyud/ mkha' dbyings mthon por thig le la sems gtad/ rkang pa brkyang te 'og sgo bsdam du bcug /bla ma dang grogs kyi rol mo'i sgra bya/ gu gul bdug /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la gsol ba drag tu btab/ yang yang gzhu rgyud skul lo/ /de 'dra lan mang du byas pas 'og gi rlung zin par 'gyur ro/ /yang tsog pu bya rog 'dug stangs la/rkang mtheb la gzhu rgyud rig ge bya/ rlud gi 'degs par bsam/ 'og rlud sdams/ rol mo sogs gong bzhin bya'o/ /'dis steng rlung zin par 'gyur ro/ /de yang rlud tshes gcig gi snga dro/ me rlung gnam stong gi srod/ cha mnyam nyer gnyis kyi nyin phyed la/ rlung chen po tshes brgyad tho rangs 'dzin te/ tsha shas che ba dang / grang shas che ba dang / bad kan can dang / rlung lhag par che ba rnams la rim pas shes so/ /'di skabs 'phar g.yo brgyal ba sogs byung na rlung zin zhing tshud pa yin la/ bla ma'i grogs kyi rtag tu lta ba gal che'o/ /thal nyen byung na sbyor ba klod/ thun mtshams su dbu ma'i nang smin mtshams su haX dkar po/ rdo —267—

rje'i rtser aX dmar po/ hro kha sbyor drag po sgom/ rdo par bde shas chen 'og klod stong shas che na steng klod/ mnyam na zung du 'jug par mnan no/ /dhu tir shernga5 pa yar 'gro mar 'gro byas la lta res bya'o/ /'phar g.yo ku co rgyal ba sogs/ches na rlung gi dug dbyung ba bya sna rtser khab tsag byas khrag dbyung ba sogs bya'o/ /spyi gtsug dang snying kar bdud rtsi lnga dang mi tshil byug lus g.yer ma dang sran phye'i mnyes/ chu skol la tang 'khun pa'i phye ba btab pa btung pa'i khyab byed log pa sel/ 'bru mar dang g.yer ma tshigs par byug la/ rkang 'og gi patre la sems gtad/ de dag gi snyo pa dang / khyab byed log pa dang / sha lpags bar du zhugs pa dang / rtsub mo'i sbyor ba zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la/ sbya skyur ba/spel ba/ dbang du bya'o/ /dang po/ dbugs 'greng ba la dmigs skor ba/cigagasang 'dus dang mthun pa'i rdor bzlas la dmigs skor gcig steng rlung 'og rlung 'then pa la dmigs skor re re/ kha sbyor gnon pa la dmigs skor ba/cigartsa gsum lte bar srad bu ltar dpyang pa la g.yas su e dmar g.yon dkyi waX dkar babs 'og rlung 'then pas e waX dbu mar zhugs/ spyi gtsug tu drang:sa so lus bde ba dang / yang ba dang / zo mdog pa de ba 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba'i don dang / yi ge'i don dang / de kho na nyi’ne kyi don dang / phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad sems dpa' sum brtseg tu ye nas gnas/ rang sems 'od dkar po sran rdog tsam 'og sgo nas dhu ti nang la 'u ru ru thon/ nyi zla thug par 'a1 trong /nam mkha' ltar rgya skyed pa ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sems mkha' khyarnga ba la —268—

sems gtad/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe mar bab ste 'og sgor sleb par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ lte ba nas 'bru gsum sbor ba ste gzhan de dang 'dra/ gsum pa ni/lte ba nas rim pa'i stong par gtong ba la sems gtod tshul gyi spro bsdu gong dang 'dra/ bzhi pa ni/ don dam pa'i lha sngags gnyug/ ma'i gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /bzhi ka la thun 'jig khar sems can thams cad sems dpa' sum brtseg tu gsal bas huX gi mthar sngags kyi skor bar bsgom mo/ /thams cad la mda' ltar 'phang ba dang / nam mkha' ltar rgya skyed pa 'dra'o/ /gsum pa dbang du bya ba ni/ lte bar 'khor lo drag tu skor zhing rgya skyed pa dang /gser gyi 'khor lo 'og sgo nas dhu tir brgyud spyi bo nas mthon mkha' dbyings mthon por 'gro zhing slar 'ong bar sgom/ gsum pa bogs dbyung ba la/ rgyas btab pa dang / zung du 'jug pa'o/ /dang po bde ba ro mnyam pa ni/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan khrus bya/ lus zung skyed rlud la slabs/ gur gum gyis byug /dbul chu dug bton pa thigs pa gnyis gsum bha gar byug /chang gar ma cung zad 'thung du bcug rang gi pang du tsog pur gnas pa'i pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khyud rdo rje pad+ma ra bcug rig ma rlung 'jam por gnon du bcug /dal bus srub/thig le rdo rjer son pa na/ 'gron bu'i rgyal po'i sbyor ba dang / rang gi 'og sgo sdams steng mnan/ bu mo'i steng rlung mnan 'og rlung gsang bar klod pa'i bde ba bzung zhing ye shes ngos bzung ngo / /de nas hūX dgur sbyor gyis drangs te /gsang ba nas yar spags pa tsam mam/ lte bar gtad la/ hring 'dren dang /snying kar gtad la gi zhi ṣa dang / mgrin par gtad la hig /ces stag mo skyug —269—

tshul dang / smin mtshams su gtad la rngub cing seng ge'i ngur sdang dang/ sgrordegatsug tu gtang rlung skor ba gsum gyi rtsa gsum spyi gtsug tu thim par bsam pa ste/ phyi ma gsum dgang 'dren yin no/ /'gram pa spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bde ba'i shes pa des snang grag la rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /gnyis pa zung du 'jug pa ni/ stong par ro snyoms pa ste/ de la dang po tshig drug dang steng sgo bcad pa ni/ rtsa gsum thig gu lta bu las rdo rje rtse po/cig hūX gis mtshan pa mda' ltar 'phang ba sogs byed/ 'di skabs su sku 4/nyes bya'o/ /snang grags la stong pa'i rgyas btang te dbyings su skyol/ gnyis pa dbu mar 'dzud pa ni/ rdor dkyil rdo rje bsdom pa gsang bar brkyang sprug cing lus sgrim mig 'byed 'dzum cung zad spel bsus pa 'gyur bya/ rtsa gsum ‘5 waX dkar haX sngo i dmar ba'i mtshan pa/ rlud mnan pas rtsa gsum 'dus skyon dor sleb/ 'og rlung sdams/ rdo rje sdams pa kha thur sub/ mig bzlog ste/ huX zhes drangs/ yig ge gsum/ spyi bor drangs yang yi ge rnams yar 'gro mar 'gro bya'o/ /sems rtags lnga yon tan brgyad 'byung ngo / /yang de thams cad kyi nyams snang grags rgyas btab/ bdag med ma'i nang khrid rdzogs rim dang ri / de yang zung 'jug tu bya'o/ /bar yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ khrub thob ra hu la'i gdam pa las rgya dang 'brel ba bshad zin to/ /gzhan yang ra hu la'i rlung phyogs gzhan rnams dang / su kha'i skor gyi lte ba sprul 'khor gyi rdzogs rim dang / bdag med ma'i nang khrid kyi rdzogs rim dang / phyis gnyen ston chen po las byung ba'i 'chi med grub pa sogs kyang —270—

legs par 'byor na/ gzhan lus kyi rdzogs rim la thogs pa med pa'i mthu thob par 'gyur ro/ shangs chos kyi man ngag dar yang bde ba lam byed kyis 'di rnams deng sang phal cher la dkon zhing / ra hu la'i man ngag gi dpe rnams cung zad mod kyang lag len phyogs mgo tsam yang ma theng ba shas che zhing / lhag ma rnams dpe yang cung zad dkon/ ni gu'i gsang lam la lag len cung zad yod mod kyang / bsre slad byas pa dang / khungs med sbyor ba sogs snang bas/ de dag la phan pa'i phyir yi ge rigs chig chog rgyal po 'di byas pa yin no/ /rab zab lam 'di bshad pas kyang / /'gro kun bde chen sku 'grub ste/ /zag med bde ba cher rgyas pa'i/ /mchod sprin rgyun mi 'chad par shog/ //ces shangs pa bka' brgyud kyis man ngag chags lam 'khrid tshul rim pa lnga yod pa rnga༅ gcig tu sgrigs pa ste/ thabs lam gser gyi phung po zhes bya ba 'di yang gtsang spyon kun dga' dpal bzang gis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laX bi stu ra ku sa zhus dag /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /

'bras bu'i rgyan yod pa rig ma gnyis kyang rgyan gtso bo de 'dra ba'i rigs yin pas/ rgas 'khogs pa'i rnam pa mi bya'o/ /(nas ra na pa ni sku pho/ dkar ba tshangs skud can/ mda' srong ba grub pa'i slob dpon rgas pa med pa de 'dra ba'i rigs la/ rgas 'khogs pa'i rnam pa bya'o/ /9) 'di pa lwa ni dur khrod na bzhugs shing / mdun na keng rus nyal ba/ rgyan med pa/ dbu skra co bregs sku mdog sngo sangs mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'o/ /()li na pa ni nya chen po'i khog pa gshag pa'i dbu nas thon pa'i tshul gyis zhabs gnyis ka'am gcig khog pa'i nang du chug tsam/ phyag gnyis gar mdzad pa'i tshul/ sku sha sngo sangs rgyan med cing skra 'dzings pa/ (mi kyi go rak+ṣa ni skra bregs pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam ba theg sku sha sngo sangs dkar ba snyan la mu dra nag po dang / mgul du rwa dung btags pa/sku lus gcer bu'am/ tsan+d+ra kan+ta zhes bya ba 'khor lo lta bu'i bem po gshegs su gsol ba/ mdun du ba lang gi khyu mtshon byed/ (na tso ra gi pa ni dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs chung du yod pa/ shing drung na gnas shing mnyam bzhag byed pa/logs gcig nas phar tshong bdag zhig gis tshong zog rnams/ sol bar song ba bris/ (skabi na sa ni dzan tar du grags pa skud pa gsum yod pa'i rgyud can brdung zhing / thod bcings pa sogs rgyal po'i rnam pa can bya/ (go shwarnyi pa ni dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta cung bgres pa'i na ma pa can paṇa zhwa gsol ba/ (spu tit+ta pa ni sma ra ring ba/ shin tu rgan po'i cha byad can/ khri thag 'thags pa/ lkon tsa ma ri pa ni lham bzo'i bya ba mdzad pa/ lkon ga rga pa ni ral pa'i thor tshugs can ral gri thogs nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ de'i nye bskor gcig na mchod rten —273—

gyi bu ga'i sgo nas sprul chen po zhig lus phyed tsamathon pa 'bri/ mchod rten sdimo nang nas sprin sprin tshogs kyi sku rib tsam mngon pa bris na legs/ lkona'aphags pa klu sgrub ni yongs su grags pa bzhin nam/ yang na sku sha sngo tha sdongs shin tu mtshar ba lta bu la gtsug tor med pa/ dge slong gi cha byad sbrul 9rdo go'i gdengs ka can du byas na don dang mthun zhing / ci ste mtshan dpe can gyi sku la mos na ni/ de 'ja' lus kyi sku yin pa'i/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha byad du byas na legs par mngon no/ /(spu nag po spyod pa ni sku sha sngo tha sdongs phyag na ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa nam mkha' gdugs rnga bdun bdun rang 'khor dang / ḍā ma ru bdun 'brol srin mo ro langs ma la chibs pa/ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gam stag lpags kyi smad nga/kris sogs ci ltar rigs pa 'bri'o/ /(go ar+ya de wa ni dge slong shing kaṇ+ḍa'i slob ma ste/ shing lo chen po zhig phyag na bsnams pa/ (na tha ga pa ni g.yas spru/yon phan tshun du nags tshal dang / grong khyer re re 'bri zhing / shing sdong gcig phyed bsnyes su bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du dge slong zhig 'greng nas gtam spre 1 ba/lkon nā ro pa ni ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus rgyan can/ mi pags gso pa ba/mi lpags kyi rkang lag gnyis nas phyag gis bzung nas zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i gar stabs mdzad pa/ lko ska bi ra lwa pa ni rnal 'byore pa ce spyang gi ro phrag par bkal ba/ lko)tsan+d+ra tai lo pa ni sku sha sngo na gtil brdung ba'i rnam pa can/ mdun du rig mas snod gcig nas til blug pa ci / rnam pa can/ lkogo tsan+t+ra pa ni pu ti rgyab du khur zhing pod chung zhig lag tu thogs pa/—274—

rab byung gi cha byad can no/ /9pe bha tra pa ne phag sha dang chang bum mdun du bzhugs pa/ tshangs skud can/ skra shad bcings pa'i thor cog can/ rgyan sogs rin po che'i rgyan cung zad yod pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs brag stegs lta bu'i mtho ba na/ bla ma rnal 'byor pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can gcig bzhugs pa'o/ /lkogo ru mkha' ru pa ni phyag dar khrod kyi gos lhan hrul po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas tshom bu mdzad pa/ lkon dzo ki pa ni dur khrod gcig tu 'phred nyal mdzad pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad yod pa/ lkon ka la kā pa ni ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad tsam dang gzugs mdzes pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ dur khrod na gnas pa'o/ /lkogo hu li pa ni gzhong pa rnams su gos rnying pa 'khrud pa'i rnam pa can no/ /lkon kaX ka na pa ni rgyal po'i rnam pa can/ rang gi lag gdub la blta zhing 'dug pa la/ nam mkha' na lha dang lha mos mchod pa 'bul ba/ lkon koX pa la pa'i lwa ba pa ni sa la rang shong bzhin du sa brus pa'i kha mtshams nas mi mgo skam pos bskor ba'i dbus na gzims pa'am yang na brag phug na gzim pa mnyam bzhag mdzad pa byas kyang drang / dge slong gi cha byad can no/ /lko ska khermi pa ni snod gcig tu 'bras blugs nas/ gtun shing gis 'bras bu sbru zhing chu la 'khrud pa'i rnam pa can/ phyogs gcig na myong tshong ma zhig yod pa bri/ (3go ban+ta sa ni rgyal po'i rnam pa can zhig nam mkha' la dge slong lhung bzed zhabar bsil thogs pa 'gro ba la blta zhing / mdun nas lha'i bzo bos gtam smra ba/ lkogo ti na pā ni sho rtse ba zhig 'bri/ sho brgyag pa gar lugs su byed/ 'ge ku ku ri pa ni rus pa'i rgyan dang thor tshugs can/—275—

bar du khyi mo yod pa 'bri/ lkon ku dzi pa ni mdun nas slob dpon klu sgrub ye de pa/ ltag par lba ba skyed pa'i rnal 'byor ba gcig 'bri/ den dha mu pa ni bram ze'i cha byad pu ti mang po dang bcas pa/ lkon ma hi la ni yan lag sbom zhing sha sul can gzhan la lus stobs 'gran pa'i tshul can no/ /(3sho aṇ+ḍi ‘ 4 ni nags na shing kha gcod cing shing khur 'khur nas 'gro ba/ lkon ba bhi rwa te ni rgyal po'i rnam pa g.yon phyogs nas btsun mos 'phyud pa/ dzan ni lo khye 4 ni pad+ma'i mtsho nas me tog pad+ma rtsa ba dang yan lag de gcod pa/ de ska bu su pe ku pa ni zhi ba lha ste mtha' dge 'dun gyis bskor ba'i khri steng nas nam mkha' la cung zad 'phags pa/ dge slong gi cha byad chos 'chad mdzad pa/ mdog dkaza ri la dmar ba'i sha nyams rgyas pa'o/ /phro)in+d+ra bhu ti ni rgyal po'i cha byad la bud med glu dang rol mo bro gar byed pa mang pos bskor ba'o/ /phro spu mi dgong spre5 ni ga bar ba 'chang zhing kha zas sna tshogs pa'i don du bkres pa'o/ /ṇa na to / tse pa ni dbu lwa thod bcings shing tog tses zhing tha rengs brkos pa'o/ /ṣe//kaX bha ri pa ni lcags mgar gyi las byed pa'i rnam pa can no/ /skon dza lan rja ste ri pa ni rnal 'byor ba ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus rgyan can/ zhabs phyogs gcig nas dpung pa la bkal ba/ phyogs gcig bzhengs pa'i pus btsugaphyag sor mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad/ gzhan rnams bsnol ba'i phyag rgya mdzad nas/ phyag rgya de mgo 'jug me tog gis spyi bor bcings pa phyogs gcig dzo nas rig mas brten pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ den ra hu la pa ni dur khrod du 'dug cing sku sha sngo sangs yid tsam bgres pa/ dbu skra bregs pa phyag gnyis ma‘nyam —276—

bzhag byas shing dur khrod kyi mi la lta ba zhig 'bri/ 'go dharma pa ni dge slong bgres po pu ti phyag na bsnams pa/ dzan dha ka na pa ni mdzo la'i nang du snod chen po zhig bcug nas slang mo slong ba'i tshul du bzhengs pa/ (na bed dha pa ni glang gnyis la gnya' shing btsug nas zhing rmo ba'i rnam pa can/ slo ska pad ka dza pa ni pad+ma'i rdzing bu'i 'gram nas spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang gcig yod pa la/dge slong gcig gi mchod pa 'bul ba/ kho rang bram ze gzhon nu'i cha byad can/'di'i lo rgyus ni spyan ras gzigs dang dbang phyug chen po nor ba'i lo rgyus yod pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar mor phyag g.yon na pad+ma g.yas de'i kha 'byed pa/ yum gyis g.yon nas 'byud pa/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du rtse gsum dang thod pa bzhag pa'o/ /lkon dril bu pa ni slob dpon nyid rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs rus rgyan stag lpags ral pa'i thor tshugs sogs yod pa/ sku lus mi sha kha'am sngo sangs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa la/ yum ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos sku mdog dmar po'am gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ de yang nam mkha' la 'phur stabs sam bde mchog lhan skyes bzhin g.yon bskum byas kyang rung ste/ nam mkha' la gshegs pa'i mtshon byed du sprin gseb tu bzhugs pa/ 'og gi phyogs nas mtsho lud pas grong khyer gyi phyed tsam pa khyer ba dang / mtsho'i dkyil na kha sar pā ṇa'i sku'i phyed tsam thon pa 'bri/ (sho dzo gi pa ni rnal 'byor pa gcer bu ga bar ba thogs shing yo byad rnams phrag rgyug gi rtse la bkyon nas phrag khur thogs pa zhig 'bri/ lkon tsa lu ka pa ni rnal 'byor pa gcig la gri sngas su btsug nas nyal ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'i gdan bting —277—

shing / mdun du bsnoms shing bskur ba/ (rnerberla gos can dbu skra co bregs/ snyi btsugs te bya shor ba'i rnam pa can/ lkon ( yu tsi ka pa ni bram ze'i rnam pa can la skra dang kha sbu 'jab tses btogs so zad zad gcig 'bri/ yon ni chu ṇi pa ni mal khri la rgyab bsnyes snyam nas zas za/ ba/mdun du rnal 'byor pa gcig yod pa 'bri/ (go dza yon to pa ni phyag na ting shag bsnams pa gtor ma sna tshogs gtong ba'i rnam pa can/ bya sna tshonas 'dus pa/ 'khor slob ma rdza rnga brdung ba dang / gling bu 'bud pa dang / sil snyan sgrogs pa dang / pi wang brdung ba sogs 'bri/ (na pa tsa ri pa ni shing drung gcig na rnal 'byor pa skra bregs pa/ na bza' ka tso ri bya ba mdoms dkri tha sdo gru gsum gcig las med pa/ snum khur phyed tsam za ba mdun du spyan ras gzigs de'i sprul pa dge slong gcig yod pa zhig 'bri/ (na tsa spa ka rnga/ ni rgyal po'i rnam pa can/ skyed mo tshal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa/ mtha' rnams shing nga ka ste yal ka rnams zlum por skyes pa/ lo ma ljang nag me tog ser skya / thod pa/ lte)bhi k+ṣa ṇa pa ni phyag ni gu ba'i snod bsnams pa de'i mdun du ma/spa' 'gro ma dmar po zhi ba'i rnam pa can skra grol ba/ rus rgyan yod pa chos ba‘ stan pa'i rnam pa can/ grub thob de rang gis so bton nas mkha' 'gro la 'bu'/ ba/9)khyu li pa ni mar nag gi snod mang po bshams te 'tshong ba'i tshul dang / kha zas sna tshogs bshams pa/ mdun du paṇ+ḍi ta gcig gi chos ston pa'i rnar/ pa can/ lte she nga ri pa ni rdza mkhan gyi rnam pa rdza bzo ba bud med dang bcas/ pa/lte ge tsa ru ṭi pa ni na bza' mi kha li gsol ba/ sel mi kha li ni rdzus ga zan —278—

'dra ba'i dkyil nas mgo 'don pa yod pa la mgo bton pa/ phyed phyed mdun rgyab kyi gos yin pa la ska rags bcings pa'o/ khreng drung gcig nas me btang zhing du ba 'thul ba/ phyogs gcig nas bcud len gyi snod yod pa/ mi rnams la bcud len de nas shing lo gcig gis 'thor tshul byed pa/ mdun du bud med gcig dang byis pa gcig thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i sngas su ma mong zla bo'i tshul gyi yod/ de'i ltag tsam na brag phug gcig nas dbus su lha gcig /g.yas su lha chung ba gcig /g.yon du lha mo gcig rnams gdan gcig la sum sgrigs su 'dug pa 'bri/ lte ) rnal 'byor ma ma ṇi bha ṭa bud med rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa nam mkha' la 'phur ba'i rnam pa/ 'og gi sa gzhi la chu bum chags pa gcig 'bri/ (7)rnal 'byor ma mi kha li ni gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can/mchan du kha ṭāX ga bcug pa/ skra grol ba zhal nas/ ral gri byung ba phyag g.yas pa'i 'dzin tshul/ phyag g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa zhig 'bri/ (67 a dha de)/lte go rnal 'byor ma ka na kha la adhe de dang 'dra ba las phyag g.yas na gri gug gam ral gri/ g.yon pas rang gi dbu bcad de bsnams pa 'bri ba yin pa la rang 'ga' zhig phal ba'i rnam rtog gis de 'dra 'bri ba mi spro na/ phag mo dbu bcad ma'i bris thang rnying pa 'ga' re la 'byung ba bzhin/ sku gzugs la yang dbu yod cing / phyag na yang dbu gcig bsnams pa bris kyang mi 'gal/ 'di gnyis kar nam mkha' la gar stabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du 'bri/ spyir rnal 'byor 'di gnyis mdzad pa 'dra ba byung bas bkod pa'ang 'dra rung bas chog go /lten ka la pa ni kha dog sngo nag dur khrod nas byas pa/ de'i mdun mtho ba nas —279—

rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan can zhig gis chos gsungs pa'i rnam pa can ga rig 'bri/ ṇa na kan+ta li yar gos mtshams byed pa'i rnam pa can la mdun dzo nas mkha' 'gro ma gcig gis chos ston pa'i rnam pa 'bri/ ṇa ska dha hu li pa :/ rtsa thag 'tshong ba'i rnam pa can 'bri/ ṇa na u ṭi li pa ni mgo la thod bci1pas shing lus la tso ma she gos phu rung can gyon pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thor tsam /rgod pa/ kha sbu bzang po can nam mkha' la blta ba/ nam mkha' la sprin kha dog sna lnga pa la/ glang po dang / rta dang / bya la sogs pa'i srog chags kyi rnam pa sna tshonas pa 'dra rung gi dbyibs can yod pa/ de dang nye bar ngang dang ngang mo ga tsho)sa 'phur ba/ de'i mdun du rnal 'byor pa shing lo thogs pa gcig yod pa 9rdo bri/ṇa na ka pā li pa ni kha dog nag po dur khrod nas bud med kyi ro zhig yod :pre 'i thod breg te phyag na bsnams pa/ lus la rus rgyan cha tshang yod pa'o/ /ṇa zhe5ki rat+na mo pa gi kha sbu bzang ba khro nyams can/ mgo la cod paṇa zhes bya gto ngeg dbus dang phyogs bzhi ste rtse mo lnga yod pa/ rin po che'i tog can skra mtshams la dpa' bo dar dpyangs zhes bya ba gser gyi 'khyud mo las rna ba'i ltag ga pa/sa g.yon nas mar la dar dpyangs 'phyang ba/ ral gri dang phub 'chang ba khri la gnas pa/ ṇa gos ka ri pa ni dge slong gi rnam pa can/ mdun nas 'phags/ pa spyan ras gzigs bzhengs pa gcig 'bri/ ṇa na sarba bha nywa pa ni mdun du sbrus da chen po gcig na zas bzang ngan sna tshogs blugs nas de za ba 'bri/ ṇa pe nā ga bho dhi ni dge slong gi rnam pa can mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ de'i phyogs ga3shāg gi brag phug zhig gi nang du rnal 'byor pa mgo la ri dwags kyi rwa skyes pa'i byu/ ma —280—

pa can 'bri/ ṇa go dwa ri ka pa ni rus rgyan can rdo rje dril bu brdung nas nam mkha' la 'phur te 'gro ba/ 'og phyogs kyi sa zhig la grong khyer nas mi rnams kyi slob dpon la blta ba dang / rdo ring gi rtse na rdo'i glang chen gcig yod pa 'bri/ṇa na pū ra li pa ni dgyes rdor thang kha bkram pa/ de'i mdun gyi phyogs nas rgyal po'i cha byad can gyis gtam smra ba 'bri/ lkon sa ra ha na pa nis lham yu bcad la gser kha sogs rgyan mang po btags pa gyon rgyug pa'i rnam pa can 'bri/ lko ska ko ki lī pa ni rgyal po'i rnam pa skyed mo'i tshal 'bras bu can gyi shing gis gang ba'i dbus na mang po yod pa/ gzhon nu ma mang po glu dang gar dang rlung g.yab dang khrus gsol ba'i rnam pa can/ shing rnams la bya ko ki lī ste khug nog mang po yod pa/ mdun du dge slong gcig dang gtam smra ba 'bri/ 'a spu a ni go sa ni rtswa khyim zhig na gnas pa'i gzugs mdzes pa gcig gi mdun du dge slong shin tu mtshar ba gcig gis bsod snyoms mdzad pa 'bri/ lkon rnal 'byor la 'i ka ra ni dur khrod na bzhugs pa skra grol ba/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ḍāX ga bsnams shing / yang na smyon thabs can 'bri ba'ang yod/ 9pe swa mu dra pa ni rgya mtsho la gzings phar btang nas 'gro ba'i rnam pa can la khong rang gi mdun nas grub thob a tsin dha pa gcer bu ral pa can gcig gis chos ston pa/ mdun du gzhong pa dang bum pa dngul chu'i bcud len gyis gang ba/ lcags mang po gser du bsgyur ba'i tshul dang / kho rang bram ze'i cha byad can du 'bri/ g.yon gyi phyogs su bud med dang mdun du rta zhig kyang 'bri/ de'i phyogs gang rung zhig tu mtsho yi dkyil na brag ri gru bzhi pa rtse na lha khang gcig dang bcas pa 'bri'o/ chi/de ltar —281—

bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/na ma mṛ ta lo ke shwa rā ya/ gang la rtag tu bsten zhing mi phyed pa'i/ /sdong po'i dpal mnga' 'gyur bral bden chen gyi/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i me tog rnam bral te/ khyod la 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'bras bur shog /gang gi zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /yongs su brnyes pa tsam gyis ni/ /nyi zla'i lam ni lam min dang / dh+wa ti'i 'tsho ba brtas pa las/ /'chi med bcud len dpyid kyi dpal/ /gang gi snying du rnam thos pa/ /'jig rten mkhyen la gus btud de/ /'chi med sgrub thabs 'dir bshad bya/ /de la skal pa dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig rdo rje theg pa'i lam po che las yang dag par gshegs te/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i khang bzang dam par 'chi med kyi seng ge'i khri mchog la dus rtag tu 'khod par 'dod pas nan tan du bya ba'i 'os su nges pa ni 'di yang ste/ de la skal pa dang ldan pa skyabs sems rdo rje slob dpon gyi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro ba can gyi lam 'di ni rnal 'byor bzhis byed pa las/ rnal 'byor dang po ni 'di ltar bskyed rim rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'am g.yin yang rung ste/ hūṃ n+ya ta'i sngags kyis rang gi lus phung ngo lngas mtshon pa'i 'khrul pa'i snang ba kun dbyings su sbyangs/ sems nyid mi shigs pa'i kho bo skad cig gis lo ke shwa ra mor phyag bzhi mda' gzhu lcags kyu zhags pa'am dgra sta 'dzin pa lwa dmar dang lho phyogs kyi lo he'i gos can/ zhi —283

zhing 'dzum la dpa' zhing rjes su chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rdorje'i gdan gyis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ thor tshugs chu shel gyi spras shing nor bu ba‘nes brgyan pa/ chu shel dang lā la'i dang po sa mda' bcas pa phrag par thogs rnga/ lha mo gnyis dang bcas 'od 'phro ba gsal gdab/ oṃ tsi ṭi tsi ni ḍi bi klo li 3/ ma ā yuX' zhi ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa bya/ de'i tshe mda' 'phangs pas/ de'i nam mkha'i mthas gshug pa'i zhing du song ste/ sa'i bcud 'chi med kyi bdung/ rtsi bkug ste lus la shin tu zhugs pas rnam pa thams cad par gyur par bang sdom/de bzhin du chu me rlung nam mkha' dang rig pa'i ye shes rnams kyi lha'i 1spyan ljags rnam pa thams cad dang / sku bde ba mchog dang ldan pa/ lha'i rna ba rna sprus thob thang yid kyi rnam rtog 'gags par bsam pa'i rnam rtog kho nas rtog rnga sprul du byed pa ni ting nge 'a dzin dang po'o/ /de ltar 'gyung ba drug gi bcud bstim 1pa'i rkyen gyis 'byung lus snyigs ma gnas 'gyur/ dngos ma gzhig mi nus pa 9 / ngo bor/ rang lhar gsal pa nam mkhar thim pa snyam byed cing / slar yang ga tha sdol ba snyam byed pa la yid 'jug yul gcig tu bgyid cing / shā n+ya ta'i ga1song sngags bzlas par bya ste ting nge 'dzin gnyis pa'o/ /rlung gtong 'ju ga gnas gsum hūX oṃ āXyig gdangs dang bcas pa lan du mar nan tan du bgyis pa ni rnal 'byor gsum pa ste sbyor ba'i ti pa ri nge 'dzin no/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i rte(da bcud thams cad bdud rtsir gyur pa spyan drangs/ lā ma'i dong la bstim/ de nas 'chi med kyi rgyun byung ba tsan+d+ra ke rgyu'i dong par bstim par bsgom nas/ tsu sngong —284—

dal ba gsum dang drag po gsum dang / hi lta ha sdu ha dā da rnams kyi rlung ro bsam/ de nas rlung nang du drangs pas de dang lhan cig dong pa mda' dang bcas pa las 'chi med kyi rgyun byon pa/ sna nang du gcig tu 'dres pa dpral ba nas brgyud spyi rngeng son/ slar mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang ba gsum nas brgyud de ba sbu'i khung bu kun tu yang khyab cing brtan par gang bas nam du yang gzhig tu med pa'i gzhom med kyi khyab la chen po'i dbyings su sems nyid rtsol med du mnyam par bzhag /nye ba'i gnas su bum pa can brtan par bzung bar bya zhing /dal bus dbyung bar bgyid pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor gyi rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas rang nyid 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug tu sad pa'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i snang ba lus pa med pa'i zhing thams cad gdod ma'i ngo bor mi shigs pa'i bdud rtsir byas/ de las lha mo sgrol ma sngo dmar ram/ rtso ku ḍi dkar dmar gnyis las ci 'dod par bsgyur nas/ a ra ba ḍar byas pa pang du byon/ ko shi kyar gyur pa las/ ku tsa ya na ba ra ti/ kṛ sti stas bde ba chen por rnam par brtas pas/ yab yum gyi rtsa stong phrag bcu bdun rtsa gnyis su byang chub kyi sems rnam par g.yos pas/ ri mo tha dang lhan cig byang chub kyi sems dkar po dang dmar skyas sku lhag par gang / de nas yab kyi phyag g.yas pas 'khyud pa dang lhan cig yum gyi snyan g.yas pa dang lan bu phyogs gcig tu bzung ba/ g.yon yum gyi sta zur g.yon pa bskul bzhin pas brtan par bsam/de nas yum gyi sku'i nang du brtan g.yo kun 'char bzhin pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de sngar bzhin rlung phyir byung / rjes su chags pas bskul te sa ni has —285—

gzugs brnyan rnams las steng 'og tu byang chub kyi sems rgekhyed byer bdud rtsi'i spyi zu babs pas sku gang bar bsgom/ de nas rlung nang du 'jug pa na/ pa ti gi rnga / nga /swe ta kas/ 'chi med bcud kyi rgyun zhal du son te/ dpral ba nas brgyud/ spyi bor gshegs nas nya las byung ba'i thig le'i rgyun dang gcig tu gyur pa/ lce chung nas 'bab par bsam zhing / ba hū sa ma'i phyag rgya bcings te lce'u ‘nung gzhib/ de nas mgrin snying lte gsang nor bur byon pas stong pa nam ma(ba 'a phyogs grol dang / bgrod pa ri'i rtsa zhes pa rnams gang bar gyur pas/ brje / ba rgyas shing myur bar bsgom zhing / steng rlung lder mnan/ de dang lhan cig tu sgyu rog rlung drangs pas/ yum gyi mngal du byon pas rak+ta'i dwangs ma rgya skyegs kyi khu/ ba lta bu rdo rje'i sbu gur son pas ri bong can dang 'dres pas slar gyen du gshetha/sa pas gsang ba lte mgrin pa spyi bo dpral ba rnams su byon/ lus thams cad byab pa'i dbang las/ brjod bral mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rnam pa thams cad pa badz+ra skal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa'i gdod ma'i dpal thob par ba5ma zhing / rtsol med kyi shes pa lhug par ba theg /rlud 'byung ba yang a nu yem ga bzhin te shin tu rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /ma na a/ mahā yo ga ni/gnyis kyi bdag nyid can rnal 'byor ba dngos gzhi'o/ /sbyor ba ni myur 'gro sogs shas che ba ni a ti yo ga bzhin te/ 'on kyang 'dir ni haX las bab pa'i khu ba dang / mkha' las drangs pa'i rdul gnyis/ ka 'byung ba lnga'i myur 'gro srad bu kha dog lnga pa lta bus dkris te gcig tu 'dre rba/ pa na yang ngo / /dbab kyang gshegs pa yang a wa dhū tī sngo skya/ dwangs shing dza/ ba —286—

gtsug tor nas gsang ba'i bar du son par 'khyil pas/ rtsa rnams gang zhing 'byung ba lnga'i rlung rnams kun dar nang gi steng 'og tu shugs dang ldan pas gshegs pa ni/ khu ba rnams spyi bo dang / rdul rnams gsang bar son/ slar yang rlung rnams steng 'og tu tshi shegs shing reg pas/ rdo rje ri bong can dang rdo rje nyin mor byed pa sad pa'i dbang las/ lus sems mtha' dag bde ba chen pos yang dag par khyab cing brtan par bsam/ de nas rlud rnams gcig tu 'dres pa ye shes kyi rlung kha dog sngon pos a wa dh+wa tī gang / des nyi ma gnon zhing zla ba 'degs par bsam pa dang / dmigs ༄med kyi ngang nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa skad cig tsam rnal 'byor du byed pa'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /yog por pad+ma zla ba yis/ /reg bya ma yin reg bya sbyin/ /chags bral dang po chags pa che/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ces dang / mkha' 'gro dpa' bo gnyis med pa/ /pad+ma'i 'od ni dri med pa/ /rnal 'byor nang la mkhas pas mchod/ /ces dang / mdo rgyan las/ dpal ldan rdo rje dbang gi mchog /ga pur sih+la mnyam sbyor ba/ /mgo bor pad+ma zla nyi yis/ /reg bya ma yin reg bya spyin/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sangs rgyas rgyal po sgyu 'phrul che/ /bud med rgya las g.yin du 'gyur/ /rdul bral mi mo dri ma med/ /rnam pa thams cad mtshan nyid bral/ /lha mo'i reg pa rnams bsten na/ /zla ba drug gi tshangs spyod can/ /mgo breg 'chi med brtul zhugs thob/ /ces pa rnams kyi nges pa las brtsams te/ mdor na nyer bsdogs kyi a nu rā ga'i bde ba la dmigs med du —287—

byas nas/ bum chen dang bcas bzhin pa'am/ gzhan du'ang ste/ sems 'o steng ni rtsol bral mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rnam pa thams cad pa/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba ris med pa brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin gdod ma'i ngo bo mi shigs pa/ rta ga brtan g.yu drung gi dpal la g.yo med du mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ sa ra dzaXmu dra la sbyor ba 'di kho na'o/ /dpal ldan 'chi med bdud rtsi rnam par grub pa'i dru/na ngag 'di ni/ slob dpon 'chi ba med pa'i sdes 'phags mchog nā ga dzu smya/ 'i gdams pa'i bdud rtsi legs par myong ba'i bcud len dam pa ste/ o sbyo mo/ na las/ 'byung ba rnams dang dpral ba yi/ /dbyangs dang thig le rnam rnga/ra 'thung / /bha ga drug ni yongs su gang / khres rab bud med dag dang sbyar/ /lce chung bcud kyi len bshad pa/ /'chi med grub pa'i mchog tu gyur/ /zhes rdo rje/ 'i tshig la brten nas so/ /'di'i nges pa las ni/ rjes su rnal 'byor gyi tshe dpral bar gtso che / ra sems 'jog cing / bdag nyid chen po biṣ+ṭha tsan+t+ra'i haX yig dbyangs yig gis bskor ba las bcud babs pa yi dam du bgyis pa 'di yang rigs pa kho na'o/ /de ltar 'dir ni smra ba'i khyu mchog grub pa'i dbang po rnams kyi sku nyams su bskur ba'i lam po che ste/ rje btsun sbas pa'i zhabs kyis brtse ba chen pos nye bar bzung ba'i dbang las/ dran pa'i snyim pa la chags pa gcig kun das/'a snying pos bdag nyid yi dam du byas pa'i slad kho nar brjed byang du 'tshal ba'o/khyab bdag grub pa'i dbang po mda' bsnun dang / /kun mkhyen gnyis pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi/ /rtag brtan g.yung drung dpal gyi longs spyod de/ /mkhar —288—

nyal bu yi dpal la longs spyod bzhin/ /dpal ldan 'chi med sdes kyang de bzhin spyad/ /ye shes rdo rje'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ khyab 'jug zla ba'i gsung gis chu skyes las/ /sbrang rtsi'i bcud mchog blo yis blangs las so /rigs pa'i dbang phyug seng ge 'jigs med dang / /lhan skyes dga' ba'i pha mthar rab gshegs nas/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sa brnyes zhing khams skyongs/ /'gran zla spangs pa'i mkhas mchog nyi ma yi/ /sgrol mas rjes bzung sbi rla ba rma dang / /rigs byed dga' sogs 'chi med brnyes la 'dud/ /mngon par lam bzang che de mkhas pa'i gtso/ /nin byed dga' bas nyin dang nyin bzhin mdzad/ /rigs kyis rdo rje go 'phang mchog brnyes nas/ /bla med mkhyen pa'i mtshon cha rnon po yis/ /rtog ge'i snyim pa ma lus bcil las slad/ /yang dag rigs pa'i lam mchog ston de rgyal/ /gang de'i zhal bum babs stegs las 'ongs pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'thungs pas ye shes lang tsho rnams brten shing / /mthar byed mun pa'i lang tsho ma lus pa/ /rtag tu 'gog mdzad ra smi ha ri zhes/ /rab grags nor 'dzin la 'khod mig stong de'i/ /zhabs sen rnyog bral zla ba'i cod pan gang / /mtha' yarnga— 'gro ba'i gtsug tu nges gyur cig /sangs rgyas ye shes 'gro rnams kyis/ /snying la rab sbas thugs rje yis/ /legs par phyung ste spyin mdzad pa/ /mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /'dir smras pa/ bgegs med dus nas ma lus 'gro 'di g.yung drung gi /dpal sar spyod med mthar byed g.yo can gyis/ /nyi zla'i mig 'phrul bslu brid —289—

ston 'di ga zha'i rgyu/ /e ma bdud rtsi'i 'byor brnyed pas de las so/ /bang shedag sgyu ma'i dmag dang rmi lam gyi/ /dga' ba'i dga' ston na yang 'jigs pa dang / 'dod pas mnar ba'i tshul de 'dir mthong nas/ /bdud rtsi'i dpal de gang gi lag rtse sa /skad cig gis thob 'gro kun dga' ba'i skyes/ /dang/la ldan bde chen 'gyur med ri bong can/ /'dod pa 'jo ba'i thabs bzang rtse dge'i dpal/ /snying po'i don de snying po la dga' ba/ /kun dga' snying po ṭa/na dga'i lam mchog 'dir/ /ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus gdod ma'i gshis/ /bsdo dkyi rtsi mchog de bdud rtsi longs spyod mchog /ma lus 'gro ba'i nye bar spyod wa 3/ du/ /yi ge'i lam du ma gyur pa'i/ /don mchog yi ger mtshon 'di las/ /ma lus 'gro rnams bdag nyid kyi/ /go 'phang 'chi med thob par shog/ //rngo ri nga 'e1 bcu drug pa la li khaX taX/ /zhus so/ / —290—

dpal 'chi med bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por slob ma snod du rung ba gcig gis/ bdag 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag kun zhu zer na/ tsas na dmar po'i lde gu'am/ li khri'i btsag gis chos 'byung gru gsum gcig bya/ de la tshom bu gsum bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis skor/ tshogs kyi yo byad bshams/ spros pa la dga' na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs/ bsdu na/ ra ni mang du bzlas te bgegasabaskrad/ tso( āXhuX kho nas mchod gtor thams cad byin gyis rlabs/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar mngon rtogs bsgoms/ gtong bsngo bya/ slob dpon rang nyid rdzogs rim bsgoms/ bzlas pa yang cung zad bya/ 'grub na skabs 'dir yang tshogs 'khor gcig byed/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/spyi dang mthun par bgegs gtor btang la bgegs phyir bskrad/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags bya/ sa gzhi la rngang gis chos 'byung gru gsum gcig bris/ de'i steng du slob ma langs te sdod du 'jug /slob ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser gri gug thod pa kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa'i skur lam ste bsgoms/ lte 'og tu chos 'byung gru gsum zur gsum pa la oṃ āXhūX/ dbus su sngags tshan gsum yi ge brtsegs ma/ de'i steng nye ba'i thad du hiXdamar ser sgom du bcug la/ chos 'byung de g.yon bskor du sgo re re 'khor/ lus sems bde bas gang ba la sems gtod du gzhug /rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te slob ma la thim par slob dpon gyis bsam —291—

zhing / rol mo'i sgra yun ring la drag po'am/ je drag je zhan bya zhing/ rma gsum ma drag tu ba‘gu thag/gu gul bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu dang / sha chen gyi bdug pa bdug go/des ma phebs na spogs cho ka bya gsungs te 'on kyang deng sang 'di ltar bya/ gzhan khyed rang lus thang sha bcad de nywa bzhi sgrims mig gyen du bzlog /rlung sna nas phyir sang sang 'bud pa yang yang byed cing / dmigs pa 'a:/ la sems gtod cig byas la/ de yang rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bla ma dang / rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor gsum dbyer ma mchis pa sku lus gar sogs log log baju / ra/zhal nas gsungs dbyangs lhang lhang 'byon/ rang gi g.yas nas lha mo dpal gyi blo gros ma dang g.yon na nag po birnya pa/ gzhan dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mang po dang / zhabs bro brdung / phyag gar byed pa/ gsung rdo rje'i gsung dbyangs 'u ming lhang / khyed rang la byin gyis rlobs pa'i tshul du bzhugs snyam gyis la/ phi4 mo 'jam pos brda' dang sbyar te/ e ma hoX kyai/ bu khyod tshur shog tshur la shog /sdos ngag thams cad sems nyid yin/ /e ma hoX sems las gzhan du lus rnga rig med/ /sems la skye dang 'jigs pa bral/ /e ma hoX khyod kyi lus la 'chi ba med/ /bu khyod 'chi med rang grol la/ /e ma hoX sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro da sdo/ra byon/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal da tshur byon/ /rdo rje phag mo da tshur byon/ /rigs kyi bu 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag la nus pa bskyed du gsol/ /ngag 'chi med thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /brjod bral rdo rje'i gsung thob sogs/ /sems la ye shes 'char du gsol/ /sems 'chi med thob sogs/ spros bral rdo rje'i thugs thob sogs gong bzhi sbyar/ de bzhi du/ lha mo dpal gyi blo gros da tshur byon sogs gong bzhi thams cad sbyar/ nag —292—

po bi ru pak+ṣa da ltar byon la'ang gong bzhi sbyar/ nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i lha mo gsum so so rang rang gi lte ba'i chos 'byung gi sdiXl thim/ de'i shugs kyis rang gi lus nam mkha' la yer gyi bteg /lha mo dpal gyis blo gros dang birnya pas kyang g.yas g.yon nas me tog ste mchod pa mang po sprin ltar gtibs/ sna tshogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te khyed rang steng gi nam mkha' mtha' med la ye re re 'gro bar bsam zhing mthar de'i ngang la mi dmigs par zhog cig byas la/ oX āXhriXhūX hūX hā/ zhes brjod pa dang bstun nas rol mo'i sgra/ dang po cung zad dal zhing / mthar je drag je drag btang ste yun ring du 'bud dkrol bya/ rol chen mi 'byor ba'i yul dang gang zag 'dzoms pa mi med lung stong du bya btang dpon slob 'dzoms pa lta bu yin na yang / ḍā dril lam/ ting shag tsam mi dgos kha med yin no/ /'di skabs ye shes phebs na dngos grub myur du thob cing / byin rlabs dpag tu med gsungs/ ba sbu ldang zhing skyi g.ya' ba dang / rnam rtog cung zad log cing / 'phar g.yo cung zad tsam byang na'ang byin rlabs che ba'o/ /yid dga' zhing dmigs pa gsal ba tsam 'ang byin rlabs 'bring ngo / / rnam 'gyur gang yang ma byung na byin rlabs chung ngu'o/ /'di dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i sku'i dpral ba nas lkoX dkar po byung / slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ bum dbang thob par bsam de bzhin du/ mgrin pa'i āX gsang dbang / thugs ka'i huX gis sher dbang / lte ba'i hriXyig gis dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas oX gsum ma'i sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par byin/ su bhā wa nas/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa'i bar dmigs pa rnams mngon rtogs ltar phog /rlung bum can gcig 'dzin du bcug /dzi ta dkar ba'i 'khrul 'khor bsdus pa de bslab bo/ /cis maṇ+ḍal phul ba sogs spyi dang 'dra/ bar 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ rjes chog gzhan —293—

mi dgos te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa byas nas slob dpon rang nyid kyi lus las—bsdu'o/ /smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /snger kun la 'phyan pa'i lus 'chi med kyi dbang bka' yin gsungs pa sems 'chi med kyi dbang bka' dang 'dra se ba de la bka' 'ga' re rgyun du lag len la mdzad mod kyang de zang ma yin/ lus 'chi med grub pa'i dbang bka' dngos smra ma de 'di 'a/gas so/ /༈ da ni 'khrid tshul nyams su len pa la man ngag bshad par sbyo ste/de la sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra ste/ zhug shas sgom 'a/ su gzhug /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyang babs kyi spyi dang 'dra ste/ he ru ka'i lugs su byed/ maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i yu'i/ gyi gtso bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa rje btsun rdo rje phag mo gtso dzin ra gsum gsal btab/ de'i sku'i mdun phyogs su grub thob nag po birlu pa/ dbu la rten 'brel gyi byin rlabs kyi cod paṇa sngon po gsol pa/ phyag g.yas rnga/ ba men gyi rwa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa gsol ba/ g.yon pa pus mo'i ste‘ri du bzhag/ pa/ sku'i mdun du ka pā la mahā ba las gang ba bzhag cing / dbra tso re'i pags pa'i gdan dang 'doms dkris can lhag ma rgyan dang na bza' spa1ngas shing / rnal 'byor ba hur bag chags pa gcig /sku'i g.yon gyi phyogs su ‘reg ma thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas pa bsgoms/ g.yin mtha' skor du bla ma da kon mchog mchod yul thams cad kyis bskor ba/ maṇ+ḍal yang de la 'bul zhing ri bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs kyang / dbang bzhi len pa rnams ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/rnam pa rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor gsum dang nag po birnya pa'i sku las len rnga/ ni —294—

khyad par yin/ g.yin thams cad 'dra pa'i khrid tshul spyi khyab kyi sngon 'gro chos la nges pa rnyed pa zhig gal che'o/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi skabs 'di skad ces bya ste/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rdo rje 'chang song ba'i rjes su/ gnas mchog bde r+ṣa pho brang du/ /bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams su/ /slob dpon nag po birlu la gsol ba 'debs/ /yul phreng ba can gyi nags khrod du/ /bla ma dur khrod nag po la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas o ṭi bi sha'i dur khrod du/ /slob dpon bram ze nag po la gsol ba 'debs/ /yul gang ga'i byang phyogs nges med du/ /grub thob la thod mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas ri gong dpal gyi yang dgon du/ /gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje grub brnyes mchog de'i gdan sa sa /'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /de man chad ni gu chos drug gi brgyud 'debs bzhin byas pas chog /'chi med grub pa 'di la sngon lo ts+tsha ba gzhan dang gzhan gyis bsgyur ba/ 'gyur mi gcig pa 'ga' re snang zhing gdam ngag gi mtshan don rang yang 'chi med grub pa bdud rtsi grub pa/ 'jigs med grub pa sogs 'gyur mi gcig pa mang po byung 'dug cing / phyis paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen dang / shā ri bu ṭa sogs kyis bsgyur bshad lag len mdzad gdab/'on kyang gzhan de dag skabs 'dir mi len gyi/ byin rlabs brgyud pa can gnyan ston chen po'i lugs 'di kho na rtsis su bzung bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po —295—

ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug mdun du bris sku'i/ tsan na dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal 'byor na bshams/ bris sku maṇ+ḍal med kyang nyams rtogs mi skye ba'i lugs ma /‘skun/dngos sam yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bshams/ thod pa la sogs pa'i snod gang yang rung bar/ chang la dam rdzas ril bu sbyar ba'i/ mdor na nang mcho / kyi rnam grangs gcig med du mi rung / de yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed snge'u / du btang / bla ma yi dam mdun du bsgoms te/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyed sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs/ sho ka gnyis dang / 95r+ghaX/nas/ shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs ma:rtse/ /sogs/ rgyun bshags rnams bya rjes tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par ba:skom mo/ /nang mchod su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ snod a las byung ba'i rbod pa'i nang gi dbus su hiXzung gsum la g.yon bskor du oṃ aXhuX/ gzhan oX gsum las dmar ri mo bkang / oṃ āXhuX lan mang du brjod/ sangs rgyas byang sems khams gsum snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud rna mu 5sa tshur bsdus/ bdud rtsi dang 'dres shing yi ge rnams kyang 'od du zhu bar lcu / ra/nga brjod cing nang mchod myang / gdan srung ba yin/ yang za brdzo/ de gnas khang dag gdan dang sa phyogs la gtor/ gnas srung ba yin/ yang rang nyid la nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ āXhuX zhes chos thams cad stong pa nying du bsgom/ lkoX swabha was sbyangs/ rang lus 'od kyi phung por gyur pa'i lte bar pad+ma dkar po dang / nyi ma la khyiXyig dmar ser de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las/ skad cig chos 'byung —296—

gzhal med khang pad ma nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ gtso bo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser g.yas spi gug g.yon thod khrag /mchan khung du kha ṭāX ga /g.yon du rdo rje rab sngags ma ljang khu g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa/zhabs g.yon brkyang / g.yas su rdo rje rnam snang ma ser mo/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang / thams cad kyang gri gug thur du sdigs shing thod khrag steng du 'phyar pa/ spyan gsum/ skra grol gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi bzad cing drag tu bzhad la/ bde ba rgyas shing lhag par khros pa/thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / thod oṃ gyi do shal can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i zhabs 'og tu 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ 'khor gnyis la gdan gsum char gyi lte 'og sor bzhi'i 'og gsang ba'i gnas su/ chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum re re/ gtso mo la dbus su baX dang de'i rgyab tu/ /oṃ sarba brnya ṭa ki ni ye huX phaṭa swā hā yi ge brtsegs ma dang /g.yon gyi la/ oṃ badz+ra waṇ+ḍa ni ye hūṃ phaṭa brtsegs ma'o/ /g.yas la oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa na ye huX phaṭa brtsegs ma'o/ /de ltar gsal ba nan du lan gnyis bsgom/ de nas gtso mo'i dbu sgra phyed phyag g.yon pas bzung / g.yas kyi gri gug gis mgul gyi rtsa ba nas bcad de/ dbu ni phyag g.yon par thod pa dang lhan cig bzung bar gyur/ des rtsa gsum chad pa na/ rtsa dbu ma nas byang chub kyi sems dang rang byung 'dren pa'i rgyun byung ste/ rang nyid kyi zhal du thim bzhin pa dang /rkyang ma nas dkar po'i rgyun dang / bzhi mnyam gyi dwangs ma byung ste/ rdo rje rab sngags ma'i zhal du 'jug bzhin pa dang / ro ma nas rak+ta dang gla rtsi'i rgyun —297—

'dren pa ste/ rdo rje rnam snang ma'i zhal du 'bab bzhin par gyur/ bsnyed dge shes phyir yang yang bzung zhing yid tsam bsgom/ lhe ba'i baX las 'od 'phros/ ro rkyang gi lam rgyud bcad mtshams nas g.yas g.yon du 'phros te mkha' 'gro ma gnyis rdo rkye sku la phog /de gnyis tshur spyan drangs te lha dang lha mo/ chos dang chos 'byung dbyer med du 'dres/ yig 'bru brtsegs pa'i sngags gnyis dbus kyi yig 'bru'i g.yas g.yon du zhugs slar de rang nyid dbu rang gnas su bzhag pas 'byar par 'gyur/ 'og rlud bskum zhing lte ba'i yig ge la sems gtad de/ oṃ sarba brnya ṭu ki ni ye oṃ badz+ra brnya nī ye/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nā ye hūX hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes zla ba nyid gtso bor mdzad la/ sngags bsdus pa la mos na/ ga/ smus g.yon gyi sngags thog brtsegs gnyis dbus ma la thim par bsam ste/ oṃ sarba bzhi ḍā ki nī ye hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nyid bzla'o/ /yang sa bon gyi yi ge huX nyed yid bzlas su byed pa'ang lugs gcig go /yang 'jam rlung bzung ste lte ba'i hiXlas me 'bar dbu ma'i lam nas song / spyi bo'i haX la reg /de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te hiḥl thim par bsgom zhing / hiXhaX zhes bzlas pa yang lurnga kas gcig go /spyir gnas skabs 'dir lha sku bsgom pa dang / yid bzlas gces che zhing / ngag bzlas gtso chung ngo / /lha sku 'od gsal du bsdu ba sogs mi dbo khro/ /nam phyed na sa gzhi dur khro chen por bsam ste/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni ni nyen rlabs spyi dang 'dra/ 'bru gsum kho nas kyang tshig rgyas bsdus khyad par skye bed gsungs te/ bde mchog yab yum gang yang rung ba'i lugs gcig dang ba / sgrun na legs/ phe zhes rje btsun ma gtso 'khor gsum spyan drangs/ spros pa la dab/'a —298—

na/ sngags gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas 'bul te/ chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sprul pa bde ba chen po'i sku/ sogs/ zhes bstod cing /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs/ spyi dang mthun par 'dod don gsol ba btab yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ oṃ yo ga shu zhi: zhes rang la thim/ gal te gtor ma mi lcogs na/ kha zas bza' ba'i tshe phud cung zad bcad nas/ cho ga 'di bzhin byas pas chog /༈ gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ thog mar 'khrul 'khor mi bya ste/skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du btang / rang rje btsun ma'i skur skad cig gis gsal 'debs pa yud tsam yang yang dran par bya/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas/ mig dang yid sna'i rtsa bar gtad/ rlung dal bus phyir 'bud pa la lag len bzhin du bslab/ zhag bdun sogs sbyangs/ de nas yang de bzhag ste rlung dal bus nang du 'then pa lag len bzhin du bslab/ de nas yang zhag bdun la sogs pa bya'o / /de 'og rlung rang gnas su bcings/ yar mi 'then/ steng rlud ran par drangs te lte 'og tu mnan/ gzhil ba sogs mi byed/mi bde ba byung na sang gis btang / mig sna rtser blta ba'i/ smin mtshams su blta ba gang bde zhig bya/ zla ba phyed tsam bsgom/ de nas gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mi bde ba skyes kyang cung zad bzung ba sogs nyin re bzhin cung zad re yun srings te bsgom pa zla ba phyed tsam bya/ de mtshams nas rang re bod yul lta bur nyi 'od la brten zhing / snga dro sug chus lus bkru/ phyi phred til dmar ram/rab tu zhun gyis dbang byugs zhes bshad kyang mi rnyed pas/ 'bru mar gyi byug pa —299—

'thems par bya/ yang re go bzlog kyang rung gsungs te zhug bdun sogs zhag shes bya/ yang dri chus lus bkrus pa dang / bku mnyes spel ba theg shang/ bya/yang thang phra mo dkar nag gang rigs kyi rtsa rtse tshang ma brdungs pa'i khu ba bcing ba la shing thal lam lci thal 'jam po btang pa de lus la byug cing mnyes nas slar chu gtsang gis bkru ba dang / bku mnyes spel ba yang zhag shas bya/ de dag gi skabs su rlung sbyor sngar gyi de kha ci rigs par 'bad/ rtsol ba ha cang drag pas bcur bcur mi bya'o/ /de nas dzi ta karma'i 'khrul 'khor byang bar bslab ste/ rlung sbyor snga ma'i steng nas nyi ma dang po la thun re bzhin tshar lnga lnga tsa zu4 bya ste/ thun gsum gyis chog /de nas nyin re bzhin thun re la tshar re bsna zu/ te/zla ba phyed tsam na nyin theg gcig la dzi ta karma tshar drug cur 'gyur/ de na tha/ zla phyed tsam slar lhag por mi spor bar/ de kha'i rgyun bskyangs/ de dag gi 'grul 'khor mi byed pa skabs thams cad du/ lus gnad khrong nge pa'i ngang nas/ mi rtog pa gtso bor skyong pas/ zla ba gcig po de la ting 'dzin gyi shugs kyis/ mi skye mi srid/ sngar rlud gi sbyangs pa gsum la zla ba phyed dang gnyis/ rdzas kyi sbyangs pa la zla ba phyed/ dzi ta karma zla ba gcig la byas pas/ lus shi zu / du sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyi nang gsang gsum rang gang 'os pa gcig/ gi phyag chen gyi lus gnad bcas rlung bum pa can spyor ba bzhi ldan spyi dang ri dra bar bsgom/ sems rang babs su lhod de ba'i ngang nas rang babs su che za ri re blta/ thun mtshams su dzi ta karma yang ji ltar 'os par rdeg go /de ltar zla gcig tsam song ba na/ thun gyi mgor dzi ta karma lan gsum tsam re song rngo spu'i —300—
